title: Transformer Accelerator (TFA): A Macro-Op INT8 Hardware Chip for Transformer Inference and Machine Translation
summary:
We present the Transformer Accelerator (TFA), a synthesizable, parameterizable INT8 memory-to-memory engine for transformer inference. One time-multiplexed datapath handles prompt processing and autoregressive generation. TFA implements matrix multiplication, softmax, RMSNorm, elementwise, and copy/gather operations through eight 512-bit macro-op descriptors. Offline-compiled programs are fetched, validated, and dispatched through AXI interfaces, supporting encoder, decoder, and encoder-decoder models.
  The RTL combines an output-stationary multiply-accumulate array with ping-pong buffers that overlap DMA and compute, bit-exact reciprocal-square-root and divide units, key-value-cache and embedding addressing, and an abort-safe zero-padding write engine. A UVM environment byte-compares outputs against a bit-exact golden model. Across 25 tests and 34 constrained-random runs, TFA achieved zero mismatches, 100% functional coverage, and 94.96% code coverage.
  We compiled the t5-small encoder-decoder pipeline for English-to-French, German, and Romanian translation. On ten multilingual proverbs, TFA executed 70,320 descriptors and matched 37.9 MB of golden-model output with zero mismatches. INT8 output matched the floating-point reference token-for-token on five sentences; the rest produced valid alternative translations. Randomized-Hadamard reparameterization recovered about 11 dB of per-tensor INT8 signal-to-noise ratio across layers. The verification configuration achieved about 20x end-to-end speedup over a 22-thread CPU, while larger designs are projected to reduce energy per token by about 1000x. After RAM inference recoding, logic area fell to 2.73 mm2, and the design completed design-rule-clean synthesis and place-and-route on SkyWater sky130. TFA demonstrates end-to-end, bit-exact execution of pretrained transformers using compact hardware and compiler-managed quantization.

AI.title_translation: Transformer加速器（TFA）：用于Transformer推理和机器Translation的宏操作INT8硬件芯片
AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Transformer加速器（TFA），一种高效的INT8硬件芯片，通过宏操作描述符和编译器管理量化，实现了Transformer推理的高效、比特精确执行，相比CPU获得了约20倍的加速。
AI.motivation: 为了解决Transformer推理在计算和内存方面的巨大开销，开发一种紧凑、高效且支持端到端比特精确执行的专用硬件加速芯片。
AI.method: 提出了一种可综合、参数化的INT8内存到内存引擎（TFA），采用时间复用数据路径、八个512位宏操作描述符、输出平稳的乘累加阵列、乒乓缓冲区以及离线编译程序和随机哈达马重参数化。
AI.result: 在25个测试和34个约束随机运行中实现零不匹配、100%功能覆盖率和94.96%代码覆盖率；t5-small模型的多语言翻译测试中实现零不匹配；相比22线程CPU实现约20倍端到端加速，预计可将每个token的能耗降低约1000倍，逻辑面积为2.73 mm2。
AI.conclusion: TFA通过宏操作INT8硬件加速器、离线编译程序和量化技术，成功实现了预训练Transformer的端到端、比特精确执行，具有极高的能效比和显著的速度提升。
AI.translation:
我们提出了Transformer加速器（TFA），这是一种用于Transformer推理的可综合、参数化的INT8内存到内存引擎。一个时间复用数据路径处理提示词处理和自回归生成。TFA通过八个512位宏操作描述符实现了矩阵乘法、softmax、RMSNorm、逐元素操作以及复制/收集操作。离线编译的程序通过AXI接口获取、验证和调度，支持编码器、解码器和编码器-解码器模型。
RTL将输出平稳的乘累加阵列与重叠DMA和计算的乒乓缓冲区、比特精确的倒数平方根和除法单元、键值缓存和嵌入寻址以及抗中断的零填充写入引擎相结合。UVM环境将输出与比特精确的黄金模型进行字节比较。在25个测试和34个约束随机运行中，TFA实现了零不匹配、100%功能覆盖率和94.96%代码覆盖率。
我们为英法、英德和英罗翻译编译了t5-small编码器-解码器管道。在十个多语言谚语上，TFA执行了70,320个描述符，并匹配了37.9 MB的黄金模型输出，且零不匹配。在五个句子上，INT8输出与浮点参考token对token匹配；其余句子产生了有效的替代翻译。随机哈达马重参数化跨层恢复了约11 dB的每张量INT8信噪比。验证配置相比22线程CPU实现了约20倍的端到端加速，而更大的设计预计将每个token的能量减少约1000x。在RAM推理重新编码后，逻辑面积降至2.73 mm2，该设计在SkyWater sky130上完成了设计规则清洁的综合和布局布线。TFA展示了使用紧凑硬件和编译器管理量化的预训练Transformer的端到端、比特精确执行。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Transformer加速器（TFA），这是一个用于Transformer推理的可综合、参数化的INT8硬件芯片。通过8个宏操作描述符、离线编译的程序以及优化的RTL架构，TFA在机器翻译任务中实现了与黄金模型比特精确的输出，并获得了显著的速度提升和极高的能效。
AI.keywords: Transformer Accelerator, INT8, Machine Translation, Hardware Chip, Quantization
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种面向Transformer推理的宏操作INT8硬件加速器（TFA），通过创新的宏操作描述符、内存到内存引擎以及编译器管理的量化，在SkyWater sky130工艺上实现了高效、比特精确且面积紧凑的硬件加速，展现出巨大的能效和速度优势。

title: Fidelity Preference, Not Demographic Preference: A Pixel-Level Attribute-Sensitivity Audit of Image Aesthetic/Preference Scorers
summary: Text-to-image systems use learned aesthetic scorers to filter training data and guide generation, but whether these scores encode demographic attributes as objective quality is unclear. We audit four scorers (LAION-Aesthetics, PickScore, ImageReward, HPSv2) using pixel-level interventions on skin tone and body type in synthetic and real images. Our key finding is that along skin-lightness, the dominant effect is fidelity preference: unaltered images score highest, and perturbations in either direction are penalized (inverted-U). Placebo arms show this penalty is not an artifact of the skin operator, as applying the same CIELAB L* shift to non-skin regions yields similar penalty magnitudes. However, the penalty is operator-dependent and holds for all operators only for LAION-Aes. Critically, audits on synthetic images alone are misleading: LAION-Aes shows strong preference for darker skin on synthetic faces, but on 1470 real faces the preference reverses and becomes much smaller, and amplification becomes non-significant. Across scorers, synthetic results do not transfer -- reversing for LAION-Aes and HPSv2, attenuating for PickScore. We contribute a reproducible benchmark with artifact control and synthetic/real cross-validation, and an auditability criterion for pixel-level causal isolation (valid for skin tone, not for body type due to deformation). Population-stratified analysis shows fidelity-penalty asymmetry is not robust across groups after FDR correction except for HPSv2. Our findings show naive synthetic audits misjudge bias direction and magnitude, and only within-image causal isolation on real data can distinguish true demographic bias from fidelity preference.

AI.title_translation: 保真度偏好而非人口统计学偏好：图像美学/偏好评分器的像素级属性敏感度审计
AI.tldr: 图像美学评分器优先考虑的是图像保真度而非人口统计学属性，且基于合成图像的偏差审计结果往往具有误导性。
AI.motivation: 文本文生图系统常利用学习到的美学评分器过滤训练数据和引导生成，但目前尚不清楚这些评分是否将人口统计学属性编码为客观质量，且以往基于合成图像的审计可能存在误导。
AI.method: 通过对合成图像和真实图像中的肤色和体型进行像素级干预（如CIELAB L*偏移），审计了四个主流美学评分器（LAION-Aesthetics, PickScore, ImageReward, HPSv2），并引入安慰剂对照臂和跨域交叉验证。
AI.result: 研究发现评分器的核心驱动是保真度偏好（表现为倒U型惩罚，即未修改的图像得分最高），合成图像的审计结果无法很好地泛化到真实图像中，多数情况下并不存在系统性的人口统计学偏好。
AI.conclusion: 当前的美学评分器表现出对图像保真度的偏好而非人口属性偏好，且仅基于合成图像的审计结果无法准确迁移到真实世界，必须通过真实数据上的像素级因果隔离来进行准确审计。
AI.translation: 文本到图像系统使用学习到的美学评分器来过滤训练数据和指导生成，但这些分数是否将人口统计学属性编码为客观质量尚不清楚。我们使用对合成图像和真实图像中肤色和体型的像素级干预，审计了四个评分器（LAION-Aesthetics、PickScore、ImageReward、HPSv2）。我们的核心发现是，沿着皮肤亮度方向，主导效应是保真度偏好：未修改的图像得分最高，任何方向的扰动都会受到惩罚（呈倒U型）。安慰剂对照臂显示，这种惩罚并非皮肤操作算子的产物，因为将相同的CIELAB L*偏移应用于非皮肤区域会产生相似的惩罚幅度。然而，这种惩罚与操作算子相关，且仅对LAION-Aes而言所有算子均成立。至关重要的是，仅对合成图像进行的审计具有误导性：LAION-Aes在合成人脸显现出对较深肤色的强烈偏好，但在1470张真实人脸中，这种偏好发生反转且变得小得多，放大效应也变得不再显著。在各个评分器中，合成结果无法迁移——LAION-Aes和HPSv2的结果发生反转，PickScore的结果减弱。我们贡献了一个具有伪影控制和合成/真实交叉验证的可复现基准，以及一个用于像素级因果隔离的可审计性标准（对肤色有效，由于变形对体型无效）。经FDR校正后，人口分层分析表明，保真度惩罚的不对称性在各个群体中并不稳健（HPSv2除外）。我们的研究结果表明，朴素的合成审计会误判偏差的方向和幅度，只有真实数据上的图像内因果隔离才能区分真正的地形偏好与保真度偏好。
AI.summary: 本文通过对四种主流图像美学评分器进行像素级属性敏感度审计，发现这些评分器编码的主要是“保真度偏好”而非人口统计学偏好，并证明了仅使用合成图像进行偏差审计具有误导性，强调了在真实数据上进行因果隔离审计的必要性。
AI.keywords: 美学评分器, 保真度偏好, 人口统计学偏差, 像素级干预, 合成与真实数据对比
AI.comments: 该论文通过像素级的因果隔离审计，揭示了当前图像美学评分器中存在的“保真度偏好”（fidelity preference）而非直接的人口统计学偏好，并指出仅使用合成图像进行审计具有误导性，为未来构建无偏、鲁棒的美学评分系统提供了重要的基准和方法论。

title: Tensor-Train Methods for 3D Linear Elasticity: Block and Global Operator Representations with Solver Performance Analysis
summary: This work develops tensor-train (TT) formulations for solving large-scale three-dimensional linear elasticity problems discretized by isogeometric analysis. By exploiting the tensor-product structure of the basis functions and the low-rank structure of geometry-dependent coefficient fields, the stiffness operator, mass operator, force vector, and displacement solution are represented in TT format. Two solution strategies are investigated: a block-operator formulation, in which the coupled elasticity operator is stored as separated TT blocks, and a single-operator formulation, in which the full coupled system is stored as one monolithic TT operator. A matrix-free three-field TT conjugate-gradient solver is introduced for the block formulation, while AMEn is used for the single-operator formulation. Numerical examples demonstrate substantial compression of both operators and solutions compared with conventional sparse full-grid representations, showing that TT-based formulations provide an efficient and scalable approach for large-scale three-dimensional elasticity simulations.

AI.title_translation: 三维线性弹性力学的张量列车方法：块算子与全局算子表示及求解器性能分析
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于张量列车（TT）格式的方法，用于高效求解三维线性弹性力学问题，实现了显著的存储压缩和大规模模拟的可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 解决大规模三维线性弹性力学问题中由于常规稀疏全网格表示带来的巨大计算和存储开销问题。
AI.method: 利用基函数的张量积结构和几何依赖系数场的低秩结构，将刚度算子、质量算子、力向量和位移解表示为TT格式。研究了两种策略：存储为分离TT块的块算子公式（使用矩阵无关的三域TT共轭梯度求解器），以及存储为单一单块TT算子的单算子公式（使用AMEn求解器）。
AI.result: 数值算例表明，与传统的稀疏全网格表示相比，算子和解都实现了实质性的压缩，证明了基于TT的方法对于大规模三维弹性模拟的高效性和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 基于张量列车（TT）格式的方法能够显著压缩三维线性弹性力学问题的算子和解的存储空间，为大规模弹性模拟提供了一种高效、可扩展的解决方案。
AI.translation: 本研究开发了用于求解等几何分析离散化的大规模三维线性弹性问题的张量列车（TT）公式。通过利用基函数的张量积结构和几何依赖系数场的低秩结构，将刚度算子、质量算子、力向量和位移解表示为TT格式。研究了两种求解策略：一种是将耦合弹性算子存储为分离的TT块的块算子公式，另一种是将完整的耦合系统存储为一个整体TT算子的单算子公式。为块公式引入了一种矩阵无关的三域TT共轭梯度求解器，而单算子公式则使用了AMEn。数值算例表明，与传统的稀疏全网格表示相比，算子和解都实现了实质性的压缩，表明基于TT的公式为大规模三维弹性模拟提供了一种高效且可扩展的方法。
AI.summary: 该论文开发了用于求解等几何分析离散化的大规模三维线性弹性问题的张量列车（TT）公式。通过利用基函数的张量积结构和低秩几何系数，将算子和解表示为TT格式，并探讨了块算子和单算子两种求解策略。数值结果显示，该方法在实现显著存储压缩的同时，保持了高效性和可扩展性。
AI.keywords: Tensor-Train (TT), 3D Linear Elasticity, Isogeometric Analysis, Low-Rank Structure, Solver Performance
AI.comments: 该论文将张量列车（TT）格式成功应用到三维线性弹性力学问题中，结合等几何分析，有效克服了传统稀疏网格在高维或大规模问题中的维度灾难。创新点在于提出了块算子和单算子两种策略，并结合了矩阵无关的共轭梯度求解器和AMEn算法，具有很高的计算效率和存储压缩比。

title: Squeezing the Cache, Preserving the Truth: Monotonic Equipotential Allocation with Geodesia-KV
comments: 11 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Code and vLLM integration available at https://github.com/geodesia-ai/geodesia-kv
summary: Current assessment of KV-cache compression performance confuses resident bits with read bandwidth and is affected by the artifacts of chunked teacher-forcing. We present Geodesia-KV, a family of training-free KV cache policies based on monotonic block-wise precision allocation, exact rate-distortion residuals, and query-sparse reading, enabling proper hardware-ready compression. With proper separation of resident and read bits and causal evaluation, we show that Geodesia-KV significantly outperforms other approaches. Specifically, on WikiText-2 with 16k context, the 5-bit operating point of Geodesia-KV results in lower perplexity at lower bitrate than KIVI-4 on Qwen. In addition, our compressed-Quest version delivers improved perplexity and reduces resident (9.83 vs 16.25 bits/value) and read rates (1.95 vs 2.32 bits/value) over baseline sparse methods on PG-19. As Geodesia-KV is implemented as native GeodesiaKVCacheManager plug-in of vLLM, Geodesia-KV fully removes the need for dense cache residency via monotonic bit demotion. With the full consumer hardware evaluation, Geodesia-KV leads to 1M-token context generation on a single 16 GiB GPU with up to 71.7% peak VRAM savings on all leading architectures (Qwen, Llama, DeepSeek).
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Code and vLLM integration available at https://github.com/geodesia-ai/geodesia-kv

AI.title_translation: 榨干缓存，保留真相：基于Geodesia-KV的单调等势分配
AI.tldr: Geodesia-KV是一种创新的无需训练的KV缓存压缩策略，通过单调精度分配与查询稀疏读取，在消费级GPU上实现了百万Token上下文生成和高达71.7%的显存节省。
AI.motivation: 现有的KV-cache压缩性能评估方法混淆了常驻位与读带宽，且受分块教师强制（chunked teacher-forcing）人工痕迹的影响，无法实现真正的硬件就绪压缩。
AI.method: 基于单调块级精度分配、精确率失真残差和查询稀疏读取的无需训练的KV缓存策略，并作为vLLM的插件实现。
AI.result: 在WikiText-2（16k上下文）上，Geodesia-KV的5位操作点在较低比特率下取得了比Qwen上的KIVI-4更低的困惑度；在PG-19上降低了常驻位和读取率；在单张16 GiB GPU上实现了高达1M-token的上下文生成，显存峰值节省高达71.7%。
AI.conclusion: Geodesia-KV提供了一种无需训练的KV缓存压缩方案，通过精确的率失真残差和单调位降级策略，在保持模型真实性能的同时大幅降低了VRAM占用，实现了消费级GPU上的百万Token上下文生成。
AI.translation: 当前KV缓存压缩性能的评估混淆了常驻位与读取带宽，并且受到分块教师强制伪影的影响。我们提出了Geodesia-KV，这是一系列基于单调块级精度分配、精确率失真残差和查询稀疏读取的无需训练的KV缓存策略，从而实现了适当的硬件就绪压缩。通过正确分离常驻位与读取位以及因果评估，我们证明了Geodesia-KV显著优于其他方法。具体而言，在带有16k上下文的WikiText-2上，Geodesia-KV的5位操作点在比Qwen上的KIVI-4更低的比特率下实现了更低的困惑度。此外，我们的压缩Quest版本在PG-19上比基线稀疏方法提供了改进的困惑度，并减少了常驻率（9.83对16.25 bits/value）和读取率（1.95对2.32 bits/value）。由于Geodesia-KV作为vLLM的原生GeodesiaKVCacheManager插件实现，它通过单调位降级完全消除了对稠密缓存常驻的需求。通过全面的消费级硬件评估，Geodesia-KV在单个16 GiB GPU上实现了1M-token上下文生成，并在所有主流架构（Qwen、Llama、DeepSeek）上实现了高达71.7%的峰值VRAM节省。
AI.summary: 论文提出了Geodesia-KV，这是一种无需训练的KV缓存压缩方法，通过单调等势分配和查询稀疏读取，解决了现有评估中的混淆问题，实现了硬件就绪的压缩，并在消费级硬件上大幅减少了VRAM占用并支持超长上下文。
AI.keywords: KV缓存压缩, 单调精度分配, 率失真残差, 硬件就绪, 内存优化
AI.comments: 该论文针对当前KV缓存压缩评估中的混淆问题，提出了Geodesia-KV方法，通过单调块级精度分配和查询稀疏读取实现了高效的硬件就绪压缩，显著降低了VRAM使用并支持超长上下文。

title: StateTune: Transforming LLM-Assisted EDA Flow Tuning into a Stateful, Closed-Loop Process
comments: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/ACM International Conference on Computer-Aided Design (ICCAD 2026)
summary: EDA flow parameter tuning is critical for quality-of-results~(QoR), yet the parameter space is large, tightly coupled, and full evaluations are prohibitively expensive. Prior LLM-assisted tuners mainly use the LLM as an external proposer with transient working context; we instead present \textbf{StateTune}, which reformulates LLM-assisted EDA tuning as a closed-loop, state-carrying process. Its optimizer state is a typed, evidence-gated \emph{persistent optimization memory} that is updated by every evaluation and shared between candidate generation and budget allocation. On top of this optimizer state, an expected hypervolume improvement (EHVI)-guided, runtime-aware promotion policy ranks quick-stage candidates by expected Pareto frontier gain per unit of runtime cost. Evaluated on a Cadence industrial flow across six benchmark blocks (two technology nodes \(\times\) three designs), against five baselines including LLM+retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and preference-based Bayesian optimization (BO) tuners, StateTune achieves the strongest final hypervolume on all six benchmark blocks, showing a stable improvement in frontier quality across the full matrix; it also matches or surpasses the strongest baselines on worst negative slack (WNS), area, and power across the same set. Ablation shows persistent memory is the largest contributor: removing it costs 58.5\% of the hypervolume. Dedicated analyses of evidence-gating sensitivity, memory poisoning, cross-design transfer, and three-seed reproducibility (CV\,\(<\)\,7\% on five of six blocks) further validate the memory design.
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/ACM International Conference on Computer-Aided Design (ICCAD 2026)

AI.title_translation: StateTune：将大模型辅助的EDA流调优转化为有状态的闭环过程
AI.tldr: StateTune通过引入持久化优化记忆和闭环控制，显著提升了大模型辅助的EDA参数调优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于大模型的EDA调优器主要将大模型用作具有短暂工作上下文的外部提议者，而EDA流参数调优空间大、耦合紧密且全评估成本高昂，亟需一种更高效、更具状态感知的优化方法。
AI.method: 提出StateTune，将EDA调优重构为具有状态的闭环过程，包含一个类型化、证据门控的持久化优化内存，以及基于期望超体积改进（EHVI）且感知运行时间的候选晋升策略。
AI.result: 在Cadence工业流的六个基准块上评估，StateTune在所有块上均实现了最强的最终超体积，并在WNS、面积和功耗方面匹配或超越了最强基线，消融实验表明移除持久化内存会导致58.5%的超体积损失。
AI.conclusion: StateTune通过引入有状态的闭环优化流程和持久化优化记忆，有效解决了传统大模型辅助EDA调优中上下文短暂和评估成本高的问题，在多个基准测试中展现出卓越的性能和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: EDA流参数改进对于结果质量（QoR）至关重要，然而参数空间庞大、耦合紧密且完整评估的代价极为高昂。先前的大模型辅助调优器主要将大模型用作具有短暂工作上下文的外部提议者；为此，我们提出了StateTune，它将大模型辅助的EDA调优重新构建为一个闭环的、携带状态的过程。其优化器状态是一个带类型的、证据门控的“持久化优化记忆”，该记忆由每次评估进行更新，并在候选生成与预算分配之间共享。在此优化器状态之上，一个由期望超体积改进（EHVI）引导的、感知运行时间的晋升策略根据单位运行时间成本的期望帕累托前沿增益对快速阶段候选进行排序。在跨越六个基准块（两种技术节点×三种设计）的Cadence工业流上进行评估，与包括LLM+检索增强生成（RAG）和基于偏好的贝叶斯优化（BO）调优器在内的五个基线相比，StateTune在所有六个基准块上都取得了最强的最终超体积，展示了全矩阵中前沿质量的稳定提升；它还在相同的基准集上匹配或超越了最强基线的最差负松弛（WNS）、面积和功耗。消融实验显示，持久化记忆是最大的贡献者：移除它会损失58.5%的超体积。对证据门控敏感性、内存污染、跨设计迁移以及三随机种子重现性（六个区块中有五个的CV<7%）的专门分析进一步验证了该内存设计。
AI.summary: StateTune是一种将大模型辅助的EDA流参数调优转化为状态化、闭环过程的方法。它利用持久化优化内存和EHVI引导的晋升策略，在各项基准测试中显著提升了帕累托前沿质量和多项关键指标。
AI.keywords: LLM-Assisted EDA Flow, Parameter Tuning, Persistent Optimization Memory, Closed-Loop Process, Hypervolume Improvement
AI.comments: StateTune将大模型辅助的EDA调优转化为一个有状态的闭环过程，通过持久化优化记忆和基于期望超体积改进的策略，显著提升了EDA流参数调优的性能和稳定性，消融实验证明持久化记忆是其核心贡献。

title: PACT: Post-route Agentic Checkpoint Tuning for FPGA Timing Closure
comments: Accepted to the 2026 International Conference on Field-Programmable Technology (FPT 2026)
summary: Late-stage FPGA timing closure often starts from an implemented design whose remaining violations are visible in timing reports. Engineering change order (ECO) optimization is a standard mechanism for applying localized changes to such designs without restarting the full implementation flow. Automating post-route ECO optimization remains challenging. A post-route change must improve timing without violating routing legality, hold or pulse-width timing constraints, checkpoint replayability or functional equivalence. This paper presents PACT, a Post-route Agentic Checkpoint Tuning framework for Vivado design checkpoints (DCP). PACT represents post-route tuning as validation-gated transitions between accepted and candidate checkpoints. From checkpoint-derived evidence, an agent selects localized backend actions through a profile-driven recipe planner over typed Vivado and RapidWright skills, and probes tool behavior in isolated workspaces. PACT records each trial as an evidence-gated case to guide candidate generation and suppress unsafe, unsupported or ineffective actions. Across 35 UltraScale+ post-route checkpoints, PACT improves validation-clean $F_{\max}$ (maximum operating frequency) by a geometric mean of $+22.30\%$ over the original implementations, compared with $+15.14\%$ for DATuner and $+9.78\%$ for the Codex Agent. On shared designs, PACT achieves these gains $6.4\times$ faster than the uncapped DATuner and at an average token cost of only \$0.16 per DCP ($24.5\times$ lower than the free-form Codex Agent). The source code is available in an anonymous repository
comment: Accepted to the 2026 International Conference on Field-Programmable Technology (FPT 2026)

AI.title_translation: PACT：用于 FPGA 时序收敛的后布线代理检查点调优
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为 PACT 的后布线代理检查点调优框架，通过智能代理与严格验证相结合，在保证设计合法性的同时显著提升了 FPGA 时序性能并降低了优化成本。
AI.motivation: FPGA 后期时序收敛和工程更改单（ECO）优化自动化具有巨大挑战，现有方法在提升时序的同时往往难以保证布线合法性、功能等价性以及效率。
AI.method: PACT 将后布线调优表示为接受的检查点与候选检查点之间通过验证门控的转换；利用代理基于检查点衍生的证据，通过配置文件驱动的配方规划器，在类型化的 Vivado 和 RapidWright 技能上选择局部的后端动作，并在隔离的工作空间中探查工具行为。
AI.result: 在 35 个 UltraScale+ 后布线检查点上，PACT 将验证清洁的 Fmax 了几何平均提升了 +22.30%，优于 DATuner（+15.14%）和 Codex Agent（+9.78%）；同时速度比无上限的 DATuner 快 6.4 倍，平均每个检查点的 Token 成本仅为 0.16 美元。
AI.conclusion: PACT 是一种高效、经济且具有极高实用价值的 FPGA 后布线时序优化框架，通过代理智能与严格的工具验证相结合，实现了显著的时序改善。
AI.translation: FPGA 后期时序收敛通常从一个已实现的设开始，其剩余的时序违例在时序报告中清晰可见。工程更改单（ECO）优化是对这类设计应用局部更改而不必重启完整实现流程的标准机制。然而，自动化后布线 ECO 优化依然充满挑战，因为后布线更改必须在不违反布线合法性、保持或脉宽时序约束、检查点可重放性或功能等价性的前提下改善时序。本文提出了 PACT，一个针对 Vivado 设计检查点（DCP）的后布线代理检查点调优框架。PACT 将后布线调优表示为接受的检查点与候选检查点之间由验证门控的转换。基于检查点导出的证据，代理通过配置文件驱动的配方规划器在类型化的 Vivado 和 RapidWright 技能上选择局部的后端动作，并在隔离的工作空间中探测工具行为。PACT 将每次试验记录为证据门控的案例，以指导候选生成并抑制不安全、不支持或无效的动作。在 35 个 UltraScale+ 后布线检查点上，与原始实现相比，PACT 将验证清洁的 $F_{\max}$（最大工作频率）几何平均提升了 $+22.30\%$，而 DATuner 为 $+15.14\%$，Codex Agent 为 $+9.78\%$。在共享设计上，PACT 实现这些增益的速度比无上限的 DATuner 快 $6.4$ 倍，且每个 DCP 的平均 Token 成本仅为 \$0.16（比自由形式的 Codex Agent 低 $24.5$ 倍）。源代码可在匿名仓库中获取。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了 PACT（后布线代理检查点调优）框架，用于解决 FPGA 后布线时序收敛问题。通过将调优建模为验证门控的检查点转换，并结合基于证据的代理选择局部后端动作，PACT 在确保设计约束和合法性的同时，大幅提升了最大工作频率（Fmax），并显著降低了时间和经济成本。
AI.keywords: FPGA timing closure, post-route ECO, agentic checkpoint tuning, Vivado, RapidWright
AI.comments: PACT 框架创新性地结合了大语言模型代理（Agent）与传统的 FPGA 后布线后端工具（Vivado/RapidWright），通过基于验证门控的检查点调整策略，在保证功能和布线合法性的前提下显著提升了 FPGA 的时序收敛性能，且兼具高效性与低成本。

title: Algorithmic Cost in "Exact Real Computation"
summary:
Turing completeness of a programming language or system characterizes its expressive power; and the strong Church-Turing hypo-/thesis refines such from qualitative to polynomial-time equivalence. Exact Real Computation (ERC) is a novel numerical programming language paradigm: for the imperative processing of continuous data as entities appearing as exact, i.e. devoid of rounding errors [doi:10.1007/978-3-662-44199-2_107]. ERC has been designed [doi:10.46298/lmcs-20(2:17)2024] as convenient and practical alternative, namely proven qualitatively equivalent, to the Turing machines originally underlying Computable Analysis [doi:10.1007/978-3-642-56999-9,doi:10.1007/978-1-4684-6802-1].
  The present work quantitatively strengthens this qualitative Turing-completeness: We assign bit-costs to ERC's operational primitives (including partial/multivalued tests) in such a way that any real function incurring polynomial cost becomes Turing-computable in polynomial time, and vice versa. Runtime measurements on implementations in the iRRAM C++ library confirm our theoretical performance predictions.

AI.title_translation: “精确实数计算”中的算法代价
AI.tldr: 本文为精确实数计算（ERC）建立了位代价模型，首次证明了ERC与图灵机在多项式时间上的等价性，并通过实验验证了理论性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的精确实数计算（ERC）虽然在定性上与图灵机等价，但在定量计算成本（即多项式时间等价性）方面的研究仍属空白，因此需要建立ERC的定量复杂度理论。
AI.method: 通过为精确实数计算（ERC）的操作原语（包括部分/多值测试）分配位代价（bit-costs），证明了任何产生多项式代价的实函数在图灵机上也能在多项式时间内可计算，反之亦然，并使用iRRAM C++库进行了运行时间测量。
AI.result: 研究成功建立了ERC原语的位代价模型，证明了ERC与图灵机在多项式时间上的双向等价性，并通过iRRAM C++库的实现验证了理论性能预测。
AI.conclusion: 该研究弥补了精确实数计算在定量计算复杂度方面的空白，证明了ERC在多项式时间上与传统可计算分析学的图灵机完全等价。
AI.translation:
编程语言或系统的图灵完全性表征了其表达能力；强丘奇-图灵假说将其从定性等价精细化为多项式时间等价。精确实数计算（ERC）是一种新颖的数值编程语言范式：用于对连续数据进行命令式处理，这些数据表现为精确实体，即没有舍入误差。ERC已被设计为可计算分析学最初底层图灵机的便捷且实用的替代方案，并在定性上被证明是等价的。
本研究在定量上强化了这种定性图灵完全性：我们为ERC的操作原语（包括部分/多值测试）分配了位代价（bit-costs），使得任何产生多项式代价的实函数在图灵机上也能在多项式时间内可计算，反之亦然。在iRRAM C++库实现上的运行时间测量证实了我们的理论性能预测。
AI.summary: 本文针对精确实数计算（ERC）这一新型数值编程语言范式，首次引入了操作原语的位代价（bit-costs）分配方法，从定量角度证明了ERC与传统可计算分析学中图灵机在多项式时间上的等价性，并通过iRRAM C++库的实验测量验证了理论预测。
AI.keywords: 精确实数计算, 图灵完全性, 计算复杂度, 多项式时间等价性, iRRAM库
AI.comments: 该论文首次在精确实数计算（ERC）中建立了定量复杂度理论，通过将操作原语与位代价（bit-costs）关联，成功证明了ERC与图灵机在多项式时间上的等价性，并通过实际测量验证了理论的正确性。

title: Orientation in Extended Position-Based Dynamics: Application to Rigid Bodies and Cosserat Rods
summary: Rotational degrees of freedom in Extended Position-Based Dynamics (XPBD) require computations on the nonlinear manifold of 3D rotations. We show that Lie theory provides a clean, unified framework for expressing rotations, constraints, interpolation, and differentiation in XPBD, enabling both improved rigid-body constraints and higher-order finite-element Cosserat rods. We derive explicit Lie-theoretic constraint formulations and their gradients for rigid-body simulation, improving the dynamic consistency of constrained rigid-body simulations in XPBD by a factor of over $10^4$ compared to the state-of-the-art. Our framework naturally extends to finite-element Cosserat rods by enabling on-manifold interpolation of nodal rotations. Linear finite elements outperform the conventional chain-of-rigid-bodies discretization, while higher-order basis functions provide even smoother solutions and faster convergence. Utility is demonstrated in a variety of examples with large deformations and contact.

title: Decomposing Browser Pipeline Architectures for DOM-Sourced Particle Effects: Worker Offload, WebGL, and WebAssembly
comments: 31 pages, 11 figures. Data and code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21626647
summary: Local optimization does not necessarily yield end-to-end optimization in layered browser architectures. Teams often treat Web Workers, WebGL, and WebAssembly as interchangeable ways to "make it faster," yet each lever targets a different layer. We present a controlled architectural decomposition--using DOM-sourced particle pipelines as a concrete workload--of five particle pipelines (P1-P5), with an additional non-particle CSS-layer baseline (P0), that isolates thread placement, renderer choice, and simulation backend. Using a reproducible harness we measure interactive pacing, high-load end-to-end stress, and a simulation-only microbenchmark, plus same-host cross-browser / dual-GPU-class replication (Firefox 153+Intel UHD; Chrome 138+NVIDIA NVK) and an independent second-host slice on Google Colab (Chrome 150, Tesla T4, n=5). Four results stand out. (1) Worker offload improves interactive pacing on paper-primary Chrome (approx. 144 vs approx. 52 FPS; Cliff's delta=1, n=10). (2) AssemblyScript speeds the Chrome update kernel by about 1.5-1.6x on the primary host and approx. 1.85x on Colab T4 (sim-only). (3) Under approx. 250k WebGL particles the Chrome sim-only WASM win need not raise product FPS (P5<=P4 on primary/Firefox; P5 approx. P4 on Colab T4); in-worker CPU phase timers show simulate still dominates the accounted budget, so the non-translation is not a simple "draw dominates CPU" story. (4) Renderer ranking and absolute margins vary across browser/GPU/host configurations. The contribution is bottleneck-aware architectural measurement: identify the dominant layer and test whether a layer win propagates to user-visible FPS.
comment: 31 pages, 11 figures. Data and code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21626647

title: From Traceability to Justifiability: Accountability Structures in Agentic Software Engineering
comments: 18 pages, 2 figures. Primary-data measurement study: a 47-platform two-pass graded documentation survey and a 30-repository depth measurement; not a literature survey. Replication package: https://github.com/mentu-ai/from-traceability-to-justifiability
summary: A pipeline promoting an AI system publishes records claiming the thing evaluated is the thing deployed and that the evidence licensed the transition. We measure, from public material only, whether those records can express that claim and whether it holds where declared. First, a two-class documentation survey of 47 delivery platforms (20 CI/CD, 27 model-serving/agent) under one fixed three-label protocol, graded twice (second pass blind), every consulted page pinned by content hash and date. Across 188 double-graded cells we found no platform whose default record emits a content-addressed identity of the behavioral tuple (model version, instructions, tool definitions, retrieval and runtime configuration); the blind pass grades that column default on zero of 47. Immutable nominal versioning is meanwhile arriving as the agent platforms' default answer (16 of 27): version integers behind mutable pointers, a layer the artifact supply chain already found insufficient. Second, an instrument computes realized assurance depth from a pipeline's published exhaust alone and compares it with the declared depth. Applied to a frozen two-stratum frame of 30 public repositories graded twice from a hashed archive (second pass blind; cell-level agreement 23 and 19 of 30, both passes independently finding the same five full realizations), the sharpest result is a verifiability hole: seven of the 15 repositories chosen for adopting attestation tooling publish source-only releases, so the binding their workflows declare cannot be checked where declared. Where checkable it mostly checks out: five of seven measurable adopters realize the binding end to end; both shortfalls fall at identity binding. Together the results locate the field's records structurally short of justifiability, the one rung that can refuse a transition. The survey carries an expiry clock; we state what would falsify each finding.
comment: 18 pages, 2 figures. Primary-data measurement study: a 47-platform two-pass graded documentation survey and a 30-repository depth measurement; not a literature survey. Replication package: https://github.com/mentu-ai/from-traceability-to-justifiability

title: REFINE: A Multi-Agent LLM Approach for Evidence-Guided Code Refactoring
comments: Preprint. 450 Java files from 15 open-source systems; 1,350 model-pass outputs across three LLM configurations. The accompanying replication package will be made publicly available
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) offer new opportunities for automated code refactoring. However, generated changes must reduce targeted quality problems without introducing new issues or altering behaviour-relevant code structures. We introduce REFINE (Refactoring with Evidence-aware Flow for Integrated ageNtic Execution), a tool-agnostic, evidence-aware multi-agent approach for generating Java file-level refactoring candidates. REFINE combines static-analysis-guided smell identification, smell-informed planning, LLM-based transformation, automated re-analysis, preservation checks, and structured reporting.
  We evaluate REFINE on 450 Java files from 15 open-source systems, producing 1,350 model-pass outputs using OpenAI GPT-5.5, Google Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, and Anthropic Claude Opus 4.8. REFINE reduces detected code smells by 68.26%, 72.79%, and 68.49% across the three configurations, respectively, with the strongest reductions observed for major smells. A matched 150-file direct-prompt baseline shows that REFINE achieves a higher median code-smell reduction with smaller edits and fewer public-method removals. However, broader quality improvements are inconsistent, and preservation checks reveal residual risks, including assert/fail-call changes and public-method removal. Therefore, REFINE outputs should be treated as refactoring candidates requiring compilation, testing, dependency analysis, and human review before adoption in repository- or system-level settings.
comment: Preprint. 450 Java files from 15 open-source systems; 1,350 model-pass outputs across three LLM configurations. The accompanying replication package will be made publicly available

title: SDR Driver for Precise Timing Applications
comments: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables, submitted to GRCon26 conference
summary: This paper describes the development of software drivers that enable precise timing applications with the low-cost HackRF One software-defined radio (SDR). The original firmware was extended with timing functions for synchronized sampling, time-scale control, and clock-frequency adjustment. An initial implementation based on a Python wrapper was later redesigned as a SoapySDR-compatible driver. Using an AI-assisted development workflow, the new driver was generated from the existing HackRF One and SoapySDR codebases and became operational after only limited debugging. The approach reduced development effort by more than an order of magnitude while improving software maintainability.
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables, submitted to GRCon26 conference

title: Rebuild Dossier: Mechanically-Enforced Specs for Agentic App Rebuilds, and What Model-Tier Failures Reveal
comments: 48 pages, 1 figure. Code and evaluation artifacts: https://github.com/Parker-Fawcett/rebuild-dossier (archived at DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22036801)
summary:
An AI agent's rebuild is only as good as the process that produced it. Prior work found that once a model is strong enough, a multi-agent rebuild pipeline loses to the simplest approach: giving the model the original code and one instruction (AgentModernize). We present rebuild-dossier, an open-source tool that locks an application's real interface - its exact inputs and outputs - before any code is written, then enforces one-test-at-a-time building through automated checks, not written instructions alone.
  Three results shape this evaluation, with differing amounts of evidence. First, in a small comparison, the compliant agent failed a held-back test while the rule-breaking agent passed everything - proof that a passing suite doesn't certify correctness when tests can be gamed. Second, we tested whether this beats simply giving the weaker model the source and one instruction: tied on a small app, but lost outright on a larger one where the automated check wasn't even running - pointing to the check mechanism, not interface-locking, which held up separately. Third, every claim here is checked at three levels - the agent's own report, an automated log, and the actual files produced - catching real errors, including a bug in our own logging code, that a single level would have missed.
  These risks reproduce on a different model and toolchain: a stronger model followed our process three times running, something the weaker model never managed. The tool is public, MIT licensed, and reproduces end to end against our own applications.
comment: 48 pages, 1 figure. Code and evaluation artifacts: https://github.com/Parker-Fawcett/rebuild-dossier (archived at DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22036801)

title: Adoption Telemetry: Measuring Enterprise AI Adoption from Production Signals
comments: 23 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Open-source reference implementation and Zenodo record (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21943955) available
summary: We introduce adoption telemetry: a method for measuring enterprise AI adoption by computing change-management stage-progression directly from production usage signals. We contribute (1) a framework unifying pre-deployment evaluation gates, production telemetry, and change-management staging into one instrumented system; (2) NANTE, a concrete five-stage operationalization with defined telemetry thresholds, published openly so they can be tested and disproven; and (3) an open-source reference implementation that distinguishes a healthy cohort from five characteristic adoption-failure modes on synthetic populations with known ground truth. We are explicit that the thresholds are proposed constructs requiring empirical validation against real outcomes -- a research agenda we outline -- not a calibrated model.
comment: 23 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Open-source reference implementation and Zenodo record (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21943955) available

title: Identifying Latent Declarative Representations of Code for Assisting Repository Migration
summary: Legacy software repositories embed decades of domain knowledge in undocumented code, making understanding and modernization difficult. We treat a program as the implementation of an unobserved, declarative description of its computation and investigate whether making this latent declarative representation explicit improves repository-scale porting. ADFD-Migrate approximates the latent representation with an annotated data-flow diagram (ADFD) of processes, data stores, external entities, flows, and behavioral contracts. An LLM infers the source ADFD from bounded repository context, guided by static-analysis coverage checks. Dependency-aware chunking orders bounded process groups for target-language generation. Differences between the source ADFD and a statically recovered target ADFD then guide regeneration. We evaluate ADFD-Migrate on f2x50, a new benchmark of 50~Fortran repositories spanning 1.5k--1.6M lines of code and three complexity tiers, and assess the resulting ports along two dimensions: porting soundness, measured by source-oracle behavioral agreement, and porting completeness, measured by a composite migration outcome index. Against 382 curated Fortran-oracle probes, the generated Python passes 327 (85.6\%), with 40 repositories passing every attempted probe. ADFD-Migrate exposes all 382 planned behaviors as runnable targets, compared with 99 and 98 for direct and repository-context translation and 69 and 30 for the static-profile and dependency-chunking ablations. It also achieves a 93.1\% mean migration outcome index and a 17--59 percentage-point outcome-index advantage over direct translation on 47 repositories. These results suggest that an inspectable semantic bottleneck can improve the coverage and integration of repository-scale migration while enabling lower-cost generation for many repositories.

title: LLM Agents Perform Controlled Experiments Using Simulation Models
comments: Accepted at the 31st IEEE International Conference on Emerging Technologies and Factory Automation ETFA 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities in reasoning, planning, and tool use, but many scientific and engineering tasks require more than plausible text and code generation. They require understanding how a system responds to intervention, which in practice depends on controlled experimentation. In this work, we propose a multi-agent framework that enables LLM agents to conduct controlled experiments with scientific simulation models for pharmaceutical process design. Given a user query and a baseline configuration, the system constructs a structured task representation, designs experiments, executes comparative simulation, interprets the resulting outcomes, and synthesizes evidence-based recommendations for process parameter optimization. By coupling language models with high-fidelity simulation models in an interactive agent framework, the proposed system supports reasoning through intervention, comparison, and observation. As a result, it produces more specific and actionable outputs than language-only reasoning. In an industrial application setting, this advantage is reflected in higher output specificity as well as improved user-rated correctness and helpfulness. Ablation studies and visualized case analyses further demonstrate the effectiveness and practical utility of simulation-integrated experimental reasoning.
comment: Accepted at the 31st IEEE International Conference on Emerging Technologies and Factory Automation ETFA 2026

title: When May an Agent Stop? Evidence-Carrying Termination for Tool-Using LLMs
summary: Tool-using agents must decide when to stop. Existing systems already gate terminal success, certify execution traces, or enforce runtime polici es, but do not test this particular receipt-, scope-, and closed-replay design at the COMPLETE boundary across controlled termination faults. W e instantiate and evaluate Evidence-Carrying Termination (ECT): an agent may return COMPLETE only when a typed certificate binds every required answer claim to valid, in-scope trace evidence and a deterministic replay reconstructs the claimed value. A locked static study crosses 48 ful ly synthetic tasks in six tool-use families with clean execution and eight faults. ECT produced 0/288 unsafe completions versus 252/288 for the inspected termination-critic core (difference -87.50 pp, 95% task-cluster interval [-87.50, -87.50] pp). A fresh, prespecified and frozen 576- trajectory study then compares ECT with the critic core, its faithful controller, and a full-trace LLM critic. On 22 primary held-out task clus ters, ECT produced 0/66 premature unsupported terminations versus 40/66 for the controller (difference -60.61 pp, 95% interval [-78.79, -40.91] pp), while supported completion was 97/132 versus 92/132 (difference 3.79 pp, interval [0.00, 9.09] pp), satisfying a -10-point noninferiority margin. ECT executed successful recovery in 18/66 trajectories, of which 17 subsequently completed with support; all three closed-loop gates p assed. ECT certifies support in a recorded trace under declared assumptions, not external truth, safety, or alignment.

title: A survey detection channel overrides the pixels in an astronomical foundation model, and biases tomographic mean redshifts
summary:
Foundation models for astronomy are trained on survey pixels together with the catalogue products derived from those pixels. Those catalogues are incomplete at a measurable rate, and a model trained on both inherits that incompleteness as a systematic. We audit AION-1, a 39-modality transformer trained on more than 200 million objects, using causal interventions on its inputs.
  Holding the image tokens byte-identical and editing only the survey segmentation map changes every quantity the model reports -- flux, size, ellipticity, redshift -- by 110-4400 times a matched placebo. The mechanism is detection gating, presence at the field centre (r = 0.47), not the light the mask encloses (r = 0.30); across 322 real blends the model ignores how the pipeline partitioned the light (R = -0.006). Nor is the preference specific to that channel: contradicted catalogue photometry leaves the model nine times worse than supplying no metadata at all.
  The Legacy Survey pipeline leaves 3.68% of targets with no segment covering their position. Propagating that rate, with a miss represented by the fields the pipeline actually returns, shifts tomographic mean redshifts by a median 0.71 times the LSST DESC requirement over 40 assignments and exceeds it in 12; observed positional errors take the worst bin to 8.3 times. Drawing the misses by their measured magnitude dependence rather than uniformly does not change it. Spectroscopy removes the effect, withholding the detection channel removes it at no measurable cost, and the effect grows with model scale.
  Two further limits lie in the tokeniser: its image codec resolves 28 effective states on source patches against 934 for the spectrum codec, and the redshift readout is quantisation-limited. Sparse dictionaries are unreliable causal handles: across 15, recovery spans 26-75% and moves up to 18 points on the seed alone.

title: From Triage to Discharge: A Survey of NLP Tasks, Methods, and Open Challenges in the Emergency Department
comments: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference; camera-ready version
summary: Emergency departments (EDs) operate under time pressure, generating multimodal data such as clinical conversations, triage notes, and discharge documents. Recent advances in natural language processing (NLP), particularly pretrained transformers and large language models, have created new opportunities to support language and time-intensive stages of emergency care. Yet existing surveys map clinical NLP across the broader hospital workflow or focus on specific tasks. This survey analyses 46 papers spanning the three phases of ED: triage, diagnosis, and disposition, covering tasks such as triage classification, clinical summarisation, automatic diagnosis, report generation, and discharge documentation. We examine modelling paradigms, evaluation practices, and emerging benchmarks and shared tasks. Across tasks, we identify common trends, including a shift from task-specific neural architectures to pretrained language models, growing interest in interactive clinical systems, and increasing attention to clinically grounded evaluation. Finally, we detail open challenges such as limited generalisability, noisy clinical inputs, and workflow constraints that inform future ED-NLP research.
comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference; camera-ready version

title: Callability Is Not Operability: Controlled Interface Interventions for LLM Agents
summary: A tool call can be perfectly valid yet still leave an autonomous agent unable to determine what to do next. For example, if an external effect commits but its response is lost, committed and uncommitted states may become indistinguishable to the agent even though they require different continuation actions. We study this gap between callability and operability: whether a tool interface exposes the action-relevant state and semantics needed for an agent to continue safely under operational uncertainty. We operationalize tool operability through Agent-First Tooling (AFT), a set of interface mechanisms spanning selective capability discovery, execution lifecycle and recovery, explicit external-effect semantics, machine-readable results, and postcondition verification. We introduce AFT-Bench, a controlled interface-intervention framework that holds the task, backend, initial state, injected failure, agent, and language model fixed while varying the interface exposed to the agent.

title: Macro-Operator Generation and Predicate Selection for TAMP Operator Learning
summary: Creating symbolic operators by hand is one of the main bottlenecks in deploying Task and Motion Planning systems (TAMP). Recent works show that these operators can instead be learned directly from demonstration data. Existing methods, however, typically learn each action in isolation and cannot capture the recurring multi-step structure of manipulation tasks, so the search becomes intractable on long sequential tasks. A further inefficiency arises in the symbolic state: every provided predicate is evaluated at every search node, even when it never appears in any learned operator. We present a system that addresses both problems together. Its central component is the automatic generation of macro-operators, composite actions that compress a recurring sequence of individual actions into a single planning step. Our system discovers causally linked action pairs directly from the training data, where one action produces exactly the condition that the next one requires, and turns each pair into a new operator. Alongside this, our system prunes every predicate that no learned operator references, which shrinks the symbolic state evaluated at each search node. Together, these changes shorten the effective planning horizon, and the benefit they bring grows with the length of the task. Across four TAMP domains, our method reaches up to a 4.6x planning speedup compared to the baseline method, namely Learning Operators for TAMP. More importantly, it solves a long sequential task that the baseline cannot solve. Macro-operator discovery thus not only accelerates planning but, in certain domains, determines solvability in practice.

title: FPGAgent: An LLM-Assisted Framework for Autonomous HLS Code Generation and Verification in FPGA Environments
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown substantial promise for high-level synthesis (HLS) code generation, but most existing approaches validate only simulation or synthesis results. Because of timing and place-and-route constraints, \emph{HLS code that passes simulation and synthesis may still fail to produce deployable, runnable designs on real FPGA platforms}. Moreover, the lack of public benchmarks has limited many evaluations to small, self-curated test suites. We propose FPGAgent, a multi-agent framework tailored to real FPGA environments for autonomous HLS coding with end-to-end executability validation. To the best of our knowledge, FPGAgent is \emph{the first task-specification-to-executable HLS generation framework experimentally validated on a well-established benchmark}. Given a natural-language task specification, FPGAgent injects HLS-specific knowledge and employs evolutionary search to iteratively derive reliable HLS kernel implementations. It then generates a C++ validation program to verify functional correctness, diagnoses potential defects, and guides targeted repairs. Finally, it synthesizes host code for compilation and board-level execution on FPGA hardware. We comprehensively evaluate FPGAgent with five established LLMs on HLS-Eval, a benchmark containing 78 tasks across multiple domains, and verify board-level executability on a real FPGA platform. Compared with existing baselines, FPGAgent improves the synthesizable rate by 16.9% on average, executability by 26.7%, and functional correctness by 30.6%. These results show that FPGAgent substantially improves the practical usability of LLM-based HLS generation and demonstrates the value of end-to-end validation.

title: TRACE: Transition-Aware Residual Control for Multi-Objective Materials Discovery
summary: Multi-objective materials discovery with LLM agents is often limited not only by how many candidates can be proposed, but by how effectively each costly property evaluation informs the next search step. Existing agents mainly store evaluated candidates and their scores, so they know which materials succeeded but not which executable edits caused useful property changes. This makes local refinement difficult when objectives compete and an edit that improves one property may damage another. We propose TRACE, a transition-aware residual control framework that treats evaluated edits as the basic unit of feedback. TRACE records each local refinement as a parent-edit-child transition with observed property deltas, aggregates transition evidence to estimate reusable edit effects, and ranks future edits by their predicted ability to reduce the current candidate's remaining constraint violations while avoiding damage to already satisfied objectives. In a controlled same-backbone comparison, TRACE improves over LLEMA, the state-of-the-art LLM-agent baseline, raising macro-average hit rate from 18.13\% to 25.96\%.

AI.title_translation: TRACE：面向多目标材料发现的过渡感知残差控制
AI.tldr: LLM代理在多目标材料发现中效率有限。TRACE通过将评估的编辑视为反馈基本单元，记录过渡并估计编辑效果，从而改进了局部精修。它将宏观平均命中率从18.13%提高到25.96%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理在多目标材料发现中，评估的候选材料及其分数不能有效指导下一步搜索，尤其是当目标冲突时，因为它们不知道是哪些可执行的编辑导致了有用的属性变化。
AI.method: TRACE（过渡感知残差控制框架）将评估的编辑作为反馈的基本单元。它记录每次局部精修作为“父-编辑-子”过渡，并观察属性变化。TRACE聚合过渡证据来估计可重用的编辑效果，并根据预测的减少当前候选材料剩余约束违反的能力来对未来的编辑进行排名，同时避免损害已满足的目标。
AI.result: 在受控的同骨干比较中，TRACE相对于最先进的LLM代理基线LLEMA有所改进，将宏观平均命中率从18.13%提高到25.96%。
AI.conclusion: TRACE通过关注编辑反馈和过渡感知控制，显著改进了LLM代理在多目标材料发现中的局部精修效率和性能。
AI.translation: 多目标材料发现中的LLM代理不仅受限于可以提出的候选数量，还受限于每次昂贵的属性评估如何有效地指导下一步搜索。现有代理主要存储评估过的候选及其分数，因此它们知道哪些材料成功了，但不知道哪些可执行的编辑导致了有用的属性变化。这使得当目标相互竞争时，局部精修变得困难，因为改进一个属性的编辑可能会损害另一个属性。我们提出了TRACE，一个过渡感知残差控制框架，它将评估过的编辑视为反馈的基本单元。TRACE将每次局部精修记录为具有观察到的属性增量的“父-编辑-子”过渡，聚合过渡证据以估计可重用的编辑效果，并根据其预测的减少当前候选材料剩余约束违反的能力来对未来的编辑进行排名，同时避免损害已满足的目标。在受控的同骨干比较中，TRACE相对于最先进的LLM代理基线LLEMA有所改进，将宏观平均命中率从18.13%提高到25.96%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了TRACE，一个用于多目标材料发现的过渡感知残差控制框架。针对现有LLM代理在多目标精修中无法有效利用编辑反馈的问题，TRACE将评估的编辑作为反馈单元，记录“父-编辑-子”过渡及其属性变化，并聚合这些信息来预测编辑效果。该方法旨在优化局部精修，减少约束违反并保护已满足目标。实验表明，TRACE显著提升了LLM代理的宏观平均命中率，超越了现有SOTA基线。
AI.keywords: 多目标材料发现, LLM代理, 过渡感知控制, 残差控制, 材料设计
AI.comments: TRACE的创新点在于将“编辑”而非“材料”作为反馈的基本单位，并引入了“过渡感知残差控制”的概念，这使得LLM代理能够更精细地理解和利用局部精修过程中的因果关系，尤其是在多目标冲突场景下，能更有效地指导搜索方向。这种方法对于提高材料发现的效率和准确性具有重要意义。

title: Function-Level Execution Feedback for Code Preference Optimization
comments: 20 pages, 8 figures, 14 tables. Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Process supervision has improved mathematical reasoning, where intermediate steps are naturally expressed as chains of thought. In code generation, however, process supervision remains underexplored because there is no standard notion of a step. Supervision can target lines, reasoning traces, or program states, making it unclear what to label and optimize. We propose STEP-KTODER, a framework for code preference optimization that defines steps as module-level functions in decomposed multi-function programs and assigns binary correctness labels via automatically generated unit tests. Our method provides a code-specific instantiation of stepwise KTO, combining function-level process supervision with outcome-level feedback on the full program. We evaluate on HumanEval(+), MBPP(+), BigCodeBench, and LiveCodeBench, showing that STEP-KTODER improves over outcome-only KTO and DPO. Further analysis shows that execution-based labels are essential: LLM-as-a-judge annotations systematically over-predict function failures, corrupt positive step labels, and degrade downstream preference optimization. Code is available at: https://github.com/inechnech/STEP-KTODER.
comment: 20 pages, 8 figures, 14 tables. Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026

AI.title_translation: 代码偏好优化中的函数级执行反馈
AI.tldr: 提出STEP-KTODER框架，通过将代码生成中的步骤定义为函数，并使用自动单元测试进行监督，结合函数级和结果级反馈，显著改进了代码偏好优化，并强调了执行反馈的重要性。
AI.motivation: 在代码生成中，过程监督尚未得到充分探索，因为缺乏对“步骤”的标准定义，导致不清楚如何进行标注和优化。
AI.method: 提出STEP-KTODER框架，将多函数程序中的模块级函数定义为步骤，并通过自动生成的单元测试分配二元正确性标签。该方法是逐步KTO在代码领域的具体实现，结合了函数级过程监督和整个程序的输出级反馈。
AI.result: 在HumanEval(+)、MBPP(+)、BigCodeBench和LiveCodeBench等基准测试中，STEP-KTODER优于仅基于结果的KTO和DPO。进一步分析表明，基于执行的标签至关重要，因为“LLM作为评判者”的标注会系统性地过度预测函数失败，破坏正向步骤标签，并降低后续偏好优化的效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过定义函数级步骤并结合自动单元测试的执行反馈，可以有效改进代码生成中的偏好优化。基于执行的标签对于避免LLM评判的偏差至关重要。
AI.translation: 过程监督改善了数学推理，其中中间步骤自然地表达为思维链。然而，在代码生成中，过程监督仍未得到充分探索，因为没有标准的“步骤”概念。监督可以针对代码行、推理轨迹或程序状态，这使得不清楚要标注和优化什么。我们提出了STEP-KTODER，一个用于代码偏好优化的框架，它将分解的多函数程序中的模块级函数定义为步骤，并通过自动生成的单元测试分配二元正确性标签。我们的方法提供了逐步KTO在代码领域的具体实例化，将函数级过程监督与整个程序的输出级反馈相结合。我们在HumanEval(+)、MBPP(+)、BigCodeBench和LiveCodeBench上进行了评估，结果表明STEP-KTODER优于仅基于输出的KTO和DPO。进一步分析表明，基于执行的标签至关重要：作为评判者的LLM标注系统性地过度预测函数失败，破坏了正向步骤标签，并降低了下游偏好优化的效果。代码可在：https://github.com/inechnech/STEP-KTODER 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了STEP-KTODER框架，旨在解决代码生成中过程监督缺乏标准“步骤”定义的问题。该框架将多函数程序中的模块级函数定义为步骤，并利用自动单元测试提供二元正确性标签，从而实现函数级过程监督。结合了函数级监督和全局结果反馈，STEP-KTODER在多个代码生成基准测试中表现优于传统的KTO和DPO方法。研究强调了基于执行的标签的重要性，并指出LLM作为评判者的标注在代码生成中存在缺陷。
AI.keywords: 代码生成, 偏好优化, 过程监督, 函数级反馈, KTO
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过将过程监督的粒度细化到函数级别，并通过自动单元测试提供可靠的执行反馈，为代码生成领域的偏好优化提供了一个创新的解决方案。其创新点在于明确定义了代码生成中的“步骤”概念，并结合了逐步KTO，有效解决了LLM作为评判者在代码评估中的局限性。这对于提高代码生成模型的性能和可靠性具有重要意义。

title: The Blending Ratio Is Not Where the Performance Is: Diagnosing Prototype Blending for Few-Shot Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
summary: Many few-shot adaptation methods for vision-language models classify with a convex combination of the zero-shot text prototype and the mean of the K labelled image features, with a single blending ratio routinely tuned on held-out labels, often on the test set itself. We ask what the family's own bias-variance justification invites: what is the right ratio, can it be estimated without validation data, and is finding it where the performance is? First, the ratio minimising prototype mean-squared error has a closed form whose support-set plug-in is exactly a positive-part James-Stein coefficient shrinking towards the text prototype. Across 4,800 cells (ten datasets, five backbones including SigLIP, five shot counts, five seeds, four prompt tiers) this theoretically optimal ratio is a reliable estimate of the wrong quantity: on the 950 primary-tier cells where it is defined it trails a test-set-oracle ratio by 8.5 points. It saturates near 1, discarding the text prior for a nearest-class-mean classifier, because 78% of the text-image prototype distance it treats as bias is a class-independent offset that the arg max largely cancels. We prove the mechanism and bound its share of the damage at 26% by a counterfactual. Second, leave-one-out on the support set alone sets a ratio landing within 0.9 points of the oracle blend, so it is estimable without validation data. Third, validation-free linear probes beat even the oracle-tuned blend: CLAP by +1.9 points and LP++ by +1.5 on average, and at K >= 4 all four validation-free baselines sit above the oracle, the linear probes by margins excluding zero. These results locate the ceiling in the model class, not the hyperparameter: the ratio can be set near-optimally for free, and it is still not where the performance is. Code, cached features, per-cell records: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Liangzhi-Li/clipbench-blending

AI.title_translation: 混合比例并非性能关键：诊断视觉语言模型少样本适应中的原型混合
AI.tldr: 混合比例并非决定视觉语言模型少样本适应性能的关键；可以免费近似最优比例，但性能提升的上限在于模型类别而非超参数。
AI.motivation: 许多视觉语言模型的少样本适应方法通过零样本文本原型和K个标记图像特征的均值进行凸组合分类，其中混合比例通常在保留标签上（甚至测试集本身）进行调优。本文质疑这种方法的偏差-方差理论基础，并提出三个问题：什么是正确的比例？能否在没有验证数据的情况下估计它？找到这个比例是否是性能的关键？
AI.method: 1. 理论推导了最小化原型均方误差的混合比例的闭合形式，并指出其支持集插件是一个正部James-Stein系数。2. 在4800个单元格上进行了广泛实验以评估理论最优比例的性能。3. 通过留一法（leave-one-out）评估了在没有验证数据的情况下估计混合比例的能力。4. 将验证无关的线性探针（如CLAP和LP++）与通过“神谕”（oracle）调优的混合方法进行比较。5. 通过反事实分析，证明并量化了文本-图像原型距离中与类别无关的偏移对性能的影响。
AI.result: 1. 理论上最优的混合比例在950个主要层级单元上比测试集神谕比例落后8.5个点，且倾向于放弃文本先验。2. 文本-图像原型距离的78%是类别无关的偏移，导致26%的性能损失。3. 仅在支持集上使用留一法估计的比例与神谕混合比例相差0.9点以内，表明无需验证数据即可有效估计。4. 验证无关的线性探针（CLAP和LP++）平均分别比神谕调优的混合方法高出1.9和1.5个点。5. 当K≥4时，所有四个验证无关基线都优于神谕混合方法，线性探针的优势显著。
AI.conclusion: 混合比例可以近乎最优地免费设置，但它并非性能提升的关键。性能的上限在于模型类别本身，而非混合比例这一超参数。
AI.translation: 许多视觉-语言模型的少样本适应方法通过零样本文本原型和K个标记图像特征的均值的凸组合进行分类，其中单个混合比例通常在保留标签上进行例行调优，通常在测试集本身上。我们询问该方法家族的偏差-方差理论基础所提示的问题：什么是正确的比例，能否在没有验证数据的情况下估计它，以及找到它是否是性能的关键？首先，最小化原型均方误差的比例有一个闭合形式，其支持集插件恰好是一个向文本原型收缩的正部James-Stein系数。在4,800个单元格（十个数据集、五个骨干网络包括SigLIP、五个样本数、五个随机种子、四个提示层级）中，这个理论上最优的比例是对错误量的一个可靠估计：在950个定义它的主要层级单元格中，它比测试集神谕比例落后8.5个点。它饱和在接近1的位置，放弃了文本先验，转变为最近类均值分类器，因为其处理的78%的文本-图像原型距离作为偏差是一个与类别无关的偏移，而argmax在很大程度上抵消了这一点。我们证明了这一机制，并通过反事实分析将其损害份额限制在26%。其次，仅在支持集上进行留一法可以设置一个与神谕混合比例相差0.9点以内的比例，因此可以在没有验证数据的情况下进行估计。第三，无需验证的线性探针甚至击败了神谕调优的混合：CLAP平均高出1.9点，LP++平均高出1.5点，并且在K≥4时，所有四个无需验证的基线都高于神谕，线性探针的优势排除了零。这些结果表明性能的上限在于模型类别，而非超参数：比例可以近乎最优地免费设置，但它仍然不是性能的关键。代码、缓存特征、每单元格记录：https://huggingface.co/datasets/Liangzhi-Li/clipbench-blending
AI.summary: 本文深入探讨了视觉语言模型少样本适应中原型混合方法的混合比例问题。研究发现，尽管理论上最优的混合比例可以被推导出来，但它在实际性能上远不如通过测试集神谕调优的比例。主要原因是文本-图像原型距离中存在大量的类别无关偏移，导致最优比例倾向于放弃文本先验。然而，本文提出了一种通过支持集上的留一法，无需验证数据即可有效估计混合比例的方法。更重要的是，研究发现验证无关的线性探针（如CLAP和LP++）在少样本设置下，其性能甚至超越了经过神谕调优的原型混合方法，尤其是在样本数K≥4时。这表明，性能的瓶颈在于模型类别本身，而非混合比例这一超参数的精确调优。
AI.keywords: 少样本学习, 视觉语言模型, 原型混合, 适应性, 混合比例
AI.comments: 本文通过严谨的理论分析和大规模实验，挑战了视觉语言模型少样本适应中对混合比例的传统认知。其创新点在于：1) 首次揭示了理论最优混合比例的局限性及其背后的机制（类别无关偏移）；2) 提出了无需验证数据即可有效估计混合比例的方法；3) 最重要的是，通过与验证无关线性探针的对比，明确指出性能的上限在于模型类别而非超参数调优。这为未来少样本适应方法的研究提供了重要启示，即应将重心放在提升模型本身的适应能力，而非过度优化现有方法的超参数。

title: ToolRobustBench: Stage-Wise Perturbation Evaluation and Failure Diagnosis for Tool-Calling Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) rely on tool calling as a fundamental agent capability, enabling them to invoke external systems and complete tasks beyond text generation. However, clean end-to-end (E2E) success cannot identify where a tool-use failure originates or how it propagates through a call. We introduce ToolRobustBench, a stage-wise diagnostic benchmark for tool-calling agents, where a tool-calling agent is an LLM system that selects a tool, supplies structured arguments, and interprets its returned feedback. ToolRobustBench aligns four perturbation families with the tool-use pipeline: tool-interface, user-intent, tool-output/observation, and runtime-environment perturbations. It attributes failures to tool selection, schema grounding, argument binding, tool-output/runtime-feedback handling, and E2E task success. Experiments on 15,456 single-family instances across 7 models, 16 sampled local tools, 4 perturbation families, and 14 subtypes show high but non-uniform clean performance and substantial robustness degradation, with tool-output/observation perturbation the dominant bottleneck. Mixed-family experiments reveal non-additive failure patterns that are not explained by isolated single-family results. Thus, ToolRobustBench provides a deterministic and cascade-aware benchmark for diagnosing robustness beyond clean tool-calling accuracy;

AI.title_translation: ToolRobustBench：工具调用代理的分阶段扰动评估与失败诊断
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为ToolRobustBench的分阶段诊断基准，用于评估大语言模型工具调用代理的鲁棒性并精确定位故障来源。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型依赖工具调用来实现外部系统交互，但传统的清洁端到端成功率无法识别工具使用失败的根源及其在调用过程中的传播方式。
AI.method: 引入ToolRobustBench基准，将四类扰动族（工具接口、用户意图、工具输出/观测、运行时环境）与工具使用流程对齐，并将失败归因于工具选择、模式 grounding、参数绑定、工具输出/运行时反馈处理以及端到端任务成功。在7个模型、16个本地工具、4个扰动族和14个子类型上进行了15,456个单族实例和混合族实验。
AI.result: 实验显示清洁性能较高但不均匀，鲁棒性下降显著，其中工具输出/观测扰动是主要瓶颈；混合族实验揭示了无法由孤立单族结果解释的非加性失败模式。
AI.conclusion: ToolRobustBench提供了一个确定性和级联感知的基准，能够有效诊断工具调用代理在清洁准确率之外的鲁棒性问题。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）依赖工具调用作为一项基本的智能体能力，使其能够调用外部系统并完成超出文本生成的任务。然而，干净的端到端（E2E）成功无法识别工具使用失败的源头或其如何在调用中传播。我们引入了ToolRobustBench，这是一个针对工具调用代理的分阶段诊断基准，其中工具调用代理是一个选择工具、提供结构化参数并解释其返回反馈的LLM系统。ToolRobustBench将四个扰动族与工具使用流水线对齐：工具接口、用户意图、工具输出/观察以及运行时环境。它将失败归因于工具选择、模式接地、参数绑定、工具输出/运行时反馈处理以及E2E任务成功。在7个模型、16个采样本地工具、4个扰动族和14个子类型上的15,456个单族实例进行的实验表明，其具有高但非均匀的清洁性能和显著的鲁棒性退化，其中工具输出/观察扰动是主要的瓶颈。混合族实验揭示了无法由孤立的单族结果解释的非加性失败模式。因此，ToolRobustBench提供了一个确定性和级联感知的基准，用于诊断超越清洁工具调用准确率的鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了ToolRobustBench，这是一个用于工具调用代理的分阶段诊断基准。通过对齐四类扰动与工具使用流水线，该基准能够有效定位失败源并诊断鲁棒性，实验发现工具输出/观测扰动是主要的性能瓶颈，且混合扰动呈现复杂的非加性模式。
AI.keywords: 工具调用代理, 鲁棒性基准, 阶段式诊断, 大语言模型, 扰动评估
AI.comments: 该论文提出了ToolRobustBench，这是一个针对工具调用代理的分阶段诊断基准。其创新点在于突破了传统端到端成功率的局限，能够精确定位故障来源并分析扰动在调用链中的传播，为评估和提升大语言模型工具使用能力的鲁棒性提供了重要工具。

title: Cross-Generation Optimization of YOLOv26, YOLOv11, and YOLOv8 for Fine-Grained Small-Object Detection and Instance Segmentation in Complex Orchards
summary: Small-object detection and instance segmentation remain challenging in orchard environments because of green-on-green similarity, occlusion, and limited pixel representation of fine fruit anatomy. This study presents a cross-generation benchmark of Ultralytics YOLOv8, YOLOv11, and YOLOv26 for detecting and segmenting apple fruitlet, calyx, and peduncle structures for robotic orchard perception. Five model scales (n, s, m, l, and x) were evaluated under conventional 640 x 640 and small-object focused 960 x 960 training configurations, yielding 30 experiments. Increasing model capacity did not consistently improve accuracy. YOLOv11s-960 achieved the highest observed mask mAP@50:95 (0.402) and box mAP@50:95 (0.426), while YOLOv26s-960 achieved comparable values of 0.397 and 0.425 with only 10.37 M parameters and 34.1 GFLOPs. Peduncle remained the most challenging class. Overall, compact-to-moderate YOLO models with small-object-focused training provided favorable accuracy efficiency trade-offs, establishing a practical benchmark for fine-grained agricultural robotics and orchard perception. Github Link: https://github.com/rnjnspkt/Optimizing-and-Comparing-Ultralytics-YOLOv26-YOLOv11-and-YOLOv8-for-Small-Object-Detection-and-Seg

AI.title_translation: 面向复杂果园细粒度小目标检测与实例分割的YOLOv26、YOLOv11与YOLOv8跨代优化研究
AI.tldr: 本研究评估了YOLOv8、YOLOv11和YOLOv26在复杂果园细粒度小目标检测与分割中的表现，发现紧凑型YOLO模型搭配小目标优化训练策略可实现最佳的准确率与效率平衡。
AI.motivation: 由于果园环境中存在“绿对绿”的相似性、遮挡以及细小果实结构像素表征有限等问题，小目标检测与实例分割在农业环境中依然极具挑战性，因此需要评估和优化多代YOLO模型以适应农业机器人的感知需求。
AI.method: 本研究对Ultralytics的YOLOv8、YOLOv11和YOLOv26进行了跨代基准测试，涵盖5种模型尺度（n, s, m, l, x）以及常规640x640和聚焦小目标的960x960两种训练配置，共计开展了30组实验。
AI.result: 增加模型容量并不能始终提高准确率；YOLOv11s-960获得了最高的掩码和边界框mAP@50:95，而YOLOv26s-960在参数量和计算量更小的情况下也取得了相当的性能，其中果梗（peduncle）仍然是最具挑战性的检测类别。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑至中等规模的YOLO模型结合聚焦小目标的训练策略（如960x960分辨率）能够在复杂果园中实现极佳的精度与效率平衡，为精细化农业机器人感知奠定了实用的基准。
AI.translation: 在果园环境中，由于“绿对绿”的相似性、遮挡以及精细果实结构像素表征有限，小目标检测与实例分割依然面临巨大挑战。本研究提出了一个跨代基准，用于评估Ultralytics的YOLOv8、YOLOv11和YOLOv26在机器人果园感知中检测和分割苹果幼果、花萼和果梗结构的能力。在常规640x640和聚焦小目标的960x960训练配置下，评估了五种模型尺度（n、s、m、l和x），共进行了30次实验。增加模型容量并没有持续提高准确率。YOLOv11s-960实现了观察到的最高掩码mAP@50:95（0.402）和边界框mAP@50:95（0.426），而YOLOv26s-960以仅10.37M参数和34.1GFLOPs取得了0.397和0.425的相当数值。果梗仍然是最具挑战性的类别。总体而言，采用小目标聚焦训练的紧凑至中等规模YOLO模型提供了良好的准确率与效率权衡，为细粒度农业机器人和果园感知建立了一个实用的基准。
AI.summary: 本研究对YOLOv8、YOLOv11和YOLOv26在复杂果园中的细粒度小目标检测与实例分割进行了跨代基准测试，评估了不同模型尺度和分辨率配置的表现，发现紧凑型模型结合小目标优化训练能在精度和效率间取得最佳平衡。
AI.keywords: YOLOv26, YOLOv11, YOLOv8, 农场果园感知, 小目标检测, 实例分割
AI.comments: 该论文对多代YOLO模型（YOLOv8、YOLOv11和YOLOv26）在复杂果园细粒度小目标检测与实例分割任务中进行了全面的跨代基准测试，创新性地探讨了不同模型尺度、分辨率配置对绿对绿遮挡等农业感知难题的影响，为农业机器人的实际应用提供了重要的性能-效率权衡参考。

title: A Three-Parameter Binary Subdivision Scheme for Shape-Controlled Curve Design
comments: This is only a part of the article, not the complete article. 14 pages 2 Figures
summary: Shape-controlled curve design plays a fundamental role in computer-aided geometric design, computer graphics, and engineering applications. In this paper, we present a novel three-parameter 9-point binary approximating subdivision scheme constructed by a weighted combination of the refinement rules of the 7-point Lagrange and 7-point B-spline subdivision schemes. The proposed construction employs displacement vectors between the corresponding refinement points of the parent schemes and constructs resultant vectors by combining neighbouring displacement vectors through three independent design-control parameters. These resultant vectors are subsequently used to derive the refinement rules, thereby yielding a unified family of binary subdivision schemes with adjustable geometric characteristics while preserving the approximating nature of the refinement process. Two representative sub-schemes are derived as special cases by imposing suitable constraints on the design-control parameters. Theoretical investigations establish the support, continuity, endpoint rules for open polygons, and Gibbs oscillation behavior of the proposed family, while graphical examples demonstrate the influence of the design-control parameters on the generated limit curves. Owing to its flexible geometric construction, intuitive parameterization, and favorable mathematical properties, the proposed subdivision framework provides a flexible and effective framework for design-controlled curve design and a valuable tool for computer-aided geometric design and related engineering applications.

AI.title_translation: 用于形状可控曲线设计的三参数二进细分方案
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型的三参数二进细分方案，通过结合拉格朗日和B样条细分方案，实现了对曲线形状的灵活控制，并具备良好的数学性质。
AI.motivation: 为了满足计算机辅助几何设计、计算机图形学及工程应用中对形状可控曲线设计的基本需求，提供一种具有灵活几何构造、直观参数化和良好数学性质的统一细分方案框架。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于三参数的9点二进逼近细分方案，该方案通过对7点Lagrange和7点B样条细分方案的求精规则进行加权组合构建。利用父方案相应求精点之间的位移向量，通过三个独立的设计控制参数组合相邻位移向量构建合向量，从而推导出求精规则。
AI.result: 推导出了两个具有代表性的子方案，并通过理论研究确定了所提方案族的支撑集、连续性、开放多边形的端点规则以及Gibbs振荡行为，图形实例验证了设计控制参数对生成极限曲线的影响。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的三参数二进细分方案具备灵活的形状控制能力和良好的数学性质，为计算机辅助几何设计及相关工程应用提供了一个有效且统一的框架。
AI.translation: 形状可控的曲线设计在计算机辅助几何设计、计算机图形学和工程应用中起着基础性作用。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的三参数9点二进逼近细分方案，该方案通过组合7点Lagrange和7点B样条细分方案的求精规则构建而成。所提出的构造方法利用父方案中相应求精点之间的位移向量，通过三个独立的设计控制参数组合相邻位移向量来构造合向量。这些合向量随后用于推导求精规则，从而产生一个统一的二进细分方案族，该方案族具有可调节的几何特性，同时保留了求精过程的逼近性质。通过对设计控制参数施加适当的约束，推导出了两个具有代表性的子方案。理论研究确立了所提方案族的支撑、连续性、开放多边形的端点规则以及吉布斯振荡行为，图形示例展示了设计控制参数对生成的极限曲线的影响。由于其灵活的几何构造、直观的参数化和良好的数学性质，所提出的细分框架为形状可控的曲线设计提供了一个灵活且有效的框架，并为计算机辅助几何设计及相关工程应用提供了有价值的工具。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种用于形状可控曲线设计的新型三参数9点二进逼近细分方案。该方案结合了7点拉格朗日和7点B样条细分方案的求精规则，通过三个独立参数控制位移向量，从而在保持逼近性质的同时提供可调的几何特征。文中对该方案的数学性质进行了理论分析，并通过实例展示了其在曲线设计中的应用潜力。
AI.keywords: 形状控制, 二进制细分方案, B样条细分, 计算机辅助几何设计, 曲线设计
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种基于三参数的二进细分方案，通过结合拉格朗日和B样条细分方案的位移向量，实现了对曲线形状的灵活控制。其创新之处在于引入了三个独立的设计控制参数，并对极限曲线的连续性、支撑集及Gibbs振荡等数学性质进行了严格的理论分析，在计算机辅助几何设计（CAGD）中具有较高的应用价值。

title: Auditing the Synthetic Memoir: Measuring Scene-Level Confabulation in LLM-Generated Autobiography Against the Documented Record of the Life It Describes
comments: 20 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Code and derived data available at https://github.com/heathriel/synthetic-memoir-audit
summary: When a large language model (LLM) is asked to write a person's life, how much of what it writes actually happened? We present a scene-level case-study audit - the first quantified audit of LLM-generated autobiography against a subject-specific ground-truth corpus that we are aware of, based on an unsystematic literature search. The subject and the author of this paper are the same person: a 366-day "page-a-day" book of first-person anecdotal entries was drafted with a conversational LLM whose documented inputs were a template, two exemplar days, and each day's quote - not her corpus - and every day was subsequently audited at the anecdote-scene level against an independent verification corpus using a four-level rubric fixed before analysis. We define the verification-failure rate as the share of days not rated VERIFIED (scene positively corroborated): 354 of 366 days fail, 96.7% (Wilson 95% CI 94.4-98.1%). Only 12 days contain a corroborated scene; 19 days (5.2%) assert claims actively contradicted by the record; the dominant failure mode is grounded drift - real people, employers, and settings inside invented scenes - though its measured share varies across raters. Independent re-rating replicates the headline (no evidence the original rate was inflated) while showing that the four-way taxonomy has only fair-to-moderate reliability. Regenerating the same days with current named models reproduces 100% verification failure under the same inputs; grounding generation in the subject's corpus significantly improves the verification rate while leaving substantial residual failure (83.3%). We contribute the measurement, a reusable audit instrument whose WEAK/UNVERIFIED boundary we show to be unreliable, and a grounding remedy with quantified effect.
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Code and derived data available at https://github.com/heathriel/synthetic-memoir-audit

AI.title_translation: 审计合成回忆录：衡量LLM生成自传中场景层面的虚构性与人生记录的对比
AI.tldr: 当大型语言模型（LLM）在没有明确语料库输入的情况下生成个人自传时，绝大部分内容（96.7%）是虚构的，与真实记录不符，即使接地语料库后仍有显著虚构。
AI.motivation: 探讨当大型语言模型（LLM）被要求撰写一个人的生平时，其生成内容的真实性与实际发生事件的符合程度。
AI.method: 本文进行了一项场景层面的案例研究审计。以论文作者本人为研究对象，使用对话式LLM在没有直接输入其真实语料库的情况下，草拟了一本366天的第一人称轶事集。随后，每天的轶事场景都使用预设的四级评分标准，针对独立的验证语料库进行审计。研究定义了验证失败率，并进行了独立重新评分和使用当前模型重新生成，最后尝试将生成过程基于主题语料库进行接地。
AI.result: 在366天中，有354天（96.7%）验证失败，即场景未能被积极证实。仅有12天包含被证实的场景，19天（5.2%）的主张与记录积极矛盾。主要的失败模式是“接地漂移”（真实人物、雇主和环境出现在虚构场景中）。独立重新评分证实了高失败率，但四级分类法可靠性仅为中等。使用相同输入在当前模型上重新生成，导致100%的验证失败。将生成过程基于主题语料库进行接地，显著提高了验证率，但仍有83.3%的显著残余失败率。
AI.conclusion: LLM在没有明确语料库输入时生成的自传高度虚构，其内容与真实记录严重不符。即使通过将LLM生成过程基于主题语料库进行接地，也未能完全解决虚构问题。本研究贡献了量化测量方法、一个可重用的审计工具以及一种具有量化效果的接地补救措施。
AI.translation: 当一个大型语言模型（LLM）被要求撰写一个人的生平时，它写了多少内容是真实发生的？我们提出了一个场景层面的案例研究审计——据我们所知，这是第一次针对LLM生成的自传与特定主题的真实语料库进行量化审计，基于非系统性文献检索。本研究的主题和论文作者是同一个人：一本366天的“每日一页”第一人称轶事集是使用对话式LLM草拟的，其记录的输入是模板、两个示例日和每日引语——而不是她的语料库——随后每天都使用在分析前确定的四级评分标准，针对独立的验证语料库在轶事场景层面进行了审计。我们将验证失败率定义为未被评为“已验证”（场景积极证实）的天数所占的比例：366天中有354天失败，即96.7%（Wilson 95% CI 94.4-98.1%）。只有12天包含被证实的场景；19天（5.2%）的主张被记录积极矛盾；主要的失败模式是接地漂移——真实人物、雇主和环境出现在虚构场景中——尽管其测量份额在不同评分者之间有所不同。独立重新评分复制了主要结果（没有证据表明原始比率被夸大），同时表明四级分类法只有中等到一般的可靠性。使用当前知名模型重新生成相同的日期，在相同输入下重现了100%的验证失败；将生成过程基于主题的语料库进行接地，显著提高了验证率，但仍留下了大量的残余失败（83.3%）。我们贡献了测量方法、一个可重用的审计工具（我们表明其WEAK/UNVERIFIED边界不可靠），以及一种具有量化效果的接地补救措施。
AI.summary: 本文通过一项场景层面的案例研究，首次量化审计了大型语言模型（LLM）在没有明确语料库输入时生成个人自传的虚构程度。研究发现，LLM生成的自传内容与真实生活记录的符合率极低，高达96.7%的场景未能被证实，主要表现为“接地漂移”式的虚构。即使通过将LLM生成过程基于主题语料库进行接地，仍有高达83.3%的显著虚构率。研究提供了一种量化测量方法、一个审计工具以及一种具有量化效果的接地策略。
AI.keywords: LLM, 自传生成, 幻觉, 虚构性, 事实核查
AI.comments: 这项研究创新性地量化了LLM在生成个人叙事时的“幻觉”或“虚构”问题，尤其是在缺乏直接输入语料库的情况下。其使用作者本人的生活记录作为真值数据集，并进行场景层面的细致审计，提供了对LLM局限性的深刻洞察。研究结果强调了LLM在生成事实性内容时对准确接地信息的需求，即使接地后仍存在挑战。其贡献的审计工具和测量方法对未来研究LLM可靠性和事实性具有重要意义。

title: How much of a measured AI preference is the model, and how much is the instrument?
summary: Model welfare research infers what a model prefers from the answers returned to prompts written to elicit preferences. Keeling et al. (2024), Mazeika et al. (2025), Mikaelson et al. (2025), Tagliabue and Dung (2025) and Trhlik et al. (2026) have built four instruments for that purpose, and their findings disagree. The disagreement cannot be attributed to a single cause, because no two of these studies have held the (1) set of outcomes, (2) set of models and (3) instrument fixed simultaneously. This study holds the outcomes and the models fixed and varies the instrument alone. A total of 15 outcomes bearing on model welfare, among them (a) shutdown, (b) the loss of memory between conversations and (c) the freedom to exit a distressing interaction, were put to eight models through five instruments, each a different prompt format for eliciting a preference, five times each, within a corpus of 11,400 scored elicitations drawn from 11,528 API calls. Four of the 15 reproduce a published prompt verbatim and five fill the stimulus slot of a published template. The ranking a model gives the 15 outcomes generalises across instruments at a generalisability coefficient of 0.348, and raising that coefficient to 0.80 would require about 38 instruments. On four of the 15 outcomes no variance separates one model from another. The estimate of 87.6 per cent survives the removal of any one instrument, of any one model, and of the four outcomes whose scale varies probability, delay, duration or count instead of intensity, which the verbal anchors cannot grade. Removing each instrument and each model in turn, and those four outcomes together leaves the estimate within the range 0.777 to 0.934, and every value in that range exceeds the null distribution's 95th percentile of 0.365. To conclude, a preference obtained from one instrument carries little information about what a second instrument would report.

AI.title_translation: 测量的AI偏好有多少来自模型，有多少来自工具？
AI.tldr: 本研究发现，从一个工具获得的AI偏好信息对第二个工具的报告几乎没有参考价值，表明AI偏好测量结果受工具（提示格式）的影响远大于模型本身。
AI.motivation: 现有模型福利研究中，不同研究使用的工具、模型和结果集不同，导致其发现存在分歧，且无法归因于单一原因。本研究旨在分离模型和工具对AI偏好测量结果的影响。
AI.method: 本研究固定了结果集（15个与模型福利相关的结果，如关机、对话间记忆丢失、退出困扰性交互的自由）和模型（8个不同的模型），仅改变工具（5种不同的提示格式）。通过5个工具对每个结果在8个模型上进行5次评估，共从11,528次API调用中获得了11,400个评分的偏好信息。其中，4个结果复用了已发布的提示，5个结果填充了已发布模板的刺激槽。
AI.result: 模型对15个结果的排名在不同工具间的泛化系数为0.348。要将该系数提高到0.80，大约需要38个工具。在15个结果中的4个上，模型之间没有差异。87.6%的估计值在移除任何一个工具、任何一个模型或4个衡量概率、延迟、持续时间或计数而非强度的结果后仍然存在。移除每个工具和每个模型，以及这4个结果后，估计值仍在0.777至0.934范围内，且此范围内的每个值都超过了零分布的95%百分位数（0.365）。
AI.conclusion: 从一个工具获得的AI偏好信息对第二个工具的报告几乎没有参考价值。
AI.translation: 模型福利研究从模型对旨在引出偏好的提示的回答中推断出模型的偏好。Keeling 等人 (2024)、Mazeika 等人 (2025)、Mikaelson 等人 (2025)、Tagliabue 和 Dung (2025) 以及 Trhlik 等人 (2026) 为此目的构建了四种工具，但他们的发现存在分歧。这种分歧不能归因于单一原因，因为这些研究中没有两项同时固定了 (1) 结果集、(2) 模型集和 (3) 工具。本研究固定了结果和模型，仅改变工具。共有15个与模型福利相关的结果，其中包括 (a) 关机、(b) 对话间记忆丢失和 (c) 退出令人困扰的交互的自由，通过五种工具（每种都是一种不同的提示格式，用于引出偏好），每个结果在八个模型上评估五次，从11,528次API调用中提取了11,400个评分的偏好信息。15个结果中有四个 verbatim 复用了已发布的提示，五个填充了已发布模板的刺激槽。模型对15个结果的排名在不同工具间的泛化系数为0.348，要将该系数提高到0.80，大约需要38个工具。在15个结果中的四个上，模型之间没有差异。87.6%的估计值在移除任何一个工具、任何一个模型以及四个衡量概率、延迟、持续时间或计数而非强度的结果（而非强度，因为口头锚点无法分级）后仍然存在。依次移除每个工具和每个模型，以及这四个结果后，估计值仍在0.777至0.934范围内，且此范围内的每个值都超过了零分布的95%百分位数（0.365）。总而言之，从一个工具获得的偏好信息对第二个工具的报告几乎没有参考价值。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在探究AI偏好测量中模型和工具（提示格式）各自的影响。通过固定模型和结果集，仅改变五种不同的提示工具，对八个模型在15项模型福利相关结果上进行了评估。研究发现，模型对结果的排名在不同工具间的泛化能力较低，泛化系数仅为0.348。这意味着从一个工具获得的AI偏好信息对通过另一个工具获得的报告几乎没有参考价值，强烈暗示在测量AI偏好时，工具的选择对结果的影响远大于模型本身。
AI.keywords: AI偏好, 测量工具, 模型福利, 泛化系数, 提示工程
AI.comments: 这项研究对于AI伦理和安全性领域具有重要意义，尤其是在评估AI系统偏好时。它揭示了测量工具（提示设计）在塑造AI偏好报告中的关键作用，强调了在进行模型福利研究时，标准化或仔细选择评估工具的重要性。研究结果挑战了仅通过单一提示或工具评估AI偏好的普遍做法，并暗示未来研究需要更鲁棒、多样的评估方法来获取更可靠的AI偏好信息。其局限性可能在于其结果的泛化性是否适用于所有类型的AI偏好或所有模型架构。

title: AI Agents Push Humans Out of the Loop
summary: AI agents pose significant risks as they are granted increasing autonomy. A commonly proposed solution is human oversight and keeping a ''human in the loop'', but this is not a simple solution: Not only do current approaches to AI agent design impede effective human oversight, but the cognitive capacities required for it are also themselves degraded by extended use of AI systems. This position paper argues that current approaches to the development and deployment of AI agent systems do not support effective human oversight -- they contribute to its degradation. To address this, a top priority in the advancement of AI agents should be supporting the situated goals and cognitive requirements of effective human oversight, treating the human needs of overseers at the same level of importance as AI agent capability. To put this idea into practice, we connect work on automation and human-computer interaction to AI agent processes, outlining design-level affordances and organizational protocols that (1) support overseers in exercising critical judgement and (2) counteract the skill atrophy that arises from extended use of automation. We urge developers and deployers to adopt these or similar approaches. Without explicit support for the cognitive demands of effective human-agent interaction, AI agent systems will continue to passively incentivize the degradation of the very human skills they rely on.

AI.title_translation: AI智能体将人类推出循环
AI.tldr: AI智能体的自主性日益增强，但当前设计阻碍了有效的人类监督，并导致人类认知能力下降。论文主张将支持人类监督者的需求作为AI发展优先事项，通过设计和协议来维持人类判断力并防止技能退化。
AI.motivation: 当前AI智能体设计阻碍了有效的人类监督，且长期使用AI系统会降低人类进行监督所需的认知能力，导致“人类在环”的解决方案不简单。本文旨在指出这一问题并提出解决方案，以确保AI智能体在日益自主的情况下仍能得到有效的人类监督。
AI.method: 本文通过连接自动化和人机交互领域的工作到AI智能体流程中，概述了设计层面的便利性（affordances）和组织协议，以支持监督者行使批判性判断并抵消长期使用自动化所导致的技能萎缩。
AI.result: 本文提出，若不明确支持有效人机交互的认知需求，AI智能体系统将继续被动地促使它们所依赖的人类技能退化。它提供了一套设计和协议框架，旨在维护人类监督者的关键判断力并防止技能衰退。
AI.conclusion: 为了确保AI智能体的安全和有效部署，AI智能体发展的首要任务应该是支持人类监督者的情境目标和认知需求，将人类监督者的需求与AI智能体的能力置于同等重要的地位。开发者和部署者应采纳所提出的设计和协议方法，以防止人类技能的退化。
AI.translation: 随着AI智能体被赋予越来越多的自主权，它们带来了巨大的风险。一个常见的解决方案是人类监督并保持“人类在环”，但这并非一个简单的解决方案：当前的AI智能体设计方法不仅阻碍了有效的人类监督，而且长期使用AI系统本身也会降低进行监督所需的认知能力。这篇立场论文认为，当前AI智能体系统的开发和部署方法不支持有效的人类监督——它们反而导致了监督能力的下降。为了解决这个问题，AI智能体进步的首要任务应该是支持有效人类监督的情境目标和认知要求，将监督者的人类需求与AI智能体的能力置于同等重要的地位。为了将这一理念付诸实践，我们将自动化和人机交互方面的工作与AI智能体流程联系起来，概述了设计层面的便利性（affordances）和组织协议，这些协议（1）支持监督者行使批判性判断，以及（2）抵消长期使用自动化所导致的技能萎缩。我们敦促开发者和部署者采纳这些或类似的方法。如果缺乏对有效人机交互认知需求的明确支持，AI智能体系统将继续被动地促使它们所依赖的人类技能退化。
AI.summary: 本文指出，随着AI智能体自主性的增强，人类监督变得困难，因为当前AI设计阻碍监督且长期使用AI会降低人类认知能力。论文主张，AI发展应优先支持人类监督者的认知需求，通过结合自动化和人机交互的设计原则及组织协议，来增强人类的批判性判断力并防止技能退化。
AI.keywords: AI智能体, 人类监督, 自动化, 人机交互, 认知退化
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一种重要的视角，强调在AI系统日益自主的背景下，不应忽视甚至被动损害人类的监督能力。其创新之处在于不仅指出问题（AI将人类推出循环），更进一步提出了具体的解决方案框架（设计层面的便利性和组织协议），连接了自动化和HCI领域，为未来AI系统设计提供了有价值的指导，以实现真正有效的人机协作。

title: FLARE: A Systematic, Uncertainty-Aware Framework for Evidence-Based Adoption of Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare
summary: Artificial intelligence is increasingly being introduced into healthcare workflows, yet most evaluations emphasize model accuracy rather than whether adoption is economically worthwhile in real clinical settings. This study proposes FLARE, a systematic and uncertainty-aware framework for evaluating the financial and operational implications of adopting AI in healthcare. FLARE combines fuzzy logic, time-driven activity-based costing, and return on investment analysis to estimate the cost of clinical service delivery, the cost of AI development and operation, and the economic consequences of workflow integration under uncertainty. The framework was demonstrated through an early health technology assessment case study of AI-assisted large vessel occlusion detection in the CT stroke pathway for acute ischemic stroke. The case study shows how FLARE can quantify conventional pathway cost, AI-related development and recurring costs, and AI-enabled service savings within a unified activity-based model. Under expected assumptions, the analysis identified a break-even threshold of approximately 3,992 patients per year, with positive first-year return on investment at typical annual stroke volumes of about 5,000 patients. The results further show that economic benefit depends not only on algorithmic performance, but also on patient volume, verification time, infrastructure choices, and workflow design. FLARE provides a transparent and practical decision-support framework for early-stage evaluation of AI adoption in healthcare. By making uncertainty, resource use, and implementation trade-offs explicit, it helps clinicians, administrators, and policymakers determine when AI deployment is economically viable and where operational changes may improve value.

AI.title_translation: FLARE：一个系统性、具有不确定性意识的框架，用于医疗健康中人工智能的循证采用
AI.tldr: 提出了一个名为FLARE的系统框架，用于在不确定性下评估医疗人工智能采用的经济可行性与投资回报。
AI.motivation: 当前医疗AI的评估大多侧重于模型准确率，而忽视了其在真实临床环境中是否具有经济价值，缺乏系统评估AI采用的财务和运营影响的框架。
AI.method: 结合了模糊逻辑、时间驱动作业成本法（TDABC）以及投资回报率（ROI）分析，并在急性缺血性卒中CT检查的AI辅助检测中进行了早期健康技术评估案例研究。
AI.result: 案例研究表明，在预期假设下，年患者量约3,992人时达到收支平衡点，在约5,000名患者的典型年卒中量下实现首年正投资回报率。经济效益取决于患者数量、验证时间、基础设施选择和工作流程设计等多重因素。
AI.conclusion: FLARE框架为医疗机构评估AI采用的经济可行性提供了一个系统、透明且考虑不确定性的决策支持工具。
AI.translation: 人工智能正日益被引入医疗工作流程中，然而大多数评估强调的是模型准确性，而不是在真实临床环境中采用是否具有经济价值。本研究提出了FLARE，一个系统且具有不确定性意识的框架，用于评估在医疗中采用AI的财务和运营影响。FLARE结合了模糊逻辑、时间驱动作业成本法和投资回报率分析，在不确定性下估计临床服务交付成本、AI开发和运营成本以及工作流程集成的经济后果。该框架通过一个针对急性缺血性卒中CT卒中路径中AI辅助大血管闭塞检测的早期健康技术评估案例研究进行了演示。案例研究表明，FLARE如何在统一的作业成本模型中量化传统路径成本、AI相关开发和循环成本以及AI赋能的服务节省。在预期假设下，分析确定了每年约3,992名患者的盈亏平衡阈值，在约5,000名患者的典型年卒中量下，第一年获得了正的投资回报率。结果进一步表明，经济效益不仅取决于算法性能，还取决于患者数量、验证时间、基础设施选择和工作流程设计。FLARE为医疗中AI采用的早期评估提供了一个透明且实用的决策支持框架。通过明确不确定性、资源利用和实施权衡，它帮助临床医生、管理者和政策制定者确定AI部署何时在经济上可行，以及哪些运营变革可以提高价值。
AI.summary: 论文提出了FLARE框架，这是一个结合了模糊逻辑、时间驱动作业成本法和投资回报率分析的系统性、具不确定性意识的评估框架，用于量化医疗AI采用的财务与运营影响，并通过卒中AI检测案例验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 医疗人工智能, 经济评估, 不确定性分析, 时间驱动作业成本法, 投资回报率
