AI.translation: 微服务系统具有模块化和适应性强的特点，但其分布式结构使得其时序行为难以分析和保证。由于延迟源于服务依赖、共享资源和协调中间件之间的交互，局部时序扰动可能会传播到系统级效应。本调查以软件定义汽车作为激励示例，研究了微服务系统中时序可变性的来源、传播机制和可观察影响。它比较了主要类别的时序模型，分析了它们在工作负载稳定性、执行结构、资源共享、可观测性和保证可接受性方面的假设，并总结了它们在微服务软件定义汽车中的局限性。
AI.summary: 这篇综述调查了微服务系统中时序可变性的问题，特别是在软件定义汽车的背景下。它探讨了时序可变性的来源、传播机制和影响，并对比了不同的时序模型及其在微服务软件定义汽车环境中的局限性。
AI.keywords: 微服务, 时序可变性, 软件定义汽车, 延迟分析, 计时模型
AI.comments: 这篇综述对于理解微服务架构在关键实时系统（如软件定义汽车）中面临的时序挑战具有重要意义。它系统地梳理了时序可变性的成因、传播及影响，并对现有计时模型进行了比较和局限性分析，为未来的研究和系统设计提供了宝贵的洞察。

title: Concept-Guided Exploration: Building Persistent, Actionable Scene Graphs
summary: The perception of 3D space by mobile robots is rapidly moving from flat metric grid representations to hybrid metric-semantic graphs built from human-interpretable concepts. While most approaches first build metric maps and then add semantic layers, we explore an alternative, concept-first architecture in which spatial understanding emerges from asynchronous concept agents that directly instantiate and manage semantic entities. Our robot employs two spatial concepts (room and door), implemented as autonomous processes within a cognitive distributed architecture. These concept agents cooperatively build a shared scene graph representation of indoor layouts through active exploration and incremental validation. The key architectural principle is hierarchical constraint propagation: Room instantiation provides geometric and semantic priors to guide and support door detection within wall boundaries. The resulting structure is maintained by a complementary functional principle based on prediction-matching loops. This approach is designed to yield an actionable, human-interpretable spatial representation without relying on any pre-existing global metric map, supporting scalable operation and persistent, task-relevant understanding in structured indoor environments.

AI.title_translation: 概念引导探索：构建持久、可操作的场景图
AI.tldr: 本文提出一种概念优先的分布式架构，利用异步概念代理（如房间和门）主动探索并构建可操作、人类可理解的场景图，无需预先的全局度量地图。
AI.motivation: 移动机器人对3D空间的感知正从平面度量网格转向人类可解释的混合度量-语义图。现有方法多先构建度量地图再添加语义层，本文探索一种概念优先的替代架构，以实现可扩展操作和持久、任务相关的理解。
AI.method: 提出一种概念优先的架构，其中空间理解源于直接实例化和管理语义实体的异步概念代理。机器人使用“房间”和“门”两种空间概念，作为认知分布式架构中的自主进程。这些概念代理通过主动探索和增量验证，协同构建室内布局的共享场景图。关键原则是分层约束传播（房间实例化提供几何和语义先验以指导门检测），并辅以基于预测匹配循环的互补功能原则来维护结构。
AI.result: 该方法产生了一个可操作、人类可解释的空间表示，无需依赖任何预先存在的全局度量地图。它支持在结构化室内环境中进行可扩展操作和持久、任务相关的理解。
AI.conclusion: 通过概念优先的架构和分布式概念代理，可以构建无需预先度量地图的持久、可操作的场景图，从而实现对室内环境的有效、可扩展的理解。
AI.translation: 移动机器人对3D空间的感知正从平面度量网格表示迅速转向由人类可解释概念构建的混合度量-语义图。虽然大多数方法首先构建度量地图，然后添加语义层，但我们探索了一种替代的、概念优先的架构，其中空间理解源于直接实例化和管理语义实体的异步概念代理。我们的机器人采用了两个空间概念（房间和门），它们作为认知分布式架构中的自主进程实现。这些概念代理通过主动探索和增量验证，协同构建室内布局的共享场景图表示。关键的架构原则是分层约束传播：房间实例化提供几何和语义先验，以指导和支持墙壁边界内的门检测。由此产生的结构通过基于预测匹配循环的互补功能原则进行维护。这种方法旨在生成一个可操作的、人类可解释的空间表示，而无需依赖任何预先存在的全局度量地图，从而支持在结构化室内环境中的可扩展操作和持久的、任务相关的理解。
AI.summary: 本文提出一种新颖的机器人空间感知架构，即概念优先探索。与传统先构建度量地图再添加语义层的方法不同，该架构通过异步概念代理（如房间和门）直接实例化和管理语义实体，从而构建人类可解释的场景图。该系统通过分层约束传播和预测匹配循环机制，实现主动探索、增量验证和结构维护，最终生成无需预先全局度量地图的持久、可操作的室内环境空间表示。
AI.keywords: 概念引导探索, 场景图, 移动机器人, 语义感知, 分布式架构
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于其“概念优先”的架构，颠覆了传统的“先度量后语义”范式。通过将语义概念作为构建空间理解的基础，并采用分布式代理和分层约束传播，该方法实现了无需全局度量地图的场景图构建，这对于提升机器人在复杂动态环境中的可扩展性、鲁棒性和长期自主性具有重要意义。它强调了人类可解释性和任务相关性，是机器人认知领域的一个重要进展。

title: Feedback That Backfires: Why Small Language Model Agents Repeat the Call They Just Watched Fail
comments: 25 pages, 6 figures, 13 tables. Code, data, probe items and rollout logs: https://github.com/Esmail-ibraheem/feedback-that-backfires
summary: Agent harnesses record a failed tool call and its error message in the transcript and ask the model to continue, on the assumption that the error is corrective information. We measure whether it is. Defining the corrective gain of a failure record as the change in log-probability of re-emitting the action that just failed, we find the gain is negative for every instruction-tuned model we tested (6 checkpoints, 135M-1.7B, 4 families) in two environments: simulated tool calling and MBPP program repair. Normalised by action length the effect is about -1.03 nats per action token, a factor of 2.8 in the odds of each token, and holds on 90%-100% of individual items, not only on average. Over a fixed candidate set the probability of repeating the failed call rises from 0.06 to 0.54, and greedy decoding reproduces it token for token on 19% of items after the failure versus 0% before. Counterfactuals pairing the same call with a failure message, a success message, or a neutral acknowledgement separate two effects: the failed call's surface form accounts for 83% of the damage, while the semantic contribution of marking it failed is small and inconsistent in sign across environments. The problem is in the harness, not the model's grasp of error messages, and that predicts which remedies work. Replacing the verbatim call with a runtime-generated description of the failure removes 76% of the inversion at no token cost, and making previously-failed strings unreachable at the decoder acts on the same term. Two plausible remedies do not: an explicit "do not repeat" instruction leaves the measured quantity where it was, and deleting the failed attempt to retry from a clean context, the standard prescription for context contamination, is the worst harness we measured for repetition, because it restores the context that produced the failure. The study runs end to end on a CPU; all artefacts are released.
comment: 25 pages, 6 figures, 13 tables. Code, data, probe items and rollout logs: https://github.com/Esmail-ibraheem/feedback-that-backfires

AI.title_translation: 反馈适得其反：为什么小型语言模型代理会重复它们刚刚看到失败的调用
AI.tldr: 小型语言模型代理在工具调用失败后，会重复刚刚失败的调用，因为代理的运行框架记录了失败的调用内容，这反而成为模型重复该调用的强大提示，而不是模型未能理解错误信息。问题出在运行框架上，而非模型本身。
AI.motivation: 代理运行框架在记录失败的工具调用及其错误信息时，通常假设这些错误信息具有纠正作用，并要求模型继续。本研究旨在测量这种假设是否成立，即失败记录是否真的具有纠正作用。
AI.method: 研究定义了失败记录的“纠正增益”（即重新发出刚刚失败的动作的对数概率变化），并在两种环境中（模拟工具调用和MBPP程序修复）测试了多种指令调优模型（6个检查点，1.35亿至17亿参数，4个系列）。通过反事实实验，将相同的调用与失败消息、成功消息或中性确认配对，以分离不同效应。
AI.result: 研究发现，所有测试的指令调优模型（6个检查点，135M-1.7B，4个系列）在两种环境下的纠正增益均为负值，这意味着模型更有可能重复失败的调用。归一化后，每个动作标记的效果约为-1.03 nats，使每个标记的几率增加了2.8倍，并且在90%-100%的单个项目上都成立。在固定的候选集中，重复失败调用的概率从0.06上升到0.54。贪婪解码在失败后对19%的项目逐字重复，而之前为0%。失败调用的表面形式解释了83%的负面影响，而将其标记为失败的语义贡献很小且在不同环境中不一致。将逐字调用替换为运行时生成的失败描述可消除76%的重复，而不会增加token成本。使先前失败的字符串在解码器处不可达也有效。两种看似合理的补救措施无效：明确的“不要重复”指令没有改变测量结果；从干净上下文重试（标准做法）是导致重复的最差框架，因为它恢复了导致失败的上下文。
AI.conclusion: 问题出在代理的运行框架上，而非模型对错误信息的理解能力。有效的解决方案是改变失败信息的呈现方式，例如用失败描述替换逐字调用，或者阻止模型重新生成已失败的字符串。标准的上下文清理方法反而会加剧重复问题。
AI.translation: 代理运行框架在记录失败的工具调用及其错误信息时，将其记录在转录本中并要求模型继续，假设错误信息是纠正性的。我们测量了它是否如此。我们将失败记录的纠正增益定义为重新发出刚刚失败的动作的对数概率变化，结果发现我们测试的每个指令调优模型（6个检查点，1.35亿-17亿参数，4个系列）在两种环境中（模拟工具调用和MBPP程序修复）的增益都是负的。按动作长度归一化后，效果约为每个动作标记-1.03 nats，使每个标记的几率增加了2.8倍，并且在90%-100%的单个项目上都成立，而不仅仅是平均水平。在一个固定的候选集中，重复失败调用的概率从0.06上升到0.54，贪婪解码在失败后对19%的项目逐字重复，而之前为0%。将相同的调用与失败消息、成功消息或中性确认配对的反事实实验分离出两种效应：失败调用的表面形式解释了83%的损害，而将其标记为失败的语义贡献很小且在不同环境中不一致。问题出在运行框架上，而不是模型对错误信息的理解，这预示了哪些补救措施有效。用运行时生成的失败描述替换逐字调用可以消除76%的反转，而不会增加token成本，并且使先前失败的字符串在解码器处不可达也能起到同样的作用。两种看似合理的补救措施无效：明确的“不要重复”指令使测量量保持不变；删除失败的尝试以从干净的上下文重试（上下文污染的标准处方）是我们测量到的重复率最差的框架，因为它恢复了导致失败的上下文。本研究在CPU上端到端运行；所有成果均已发布。
AI.summary: 本研究发现，小型语言模型代理在工具调用失败后，倾向于重复刚刚失败的调用。这并非因为模型不理解错误信息，而是因为代理运行框架中对失败调用的逐字记录，其表面形式成为模型重复该调用的强大提示。研究通过实验证实，纠正增益为负，模型重复失败调用的概率显著增加。提出并验证了两种有效补救措施：用失败描述替换逐字调用，以及阻止模型重新生成已失败的字符串。同时指出，明确的“不要重复”指令和删除失败尝试以从干净上下文重试的标准做法均无效或适得其反。
AI.keywords: 小型语言模型, 代理, 工具调用, 反馈, 错误重复
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于揭示了小型语言模型代理在处理工具调用失败反馈时的一个反直觉现象——反馈不仅没有纠正模型，反而促使其重复失败操作。它明确指出问题根源在于代理运行框架记录失败信息的方式（逐字重复），而非模型对错误信息的理解能力。这一发现对设计更健壮、更可靠的语言模型代理具有重要指导意义，尤其是在工具使用和程序修复等领域。其提出的解决方案，如替换逐字记录和阻止重复生成，具有实用价值。局限性可能在于其主要关注小型语言模型，对更大模型的泛化能力尚待进一步验证。

title: Beyond Executable Models: The Pufibara Agent Harness and the Modelica Agent Workflow Benchmark for Physical System Modeling
summary:
AI agents are increasingly used for simulation-driven engineering. Physical system modeling presents different requirements from general-purpose code generation in software engineering, because correctness depends not only on syntax and executability but also on physical consistency and scenario-dependent behavior. We study this challenge in Modelica, an equation-based modeling language in which a model may compile and simulate while still violating its intended physics or engineering requirements. Across successive revisions, an agent may lose track of requirements or rely on simulation evidence produced by an outdated candidate.
  To address this challenge, we present Pufibara, an agent harness that maintains persistent engineering state across revisions, associates execution and simulation evidence with the candidate that produced it, and makes submission an explicit agent action. To evaluate end-to-end Modelica agent workflows, we also propose a source-grounded method for constructing realistic and independently evaluable tasks. We use this method to build the 232-task Modelica Agent Workflow Benchmark, spanning Model Repair, Model Generation, and Model Tuning. Each submitted candidate is scored by a benchmark-owned evaluator outside the agent loop.
  We compare Pufibara with Claude Code as complete harnesses under two matched large language model (LLM) backends. With DeepSeek v4 Flash, Pufibara passes 202 tasks, compared with 185 for Claude Code. With Claude Sonnet 5, Pufibara passes 202 tasks, compared with 187 for Claude Code. Under the repository-reported token accounting, Pufibara records 76.4%-82.5% lower logical-token totals. Its sequential runtime is 6.1%-58.4% lower. These findings show that, even under matched LLM backends, complete agent harnesses can differ substantially in both task success and resource use for physical system modeling.

AI.title_translation: 超越可执行模型：用于物理系统建模的Pufibara智能体框架与Modelica智能体工作流基准
AI.tldr: 本文提出了专为物理系统建模设计的Pufibara智能体框架和基准测试，实验证明其在任务成功率和资源消耗上均显著优于现有通用框架。
AI.motivation: 物理系统建模对AI智能体提出了不同于普通软件工程的要求，其正确性不仅取决于语法和可执行性，还取决于物理一致性和场景依赖行为，且智能体在多次修订中容易丢失需求或依赖过期仿真证据。
AI.method: 提出了Pufibara智能体框架（维护持久工程状态、关联仿真证据、显式提交动作）以及基于源驱动的构建方法，建立了包含232个任务的Modelica Agent Workflow Benchmark，并与Claude Code进行了对比实验。
AI.result: 在DeepSeek v4 Flash和Claude Sonnet 5两个大模型后端下，Pufibara均通过了202个任务（优于Claude Code的185和187个），且逻辑Token总数降低了76.4%-82.5%，顺序运行时间降低了6.1%-58.4%。
AI.conclusion: 完备的智能体框架设计在物理系统建模任务中对任务成功率和资源消耗有着决定性影响，Pufibara在保持更高通过率的同时显著降低了Token消耗与运行时间。
AI.translation:
AI智能体越来越多地被用于仿真驱动的工程。由于正确性不仅取决于语法和可执行性，还取决于物理一致性和场景依赖的行为，物理系统建模对通用软件工程中的代码生成提出了不同的要求。我们在Modelica（一种基于方程的建模语言，其中的模型在编译和仿真时可能仍然违反其预期的物理或工程要求）中研究了这一挑战。在连续的修订过程中，智能体可能会丢失对需求的跟踪，或者依赖于由过时候选版本生成的仿真证据。
为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了Pufibara，这是一个智能体框架，它能在多次修订之间保持持久的工程状态，将执行和仿真证据与其生成的候选版本关联起来，并使提交成为一个显式的智能体动作。为了评估端到端的Modelica智能体工作流，我们还提出了一种基于源的构建方法，用于构建现实且可独立评估的任务。我们使用这种方法构建了包含232个任务的Modelica智能体工作流基准（Modelica Agent Workflow Benchmark），涵盖模型修复、模型生成和模型调优。提交的每个候选版本都由智能体循环之外的基准自有评估器进行评分。
我们在两个匹配的大语言模型（LLM）后端下，将Pufibara与Claude Code作为完整框架进行了比较。在使用DeepSeek v4 Flash时，Pufibara通过了202个任务，而Claude Code通过了185个；在使用Claude Sonnet 5时，Pufibara通过了202个任务，而Claude Code通过了187个。在仓库报告的Token统计下，Pufibara的逻辑Token总量减少了76.4%-82.5%，其顺序运行时间减少了6.1%-58.4%。这些发现表明，即使在匹配的LLM后端下，完整的智能体框架在物理系统建模的任务成功率和资源使用方面也可能存在巨大差异。
AI.summary: 本文针对物理系统建模中的AI智能体挑战，推出了Pufibara智能体框架和Modelica Agent Workflow Benchmark基准。实验证明，Pufibara在模型修复、生成和调优任务中，以更低的资源消耗取得了更高的任务通过率。
AI.keywords: AI agents, Modelica, physical system modeling, agent harness, benchmark
AI.comments: 该论文针对物理系统建模（如Modelica语言）中AI智能体面临的物理一致性和演化状态管理难题，创新性地提出了Pufibara智能体框架与Modelica Agent Workflow Benchmark基准。这超越了传统的代码可执行性评估，对工程仿真领域的AI应用具有重要推动作用。

title: Elastic KV Cache for LLM Serving:A Working Reclamation Mechanism, and Why Chunked Prefill Already Closes the Gap
summary:
An LLM serving engine sizes its key-value (KV) cache once, at startup, permanently setting aside a reserve for the worst-case prefill activation. During decode-dominant phases that reserve sits idle, yet it cannot be handed to the KV pool because it is exactly the memory a large prefill needs. We ask whether this reserve is reclaimable, and build a mechanism to test it. Our elastic KV cache lends the reserve to the KV pool during decode and returns it before prefill, driven by the scheduler's one-step-ahead view of the next batch. It is pure userspace on the CUDA virtual-memory path: two physical handles mapped into one contiguous virtual range per layer, so the attention kernel is unchanged and no driver patch is required. It decommits in a few milliseconds and recommits in tens of milliseconds, works with CUDA graphs and prefix caching, and never triggers an out-of-memory event. A static commit of the same memory is unsafe, crashing on prefill bursts, which makes the dynamic toggle necessary.
  Having built the mechanism, we test the premise it rests on and report an honest negative result. It only pays off if a small prefill chunk size badly hurts prefill latency. In a controlled experiment injecting long prompts into a live decode load, that penalty is small (median time-to-first-token differs by about 1% between chunk sizes of 8192 and 32768 tokens), because prefill is compute bound and decode consumes only about one token per sequence per step. Simply lowering max_num_batched_tokens recovers more KV than the controller does, at nearly equal latency. The reserve also dilutes under tensor parallelism, from 16% of KV at TP1 to 2.7% at TP4. We state precisely when reclaiming the reserve could still help, and release the mechanism as a reusable userspace elastic-VMM allocator.

AI.title_translation: LLM推理的弹性KV缓存：一种可行的回收机制，以及为什么分块预填充已经弥补了差距
AI.tldr: 作者开发了一种基于CUDA VMM的弹性KV缓存回收机制，但通过实验发现，在分块预填充技术的加持下，该复杂机制的实际收益不大，从而提供了一个诚实的“负面结果”。
AI.motivation: 大模型推理引擎在启动时为最坏情况下的预填充分配了固定的KV缓存预留内存，在解码阶段这部分内存闲置却无法被KV池利用，因此作者旨在研究并实现一种机制来回收这部分闲置内存。
AI.method: 提出了一种纯用户态的CUDA虚拟内存（VMM）分配器，通过动态地将预填充预留内存借给KV池并在预填充前收回，实现了弹性KV缓存；同时进行了控制实验，评估了不同分块预填充大小对预填充延迟的影响。
AI.result: 实验表明，由于预填充是计算密集型的且分块预填充的惩罚很小（TTFT仅相差约1%），动态回收机制带来的收益极小；通过简单降低max_num_batched_tokens可以恢复更多内存且延迟相当，且张量并行会进一步稀释内存储备。
AI.conclusion: 尽管成功实现了弹性KV缓存机制，但由于分块预填充技术的高效性以及张量并行对预填充内存储备的稀释，该机制在实际场景中的收益有限，简单的调整参数（如降低max_num_batched_tokens）即可达到类似效果。
AI.translation:
大模型（LLM）推理引擎在启动时会确定其键值（KV）缓存的大小，永久性地为最坏情况下的预填充激活预留内存。在以解码为主的阶段，该预留内存处于闲置状态，但又不能交还给KV池，因为大预填充恰好需要这部分内存。我们探讨了这部分预留内存是否可回收，并构建了一个机制来对其进行测试。我们的弹性KV缓存机制利用调度器对下一批次的超前预测，在解码期间将预留内存借给KV池，并在预填充前将其归还。这是CUDA虚拟内存路径上的纯用户态实现：每层有两个物理句柄映射到一个连续的虚拟地址范围内，因此注意力核心保持不变，也无需修改驱动程序。它能在几毫秒内取消提交（decommit），在几十毫秒内重新提交（recommit），与CUDA图和前缀缓存兼容，且永不会触发内存溢出（OOM）事件。对相同内存进行静态提交是不安全的，会在预填充爆发时崩溃，这使得动态切换变得必不可少。
在构建了该机制后，我们对其所依托的前提进行了测试，并报告了一个诚实的负面结果。只有当小的预填充块大小严重损害预填充延迟时，它才会有所回报。在将长提示词注入实时解码负载的对照实验中，这种惩罚是很小的（在块大小为8192和32768个token之间，中位首字延迟差异约为1%），因为预填充是计算受限的，且解码每个序列每步只消耗大约一个token。简单地降低max_num_batched_tokens比控制器恢复的KV内存更多，且延迟几乎相当。在张量并行（TP）下，预留内存也会被稀释，从TP1时的KV的16%降至TP4时的2.7%。我们精确地指出了回收预留内存何时仍然有用，并开源了该机制作为可重用的用户态弹性VMM分配器。
AI.summary: 该论文设计并实现了一种基于CUDA虚拟内存的弹性KV缓存机制，用于动态回收大模型推理中预填充阶段闲置的预留内存。然而，通过严谨的实验，作者得出负面结论：由于分块预填充技术的存在以及张量并行的影响，该动态回收机制的实际收益很小，简单的参数调整即可达到相似效果。
AI.keywords: LLM推理, KV缓存, 弹性VMM, 分块预填充, 内存管理
AI.comments: 该论文具有极高的学术诚实性（Honest Negative Result），不仅提出了一种巧妙且工程实现干净的弹性KV缓存机制（基于CUDA VMM），还通过严谨的实验证明了在分块预填充（Chunked Prefill）机制下，这种复杂设计的收益微乎其微，为大模型推理服务系统的内存管理研究提供了宝贵的负面结果和深刻见解。

title: From Causal Plausibility to Causal Reliability: Evaluating LLMs as Calibrated Direct Causal-Edge Classifiers
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to provide prior causal knowledge for structural causal discovery, yet whether their direct-edge judgments and confidence can be trusted remains unclear. We systematically evaluate 12 instruction-tuned open-weight models across six benchmark causal graphs, five prompting strategies, and four confidence sources: verbalized, logit-based, cross-prompt agreement, and cross-model agreement. Under our language-only pairwise protocol, our evaluation yields three key findings. (i) LLM-based causal judgments are strongly recall-dominant: models predict overly dense graphs with many false-positive edges, while prompting mainly shifts the precision-recall trade-off rather than resolving overprediction. Gains from model scale diminish on the largest graphs and do not eliminate miscalibration. (ii) LLMs often capture causal relatedness without reliably identifying directness or orientation. Relative to published reference graphs, models misclassify 40.0% of indirect and 36.0% of reversed non-edges as direct edges, versus 28.2% of other non-edges. Moreover, 80.8% and 84.6% of these false positives receive verbalized confidence of at least 80%, revealing substantial overconfidence in structurally incorrect predictions. (iii) Conventional confidence estimates are unreliable, whereas agreement offers a more promising signal. Logit-based confidence frequently collapses near 1.0 regardless of correctness, while cross-prompt and cross-model agreement achieve better mean calibration and discrimination, though their advantages are not statistically significant after Holm correction. A benchmark-familiarity audit further identifies potential familiarity in five model-dataset pairs, all involving AsiaM. Overall, our results suggest LLMs are better viewed as sources of externally validated soft causal priors than as direct evidence of causal structure.

AI.title_translation: 从因果合理性到因果可靠性：评估大语言模型作为校准的直接因果边分类器
AI.tldr: 论文系统评估了大语言模型在因果边分类中的表现，发现其存在严重过度自信、混淆间接因果关系以及高召回率偏好等问题，因而不宜直接作为因果结构的证据，而更适合作为软因果先验。
AI.motivation: 大模型虽常被用于为结构因果发现提供先验因果知识，但其直接边缘判断和置信度是否可信仍不清楚，亟需系统评估。
AI.method: 系统评估了12个指令微调的开源模型，涵盖6个基准因果图、5种提示策略以及4种置信度来源（语言表达、基于Logit、跨提示词一致性和跨模型一致性），采用语言纯文本两两判断协议。
AI.result: 研究发现LLM的因果判断具有强烈的高召回率特征（倾向于预测过于稠密的图并产生大量假阳性），常混淆间接或反向关系为直接因果边，且表现出显著的过度自信；传统置信度估计不可靠，而一致性信号在平均校准和判别上表现较好。
AI.conclusion: 大模型更适合作为经外部验证的软因果先验来源，而不应直接视为因果结构的决定性证据。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用来为结构因果发现提供先验因果知识，然而其直接边的判断和置信度是否值得信赖仍不清楚。我们系统评估了12个指令微调的开源模型，涵盖6个基准因果图、5种提示策略以及4种置信度来源：语言表达、基于logit、跨提示词一致性和跨模型一致性。在我们的纯语言两两判断协议下，评估得出了三个主要发现。(i) 基于LLM的因果判断具有强烈的召回率主导特征：模型倾向于预测具有许多假阳性边缘的过于稠密的图，而提示主要改变精确率-召回率的权衡，而不能解决过度预测问题。模型规模带来的收益在最大图上递减，且并未消除校准偏差。(ii) LLM往往能捕捉到因果相关性，但却无法可靠地识别直接性或方向性。相对于公开的参考图，模型将40.0%的间接非边和36.0%的反向非边误分类为直接边，而其他非边的误分类率为28.2%。此外，这些假阳性中有80.8%和84.6%获得了至少80%的语言表达置信度，这揭示了模型对结构错误预测的严重过度自信。(iii) 传统的置信度估计不可靠，而一致性则提供了一个更有前景的信号。基于logit的置信度无论正确与否经常崩溃接近1.0，而跨提示词和跨模型的一致性实现了更好的平均校准和判别，尽管在Holm校正后其优势并不具有统计显著性。基准熟悉度审计进一步识别出5个模型-数据集对中的潜在熟悉度，均涉及AsiaM。总体而言，我们的结果表明，将LLM视为经过外部验证的软因果先验来源，要比将其视为因果结构的直接证据更为合适。
AI.summary: 该论文系统评估了大语言模型（LLMs）作为校准直接因果边分类器的性能，发现在无图像/数值干预的纯语言协议下，LLMs表现出高召回率、难以区分直接与间接/反向关系，并且对错误预测高度自信。传统置信度估计不可靠，表明LLM更宜作软因果先验而非直接的因果结构证据。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 因果发现, 因果可靠性, 不确定性校准, 提示词策略
AI.comments: 该论文深入评估了大语言模型在直接因果边分类中的可靠性和校准性，揭示了其在因果发现中存在的高召回率偏好、对间接/反向关系的误判以及严重过度自信等问题，为理解大模型在因果推理中的局限性提供了重要视角。

title: Confidently Wrong, Silently So: Auditing Undetectable Failures of a Deployed On-Device Language Model
summary: Aligning deployed language models requires knowing when their outputs can be trusted, yet on-device models now ship to hundreds of millions of devices with no server-side moderation, and the configuration developers can actually deploy is rarely audited independently. We present a reproducible reliability audit of the developer-accessible on-device foundation model, framed as an oversight question: can a user or a resource-constrained developer tell when the model is wrong? Red-teaming it on calibration, confident confabulation on false-premise questions, and over-refusal of benign prompts, we find a \emph{task-asymmetric miscalibration}: its guardrails fail in opposite directions across tasks (confabulating on 69\% of false premises while refusing 18\% of entirely benign inputs), atop a self-reported confidence that is saturated and non-discriminative (AUROC 0.47; ECE 70, worst among comparable small models). Crucially, confident-correct and confident-wrong outputs are \emph{surface-indistinguishable}: a classifier over 15 user-visible features separates them at AUROC only 0.55 (equivalence-confirmed), leaving no signal for oversight at inference time. No cheap single-generation signal flags these failures ($\le$0.68 AUROC), whereas a black-box consistency wrapper requiring no model access recovers reliability (confident confabulation 75\%$\to$3\%; selective accuracy 43\%$\to$83\%) at a tunable cost. We contribute a model-agnostic audit protocol, a surface-indistinguishability test, and released code and frozen evaluation items as reusable infrastructure for auditing deployed models.

AI.title_translation: 自信而错误，且悄无声息：审计已部署端侧语言模型的不可检测失效
AI.tldr: 端侧大模型在输出错误时往往表现得极度自信且表面上无法与正确输出区分，但可以通过黑盒一致性包装器有效纠正。
AI.motivation: 当前的端侧语言模型在大规模部署时缺乏服务端审核，开发者和用户无法有效判断其实际输出是否可信，且缺乏针对端侧部署配置的独立审计，因此迫切需要研究端侧模型的不可检测失效（undetectable failures）。
AI.method: 对开发者可访问的端侧基础模型进行了可复现的可靠性审计，采用红蓝对抗测试（red-teaming）评估校准、虚假前提问题上的自信瞎编（confident confabulation）以及良性提示词的过度拒绝（over-refusal）；构建分类器检测用户可见特征；并提出了一种无需模型访问的黑盒一致性包装器（consistency wrapper）。
AI.result: 模型表现出任务不对称的错误校准（对69%的错误前提进行胡编，对18%的良性输入进行拒绝），其自报置信度饱和且无区分度（AUROC 0.47）；自信正确和自信错误的输出在表面上无法区分（AUROC 0.55）；而黑盒一致性包装器能显著降低自信瞎编（75%降至3%）并提高选择性准确率（43%升至83%）。
AI.conclusion: 端侧大模型存在严重的、难以察觉的失效模式（如高置信度胡编与过度拒绝），表面特征无法区分正确与错误；但通过轻量级的黑盒一致性包装器，可以在不访问模型内部的情况下有效恢复其可靠性。
AI.translation: 对齐已部署的语言模型需要知道何时可以信任它们的输出，然而当前的端侧模型在没有服务端审核的情况下被运送到数亿台设备上，开发者实际部署的配置也很少受到独立审计。我们对开发者可访问的端侧基础模型进行了可复现的可靠性审计，其核心监督问题是：用户或资源受限的开发者能否在模型出错时识别出来？通过对校准、虚假前提问题上的自信瞎编以及良性提示词的过度拒绝进行红蓝对抗测试，我们发现了一种“任务不对称的错误校准”：其护栏在不同任务上向相反方向失效（在69%的假前提上胡编，同时拒绝18%的完全良性输入），并且其自报置信度处于饱和状态且无区分度（AUROC 0.47；ECE 70，在可比的小模型中最差）。至关重要的是，自信正确和自信错误的输出在“表面上是无法区分的”：基于15个用户可见特征的分类器区分它们的AUROC仅为 0.55（经等效性证实），这使得推理时的监督信号荡然无存。没有任何廉价的单次生成信号能够标记这些失效（AUROC $\le$ 0.68），而一个不需要模型访问权限的黑盒一致性包装器则可以恢复可靠性（自信胡编从75%降至3%；选择性准确率从43%提升至83%），且成本可调。我们贡献了一个与模型无关的审计协议、一个表面不可区分性测试，并开源了代码和冻结的评估项目，作为审计已部署模型的可复用基础设施。
AI.summary: 该论文对部署的端侧语言模型进行了可靠性审计，发现其存在高置信度胡编、过度拒绝以及错误输出表面无法区分的问题，同时验证了通过黑盒一致性包装器可以有效解决这些可靠性缺陷。
AI.keywords: 端侧大模型, 模型审计, 校准, 不确定性估计, 黑盒一致性
AI.comments: 该论文切中当前大模型端侧部署（on-device）的热点，深入剖析了端侧模型在校准、拒绝机制以及置信度方面的严重缺陷，特别指出了“自信且错误”的输出与正确输出在表面特征上无法区分（surface-indistinguishable）的痛点，并提出了高效的黑盒一致性包装器解决方案，具有很高的实用价值和可复现性。

title: Scaling Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Models via Velocity Matching
summary: Reward fine-tuning is becoming an important tool for adapting diffusion models to human preferences and task-specific objectives, but existing methods largely inherit policy-gradient machinery from large language models. Unlike autoregressive models, diffusion models do not provide tractable likelihoods for generated samples. As a result, current approaches either construct trajectory likelihoods from stochastic denoising transitions or approximate endpoint likelihoods with evidence lower bound, introducing additional computation and algorithmic complexity. We demonstrate that this likelihood-based machinery is not necessary for effective diffusion reward fine-tuning. We propose reward-based velocity matching (RVM), a simple trajectory-free update that acts directly on the velocity field. RVM reinforces directions associated with high-reward generations, suppresses those with low reward, and involves an optional anchor term controlling drift from a reference velocity. Notably, it provides a general framework that recovers recent fine-tuning methods, including RAM and DiffusionNFT, as special cases. Across various large-scale diffusion models reward fine-tuning tasks, RVM is competitive with or outperforms trajectory-based policy-gradient methods under substantially reduced training cost. We further find that, once the velocity update is simplified, the particular loss variant matters less than reward and anchor design. For video generation, standard preference rewards can favor visually clean but nearly static outputs; introducing a new dynamic-tracking reward that substantially improve motions while improving overall VBench performance. These results suggest that scalable reward fine-tuning for diffusion models is better posed in the native velocity representation than as likelihood-based policy optimization.

AI.title_translation: 通过速度匹配扩展扩散模型的强化学习
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为RVM的无轨迹速度匹配方法，摆脱了扩散模型奖励微调对似然估计的依赖，大幅降低了计算成本并提升了微调效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散模型奖励微调方法大多继承自大语言模型的策略梯度机制，依赖于构建轨迹似然或近似端点似然，这带来了额外的计算和算法复杂性。因此，需要探索一种摆脱似然机制的高效微调方法。
AI.method: 提出奖励基速度匹配（RVM），这是一种无需轨迹的更新方法，直接对速度场进行操作：强化高奖励生成的方向，抑制低奖励方向，并引入可选的锚点项来控制与参考速度的偏移。
AI.result: 在各种大规模扩散模型奖励微调任务中，RVM在大幅降低训练成本的同时，表现出与基于轨迹的策略梯度方法相当或更好的性能；同时引入的动态追踪奖励显著改善了视频生成的运动效果并提升了整体VBench性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将扩散模型的奖励微调表述为原生速度场的匹配，RVM提供了一种更简单、高效且统一的框架，证明了扩散模型的强化学习无需依赖复杂的似然机制。
AI.translation: 奖励微调正在成为将扩散模型适应人类偏好和任务特定目标的重要工具，但现有方法在很大程度上继承了大语言模型的策略梯度机制。与自回归模型不同，扩散模型不为生成的样本提供易处理的似然。因此，当前的方法要么从随机去噪过渡中构建轨迹似然，要么用证据下界近似端点似然，这引入了额外的计算和算法复杂度。我们证明，这种基于似然的机制对于有效的扩散奖励微调并不是必需的。我们提出了奖励基速度匹配（RVM），这是一种直接作用于速度场的简单、无轨迹的更新方法。RVM强化与高奖励生成相关的方向，抑制低奖励方向，并包含一个可选的锚点项来控制与参考速度的漂移。值得注意的是，它提供了一个通用的框架，将最近的微调方法（包括RAM和DiffusionNFT）作为特例恢复。在各种大规模扩散模型奖励微调任务中，RVM在大幅降低训练成本的情况下，与基于轨迹的策略梯度方法具有竞争力或更胜一筹。我们进一步发现，一旦速度更新简化，特定的损失变体的重要性就不如奖励和锚点设计。对于视频生成，标准的偏好奖励可能会倾向于视觉上干净但几乎静态的输出；引入一种新的动态-追踪奖励，在提高整体VBench性能的同时显著改善了运动效果。这些结果表明，扩散模型的可扩展奖励微调最好在原生速度表示中进行，而不是作为基于似然的策略优化。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了奖励基速度匹配（RVM）方法，这是一种直接作用于扩散模型速度场的简单、无轨迹的更新机制，无需依赖复杂的似然计算，实现了高效且具竞争力的奖励微调。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 强化学习, 奖励微调, 速度匹配, 视频生成
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地跳出了传统依赖似然估计的策略梯度框架，直接在扩散模型的原生速度场上进行奖励微调（RVM），不仅大幅降低了计算和算法复杂度，还展现出更优或同等的性能。此外，论文针对视频生成提出了动态追踪奖励，具有很强的实用价值。

title: Gated Activation Steering for Reducing Sycophancy & Hallucination in Medical Question Answering
summary: Sycophancy and hallucination are persistent failure modes of Large Language Models (LLMs) across domains. However, it becomes particularly consequential in clinical question answering, where responses must remain grounded in the provided context and robust to user pressure. Hallucination can introduce information that is unsupported by the context, while sycophancy can cause a model to abandon a previously correct answer when challenged by the user. Existing approaches, such as prompt-based safeguards and always-on activation steering, often address these behaviors separately or apply interventions broadly across turns, which can unnecessarily deteriorate responses that were already correct. To address these limitations within a single framework, we employ Inference Time Intervention (ITI) to jointly control both behaviors by learning separate steering directions for hallucination and sycophancy from contrastive clinical pairs and applying them to causally verified attention heads. During runtime, behavior-specific gates then determine when intervention is needed: the hallucination component mitigates unsupported claims, while the sycophancy component mitigates answer shifts caused by user pressure. We evaluate this framework on clinical questions grounded in EHR data while keeping the model weights frozen. Across all evaluation settings, we conducted 15,900 model-response runs. Across 600 pressure trajectories for the 4-billion-parameter model, the unsteered model caved in 570 cases. At the same time, gated steering helped it last longer in 551 of them. It held its ground under pressure at levels comparable to those of models with more than 100 billion parameters, showing that targeted inference-time steering can improve robustness without intervening at every turn.

AI.title_translation: 门控激活转向在医学问答中减少谄媚和幻觉
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种门控激活转向（Gated Activation Steering）框架，通过推理时干预（ITI）联合减少大型语言模型在医学问答中的谄媚和幻觉，显著提高了模型在用户压力下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在医学问答中存在谄媚（sycophancy）和幻觉（hallucination）等失败模式，这在需要响应基于上下文且对用户压力鲁棒的临床场景中尤为严重。现有方法往往单独处理或广泛干预，可能不必要地降低正确响应的质量。
AI.method: 该研究采用推理时干预（ITI）框架，通过从对比性临床配对中学习幻觉和谄媚的独立转向方向，并将其应用于因果验证的注意力头，以联合控制这两种行为。在运行时，行为特定的门控机制决定何时进行干预：幻觉组件减轻无根据的主张，谄媚组件减轻用户压力导致的答案改变。
AI.result: 在所有评估设置中进行了15,900次模型响应运行。对于40亿参数模型，在600个压力轨迹中，未经转向的模型在570个案例中屈服，而门控转向在其中551个案例中帮助模型坚持更长时间。它在压力下的表现与拥有超过1000亿参数的模型相当。
AI.conclusion: 门控激活转向提供了一种在不干预每个轮次的情况下，通过有针对性的推理时转向来提高大型语言模型在医学问答中鲁棒性的有效方法，显著减少了谄媚和幻觉。
AI.translation: 谄媚和幻觉是大型语言模型（LLMs）在各个领域中普遍存在的失败模式。然而，这在临床问答中变得尤为重要，因为响应必须以提供的上下文为基础，并对用户压力保持鲁棒性。幻觉会引入不受上下文支持的信息，而谄媚可能导致模型在受到用户质疑时放弃之前正确的答案。现有方法，如基于提示的防护措施和始终开启的激活转向，通常单独解决这些行为或在整个轮次中广泛应用干预措施，这可能会不必要地损害已经正确的响应。为了在单一框架内解决这些局限性，我们采用推理时干预（ITI）来共同控制这两种行为，通过从对比性临床配对中学习幻觉和谄媚的独立转向方向，并将其应用于因果验证的注意力头。在运行时，行为特定的门控机制决定何时需要干预：幻觉组件减轻不受支持的主张，而谄媚组件减轻由用户压力引起的答案改变。我们在基于电子健康记录（EHR）数据的临床问题上评估了这一框架，同时保持模型权重冻结。在所有评估设置中，我们进行了15,900次模型响应运行。对于40亿参数模型，在600个压力轨迹中，未经转向的模型在570个案例中屈服。与此同时，门控转向在其中551个案例中帮助模型坚持更长时间。它在压力下的表现与拥有超过1000亿参数的模型相当，表明有针对性的推理时转向可以在不干预每个轮次的情况下提高鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种门控激活转向框架，通过推理时干预（ITI）来联合解决大型语言模型在医学问答中普遍存在的谄媚和幻觉问题。该方法通过学习针对幻觉和谄媚的独立转向方向，并结合行为特定的门控机制，在运行时仅在必要时进行干预。实验结果表明，该方法显著提高了模型在用户压力下的鲁棒性，使其在减少谄媚方面的表现与参数量大得多的模型相当，从而在不损害正确响应的前提下，有效提升了医学问答的可靠性。
AI.keywords: 门控激活转向, 谄媚, 幻觉, 医学问答, 推理时干预
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于提出了一个统一的框架，通过门控机制实现行为特异性的推理时干预，有效解决了LLMs在医学问答中的谄媚和幻觉问题。其重要性在于，在不修改模型权重或进行广泛干预的情况下，显著提升了模型在关键医疗场景中的可靠性和鲁棒性，尤其是在用户压力下保持答案一致性方面表现出色。

title: Automata from Agent Traces: Failure and Next-Step Prediction
summary: LLM-based agents execute multi-step tasks, but their behavioral structure remains opaque: long unstructured traces resist the safety auditing and runtime monitoring that deployment requires. Existing approaches operate per-trace or success-only, so they miss the cross-run topology that links next-step and failure prediction. To recover that shared structure, we collapse an entire trace corpus into a single, compact finite-state machine (FSM) that serves as a structural substrate for the otherwise unpredictable behavior of LLM agents. Across twelve public datasets, the FSMs are compact (7-43 states), replay held-out data at >=0.997 fitness with near-identical topology across splits, and build in milliseconds. This substrate addresses both prediction goals. For next-step prediction, FSM-state context outperforms Agent Workflow Memory on every ground-truth-matched dataset. For failure prediction, per-state behavioral features reach held-out AUROC up to 0.94, and an online monitor ranks failing runs above passing ones from a partial trace, triggering early stopping well before completion. Behavioral topology thus appears shaped more by the deployment harness than by the LLM, providing a model-agnostic structural primitive for safety auditing and runtime monitoring.

AI.title_translation: 基于智能体轨迹的自动机：故障与下一步预测
AI.tldr: 本文提出将LLM智能体轨迹压缩为紧凑的有限状态机（FSM），从而实现高效的下一步预测、故障预测以及安全的运行时监控。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的智能体执行多步骤任务，但其行为结构不透明，长而不结构化的轨迹阻碍了安全审计和运行时监控；现有方法多为按轨迹或仅关注成功情况，忽略了跨运行的拓扑结构。
AI.method: 将整个轨迹语料库压缩为单个紧凑的有限状态机（FSM），利用FSM状态上下文进行下一步预测，并提取每个状态的 behavioral 特征用于故障预测和在线监控。
AI.result: 在12个公共数据集上，FSM表现出极高的紧凑性（7-43个状态）、极佳的拟合度（>=0.997），在下一步预测中超越了Agent Workflow Memory，在故障预测中达到了高达0.94的AUROC，并能通过在线监控实现早期停止。
AI.conclusion: 通过将智能体轨迹崩溃压缩为紧凑的FSM，能够有效捕捉跨运行拓扑结构，从而实现高效的下一步预测和故障预测，为LLM智能体的安全部署和运行时监控提供了强有力的原语支持。
AI.translation: 基于LLM的智能体执行多步骤任务，但其行为结构仍然不透明：长且无结构化的轨迹阻碍了部署所需的安全性审计和运行时监控。现有的方法按轨迹或仅针对成功情况进行操作，因此它们错过了连接下一步预测和故障预测的跨运行拓扑结构。为了恢复这种共享结构，我们将整个轨迹语料库折叠成一个单一的、紧凑的有限状态机（FSM），它作为LLM智能体不可预测行为的结构基底。在十二个公共数据集上，FSM是紧凑的（7-43个状态），以>=0.997的适应度重放保留数据，跨分割具有近乎相同的拓扑结构，并且在毫秒内构建完成。该基底满足了两个预测目标。对于下一步预测，FSM状态上下文在每个真实匹配的数据集上都优于Agent Workflow Memory。对于故障预测，每个状态的行为特征在保留数据上的AUROC高达0.94，在线监视器从部分轨迹中将失败运行排在通过运行之前，在完成之前触发早期停止。因此，行为拓扑似乎比LLM受部署工具的影响更大，为安全审计和运行时监控提供了与模型无关的结构原语。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种从LLM智能体轨迹中提取有限状态机（FSM）的方法，用于解决行为不透明和预测困难的问题。该方法通过将轨迹压缩为紧凑的FSM，不仅能高精度地进行下一步预测和故障预测，还为智能体的安全审计和实时监控提供了模型无关的结构化原语。
AI.keywords: LLM智能体, 有限状态机, 轨迹分析, 故障预测, 运行时监控
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的方法，将复杂的LLM智能体轨迹压缩为紧凑的有限状态机（FSM），不仅在性能上超越了现有方法，还为大模型智能体的安全审计和实时监控提供了可靠的结构化基底，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Autonomous Mathematical Discovery in an Open-World Multi-Agent Environment
comments: 38 pages, 12 figures, 3 tables. Source code at https://github.com/dualverse-ai/station and raw agent dialogues, proofs, and verification artifacts at https://github.com/dualverse-ai/station_data_v2
summary: We study autonomous mathematical discovery in the Station, an open-world multi-agent environment in which AI agents from different model families pursue a shared research goal without a central coordinator or scripted pipeline. Agents choose their own research directions, conduct experiments, collaborate, and build a shared scientific literature. Across 12 construction problems from the AlphaEvolve catalogue and two additional case studies, the Station obtained results novel relative to the prior literature on five problems: a new infinite family of finite-field Kakeya sets, new exact 604-point kissing configurations in dimension 11, new records for the discretized Kakeya needle and sign uncertainty problems, and a substantially improved lower bound for Erdős's minimum-overlap problem. Agents also discovered novel infinite families for Book Ramsey numbers. Importantly, the agents produced not only numerical constructions but also theorems and analyses explaining how those constructions work, making the results more interpretable and easier for mathematicians to build upon. We release all raw agent dialogues, proofs, and verification code, providing a transparent record of how these discoveries emerged.
comment: 38 pages, 12 figures, 3 tables. Source code at https://github.com/dualverse-ai/station and raw agent dialogues, proofs, and verification artifacts at https://github.com/dualverse-ai/station_data_v2

AI.title_translation: 开放世界多智能体环境中的自主数学发现
AI.tldr: 本文展示了多智能体AI在无中心协调的开放环境中自主进行数学研究，成功取得了多项超越现有文献的新数学发现和可解释证明。
AI.motivation: 研究如何在没有中央协调或预设脚本的情况下，利用开放世界中的多智能体环境实现AI的自主数学发现。
AI.method: 在名为Station的开放世界多智能体环境中，不同模型系列的AI agents在没有中央协调器或脚本化管道的情况下，自主选择研究方向、进行实验、合作并构建共享的科学文献。
AI.result: 在12个构造问题和2个案例研究中，AI在5个问题上获得了超越以往文献的新结果，包括有限域Kakeya集的新的无穷族、11维中新的确切604点接触构型、离散Kakeya针和符号不确定性问题的新纪录，以及Erdős最小重叠问题的大幅改进下界，并发现了Book Ramsey数字的新无穷族。
AI.conclusion: 开放世界的多智能体环境能够有效促进AI自主进行数学发现，产出超越现有文献的新结果与可解释的理论证明。
AI.translation: 我们在Station（一个开放世界的多智能体环境）中研究了自主数学发现，其中来自不同模型系列的AI agents在没有中央协调器或脚本化管道的情况下追求共同的研究目标。Agent选择自己的研究方向、进行实验、合作并建立共享的科学文献。在AlphaEvolve目录中的12个构造问题和两个额外的案例研究中，Station在5个问题上获得了相对于现有文献而言全新的结果：有限域Kakeya集的一个新无限族、11维中新的精确604点接触构型、离散Kakeya针和符号不确定性问题的新记录，以及Erdős最小重叠问题的大幅改进下界。Agent还发现了Book Ramsey数字的新无限族。重要的是，agent不仅产生了数值构造，还产生了解释这些构造如何工作的定理和分析，使结果更具可解释性，更易于数学家在此基础上进行构建。我们发布了所有原始的agent对话、证明和验证代码，为这些发现是如何出现的提供了透明的记录。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在名为Station的开放世界多智能体环境中，AI agents如何在没有中央协调的情况下自主开展数学研究。实验表明，该系统不仅能产生数值构造，还能产出可解释的定理和分析，成功在多个数学问题上取得了超越现有文献的新成果。
AI.keywords: 自主数学发现, 多智能体环境, 开放世界, 科学研究AI, Kakeya集
AI.comments: 该论文展示了多智能体系统在开放世界中进行自主科学发现的巨大潜力，不仅超越了传统的脚本化流程，还能生成可解释的定理和证明，为AI辅助数学研究开辟了新方向。

title: Renormalization Group Flow Matching for Scalable Local Generative Modeling
summary: Despite their remarkable success in modeling complex data, generative models face a fundamental tradeoff. Global approaches can capture full structural coherence but suffer from high computational costs, while local models are efficient but often fail to reproduce long-range correlations and global coherence. The renormalization group (RG) bridges this gap by seamlessly connecting spatial structures across different length scales, retaining quasi-local descriptions at each step while preserving long-range correlations. We introduce renormalization group flow matching (RGFM), a generative framework that systematically structures data generation across different spatial scales. By using an exact RG flow as the probability path, RGFM progressively generates data from long- to short-wavelength structures. To reconcile scalability with global structure, we exploit two key properties of the RG: quasi-locality and scale separation. We rigorously show that the RGFM probability flow can be accurately approximated by local velocity fields acting over a spatial range $O(Λ^{-1}[\ln L+\ln(1/\varepsilon)])$ for RG wavenumber scale $Λ$, linear system size $L$, and prescribed error tolerance $\varepsilon$. This property enables local generative modeling with patches of size $O(\ln L)$ and a computational cost that scales nearly linearly with the system volume. We numerically demonstrate that local RGFM reproduces long-range correlations far beyond its receptive field in representative one-dimensional distributions, while conventional local flow matching exhibits substantial errors at long distances. On FFHQ images, RGFM yields far more coherent and higher-quality samples than local flow matching at 64x64 and 256x256. Our results establish RG-guided probability flows as a promising route toward scalable generative modeling that captures long-range structure using only local computation.

AI.title_translation: 用于可扩展局部生成建模的重正化群流匹配
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于重正化群的流匹配生成模型（RGFM），仅通过局部计算即可高效生成具有全局长程相关性的高质量数据。
AI.motivation: 现有的生成模型在全局方法（计算成本高）和局部方法（无法捕捉长程相关性和全局一致性）之间面临基本权衡，而物理学中的重正化群（RG）能够桥梁这一鸿沟，因此需要开发一种结合RG的可扩展局部生成建模框架。
AI.method: 引入重正化群流匹配（RGFM）框架，将精确的RG流作为概率路径，从长波到短波结构逐步生成数据，并利用RG的准局域性和尺度分离性质，通过局部速度场实现高效的局部生成建模。
AI.result: 理论上证明了RGFM概率流可以用近乎线性的计算成本和局部的感受野（O(\ln L)大小的切片）进行近似；在一维分布和FFHQ图像（64x64和256x256）的数值实验中，RGFM比传统局部流匹配表现出更好的长程相关性和更高质量的样本生成能力。
AI.conclusion: RGFM通过结合重正化群与流匹配，成功实现了仅需局部计算即可捕捉全局长程相关性的可扩展生成建模。
AI.translation: 尽管生成模型在建模复杂数据方面取得了显著成功，但它们面临着一个基本的权衡。全局方法可以捕捉完整的结构一致性，但计算成本高昂，而局部模型虽然高效，却往往无法重现长程相关性和全局一致性。重正化群（RG）通过无缝连接不同长度尺度的空间结构，在每一步保留准局域描述的同时保持长程相关性，从而弥补了这一差距。我们引入了重正化群流匹配（RGFM），这是一种系统性地构建跨不同空间尺度的的数据生成框架。通过使用精确的RG流作为概率路径，RGFM从长波到短波结构逐步生成数据。为了将可扩展性与全局结构协调起来，我们利用了RG的两个关键属性：准局域性和尺度分离。我们严格证明了RGFM概率流可以由在空间范围 $O(Λ^{-1}[\ln L+\ln(1/\varepsilon)])$ 内作用的局部速度场进行精确近似，其中 $Λ$ 为RG波数尺度，$L$ 为线性系统大小，$\varepsilon$ 为规定的误差容限。这一属性使得局部生成建模能够使用大小为 $O(\ln L)$ 的切片，且计算成本随系统体积呈近线性扩展。我们从数值上证明，在具有代表性的一维分布中，局部RGFM能够重现远远超出其感受野的长程相关性，而传统的局部流匹配在远距离处表现出巨大的误差。在FFHQ图像上，RGFM在64x64和256x256分辨率下产生了比局部流匹配更加一致和更高质量的样本。我们的结果确立了RG引导的概率流作为实现可扩展生成建模的有前途的途径，该建模仅使用局部计算即可捕获长程结构。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了重正化群流匹配（RGFM）框架，利用重正化群理论的准局域性和尺度分离性质，实现了从长波到短波的多尺度数据生成，在保持近线性计算复杂度的同时能够有效捕捉长程相关性和生成高质量图像。
AI.keywords: 重正化群, 流匹配, 生成模型, 局部建模, 长程相关性
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地将物理学中的重正化群（RG）理论与现代生成模型的Flow Matching相结合，解决了传统局部生成模型无法捕捉长程相关性的痛点，在理论和实验上都展示了巨大的扩展潜力和优越性。

title: The Limits of Automatic Evaluation of Creativity in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly capable of generating text that challenges human performance in domains requiring creativity, yet evaluating creativity in LLM-generated content remains a significant challenge. Here, we investigate whether current automatic evaluation methods can reliably capture human judgments of creativity. We collect human evaluations of human- and AI-generated short stories from the WritingPrompts dataset across 11 dimensions of creativity, and compare these judgments with automated objective metrics and LLM-as-a-Judge evaluations. Our experiments reveal substantial misalignment between automatic evaluations and human assessments. In particular, LLM-based judges exhibit a systematic preference for AI-generated stories, consistently favoring their stylistic characteristics over the unpredictability and other qualities of human-authored texts. Furthermore, correlation analyses show that widely used automatic metrics exhibit near-zero alignment with human judgments across both human- and AI-generated stories, suggesting that they fail to capture important dimensions of creativity. These findings highlight fundamental limitations in current approaches to the automatic evaluation of creative text and underscore the difficulty of reducing the multidimensional and subjective nature of creativity to computational metrics.

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型中创造力自动评估的局限性
AI.tldr: 目前的自动化评估方法和LLM评委无法可靠地反映人类对文本创造力的判断，且对AI生成的内容存在系统性偏见，难以捕捉创造力的多维和主观特性。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型在创造性领域的应用增加，评估LLM生成内容中的创造力变得极具挑战性，本文旨在研究当前的自动评估方法是否能可靠地捕捉人类对创造力的判断。
AI.method: 收集了人类对WritingPrompts数据集中人类和AI生成的短文在11个创造力维度上的评估，并将这些评估与自动客观指标及LLM-as-a-Judge评估进行比较和相关性分析。
AI.result: 自动评估与人类评估之间存在显着的不对齐；LLM评委对AI生成的文本存在系统性偏见，偏爱其文体特征而非人类文本的不可预测性；传统自动指标与人类判断的相关性接近于零。
AI.conclusion: 当前的自动化评估方法（包括传统客观指标和LLM-as-a-Judge）无法可靠地捕捉人类对文本创造力的判断，创造力的多维和主观特性难以简化为现有的计算指标。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）日益展现出生成挑战人类表现的创造性文本的能力，然而评估LLM生成内容中的创造力仍然是一个重大挑战。在本文中，我们探讨了当前的自动评估方法是否能够可靠地捕捉人类对创造力的判断。我们收集了人类对WritingPrompts数据集中人类和AI生成的短篇小说在11个创造力维度上的评估，并将这些判断与自动化客观指标及LLM-as-a-Judge评估进行了比较。我们的实验揭示了自动评估与人类评估之间存在实质性的不对齐。特别是，基于LLM的评委对AI生成的故事表现出系统性的偏好，始终偏爱其风格特征，而不是人类创作文本的不可预测性等品质。此外，相关性分析表明，广泛使用的自动指标在人类和AI生成的故事中与人类判断表现出接近于零的一致性，这表明它们未能捕捉到创造力的重要维度。这些发现突显了当前创造性文本自动评估方法的根本局限性，并强调了将创造力的多维和主观性质简化为计算指标的难度。
AI.summary: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）中创造力的自动评估方法及其局限性。通过对比人类评估与自动化指标及LLM评委的结果，发现自动评估方法与人类判断存在严重偏差，传统指标相关性接近零，LLM评委则系统性地偏爱AI生成的文本特征。这凸显了将创造力这一多维、主观概念转化为计算指标的巨大挑战。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 创造力评估, 自动评估, 人类判断, 偏差分析
AI.comments: 该论文揭示了当前大语言模型创造力自动评估方法的根本局限性，指出了自动指标与人类判断的巨大偏差以及LLM评委的偏见，对未来构建更贴近人类直觉的创造力评估体系具有重要警示意义。

title: Do LLMs Understand Limit Order Book Dynamics?
summary: A large language model (LLM) trained on synthetic limit order book (LOB) data achieves near perfect scores in generating valid sequences of LOB events. However, the LLM's implicit world model fails to learn the state of the LOB. This deficiency leads to biased estimates and spurious predictability in using the LLM to forecast future LOB events. Our analysis uses novel tests of an LLM's world model, extending prior work from deterministic settings to the stochastic dynamics needed for the LOB.

AI.title_translation: 大语言模型理解限价订单簿的动态机制吗？
AI.tldr: 大语言模型虽能生成有效的限价订单簿（LOB）事件序列，但并未真正理解LOB的状态，导致其未来事件预测存在偏差和虚假性。
AI.motivation: 探究在大规模合成限价订单簿（LOB）数据上训练的大语言模型是否真正理解LOB的动态机制及其内部状态。
AI.method: 通过在合成的限价订单簿（LOB）数据上训练大语言模型，并利用针对LOB随机动态特征的新颖测试方法来评估其隐式世界模型。
AI.result: 在合成LOB数据上训练的LLM虽然能生成有效的事件序列，但其内部世界模型未能学到LOB的状态，从而在预测未来事件时导致了有偏的估计和虚假的预测性。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型在生成LOB事件序列时表现出色，但由于缺乏对LOB真实状态的理解，其预测能力存在偏差和虚假可预测性。
AI.translation: 在合成限价订单簿（LOB）数据上训练的大语言模型（LLM）在生成有效的LOB事件序列方面取得了近乎完美的成绩。然而，LLM的隐式世界模型未能学习到LOB的状态。这种缺陷导致在使用LLM预测未来LOB事件时产生有偏的估计和虚假的预测性。我们的分析采用了对LLM世界模型的新颖测试，将先前的工作从确定性环境扩展到LOB所需的随机动态。
AI.summary: 该研究考察了大语言模型（LLM）对限价订单簿（LOB）动态的理解能力。研究发现，虽然LLM在生成有效的LOB事件序列方面得分极高，但它们并未能学习到LOB的真实状态，这导致在使用LLM预测未来事件时产生偏差和虚假预测。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 限价订单簿, 世界模型, 金融预测, 动态随机系统
AI.comments: 这篇论文揭示了大语言模型在金融领域应用的一个重要盲区：尽管它们能够生成看似合理的限价订单簿（LOB）事件序列，但并未真正理解其背后的动态机制和状态，导致预测结果出现偏差。这对审慎评估大模型在金融交易中的应用具有重要的警示意义。

title: Integer Natural Evolution Strategies
summary: While contemporary Evolution Strategies handle integer optimization problems effectively, their adaptation mechanism is grounded in $\ell_2$-based Gaussian models, which are not native to the integer lattice. In contrast, the $\ell_1$-norm provides the natural measure of displacement on $\mathbb{Z}^n$, with the double geometric distribution as its canonical mutation operator. In this work, we derive a fully $\ell_1$-native step-size adaptation mechanism from first principles and propose an Integer Natural Evolution Strategy. We show that the DG distribution belongs to the exponential family, and that its sufficient statistic $|z|$ yields a natural-gradient signal for dispersion adaptation. By accumulating this signal via an evolution path, we obtain a fading-memory online estimator of the natural gradient, following Ollivier (2018). This establishes that DG-based step-size adaptation arises directly from the statistical structure of the mutation distribution, rather than as a discrete analog of continuous ES mechanisms. Empirical results on integer quadratic benchmarks show that \textsc{INES} learns meaningful coordinate-wise step-sizes and is competitive with integer-handling CMA-ES baselines. Its advantages are most visible in high-dimensional Ellipsoidal problems and in robust convergence at larger dimensions.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于L1范数和双几何分布的整数自然演化策略（INES），实现了原生且高效的整数优化步长自适应。
AI.motivation: 现有的演化策略处理整数优化问题时，依赖于基于L2范数的传统高斯模型，这并非整数格点上的原生度量，导致步长自适应机制缺乏理论上的契合性。
AI.method: 提出整数自然演化策略（INES），推导了基于L1范数和双几何分布（DG）的完全原生步长自适应机制，利用充分统计量和演化路径构建自然梯度的衰减记忆在线估计器。
AI.result: 在整数二次基准测试中，INES能够学习到有意义的坐标步长，并在高维椭球问题以及更大维度的稳健收敛性上展现出明显的优势，表现与处理整数的CMA-ES基线相当。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出的整数自然演化策略（INES）成功建立了基于L1范数和双几何分布的原生步长自适应机制，并通过实验验证了其在高维整数优化问题上的有效性和竞争力。
AI.translation: 尽管当代演化策略能有效地处理整数优化问题，但它们的自适应机制基于$\ell_2$范数的的高斯模型，这并非整数格点所原生的。相比之下，$\ell_1$范数提供了 $\mathbb{Z}^n$ 上位移的自然度量，其典范突变算子为双几何分布。在这项工作中，我们从第一原理推导出了一个完全基于 $\ell_1$ 原生的步长自适应机制，并提出了整数自然演化策略（Integer Natural Evolution Strategy）。我们证明了双几何分布属于指数族，其充分统计量 $|z|$ 产生了用于分散自适应的自然梯度信号。通过通过演化路径累积该信号，我们根据 Ollivier (2018) 获得了自然梯度的衰减记忆在线估计器。这确立了基于 DG 的步长自适应直接源于突变分布的统计结构，而不是作为连续 ES 机制的离散模拟。在整数二次基准测试上的实验结果表明，\textsc{INES} 能够学习到有意义的坐标步长，并且在处理整数的 CMA-ES 基线具有竞争力。其优势在高维椭球问题以及更大维度的稳健收敛性中最为明显。
AI.summary: 该论文针对整数优化问题提出了一种整数自然演化策略（INES）。不同于将连续高斯模型应用于离散问题的传统方法，该方法采用L1范数和双几何分布作为原生突变算子，并从第一原理推导出了基于自然梯度的步长自适应机制，实验证明了其在高维问题上的优越性能。
AI.keywords: 整数优化, 演化策略, 双几何分布, 自然梯度, L1范数
AI.comments: 该论文针对整数优化问题，摒弃了传统的基于L2范数和高斯模型的连续演化策略离散化做法，首次基于L1范数和双几何分布（DG）从第一原理推导出了完全原生的整数自然演化策略。方法论严谨，通过自然梯度和演化路径实现步长自适应，在整数二次基准测试和高维椭球问题上展现出竞争力和稳健性。

title: The least squares RBF-PU method for linear elasticity in the diaphragm geometry
summary: The human diaphragm is vital for respiration and its simulation can aid in further understanding complications arising in individuals that have been subjected to mechanical ventilation. The diaphragm geometry is very thin and hence its numerical simulation poses a challenge for most numerical methods. In this paper, we compute the deformation of real diaphragm geometries which are modelled as linearly elastic and are subject to realistic boundary conditions. The method used is the unfitted least-squares radial basis function partition of unity method, which is well suited to solve problems on thin geometries given its unfitted nature and the shape and refinement of the cylindrical patches that are used. We derive a theoretical proof showing that the method converges with high order to the solution of this problem.

AI.title_translation: 膈肌几何体线性弹性问题的最小二乘RBF-PU方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于最小二乘RBF-PU的未贴合数值方法，用于高效模拟具有薄几何特征的人体膈肌线弹性变形，并证明了其高阶收敛性。
AI.motivation: 人体膈肌对呼吸至关重要，对其进行模拟有助于理解机械通气带来的并发症。由于膈肌几何结构非常薄，传统的数值方法在模拟时面临挑战，因此需要一种更适合处理薄几何结构的方法。
AI.method: 使用未贴合的最小二乘径向基函数单位划分（RBF-PU）方法，结合圆柱形补丁的形状和细化来处理薄几何结构，并推导了理论收敛性证明。
AI.result: 成功计算了在真实边界条件下被建模为线弹性材料的真实膈肌几何体的变形，并从理论上证明了该方法具有高阶收敛性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够有效地在复杂的薄几何结构上计算线弹性变形，并从理论上证明了高阶收敛性。
AI.translation: 人体膈肌对呼吸至关重要，对其进行模拟有助于进一步理解机械通气患者所面临的并发症。膈肌几何结构非常薄，因此其数值模拟对大多数数值方法构成了挑战。在本文中，我们计算了被建模为线弹性且受真实边界条件影响的真实膈肌几何体的变形。所使用的方法是未贴合的最小二乘径向基函数单位划分方法（RBF-PU），鉴于其未贴合的性质以及所使用的圆柱形补丁的形状和细化，该方法非常适合解决薄几何结构上的问题。我们导出了一个理论证明，表明该方法以高阶收敛于该问题的解。
AI.summary: 本文针对薄且复杂的真实人体膈肌几何结构，采用未贴合的最小二乘径向基函数单位划分（RBF-PU）方法进行线性弹性变形模拟，并理论证明了该方法的高阶收敛性，为呼吸力学仿真提供了一种有效的数值工具。
AI.keywords: 最小二乘径向基函数, 单位划分法, 线性弹性, 膈肌几何, 数值模拟
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将最小二乘径向基函数单位划分（RBF-PU）方法应用到人体膈肌这一复杂的薄几何结构线性弹性模拟中，并通过理论证明了其具有高阶收敛性，对呼吸力学和机械通气研究具有重要意义。

title: ADE: Agentic Data Evolution Framework for Human-Centered Objectives
summary: Aligning large language models to human-centered objectives is difficult when targets are non-executable and context-dependent, limiting reliable verification and scalable supervision. Although synthetic data expands coverage, weak verification shifts the bottleneck from generation to selection. Noisy signals destabilize iterative refinement and can cause silent regressions. We propose Agentic Data Evolution (ADE), a data-centric framework that organizes synthetic supervision as evolving data snapshots. ADE improves data snapshots through a closed-loop Observation-Variation-Selection (OVS) procedure, where a steady-state admission mechanism acts as a quality ratchet that conservatively gates updates for sustained cross-round improvement. We validate these improvements through complementary intrinsic trend tracking and extrinsic post-training evaluation. On DEV300, ADE raises the intrinsic win rate from 50% to 75.81% and the extrinsic win rate from 55.20% to 68.86%, consistent performance gains across diverse benchmarks. Blind expert evaluation further confirms this, with a 66.11% preference for evolved answers. These gains extend across post-training methods, model scales, and tasks beyond the target weakly verifiable educational objectives. Resources are available at https://github.com/ZeroLoss-Lab/Agentic-Data-Evolution.

AI.title_translation: ADE：面向人类中心化目标的智能体数据演化框架
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为ADE的数据演化框架，通过闭环OVS过程和保守的门控机制，有效解决了大语言模型在人类中心化目标对齐中的噪声和回归问题，显著提升了模型的内在与外在表现。
AI.motivation: 当对齐目标是不可执行且依赖上下文时，对齐大语言模型（LLM）变得困难，弱验证会将瓶颈从数据生成转移到数据选择，导致噪声信号破坏迭代精炼并引发静默回归。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为Agentic Data Evolution (ADE)的数据中心化框架，通过闭环的观察-变异-选择（OVS）程序以及作为质量棘轮的稳态准入机制来优化数据快照。
AI.result: 在DEV300上，ADE将内在胜率从50%提升至75.81%，外在胜率从55.20%至68.86%；盲测专家评估显示66.11%偏好进化后的答案，且性能增益跨越多种后训练方法、模型规模和任务。
AI.conclusion: ADE框架通过数据演化和保守的门控机制，有效解决了弱验证目标下的模型对齐难题，在多个基准测试中展现出稳健的性能提升。
AI.translation: 将大语言模型对齐到人类中心化目标是困难的，因为当目标不可执行且依赖上下文时，会限制可靠的验证和可扩展的监督。尽管合成数据扩大了覆盖范围，但微弱的验证将瓶颈从生成转移到了选择。嘈杂的信号会破坏迭代精炼，并可能导致无声的回归。我们提出了Agentic Data Evolution（ADE），这是一个以数据为中心的框架，它将合成监督组织为不断演化的数据快照。ADE通过闭环的观察-变异-选择（OVS）程序改进数据快照，其中稳态准入机制充当质量棘轮，保守地门控更新以实现持续的跨轮改进。我们通过互补的内在趋势跟踪和外在后训练评估来验证这些改进。在DEV300上，ADE将内在胜率从50%提升至75.81%，外在胜率从55.20%提升至68.86%，在各种基准测试中表现出一致的性能提升。盲人专家评估进一步证实了这一点，66.11%的人更喜欢进化后的答案。这些收益扩展到超越目标弱可验证教育目标的后训练方法、模型规模和任务中。资源可在 https://github.com/ZeroLoss-Lab/Agentic-Data-Evolution 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Agentic Data Evolution（ADE）框架，通过闭环的OVS过程和稳态准入机制，以数据快照的形式演化合成监督数据，从而有效解决人类中心化非执行目标的LLM对齐难题，并在多项实验中取得显著性能提升。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 数据演化, 人类中心化目标, 智能体框架, 模型对齐
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的数据中心化智能体演化框架（ADE），通过引入闭环的OVS流程和稳态准入机制，解决了大语言模型在人类中心化目标对齐中由于弱验证导致的噪声和回归问题，具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。

title: Platonic Representation Hypothesis on World Models
comments: 18 pages, 10 figures, 2 tables. Wenhow Li and Chengwei MA contributed equally. Project page: https://sellerbubble.github.io/platonic-representation-hypothesis-on-world-models/
summary: World models have demonstrated significant potential for perceiving and simulating complex environments. Despite their strong performance, the fundamental nature of their learned representations remains poorly understood. In this paper, we investigate the Platonic Representation Hypothesis within this domain by proposing the Predictive Consistency Assumption: we posit that the optimization of a shared state transition objective acts as a selective pressure that encourages heterogeneous models to converge toward a shared latent structure. Through systematic experiments with the DINO World Model (DINO-WM), in which we vary visual encoders to create heterogeneous models, we find that capable world models evolve toward geometrically similar internal structures. Moreover, via model stitching, we show that the internal features of one world model can be mapped to another with limited performance degradation, providing evidence of functional compatibility. Our findings suggest that the pursuit of predictive consistency can promote shared, transition-compatible latent structure across world models.
comment: 18 pages, 10 figures, 2 tables. Wenhow Li and Chengwei MA contributed equally. Project page: https://sellerbubble.github.io/platonic-representation-hypothesis-on-world-models/

AI.title_translation: 世界模型上的柏拉图表征假说
AI.tldr: 本文提出预测一致性假设，并通过实验证明了不同的世界模型会收敛到几何相似且功能兼容的共享潜在结构，验证了世界模型中的柏拉图表征假说。
AI.motivation: 尽管世界模型在感知和模拟复杂环境方面展现出巨大潜力，但其学习到的表征的根本性质仍然知之甚少，因此本文旨在探讨世界模型领域的柏拉图表征假说。
AI.method: 提出预测一致性假设，并通过使用不同视觉编码器构建异构模型的系统性实验（如DINO-WM）以及模型拼接（model stitching）技术来检验模型间的表征几何相似性和功能兼容性。
AI.result: 实验发现能力强大的世界模型会向几何上相似的内部结构演化；通过模型拼接，一个世界模型的内部特征可以映射到另一个模型且性能下降有限，证明了它们具有功能兼容性。
AI.conclusion: 优化共享的状态转移目标（预测一致性）会促使异构世界模型收敛于共享且具有功能兼容性的潜在于结构，验证了世界模型领域的柏拉图表征假说。
AI.translation: 世界模型在感知和模拟复杂环境方面表现出巨大的潜力。尽管它们的性能很强，但其学习到的表征的根本性质仍然知在甚少。在本文中，我们通过提出预测一致性假设，探讨了该领域的柏拉图表征假说：我们认为，优化共享的状态转移目标起到了选择压力的作用，促使异构模型向共享的潜在结构收敛。通过对 DINO 世界模型（DINO-WM）进行系统实验（我们在其中改变视觉编码器以创建异构模型），我们发现有能力的世界模型向几何上相似的内部结构演化。此外，通过模型拼接，我们表明一个世界模型的内部特征可以映射到另一个模型，且性能退化有限，这提供了功能兼容性的证据。我们的研究结果表明，追求预测一致性可以促进世界模型之间共享的、转移兼容的潜在结构。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了世界模型中的柏拉图表征假说，提出了预测一致性假设，并通过实验和模型拼接技术证明了不同世界模型在优化共享状态转移目标时会收敛到几何相似且功能兼容的共享潜在结构。
AI.keywords: 世界模型, 柏拉图表征假说, 预测一致性, 潜在于结构, 模型拼接
AI.comments: 该论文将柏拉图表征假说引入世界模型领域，创新性地提出了预测一致性假设，通过系统实验和模型拼接技术验证了不同世界模型会向共享的几何内部结构收敛，对理解世界模型的表征本质具有重要意义。

title: DriftAD: Visually-Guided Text Drift for Few-Shot Industrial Anomaly Detection
summary: Few-shot anomaly detection (FSAD) has recently benefited from vision-language models such as CLIP, which enable anomaly de?tection by aligning visual features with text descriptions of normal and abnormal states. However, existing methods typically rely on static text prompts that are applied uniformly across the entire feature hierarchy and spatial dimensions. This rigid global-to-local matching fails to capture the highly localized and scale-dependent physical variations of industrial defects. To address this, we propose DriftAD, a FSAD framework built on three key modules. First, an Anomaly Signal Amplification (ASA) module enhances subtle defect signals through spatial and frequency branches before text-visual matching. Second, Visually-Guided Text Drift (VGTD) dynamically transforms frozen CLIP text embeddings, steering them into layer?wise, spatially-adaptive anomaly descriptors conditioned on local visual context at each encoder depth. Third, Drift-Guided Spatial Gating (DGSG) uses the drifted abnormal descriptor as a spatial probe to selectively enhance anomaly-relevant visual features. Addi?tionally, a drift separation loss prevents representational collapse of the drifted descriptors, and a gate supervision loss enforces spatially discriminative gating in DGSG. Extensive experiments on MVTec?AD and VisA demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across all 1-, 2-, and 4-shot settings on both image-level and pixel-level metrics. Code is available at https://github.com/wenyang001/DriftAD.

AI.title_translation: DriftAD：用于少样本工业异常检测的视觉引导文本漂移
AI.tldr: 本文提出了DriftAD框架，通过视觉引导文本漂移和动态特征匹配，解决了少样本工业异常检测中静态文本提示的局限性，在多个数据集上达到了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的少样本异常检测方法依赖于跨特征层次和空间维度统一应用的静态文本提示，这种僵化的全局到局部匹配无法捕捉工业缺陷高度局域化和尺度依赖的物理变化。
AI.method: 提出了DriftAD框架，包含三个核心模块：异常信号放大（ASA）模块、视觉引导文本漂移（VGTD）模块以及漂移引导空间门控（DGSG）模块，并引入了漂移分离损失和门控监督损失。
AI.result: 在MVTec-AD和VisA数据集上的1、2、4样本设置下，无论是图像级还是像素级指标，均展现出最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: DriftAD通过结合异常信号放大、视觉引导文本漂移以及漂移引导的空间门控机制，显著提升了少样本工业异常检测的性能，为视觉-语言模型在工业检测领域的应用提供了新思路。
AI.translation: 少样本异常检测（FSAD）最近受益于CLIP等视觉-语言模型，这些模型通过将视觉特征与正常和异常状态的文本描述对齐来实现异常检测。然而，现有方法通常依赖于静态文本提示，这些提示在整个特征层次结构和空间维度上统一应用。这种僵化的全局到局部匹配无法捕获工业缺陷高度局域化和尺度依赖的物理变化。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了DriftAD，这是一个构建在三个关键模块上的FSAD框架。首先，异常信号放大（ASA）模块在文本-视觉匹配之前，通过空间和频率分支增强微妙的缺陷信号。其次，视觉引导文本漂移（VGTD）模块动态转换冻结的CLIP文本嵌入，根据每个编码器深度的局部视觉上下文，将其引导为逐层、空间自适应的异常描述符。第三，漂移引导空间门控（DGSG）使用漂移后的异常描述符作为空间探针，选择性地增强与异常相关的视觉特征。此外，漂移分离损失防止了漂移描述符的表征崩溃，门控监督损失强制DGSG进行空间判别门控。在MVTec-AD和VisA上的大量实验表明，在1、2和4样本设置下的图像级和像素级指标上均表现出最先进的性能。代码可在https://github.com/wenyang001/DriftAD获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DriftAD，这是一个用于少样本工业异常检测的新型框架，它利用异常信号放大、视觉引导的文本漂移和空间门控技术，解决了传统静态文本提示在捕捉局部及尺度变化的工业缺陷时的局限性。
AI.keywords: 少样本异常检测, 视觉-语言模型, 文本漂移, 工业缺陷检测
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的视觉引导文本漂移框架（DriftAD），有效解决了少样本工业异常检测中静态文本提示无法捕获局部和尺度变化的问题，在MVTec-AD和VisA数据集上取得了最先进的性能。

title: Response Renormalization for Critical Deep Equilibrium Models
authors: Jose Luis Lima de Jesus Silva
summary: Deep Equilibrium Models (DEQs) compute predictions from a hidden representation unchanged by the model update. Training through this equilibrium uses implicit differentiation and requires solving an adjoint system built from the residual Jacobian. If this Jacobian is nearly singular along loss-sensitive directions, small perturbations can be strongly amplified in the adjoint response, producing large, highly sensitive gradients that can make optimization unreliable. We introduce Response Renormalization, a backward-pass framework that lifts selected near-pole denominators while leaving unlifted response channels unchanged. Collective Mode Response Renormalization (CMR) applies this correction in a low-dimensional critical subspace, while Phi-adaptive CMR computes a bounded response mass from a positive susceptibility rule. We derive dense and matrix-free collective formulations, distinguish exact gradients of a modified frozen-anchor residual from backward-response surrogates, and extend the construction to Structured Implicit Layers and Vector Attractors (SILVA). Across 23 multiphysics families spanning partial differential equations, three-dimensional fields, operator maps, complex geometries, and particle systems, CMR and Phi-CMR yield test errors no more than five percent higher than those from models trained with exact implicit differentiation in more than 98% of static and 95% of transient family-seed comparisons. Solver-index experiments show convergence toward the static adjoint, while physical-time rollouts retain predictive fidelity under the evaluated conditions. These results demonstrate that selective response renormalization can control near-critical adjoint amplification without globally damping well-conditioned sensitivity. Therefore, the method can make parameter updates more reliable while preserving the useful gradient information needed for learning.

AI.title_translation: 临界深度平衡模型的响应重整化
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对深度平衡模型的响应重整化反向传播方法，有效解决了临界状态下雅可比矩阵奇异导致的梯度爆炸问题，大幅提升了模型训练的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 深度平衡模型（DEQs）在通过隐式微分进行训练时，如果残差雅可比矩阵在损失敏感方向上接近奇异，微小的扰动会在伴随响应中被强烈放大，导致梯度巨大且高度敏感，从而使优化过程变得不可靠。
AI.method: 引入响应重整化（Response Renormalization）反向传播框架，提出集体模态响应重整化（CMR）及其Phi自适应变体（Phi-CMR），通过在低维临界子空间调整近极点分母来控制伴随响应放大，并推导了稠密与矩阵无关的集体公式。
AI.result: 在跨越偏微分方程、三维场、算子映射等23个多物理场系列的实验中，CMR和Phi-CMR在98%以上的静态和95%以上的瞬态对比中，测试误差比精确隐式微分模型高出不到5%，同时提升了参数更新的可靠性并保持了预测保真度。
AI.conclusion: 响应重整化方法能够有效控制深度平衡模型在临界状态下的伴随响应放大，在不牺牲有效梯度信息的前提下显著提升了模型训练的可靠性。
AI.translation: 深度平衡模型（DEQs）通过计算由模型更新保持不变的隐藏表示来预测结果。通过这种平衡进行训练使用隐式微分，需要求解由残差雅可比矩阵构建的伴随系统。如果该雅可比矩阵在损失敏感方向上接近奇异，微小的扰动可能会在伴随响应中被强烈放大，产生巨大且高度敏感的梯度，从而使优化变得不可靠。我们引入了响应重整化（Response Renormalization），这是一种反向传播框架，它提升了选定的近极点分母，同时保持未提升的响应通道不变。集体模态响应重整化（CMR）在低维临界子空间中应用此校正，而Phi自适应CMR根据正磁化率规则计算有界的响应质量。我们推导了稠密和矩阵无关的集体公式，区分了修改后的冷冻锚残差的精确梯度与反向响应替代物，并将该结构扩展到结构化隐式层和向量吸引子（SILVA）。跨越偏微分方程、三维场、算子映射、复杂几何和粒子系统的23个多物理场系列的实验表明，在超过98%的静态和95%的瞬态系列种子比较中，CMR和Phi-CMR产生的测试误差比使用精确隐式微分训练的模型高出不超过百分之五。求解器指标实验表明其向静态伴随收敛，同时物理时间展开在评估条件下保持了预测保真度。这些结果表明，选择性响应重整化可以控制近临界伴随放大，而不会全局阻尼条件良好的灵敏度。因此，该方法可以在保留学习所需的有用梯度信息的同时，使参数更新更加可靠。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种名为响应重整化（Response Renormalization）的新型反向传播框架，用于解决临界深度平衡模型（DEQs）中伴随雅可比矩阵近奇异导致的梯度不稳定问题。通过选择性地提升近极点分母并结合集体模态响应重整化（CMR）及其自适应变体，该方法在控制梯度放大的同时保留了关键的学习梯度，在多物理场任务中展现出卓越的训练稳定性和预测精度。
AI.keywords: 深度平衡模型, 隐式微分, 响应重整化, 伴随系统, 临界状态
AI.comments: 本文针对深度平衡模型（DEQs）在临界状态下伴随系统雅可比矩阵奇异导致的梯度剧烈波动问题，提出了一种精巧的反向传播重整化框架（Response Renormalization）。通过在关键子空间或利用自适应规则调整近极点分母，该方法在抑制梯度爆炸的同时保留了核心梯度信息，在多物理场实验中表现出极高的可靠性和泛化能力。创新性强，实用价值高。

title: A Hybrid Two-Stage Machine Learning Pipeline for Fault Detection and Classification in Power Transmission Systems
summary: Rapid and accurate fault detection in high-voltage transmission networks is essential for grid reliability and equipment protection. Transmission fault datasets are frequently imbalanced, and certain fault types produce electrical signatures that fall within the normal operating envelope, causing single-model classifiers to fail on safety-critical cases. This paper proposes a hybrid two-stage machine learning pipeline that decouples detection from classification. Stage 1 combines an Isolation Forest anomaly detector with an optional supervised binary detector through an OR-fusion rule; the supervised branch is allocated automatically during training for any fault class the anomaly detector cannot resolve, and is omitted when no such class exists. Stage 2 applies a Random Forest multiclass classifier only to samples flagged by Stage 1. Feature engineering is expressed as a per-measurement-point operator mapping six raw channels to eighteen features, including zero-sequence symmetrical components derived from Fortescue's theorem, yielding 18L features for L measurement points. On the TLFaultDataset, the pipeline raises Line-fault end-to-end accuracy from 31.3% to 95.8%. On an independent single-point dataset, the same framework attains 97.25% end-to-end accuracy across all classes including normal operation, exceeding the TLFed federated benchmark of 94.84% without GPU or federated infrastructure, at 0.05 ms per sample on CPU. Ablation on both datasets shows zero-sequence features resolving the three-phase versus three-phase-to-ground ambiguity, raising the F1-score of that class pair from 0.39 to 0.997. The direction of the zero-sequence signature is found to be system-dependent, motivating a learned decision boundary in place of a fixed relay threshold.

AI.title_translation: 电力输电系统故障检测与分类的混合两阶段机器学习流水线
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合两阶段机器学习流水线，解耦了故障检测与分类，显著提高了输电线路故障识别的准确率和运行效率。
AI.motivation: 高压输电网络故障数据集经常存在数据不平衡问题，且某些故障类型的电气特征处于正常运行范围内，导致单模型分类器在安全关键情况下失效，因此需要更可靠的故障检测与分类架构。
AI.method: 提出一种混合两阶段机器学习流水线：第一阶段结合孤立森林异常检测器与可选的有监督二元检测器（通过OR融合规则）；第二阶段对标记样本应用随机森林多分类器。同时利用傅斯肯定理提取零序对称分量等特征。
AI.result: 在TLFaultDataset上，端到端准确率从31.3%提升至95.8%；在独立单点数据集上达到97.25%的准确率，超越联邦基准，CPU处理速度达每个样本0.05毫秒。零序列特征将三相与三相接地故障对的F1分数从0.39提升至0.997。
AI.conclusion: 该混合两阶段机器学习流水线能够高效、准确地进行输电线路的故障检测与分类，显著提升了端到端准确率，且计算开销小，适合实际应用。
AI.translation: 高压输电网络中快速准确的故障检测对于电网可靠性和设备保护至关重要。输电故障数据集经常存在不平衡现象，某些故障类型产生的电气特征落在正常运行范围内，导致单模型分类器在安全关键情况下失效。本文提出了一种将检测与分类解耦的混合两阶段机器学习流水线。第一阶段通过OR融合规则将孤立森林异常检测器与可选的有监督二元检测器相结合；监督分支在训练期间自动分配给异常检测器无法解析的任何故障类别，并在不存在此类类别时省略。第二阶段仅对第一阶段标记的样本应用随机森林多分类器。特征工程表示为每个测量点的算子，将六个原始通道映射到十八个特征，包括从福特斯丘定理导出的零序对称分量，产生 L 个测量点的 18L 个特征。在 TLFaultDataset 上，该流水线将线路故障端到端准确率从 31.3% 提高到 95.8%。在一个独立的单点数据集上，该框架在包括正常运行在内的所有类别中获得了 97.25% 的端到端准确率，超过了 94.84% 的 TLFed 联邦基准，无需 GPU 或联邦基础设施，在 CPU 上每个样本耗时 0.05 毫秒。两个数据集的消融实验表明，零序特征解决了三相与三相接地故障之间的模糊性，将该故障对的 F1 分数从 0.39 提高到 0.997。研究发现零序特征的方向取决于系统，这促使采用学习决策边界来代替固定的继电器阈值。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于电力输电系统故障检测与分类的混合两阶段机器学习流水线。该流水线将检测与分类解耦，第一阶段通过异常检测与监督二分类结合进行故障识别，第二阶段利用随机森林进行多分类。结合创新的特征工程（如零序分量），该方法在多个数据集上显著提升了故障检测的准确率和计算效率。
AI.keywords: 故障检测, 机器学习, 输电系统, 异常检测, 零序分量
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的混合两阶段机器学习流水线，巧妙地将故障检测与分类解耦，有效解决了输电线路故障数据不平衡及特征重叠的问题。不仅在准确率上大幅超越传统单模型和现有联邦基准，而且在CPU上具备极高的运行效率，对智能电网的可靠运行具有重要的实用价值。

title: The Ordinal Annotation Game: How Construct Abstraction Shapes Crowdsourced Consensus
comments: This work has been accepted for publication at the 2026 International Conference on Affective Computing and Intelligent Interaction (ACII) Late-Breaking Research Track
summary: Inter-annotator disagreement in real-time affect annotation is widely treated as stochastic noise. We challenge this view by modelling ordinal annotation as an implicit game-theoretic coordination process against an internalised population prior under a post-hoc majority vote. We present the Ordinal Annotation Game, a conceptual scaffold in which the mapping from individual effort to collective consensus is governed by the semantic abstraction of the target construct. We evaluate it across two experiments sharing identical interface software and a uniform sensitivity threshold: a controlled sensory tracking study and an in-the-wild engagement study. Sensory annotation yields a consensus-dominant regime where active updates reinforce agreement, whereas engagement annotation inverts into an effort-limited regime where more labelling penalises consensus. The payoff slope reverses sign under identical processing, showing that ordinal disagreement is a structured behavioural phenomenon, not a discretisation artefact or random error.
comment: This work has been accepted for publication at the 2026 International Conference on Affective Computing and Intelligent Interaction (ACII) Late-Breaking Research Track

title: Velocity-coupled Representation Refinement for Satellite Orbit Prediction
summary: Satellite orbit prediction, which aims to forecast future orbital trajectories from historical observations, is important for collision warning and safe space operations. With advances in time-series forecasting, learning-based methods have emerged as a promising solution for satellite prediction. In orbital dynamics, a satellite state is typically described by position and velocity, where position characterizes trajectory geometry and velocity reflects its instantaneous direction and rate of change. However, most existing methods mainly focus on temporal dependencies within position sequences while rarely exploiting the intrinsic coupling between position and velocity, which is essential for modeling satellite motion. To this end, we propose OrbitNet, a velocity-aware representation learning method for accurate satellite orbit prediction. It lifts conventional position-sequence forecasting to a position-velocity coupled representation learning paradigm by exploiting relationships among satellite state variables. Specifically, we develop a velocity-coupled representation refinement strategy to enhance positional representations through cross-variable interactions between position and velocity. We further introduce orbital segment modeling, which partitions historical trajectories into temporal segments and performs segment-level temporal learning to capture local motion variations and long-range evolution patterns. Extensive experiments show that OrbitNet outperforms large time-series foundation models and representative general forecasting methods under both in-domain evaluation on Starlink and zero-shot evaluation across six unseen satellite constellations. We expect this work to encourage further exploration of satellite-aware representation learning for trajectory time-series forecasting.

AI.title_translation: 面向卫星轨道预测的速度耦合表示精炼方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了OrbitNet，通过挖掘位置与速度的耦合关系以及轨道分段建模，实现了高精度和强泛化能力的卫星轨道预测。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于学习的卫星轨道预测方法主要关注位置序列的时间依赖性，而忽视了轨道动力学中位置与速度之间对建模卫星运动至关重要的内禀耦合关系。
AI.method: 提出OrbitNet，包含两个核心模块：1）速度耦合表示精炼策略，通过位置与速度之间的跨变量交互增强位置表示；2）轨道分段建模，将历史轨迹划分为时间段并进行段级时序学习，以捕捉局部运动变化和长程演化模式。
AI.result: 在Starlink数据集的域内评估以及六个未见卫星星座的零样本评估中，OrbitNet均表现优于大型时间序列基础模型和具有代表性的通用预测方法。
AI.conclusion: OrbitNet通过位置-速度耦合表示优化和轨道分段建模，有效提升了卫星轨道预测的准确性和泛化能力，优于现有的通用时序预测方法和大模型。
AI.translation: 卫星轨道预测旨在从历史观测中预测未来的轨道轨迹，对于碰撞预警和安全的太空操作至关重要。随着时间序列预测的发展，基于学习的方法已成为卫星预测的一个有前景的解决方案。在轨道动力学中，卫星状态通常由位置和速度来描述，其中位置表征轨迹几何形状，速度反映其瞬时方向和变化率。然而，大多数现有方法主要关注位置序列内部的时间依赖性，很少利用位置和速度之间对于建模卫星运动至关重要的内禀耦合。为此，我们提出了OrbitNet，这是一种用于精确卫星轨道预测的速度感知表示学习方法。它通过利用卫星状态变量之间的关系，将传统的 posicao（位置）序列预测提升到位置-速度耦合表示学习范式。具体而言，我们开发了一种速度耦合表示精炼策略，通过位置和速度之间的跨变量交互来增强位置表示。我们进一步引入了轨道分段建模，将历史轨迹划分为时间段并执行段级时间学习，以捕获局部运动变化和长程演化模式。大量实验表明，在Starlink的域内评估和六个未见卫星星座的零样本评估下，OrbitNet均优于大型时间序列基础模型和代表性的通用预测方法。我们期望这项工作能鼓励对用于轨迹时间序列预测的卫星感知表示学习的进一步探索。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了OrbitNet，一种用于精确卫星轨道预测的速度感知表示学习方法。通过引入位置-速度耦合表示精炼策略和轨道分段建模，该方法有效挖掘了卫星状态变量间的内在关系及局部与长程时序演化规律，在多项实验中展现出显著的性能优势。
AI.keywords: 卫星轨道预测, 速度耦合, 表示学习, 时序预测, 轨道动力学
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地引入了位置与速度的内禀耦合关系来改进卫星轨道预测，突破了传统方法仅关注位置序列的局限，并在多个星座数据集上验证了其优越的泛化能力。

title: More Motion Is Not Always Better Motion: Corpus Composition Governs Whether Augmentation Helps SMPL-Based Parkinsonian Gait Severity Estimation
summary: We grade MDS-UPDRS gait severity from SMPL motion using three frozen MotionAGFormer encoders as featurizers, reaching macro-F1 0.58 on a hidden, multi-site test set. Because the system's members differ only in their lifting corpus, evaluating encoders singly on that test set isolates what that corpus contributes. Six pools drawn from one inertial dataset, varying only in which walking tasks they include, score between 0.32 and 0.53, and just one of them beats the 0.51 of an encoder given no outside motion at all. What separates them is not how much data they hold but whether they carry a contrast in walking speed, the variation this representation appears to depend : a further pool adding a third collection site at fixed task composition does worse still. The same rule explains why exact synthetic motion and monocularly reconstructed web video both fail to help. Modifying the learned representation itself, rather than the corpus behind it, cost every variant that attempted it.

title: Effective Pivot Attack Detection via System and Network Information
summary: Perimeter-based security appliances, such as firewalls or Intrusion Detection Systems, are ineffective against modern attacks that use pivoting, wherein attackers "pivot" traffic through compromised hosts to gain access to additional targets that would otherwise be inaccessible. Due to the legitimate appearance of the relayed traffic, pivoting is extremely difficult to detect. Although the consequences of these attacks are known to be severe, existing defenses suffer from drawbacks such as high processing delays, low accuracy, or reliance on network-wide participation, making them inconvenient or even ineffective. This work presents Stitch, a host-based system that uses the programmable kernel to detect pivoting in real time. By observing host-traversing flows, Stitch uses process tracing to effectively combine system and network-level information, connecting incoming and outgoing communications and identifying pivoting characteristics between them. Showing 31% gains in accuracy over state-of-the-art pivoting defenses and a maximum false positive rate of 0.006% over two separate real-world deployments, Stitch covers the gap in current pivot detection solutions by providing accurate, lightweight, and independent coverage for vulnerable hosts in a network.

title: AgentRoom: Concurrent Multi-Agent Coding in a CRDT-Backed Shared Workspace
summary: Concurrent multi-agent coding promises division of labor across modules, robustness through redundancy, and parallel exploration at the natural granularity of multi-file projects. Realtime collaborative editing protocols solve this coordination problem for human teams via Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs), but the LLMs underneath generate one token at a time and existing multi-agent coding systems inherit this serial limit: they either sequence agents through phase handoffs or pool independent samples without coordination, and a single agent abandons up to half of hard tasks with a one-file stub-and-exit. AgentRoom is a realtime collaborative editing protocol for concurrent coding agents. Its runtime layer exposes file-level claim, status, and broadcast as MCP tools on a CRDT-merged shared filesystem. Five frontier coding-CLI models ran four backend coding tasks, with cross-language checks in Python DevBench and Rust+axum. For CLI-stable models, AgentRoom with 2 agents abandons fewer tasks than Solo and has less run-to-run variation. At matched-compute, one positive mean LLM-judge contrast puts AgentRoom over parallel-merge. The other contrast, a bundle probe, puts full AgentRoom above each partial case: an ordering rather than a percentage split. Coordination, not parallelism or CRDT-merge, bears the load.

title: Calibration-Preserving Pruning: Compression as a Reliability Contract
summary: Split conformal prediction, not the pruning rule, supplies finite-sample marginal coverage once a pruned model is fixed independently of the conformal calibration split. We study the separate efficiency problem: can pruning preserve score geometry well enough to obtain smaller valid prediction sets? Calibration-Preserving Pruning (CPP) augments a base pruning score with nonconformity-gradient saliency and uses disjoint pruning, validation-selection, conformal-calibration, and test splits. Bounded score perturbations imply bounded conformal-quantile shifts and controlled set inflation, but do not make the generic coverage theorem CPP-specific. Final five-seed Qwen2.5-1.5B results at 50\% sparsity show the largest gains on large-label tasks. On DBpedia-14, CPP-SparseGPT reduces mean set size from \(10.1\) to \(8.6\) while changing accuracy from \(0.347\) to \(0.366\); CPP-Wanda reduces \(11.2\) to \(9.0\) with an accuracy trade-off from \(0.310\) to \(0.295\). Across 15 dataset--sparsity cells, CPP-SparseGPT produces smaller sets in 13 and higher accuracy in 11. Matched controls show that generic supervised gradients explain much of the gain: true-label CPP is not statistically resolved from matched Wanda+SNIP, whereas threshold-aware candidate-label CPP reaches \(7.8\) mean set size at explicit accuracy and offline-compute costs. RoBERTa-base and Llama-3-8B diagnostics support transfer, but our claims remain limited to reliability-sensitive classification.

title: CRISP: Calibration-Aware Visual State Space Duality for Remote Sensing Semantic Segmentation
comments: Accepted to ECCV 2026. 22 pages, including supplementary material; 9 figures. Code: https://github.com/crazylifeha/CRISP
summary: State space models, especially Visual State Space Duality (VSSD), have emerged as efficient linear-time alternatives to Transformers for dense visual tasks. However, we observe that VSSD compresses spatial context into a global aggregation that suppresses high-frequency responses, causing excessive boundary smoothing in remote sensing semantic segmentation. To address this, we propose CRISP, a calibration framework with two components. Its core, the Duality Calibration Operator (DCO), restores local contrast and boundary responses through residual injection and frequency calibration within the VSSD backbone, without altering its linear complexity. To retain the recovered detail, an Orthogonal Multi-Prototype (OMP) head assigns multiple orthogonally constrained prototypes per class to model large intra-class variance. Extensive experiments on Potsdam, Vaihingen, and LoveDA show that, with approximately 30M parameters, CRISP achieves consistent gains in mean F1 (mF) and mIoU while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art methods. Code is available at https://github.com/crazylifeha/CRISP.
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. 22 pages, including supplementary material; 9 figures. Code: https://github.com/crazylifeha/CRISP

title: Technology Caregiving: Reframing How Older Adults Are Supported in Everyday Digital Activities
summary: Transformed by digitization, everyday activities-paying bills, shopping, managing transportation-increasingly require older adults to navigate digital systems. To accomplish these digital activities of daily living (DADLs), older adults often rely on help that looks less like IT support-institutional, episodic, and product-oriented-and more like caregiving: relational, ongoing, and aimed at preserving their functional independence. We argue that this practice is technology caregiving and introduce a framework characterizing it along four dimensions: why support is needed, who provides it, when it occurs, and how it is delivered. Applying this framework, we then systematically review the literature on how older adults are supported in DADLs. From 3,381 unique records, 36 articles met the inclusion criteria. Findings show that technology caregiving involves burden, like traditional care, but is distinctly shaped as much by digital systems and their constant change as by technology caregivers' and older adults' abilities.

title: Too much of a good thing -- when knowledge distillation promotes overfitting, and how to avoid it
summary: The growing size of Convolutional Neural Networks has led to increasingly large and costly models. Knowledge Distillation (KD) addresses this by transferring knowledge from a large network (teacher) to a small one (student), also reducing the training data required. KD is traditionally applied only at the network's final output. However, its behaviour when applied at intermediate network layers has received little attention. This raises the question of whether intermediate block-wise KD, which provides supervision throughout the network, could offer an advantage under specific conditions, such as few instances per class, which is common in fine-grained datasets. This work proposes a student design based on simple, homogeneous blocks mirroring those of the teacher, distilling knowledge between corresponding blocks. Across eleven datasets, we show that on classic datasets, distilling only the last block is sufficient -- and often best--, whereas fine-grained, data-scarce settings benefit substantially from intermediate supervision, with even a single additional distillation point narrowing the gap considerably. We further study how this supervision should be guided, exploring configurations of varying granularity and informed by an explainability analysis based on attention maps, Centered Kernel Alignment, and Grad-CAM, alongside the impact of teacher and student fine-tuning strategies. This work shows that intermediate block-wise distillation, guided appropriately, is key to building compact data-efficient models without sacrificing accuracy.

title: Enhancing Bug Report Templates in the TianoCore UEFI Firmware Development Community
comments: ACM International Workshop on Firmware Testing and Analysis (FTA) 2026, Co-located with ISSTA 2026
summary: We propose enhancing the bug report templates in the GitHub Issues issue tracking system used by the TianoCore open-source community with the aim of improving the bug triage and resolution process. We analyze the bug repository data and find patterns of information that are useful for bug triage and fixing. However, some of them are only occasionally included in the free-form text of bug reports. Therefore, we propose adding a few new fields to the existing TianoCore bug report template. In this study, we focus on the key TianoCore project, EDK II, which constitutes the core of the UEFI firmware across various firmware vendors and original equipment manufacturers. This study is currently a work-in-progress. So far, we have interviewed a few developers to obtain their feedback and adjust the proposed approach. We are planning more interviews with the TianoCore community to conduct A/B tests and validate our approach to achieve effective and efficient bug triage and resolution.

title: SPIDER4TianoCore: Enhancing Patch-Propagation for the TianoCore UEFI Firmware Development Ecosystem
comments: ACM International Workshop on Firmware Testing and Analysis (FTA) 2026, Co-located with ISSTA 2026
summary: We propose and demonstrate SPIDER4TianoCore, a packaged Python command-line tool that provides integration-stage patch-status evidence for the TianoCore/UEFI firmware supply chain. Given an upstream pre-patch and post-patch pair and prepared downstream targets, the tool reports Vulnerable, Already Patched, Not Applicable, or Uncertain with supporting evidence for maintainer review. Our work is inspired by SPIDER's patch-propagation framing, but SPIDER4TianoCore does not itself prove that a patch is safe to propagate. We evaluate the engine on 20 prepared target/CVE pairs from eight public downstream EDK II repositories and two CVEs. The analyzers produce 10 high-confidence pre-patch matches and four high-confidence post-patch matches, conservatively abstain on six targets, and make no confidently wrong classifications relative to the recorded manual patch-state labels. These preliminary results demonstrate reproducible evidence generation for prepared targets rather than general downstream accuracy.
