AI.translation: 从单张图像推断一群人的集体情感状态，即群体情感识别（GER），需要整合空间分布的线索，如面部、姿势、互动和场景上下文。当前方法依赖于检测器驱动的多流管线。这些方法仅通过图像级监督进行训练，缺乏关于哪些区域重要或每个区域贡献强度的指导。我们提出了LG-GER，一个语言引导的蒸馏框架，它使用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）为训练图像生成密集的、空间接地的证据，即与情感信号和置信度分数配对的边界框。这种结构化证据通过四种互补损失：分类、区域-文本接地、空间情感和空间置信度回归，蒸馏到一个单一的视觉-语言模型（VLM）骨干中。在推理时，LG-GER不需要检测器、不需要MLLM，也不需要多流融合，这使得GER在实时和资源受限的部署中变得实用。LG-GER已在两个基准GER数据集（GroupEmoW和GAF~3.0）上进行了评估，与在推理时需要检测和多流处理的现有最先进方法相比，取得了具有竞争力或更优异的结果。
AI.summary: LG-GER是一种新型的群体情感识别框架，通过利用多模态大语言模型生成精细的空间情感证据，并将其蒸馏到单一视觉-语言模型中。该方法克服了传统方法对检测器和多流处理的依赖，在推理时更加高效，并在标准数据集上取得了领先或相当的性能。
AI.keywords: 群体情感识别, 多模态大语言模型, 视觉-语言模型, 知识蒸馏, 情感识别
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新点在于引入了语言引导的多模态大语言模型来生成精细的空间情感证据，并通过蒸馏将其集成到单一的VLM骨干中。这显著简化了推理过程，使其适用于实时和资源受限的环境，同时保持了高精度。其重要性在于为群体情感识别提供了一种更高效、更实用的解决方案，并为未来结合大语言模型进行视觉任务提供了新的思路。

title: A co-rotational formulation for arbitrarily shaped planar beams under large displacements and rotations
summary: A planar co-rotational beam formulation is proposed for the large displacement and large rotation analysis of beams with arbitrary initial geometries. A local frame is attached to each differential beam segment and follows its rigid body translation and rotation, enabling a consistent kinematic description suitable for higher-order basis functions. An auxiliary straight reference configuration is introduced so that both the arbitrary initial configuration and the current deformed configuration can be described relative to a common reference, enabling arbitrary initial geometries to be treated within the co-rotational framework. While the framework is general and applicable to a wide range of higher-order basis functions, Non-Uniform Rational B-Splines (NURBS) basis functions are adopted in this study to exploit their superior geometric representation and smoothness. The performance of the proposed formulation is evaluated through five numerical examples, including static, post-buckling, dynamic, and coupled static-dynamic cases. The results demonstrate excellent convergence, accurate prediction of large-deformation responses, effective mitigation of locking without additional treatment, and robust performance for beams with non-uniform cross-sections and spatially varying curvature.

AI.title_translation: 大位移与转动下任意形状平面梁的共旋转公式
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于共旋转框架和NURBS基函数的平面梁大变形分析方法，能精确处理任意初始形状的梁。
AI.motivation: 为了解决现有共旋转梁理论难以处理具有任意初始几何形状、非线性大变形以及高阶基函数描述不足的问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种平面共旋转梁公式，为每个微分梁段附加局部坐标系以追踪其刚体平移与转动；引入辅助直参考构型以统一描述任意初始构型和当前变形构型；并采用NURBS基函数进行离散以实现精确的几何表达和光滑性。
AI.result: 通过五个数值算例（包括静力学、后屈曲、动力学及耦合静动力学）验证了该公式，结果表明其具有极佳的收敛性、大变形响应的高精度预测能力、无需额外处理即可有效缓解锁定现象，以及对非变截面和空间变化曲率梁的鲁棒性能。
AI.conclusion: 该共旋转平面梁公式通过引入局部坐标系和辅助直参考构型，成功实现了对任意初始几何形状平面梁在大变形下的精确分析，具有出色的收敛性和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种平面共旋转梁公式，用于分析具有任意初始几何形状的梁在大位移和大转动下的力学行为。局部坐标系被附加到每个微分梁段上，以跟随其刚体平移和转动，从而实现适用于高阶基函数的自洽运动学描述。引入了辅助直参考构型，使得任意初始构型和当前变形构型都能相对于公共参考进行描述，从而使共旋转框架能够处理任意初始几何形状。虽然该框架具有通用性且适用于广泛的高阶基函数，但本研究采用了非均匀有理B样条（NURBS）基函数，以利用其卓越的几何表达能力和平滑度。通过五个数值算例（包括静态、后屈曲、动态以及耦合静态-动态情况）对所提公式的性能进行了评估。结果表明，该公式具有极佳的收敛性、对大变形响应的准确预测能力、无需额外处理即可有效缓解锁定现象，并且对具有非均匀截面和空间变化曲率的梁表现出稳健的性能。
AI.summary: 该论文开发了一种用于任意形状平面梁在大位移和转动下分析的共旋转公式，通过局部坐标系与辅助直参考构型相结合，并采用NURBS基函数，成功实现了对复杂几何梁的高精度、无锁定和强收敛性的非线性响应预测。
AI.keywords: 共旋转梁公式, 大位移大转动, NURBS基函数, 任意初始几何形状, 非线性分析
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的共旋转梁理论，能够有效处理具有任意初始几何形状的平面梁在大变形和转动下的力学行为，并结合NURBS基函数展现出优异的几何表达能力和收敛性。局限性在于摘要未提及三维空间下的扩展性。

title: A tale of perfect fit and phantom optima: how data-driven models can fail in real-time optimization
summary: Real-time optimization (RTO) relies on process models to locate economically optimal operating conditions. Because developing first-principles models requires significant process knowledge, data-driven alternatives are increasingly attractive. Modern machine-learning models can fit historical plant data accurately and often pass standard validation tests. Whether such models can be trusted for economic optimization, however, remains unclear. We investigate this question using a vinyl acetate monomer benchmark process with a unique, well-conditioned economic optimum. We train a structured hybrid model that combines known mass balances and thermodynamics with a neural-network closure for unknown kinetics, and a fully data-driven neural ordinary differential equation (ODE) model. Both models reproduce plant measurements accurately and exhibit little variation in predictions across random initializations. Yet their economic optima differ substantially from that of the plant. Where the plant returns a single optimum on multistart search, the trained models return many phantom optima. We further show that the training optimizer alone can be yet another source of error. Even with noise-free data and initialization at weights that recover the plant optimum, stochastic gradient training can drift to weights that yield substantially worse RTO solutions. The identified model is thus an artifact of the training optimizer as well as the data. These results demonstrate that a good predictive fit of all available measurements does not guarantee reliable economic performance. A data-driven model for RTO should at least be required to recover the optimum on a decision-oriented benchmark like the one developed here before being considered for plant testing and application.

AI.title_translation: 完美拟合与幻影最优的故事：数据-驱动模型如何在实时优化中失败
AI.tldr: 数据驱动模型即使能完美拟合工厂数据，也不能保证其在实时优化中表现可靠，因为它们可能会产生虚假的“幻影最优解”。
AI.motivation: 开发基于第一性原理的机理模型需要大量的工艺知识，这使得数据驱动的替代方案越来越具有吸引力。然而，现代机器学习模型虽然能准确拟合历史数据并通过标准验证测试，但它们是否能够可靠地用于经济优化仍不清楚。为此，本文旨在探究数据驱动模型在实时优化（RTO）中失效的原因。
AI.method: 使用乙酸乙烯酯单体基准过程，训练了一个结合第一性原理与神经网络的混合模型以及一个完全数据-驱动的神经常微分方程（ODE）模型，并研究了其在多起点搜索和随机梯度训练下的表现。
AI.result: 尽管这两个模型能够准确再现工厂测量值，但它们的经济最优解与实际工厂有很大不同：模型产生了许多“幻影最优解”，而不是单一的真实最优解；此外，训练优化器本身（如随机梯度训练）也会导致模型参数漂移，产生更差的RTO解。
AI.conclusion: 数据驱动模型即使预测精度高且通过常规验证，也不能保证其经济优化性能。未来的RTO模型应在决策导向的基准测试中通过验证后再应用于工业实际。
AI.translation: 实时优化（RTO）依赖于过程模型来寻找经济上最优的操作条件。由于开发第一性原理模型需要大量的工艺知识，数据驱动的替代方案越来越具有吸引力。现代机器学习模型可以准确拟合历史工厂数据，并且通常能通过标准验证测试。然而，这些模型是否可以信赖用于经济优化仍不清楚。我们使用一个具有独特、条件良好的经济最优解的醋酸乙烯单体基准过程来研究这个问题。我们训练了一个结构化的混合模型（结合了已知的质量平衡和热力学与用于未知动力学的神经网络闭包）以及一个完全数据驱动的神经常微分方程（ODE）模型。这两个模型都准确地重现了工厂测量值，并且在随机初始化下预测结果变化很小。然而，它们的经济最优解与工厂的最优解有很大不同。当工厂在多起点搜索中返回单个最优解时，受训模型返回了许多幻影最优解。我们进一步表明，训练优化器本身可能是另一个误差来源。即使在无噪声数据和恢复工厂最优解的权重初始化下，随机梯度训练也可能漂移到产生明显更差RTO解的权重。因此，所识别的模型既是训练优化器的人工产物，也是数据的人工产物。这些结果表明，对所有可用测量结果的良好预测拟合不能保证可靠的经济性能。在考虑用于工厂测试和应用之前，用于RTO的数据驱动模型至少应该被要求在决策导向的基准测试（如这里开发的基准测试）上恢复最优解。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了数据驱动模型在实时优化（RTO）中的失败模式，通过乙酸乙烯酯单体基准过程证明了：即使模型能够完美拟合历史数据并通过标准验证，由于“幻影最优解”和训练优化器的偏差，它们也可能无法找到真正的经济最优解。
AI.keywords: 实时优化, 数据驱动模型, 机器学习, 幻影最优解, 混合模型
AI.comments: 本文揭示了数据驱动模型在实时优化（RTO）中的潜在风险，指出高拟合度并不等同于经济上的成功，对未来可信赖的工业优化模型开发具有重要警示作用。

title: Interpreting Control Latents for System Identification via Conditional Flow Matching
summary: Latent-conditioned adaptive policies can control robots across changing dynamics, but their learned latents remain internal representations of the policy rather than physical models that can be inspected, rolled out, or used by other control modules. This limits closed-loop analysis, diagnosis, and further improvement of a fixed policy. A direct mapping from latent to physical parameters is also under-specified, because multiple systems can induce similar closed-loop behavior. We therefore decode each operational latent into a distribution of quadrotor models using conditional flow matching. The decoded distribution enables two downstream uses without modifying the policy: online predictive tuning of a high-level controller around the fixed low-level policy, and robustness analysis under specified disturbances. Under perturbed actuator dynamics, decoded-model predictive tuning reduces position tracking RMSE by $23\%$ and heading RMSE by $45\%$ relative to fixed gains. Under Gaussian force disturbances, decoded-model ensembles closely predict the lateral tracking-error evolution. Together, these results show that control latents can be converted into physical model ensembles for tuning, robustness analysis, and diagnosis of frozen adaptive policies.

AI.title_translation: 通过条件流匹配解释控制潜在变量用于系统识别
AI.tldr: 本文通过条件流匹配将机器人控制策略的内部潜在变量解码为物理模型分布，以实现策略的在线调优和鲁棒性分析。
AI.motivation: 现有潜在变量条件自适应策略的潜在变量是内部表示，难以检查、展开或被其他控制模块使用，这限制了闭环分析、诊断和改进。直接映射到物理参数又是不明确的，因为多个系统可能产生相似的闭环行为。
AI.method: 使用条件流匹配将每个操作潜在变量解码为四旋翼模型分布。
AI.result: 在扰动的执行器动力学下，解码模型预测调优使位置跟踪RMSE降低23%，航向RMSE降低45%。在高斯力扰动下，解码模型集合能准确预测横向跟踪误差演变。
AI.conclusion: 控制潜在变量可以转换为物理模型集合，用于冻结自适应策略的调优、鲁棒性分析和诊断。
AI.translation: 潜在变量条件自适应策略能够控制机器人应对变化的动力学，但其学习到的潜在变量仍然是策略的内部表示，而非可检查、可展开或可被其他控制模块使用的物理模型。这限制了固定策略的闭环分析、诊断和进一步改进。将潜在变量直接映射到物理参数也是不明确的，因为多个系统可能产生相似的闭环行为。因此，我们利用条件流匹配将每个操作潜在变量解码为四旋翼模型分布。解码后的分布无需修改策略即可实现两个下游应用：围绕固定低级策略对高级控制器进行在线预测调优，以及在指定扰动下的鲁棒性分析。在扰动的执行器动力学下，解码模型预测调优相对于固定增益，将位置跟踪RMSE降低了23%，航向RMSE降低了45%。在高斯力扰动下，解码模型集合能够密切预测横向跟踪误差的演变。总而言之，这些结果表明控制潜在变量可以转换为物理模型集合，用于冻结自适应策略的调优、鲁棒性分析和诊断。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种通过条件流匹配将机器人控制策略中的内部潜在变量解码为物理模型分布的方法。传统方法中，这些潜在变量作为策略的内部表示，限制了对策略的分析和改进。通过将潜在变量转换为可检查的物理模型集合，该方法在不修改原有策略的前提下，实现了对高级控制器的在线预测调优和策略在特定扰动下的鲁棒性分析。实验结果表明，该方法显著提升了扰动环境下的跟踪精度，并能有效预测误差演变，为自适应策略的诊断和改进提供了新途径。
AI.keywords: 控制潜在变量,系统识别,条件流匹配,自适应策略,机器人控制
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了一种将抽象的控制潜在变量转化为可解释物理模型分布的方法，从而克服了现有自适应控制策略在分析和诊断上的局限性。通过条件流匹配技术，实现了对“黑箱”潜在变量的“白箱化”解释，对于提升机器人控制系统的可信赖性和可调性具有重要意义。该方法无需修改原有策略即可实现下游应用，具有良好的实用性。

title: A Mathematical Theory of Interpretation: Rational Entropy, Spectral Readout, and Confusability as a Resource
comments: Abridged core theory of the 2026 dissertation A Mathematical Theory of Interpretation
summary: This article presents the abridged core of \emph{A Mathematical Theory of Interpretation} (MTI), which treats interpretation as observer-relative spectral measurement under an access structure. MTI makes interpretation a method-design problem: access, query, utility, and medium determine what an observer can select, identify, communicate, or refuse. On a learning-invariant Hilbert realization, Rational Entropy measures residual uncertainty across knowledge, utility, and medium. In the finite-effective regime, we classify its zero set. Pairwise confusability is equivalent to uniform atomic collapse, while a unique utility maximum can select one atom even when other zero-cost states remain non-atomic. This reverses the usual zero-error role of confusability: agreement in at least one observer direction excludes unresolved multi-atom readings, while the joint label preserves identification. The corresponding free-design capacity is the product of all but the smallest direction budget. A four-condition certificate characterizes sharp, decodable, medium-faithful, and order-independent readout on a finite commuting code sector and returns typed obstructions when those guarantees fail. Together, these results establish MTI as a theoretical basis for constructing interpretation methods with explicit access assumptions, guarantees, and failure modes.
comment: Abridged core theory of the 2026 dissertation A Mathematical Theory of Interpretation

AI.title_translation: 解释的数学理论：理性熵、谱读出与作为资源的混淆性
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个解释的数学理论（MTI），将解释建模为谱测量，并为设计具有严格保证的解释方法提供了理论基础。
AI.motivation: 现有的解释缺乏统一的数学理论基础，无法将访问、查询、效用和介质等因素系统性地转化为方法设计的保证与失败模式。因此，需要建立一个将解释视为观察者相对的谱测量的数学理论。
AI.method: 构建了基于学习不变希尔伯特实现的框架，利用理性熵度量残余不确定性，对有限有效区间的零集进行分类，引入谱读出和四条件证书来表征可解码性和介质保真度等。
AI.result: 证明了成对可混淆性等价于统一的原子坍缩，导出了自由设计容量为除最小方向预算外的所有方向预算的乘积，并利用四条件证书表征了有限交换码扇区上的尖锐、可解码、介质保真且与顺序无关的读出。
AI.conclusion: 通过建立解释的数学理论（MTI），论文将解释过程转化为方法设计问题，提供了理性熵、谱读出和可混淆性等核心概念及其数学保证，为构建具有显式访问假设和故障模式的解释方法奠定了理论基础。
AI.translation: 本文介绍了《解释数学理论》（MTI）的删节核心，该理论将解释视为访问结构下的观察者相对谱测量。MTI 将解释变成了一个方法设计问题：访问、查询、效用和介质决定了观察者可以选择、识别、通信或拒绝的内容。在一个学习不变的希尔伯特实现上，理性熵衡量了跨越知识、效用和介质的残余不确定性。在有限有效区间内，我们对其零集进行了分类。成对混淆性等价于统一的原子坍缩，而唯一的效用最大值可以选择一个原子，即使其他零成本状态保持非原子状态。这逆转了混淆性的通常零误差角色：至少在一个观察者方向上的同意排除了未解决的多原子读数，而联合标签保留了识别。相应的自由设计容量是除最小方向预算外所有方向预算的乘积。一个四条件证书刻画了有限交换码扇区上尖锐的、可解码的、介质保真的和顺序无关的读出，并在这些保证失效时返回定型阻碍。总之，这些结果确立了 MTI 作为构建具有显式访问假设、保证和失效模式的解释方法的理论基础。
AI.summary: 本文提出了“解释数学理论”（MTI），将解释定义为访问结构下的观察者相对谱测量。文章通过理性熵、谱读出和可混淆性等核心工具，建立了用于设计和保证解释方法的理论框架。
AI.keywords: 解释数学理论, 谱测量, 理性熵, 可混淆性, 自由设计容量
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一个全新的解释数学理论（MTI），将解释视为观察者相对的谱测量，为理解和设计带有显式访问假设和失败模式的解释方法提供了严谨的数学基础。

title: Provenance Guided Incremental Learning Under Evolving Concept Definitions
summary: Learning systems deployed over long periods must adapt not only to statistical changes in incoming data, but also to revisions of the definitions that generate their prediction targets. Conventional concept-drift methods typically infer such changes from observations or prediction errors, even when the underlying policy, rule, or query has been explicitly modified. This paper studies rule-induced concept shift, where the target-defining concept is revised directly, causing previously stored instances to acquire different semantic labels without requiring any change in their observed data. We introduce a provenance-guided incremental learning framework that compiles consecutive concept definitions into a structured rule delta, traces the changed components through historical provenance, certifies records whose previous labels remain valid, and restricts reevaluation to a localized candidate region. Executable revisions are relabeled automatically, ambiguous cases are handled through selective supervision, and the resulting changes are used for incremental predictor repair. A versioned concept memory further supports recurring definitions. We also introduce RuleShift-Bench, spanning financial, demographic, cybersecurity, and graph-structured data with threshold, predicate, logical, relational, recurring, and mixed concept revisions. Across the benchmark, provenance-guided repair attains 92.3% accuracy and 90.2% Macro-F1 while reprocessing 14.7% of the historical collection and retaining 94.6% of affected records. Its average update latency is 179s compared with 993s for complete relabeling and retraining. The results demonstrate that an explicit concept revision can be exploited as a data-maintenance signal, allowing learning systems to update the supervision and predictive state that depend on the change while preserving knowledge that remains valid.

AI.title_translation: 演化概念定义下的溯源引导增量学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种溯源引导的增量学习框架，利用显式的概念规则修订高效修复受影响的预测状态，显著降低了长周期学习系统的更新成本并保持了高准确率。
AI.motivation: 长期部署的学习系统不仅要适应数据的统计变化，还要适应预测目标定义（规则、策略或查询）的修订。传统概念漂移方法通常从观测或预测误差中推断变化，忽视了目标定义被显式修改的情况，导致历史数据标签失效且处理成本高昂。
AI.method: 引入了一个溯源引导的增量学习框架，将连续的概念定义编译为结构化规则增量，通过历史溯源追踪变更组件，认证旧标签依然有效的记录，并将重新评估限制在局部候选区域；采用自动重新标记、选择性监督和版本化概念记忆来修复增量预测器。
AI.result: 在RuleShift-Bench基准测试中，该方法达到了92.3%的准确率和90.2%的Macro-F1，重新处理了14.7%的历史合集，保留了94.6%的受影响记录，平均更新延迟为179秒（完全重新标记和重新训练为993秒）。
AI.conclusion: 通过将显式的概念修订作为数据维护信号，提出的溯源引导增量学习框架能够高效地更新受影响的预测状态，同时保留有效知识，显著优于传统的完全重训方法。
AI.translation: 长期部署的学习系统不仅必须适应传入数据的统计变化，还必须适应生成其预测目标的定义的修订。传统概念漂移方法通常从观察结果或预测误差中推断出此类变化，即使底层策略、规则或查询已被明确修改。本文研究了规则诱导的概念偏移，即目标定义概念被直接修订，导致先前存储的实例在不需要更改其观测数据的情况下获得不同的语义标签。我们引入了一个溯源引导的增量学习框架，该框架将连续的概念定义编译为结构化规则增量，通过历史溯源追踪更改的组件，认证先前标签仍然有效的记录，并将重新评估限制在局部候选区域。可执行修订会自动重新标记，模糊情况通过选择性监督处理，由此产生的变化用于增量预测器修复。版本化概念记忆进一步支持重复出现的定义。我们还推出了 RuleShift-Bench，涵盖金融、人口统计、网络安全和图结构数据，具有阈值、谓词、逻辑、关系、循环和混合概念修订。在整个基准测试中，溯源引导修复获得了 92.3% 的准确率和 90.2% 的 Macro-F1，同时重新处理了 14.7% 的历史集合并保留了 94.6% 的受影响记录。其平均更新延迟为 179 秒，而完全重新标记和重新训练则为 993 秒。结果表明，显式概念修订可以被利用作为数据维护信号，允许学习系统更新依赖于变化的监督和预测状态，同时保留仍然有效的知识。
AI.summary: 本文研究了规则诱导的概念偏移问题，提出了一种溯源引导的增量学习框架。该框架利用概念修订作为数据维护信号，通过结构化规则增量和历史溯源高效识别并更新失效标签，在保证高准确率的同时大幅降低了计算延迟和重标注成本。
AI.keywords: 增量学习, 概念漂移, 规则诱导概念偏移, 数据溯源, 概念记忆
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的基于溯源的增量学习框架，用于应对概念定义演化带来的标签冲突问题。创新之处在于利用规则增量和历史溯源精确定位并修复受影响的数据，大幅降低了计算成本，对实际业务场景（如金融、网络安全等）中规则频繁变更的系统具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。

title: Names Can Hurt: Spotting Slopsquatting Risks Caused by Package Name Hallucinations in Local Coding LLMs
comments: 14 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Code and data at https://github.com/sargamsahu1011/package-hallucination-detector
summary: When a code generating language model fabricates a Python package name, an adversary who has pre-registered that name on PyPI can convert that hallucination into a supply chain compromise. This event has been termed as 'slopsquatting'. We propose a two layer detector to counter this issue. The first layer performs a deterministic PyPI existence check. The second is a Random Forest classifier trained on ten features derived from the package name and its PyPI metadata. An import name reconciler bridges the two, resolving cases such as 'import cv2' versus 'pip install opencv-python' without a security bypass. The detector is embedded in a LangGraph state machine that retries at escalating temperatures and, on repeated failure, routes to a stronger fallback model. Across 300 curated prompts, the pipeline produces hallucination free code on 76% of runs. The primary exhausts its retry budget on 28.7%; intra model retries recover roughly a quarter of those, and cross model fallback recovers a further 16.5% of the remainder. Four findings have been observed. First, half of the flagged hallucinations are packages already registered on PyPI, as low quality lookalikes of well known projects, caught by the classifier rather than the deterministic layer (e.g., pil, faiss, tabula, haystack). Second, hallucination rate scales almost linearly with prompt adversariality, from 0 to 10% on routine coding to 40 to 73% on slopsquat baits. Third, the weaker primary refused 6 of 10 direct baits unaided, suggesting recent instruction tuning provides a baseline defense. Fourth, when primary and fallback share a model family, approximately 84% of primary failures recur on the fallback, motivating cross family pairing. A user study (n = 24) reports mean satisfaction 4.4 out of 5 and 21 of 24 stated adoption intent.
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Code and data at https://github.com/sargamsahu1011/package-hallucination-detector

AI.title_translation: 名字会伤人：识别本地编码LLMs中由包名幻觉引发的Slopsquatting风险
AI.tldr: 针对代码大模型虚构包名导致的供应链安全隐患（slopsquatting），本文提出了一种双层检测防御系统，通过智能重试和模型回退策略有效防范了此类攻击。
AI.motivation: 代码生成大语言模型常会产生虚假的Python包名，攻击者可提前注册这些包名实施供应链攻击（即slopsquatting），因此需要有效的检测与缓解机制。
AI.method: 提出一个双层检测器：第一层进行确定性PyPI存在性检查，第二层是基于十个特征的随机森林分类器；通过导入名称调节器桥接两者，并将其嵌入在带有重试和跨模型回退机制的LangGraph状态机中。
AI.result: 在300个精心挑选的提示词上，该管道在76%的运行中生成了无幻觉代码；通过引入重试机制和跨模型回退进一步恢复了部分失败案例；用户研究显示平均满意度为4.4/5，24人中有21人表示有采纳意向。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出的双层检测机制、重试状态机及模型回退策略有效缓解了代码大模型的包名幻觉及slopsquatting风险，在保证高安全性的同时获得了良好的用户采纳意向。
AI.translation: 当代码生成语言模型fabricates（虚构）Python包名时，攻击者若在PyPI上预先注册该名称，就能将这种幻觉转化为供应链妥协。该事件被称为“slopsquatting”。我们提出了一个双层检测器来对抗这一问题。第一层执行确定性的PyPI存在性检查。第二层是基于从包名及其PyPI元数据中提取的十个特征训练的随机森林分类器。一个导入名称调节器桥接了这两者，在不绕过安全机制的情况下解决了诸如‘import cv2’与‘pip install opencv-python’等情况。该检测器嵌入在LangGraph状态机中，该状态机会以不断升级的温度进行重试，并在重复失败时路由到更强的备用模型。在300个精心挑选的提示词中，该管道在76%的运行中产出了无幻觉的代码。主模型耗尽了28.7%的重试预算；模型内重试恢复了其中大约四分之一，而跨模型回退恢复了其余部分的16.5%。观察到了四个发现。首先，一半被标记的幻觉是PyPI上已经注册的、知名项目的低质量仿冒包，它们是由分类器而非确定性层捕获的（例如pil、faiss、tabula、haystack）。其次，幻觉率随提示词的对抗性呈近线性缩放，在常规编码中为0到10%，而在slopsquat诱饵中为40到73%。第三，较弱的主模型未经协助就拒绝了10个直接诱饵中的6个，这表明最近的指令调优提供了基线防御。第四，当主模型和备用模型共享模型系列时，主模型约84%的失败会在备用模型上重现，这促使了跨系列配对。一项用户研究（n = 24）报告平均满意度为4.4/5，且24名用户中有21人表示有采用意向。
AI.summary: 本文研究了本地编码大模型中由包名幻觉引起的slopsquatting供应链风险，提出了一种集成确定性检查、随机森林分类器、状态机重试和模型回退的双层检测防御系统，实验证明该系统能有效减少幻觉并获得用户的认可。
AI.keywords: 代码生成大语言模型, 软件包名幻觉, 供应链安全, Slopsquatting, 机器学习检测器
AI.comments: 本文针对本地编码大模型中因包名幻觉引发的“slopsquatting”供应链安全风险，创新性地提出了一种包含确定性检查和机器学习分类器的双层检测器，并结合状态机重试与模型回退策略，有效提升了代码生成安全性。该研究不仅对防范AI生成的软件供应链攻击具有重要实践意义，还通过用户研究验证了其可用性。

title: BenchBench-Protocol: Evaluating Real-World Wet-Lab Protocol Reasoning and Modification
summary: We introduce BenchBench-Protocol, a benchmark for large language models of 149 protocol-modification tasks recovered from modifications that scientists made to published protocols during real experimental work. Adapting a published protocol to a new experiment is a routine task for a wet-lab scientist, and a correct modification requires accounting for prior choices and downstream steps. Recent life-science benchmarks have moved toward open-ended, rubric-graded tasks, but tasks are typically elicited from experts rather than reconstructed from real-world modifications. BenchBench-Protocol tasks are derived from differences between a published protocol and a version a scientist modified, which provides the basis for the query and the weighted rubric elements for a correct response. The benchmark draws from 96 source protocols across nine domains of wet-lab biology and only includes tasks rated highly after review by domain experts. We evaluate nine closed and open models; Claude Opus 5 scores highest at 59.2% normalized rubric score, with other models between 34.1% and 47.1%, and the benchmark remains unsaturated when taking the best of ten attempts. As models are increasingly helpful in life-sciences research, evaluating them on routine wet-lab tasks becomes correspondingly important. We present BenchBench-Protocol as both a grounded assessment of wet-lab reasoning and evidence for the utility of real-world experiments to construct benchmark tasks.

AI.title_translation: BenchBench-Protocol：评估真实世界湿式实验方案的推理和修改
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了BenchBench-Protocol，一个包含149个真实世界湿式实验方案修改任务的基准，用于评估大型语言模型在理解和修改实验方案方面的能力。结果显示，现有模型表现不佳，基准仍有改进空间，凸显了评估模型在常规湿式实验任务上能力的重要性。
AI.motivation: Adapting published protocols to new experiments is a routine but complex task for wet-lab scientists, requiring consideration of prior choices and downstream steps. Evaluating LLMs on these real-world tasks is crucial as they become more integrated into life sciences research.
AI.method: BenchBench-Protocol benchmark was created from differences between published protocols and scientist-modified versions. It comprises 149 protocol-modification tasks from 96 source protocols across nine wet-lab biology domains, with tasks rated highly by domain experts. Nine closed and open models were evaluated on this benchmark.
AI.result: Claude Opus 5 achieved the highest score at 59.2% normalized rubric score. Other models scored between 34.1% and 47.1%. The benchmark remains unsaturated, even with ten attempts per model.
AI.conclusion: BenchBench-Protocol serves as a grounded assessment of wet-lab reasoning capabilities for LLMs and demonstrates the value of using real-world experimental modifications to construct benchmark tasks. Current models still have significant room for improvement on these types of tasks.
AI.translation: 我们引入了BenchBench-Protocol，一个包含149个协议修改任务的基准，这些任务是从科学家在真实实验工作中对已发布协议所做的修改中恢复出来的。调整已发布的协议以适应新实验是湿式实验室科学家的一项常规任务，正确的修改需要考虑先前的选择和下游步骤。近期的生命科学基准已转向开放式、有评分标准的任务，但任务通常是由专家提出的，而不是从真实世界的修改中重建的。BenchBench-Protocol任务源于已发布的协议与科学家修改后的版本之间的差异，这为查询和正确响应的加权评分要素提供了基础。该基准涵盖了湿式生物学九个领域的96个源协议，并且只包括经过领域专家评审后评级很高的任务。我们评估了九个闭源和开源模型；Claude Opus 5以59.2%的归一化评分最高，其他模型得分在34.1%到47.1%之间，并且考虑到十次尝试的最佳结果，该基准仍未饱和。随着模型在生命科学研究中越来越有帮助，在常规湿式实验任务上评估它们变得同样重要。我们将BenchBench-Protocol呈现为对湿式实验推理的实际评估，以及证明真实世界实验在构建基准任务方面的效用的证据。
AI.summary: BenchBench-Protocol是一个新提出的基准，包含149个真实世界中科学家修改实验方案的任务，旨在评估大型语言模型在湿式实验方案推理和修改方面的能力。该基准通过分析已发表协议与实际修改版本之间的差异构建而成，涵盖了广泛的生物学领域，并经过专家评审。在对九个模型进行的评估中，Claude Opus 5表现最佳，但整体得分不高，且基准仍未饱和，表明现有模型在处理这类常规但复杂的湿式实验任务方面仍有很大提升空间。
AI.keywords: BenchBench-Protocol, 湿式实验方案, 大型语言模型, 协议修改, 科学推理
AI.comments: 这是一个非常有价值的基准，因为它利用了真实世界的实验数据来评估模型在科学研究中的实际应用能力。将模型评估的重点放在“真实世界修改”上，比仅仅依赖专家凭空设计任务更能反映模型的实际效用。然而，59.2%的最高得分表明，即使是最好的模型也远未达到人类科学家的水平，这揭示了LLMs在理解和应用复杂科学知识方面仍然存在巨大挑战。该研究的局限性可能在于基准的覆盖范围和任务的多样性，以及对“高评分”的定义可能存在主观性。未来的工作可以考虑扩展基准的领域，增加任务的复杂性，并探索更客观的评估方法。

title: Ray-Traced Augmentation for Signal Strength Based Localization
summary: Indoor localization based on Wi-Fi typically relies on extensive collection of real-world received signal strength (RSS) fingerprints, making deployment costly and time-consuming. We present a ray-tracing-based framework that reduces this reliance by generating synthetic RSS fingerprints from a building model. We first calibrate the building model using a small amount of real RSS fingerprints through Bayesian optimization, followed by per-access-point calibration to account for residual errors in simulated RSS values. The calibrated model is then used to generate a large augmented dataset of synthetic RSS fingerprints at arbitrary locations. To effectively exploit these data for localization, we introduce novel binary and multivalued representations of RSS values and a ResNet-based localization architecture that supports cross-band fusion of 2.4 and 5 GHz measurements. We evaluate our localization method on a real campus building against a diverse set of four baselines. When trained exclusively on synthetic data, the proposed method with multivalued representation and upstream cross-band fusion achieves a mean localization error of 3.05m on a real-data test set, outperforming the best baseline by 33.6%. The results demonstrate that calibrated ray-tracing-based simulation can substantially reduce the need for real RSS fingerprints while enabling accurate deep-learning-based indoor localization.

AI.title_translation: 基于光线追踪的信号强度定位数据增强方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于光线追踪和深度学习的室内定位数据增强方法，大幅减少了真实Wi-Fi指纹采集的需求并提高了定位精度。
AI.motivation: 基于Wi-Fi的室内定位通常严重依赖于大规模真实世界接收信号强度（RSS）指纹的采集，这导致部署成本高昂且耗时。
AI.method: 提出一个基于光线追踪的框架，首先通过贝叶斯优化结合少量真实RSS指纹校准建筑模型，再进行接入点级别校准以处理残余误差，生成大规模合成数据集；同时引入二进制和多值RSS表示，并设计基于ResNet的跨频段融合定位架构。
AI.result: 在真实校园建筑上的评估表明，仅使用合成数据训练时，该方法配合多值表示和上游跨频段融合，在真实测试集上实现了3.05米的平均定位误差，比最佳基线方法提高了33.6%。
AI.conclusion: 经校准的光线追踪仿真能显著减少对真实RSS指纹的依赖，并实现高精度的基于深度学习的室内定位。
AI.translation: 基于Wi-Fi的室内定位通常依赖于对现实世界接收信号强度（RSS）指纹的大规模采集，这使得部署成本高昂且耗时。我们提出了一种基于光线追踪的框架，通过从建筑模型生成合成RSS指纹来减少这种依赖。我们首先通过贝叶斯优化利用少量真实RSS指纹对建筑模型进行校准，随后进行每个接入点的校准以消除模拟RSS值中的残余误差。然后，利用校准后的模型在任意位置生成大量合成RSS指纹的增强数据集。为了有效利用这些数据进行定位，我们引入了RSS值的新型二值和多值表示，以及支持2.4和5 GHz测量结果跨频段融合的基于ResNet的定位架构。我们在一个真实的校园建筑中，针对四种不同的基线评估了我们的定位方法。当仅使用合成数据进行训练时，所提出的采用多值表示和上游跨频段融合的方法在真实数据测试集上实现了3.05米的平均定位误差，比最佳基线性能提升了33.6%。结果表明，基于校准光线追踪的仿真可以显着减少对真实RSS指纹的需求，同时实现基于深度学习的精确室内定位。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种基于光线追踪的框架，通过校准建筑模型并生成合成RSS指纹，结合新型RSS表示与ResNet跨频段融合架构，大幅减少了真实指纹采集需求，实现了高效准确的室内定位。
AI.keywords: 室内定位, 接收信号强度, 光线追踪, 数据增强, 深度学习
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种基于光线追踪的室内定位数据增强框架，通过贝叶斯优化校准建筑模型，并引入多值表示与跨频段融合架构，有效解决了Wi-Fi指纹采集成本高、耗时的问题，在仅使用合成数据训练的情况下表现优异。

title: Continual Visual Learning under Evolving Semantic Concept Shift
summary: Visual foundation models are commonly adapted under the assumption that the appearance of incoming data may change while the semantic meaning of the prediction task remains fixed. In long-lived visual systems, however, taxonomies, policies, and concept definitions can themselves evolve, causing the same visual evidence to require a different interpretation. We study this setting as evolving semantic concept shift and introduce SemReWrite, a framework for selectively updating obsolete visual--semantic mappings while preserving knowledge that remains valid. SemReWrite represents changes between old and revised semantic specifications, combines semantic discrepancy with sparse revised supervision to localize affected visual regions, and uses an input-dependent low-rank rewriting mechanism together with structured semantic memory, preservation, and obsolete-decision suppression. We further introduce EvoShift-Bench, spanning ImageNet, iNaturalist, CUB-200-2011, and DomainNet, with semantic transitions including class split, merge, boundary revision, insertion, partial redefinition, recurrence, and mixed semantic--appearance shift. To explicitly evaluate selective semantic revision, we introduce Rewrite Accuracy (RA) and Preservation Accuracy (PA) for affected and unaffected regions, respectively, Obsolete Retention (OR) for measuring residual outdated semantic associations, and the Selective Revision Score (SRS), which jointly summarizes rewriting and preservation performance. Experiments show that SemReWrite achieves a stronger balance between learning revised semantics and retaining unaffected knowledge than prompt replacement, conventional fine-tuning, parameter-efficient adaptation, and continual-learning strategies.

AI.title_translation: 演变语义概念偏移下的持续视觉学习
AI.tldr: 针对长期视觉系统中语义定义演变的问题，本文提出了SemReWrite框架，能够选择性地更新过时的语义映射并保留有效知识。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉基础模型适应方法通常假设预测任务的语义固定，而长寿视觉系统中分类法、策略和概念定义会发生演变，导致相同的视觉证据需要不同的解释，因此需要研究演变语义概念偏移问题。
AI.method: 提出了SemReWrite框架，结合语义差异与稀疏修订监督来定位受影响的视觉区域，采用输入依赖的低秩重写机制、结构化语义 memory、知识保持以及废旧决策抑制策略。同时引入了EvoShift-Bench基准和专门的评估指标（RA、PA、OR、SRS）。
AI.result: 实验表明，与提示替换、常规微调、参数高效微调和持续学习策略相比，SemReWrite在学习修订后的语义和保留不受影响的知识之间取得了更强的平衡。
AI.conclusion: SemReWrite框架有效地解决了演变语义概念偏移问题，在保持不受影响知识的同时能够准确学习修订后的语义，优于现有的微调和持续学习方法。
AI.translation: 视觉基础模型通常在输入数据外观可能变化而预测任务语义保持不变的假设下进行适应。然而，在长期运行的视觉系统中，分类体系、策略和概念定义本身可能会演变，导致相同的视觉证据需要不同的解释。我们将此设定研究为演变语义概念偏移，并引入了SemReWrite框架，用于有选择地更新过时的视觉-语义映射，同时保留仍然有效的知识。SemReWrite表示新旧语义规范之间的变化，结合语义差异与稀疏修订监督来定位受影响的视觉区域，并使用输入依赖的低秩重写机制以及结构化语义记忆、保留和废旧决策抑制。我们进一步推出了EvoShift-Bench，涵盖ImageNet、iNaturalist、CUB-200-2011和DomainNet，其语义转换包括类别分裂、合并、边界修订、插入、部分重新定义、复现以及混合语义-外观偏移。为了明确评估选择性语义修订，我们引入了针对受影响和不受影响区域的重写准确率（RA）和保持准确率（PA），用于衡量残余过时语义关联的过时保留率（OR），以及综合总结重写和保持性能的选择性修订分数（SRS）。实验表明，与提示替换、常规微调、参数高效适应和持续学习策略相比，SemReWrite在学习修订后的语义和保留不受影响的知识之间实现了更好的平衡。
AI.summary: 论文研究了视觉持续学习中的演变语义概念偏移问题，推出了SemReWrite框架和EvoShift-Bench基准，能够选择性地更新过时的视觉-语义映射，同时保留有效知识，实验证明其性能优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 持续视觉学习, 语义概念偏移, 视觉基础模型, 知识保留, 选择性重写
AI.comments: 该论文针对视觉基础模型在长期应用中面临的语义概念演变问题，提出了SemReWrite框架及EvoShift-Bench基准，创新性地实现了选择性视觉-语义映射更新，平衡了新语义学习与旧知识保留，具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。

title: Quantifying System-Level Harms from AI Adoption in Complex Sociotechnical Systems
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into complex sociotechnical systems, including Critical National Infrastructure (CNI), where harms emerge from interactions between technical, human, and organisational elements. Yet current AI evaluation remains model-centric, offering little insight into how observed behaviours might translate into system-level risk. We propose a framework that links structured hazard analysis, component-level testing, and probabilistic system modelling to bridge this gap. By providing a traceable pathway from model behaviour to system-level outcomes, the framework enables practitioners to answer the "so what?" of AI failures, quantify their systemic impact, and move toward evidence-based and anticipatory governance of AI in complex systems. Applied to the UK's Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) system as an illustrative worked example, we derive AI-driven loss scenarios using Systems Theoretic Process Analysis (STPA) and examine adversarial manipulation of LLM-based trading as one such loss scenario. Component-level experiments show that simple adversarial inputs induce measurable behavioural shifts where AI recommendations are followed. Under the component-to-system mapping used here for a financial contagion model, these shifts alter system resilience, increasing bank failures and lowering the threshold at which shocks lead to cascading disruption, particularly under widespread or monopolistic AI adoption.

AI.title_translation: 量化复杂社会技术系统中AI采纳带来的系统级危害
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新框架，连接模型行为与系统级风险，用于量化和治理AI在复杂社会技术系统中的潜在危害。
AI.motivation: 当前的人工智能评估主要关注模型本身，无法为模型行为如何转化为复杂社会技术系统（如国家关键基础设施）中的系统级风险提供足够的洞察。
AI.method: 提出一个连接结构化危害分析、组件级测试和概率系统建模的框架；结合英国实时全额结算系统（RTGS）和基于系统理论的过程分析（STPA）方法进行了实例验证与组件级实验。
AI.result: 实验表明，简单的对抗性输入会导致AI建议的行为发生可度量变化；在金融传染模型中，这些变化会降低系统韧性，增加银行倒闭数量，并降低引发级联破坏的阈值，特别是在广泛或垄断性AI采纳的情况下。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过连接组件测试与系统建模，能够有效量化AI在复杂社会技术系统（如国家关键基础设施）中引发的系统级危害，推动基于证据的前瞻性AI治理。
AI.translation: 人工智能（AI）正日益融入包括国家关键基础设施（CNI）在内的复杂社会技术系统中，其危害往往源于技术、人类和组织要素之间的相互作用。然而，当前的人工智能评估仍然以模型为中心，对观察到的行为如何转化为系统级风险提供的信息甚少。我们提出了一个将结构化危害分析、组件级测试和概率系统建模结合起来的框架来弥补这一差距。通过提供从模型行为到系统级结果的可追踪路径，该框架使从业者能够回答AI故障的“那又怎样？”问题，量化其系统性影响，并推动对复杂系统中AI的基于证据和前瞻性的治理。以英国的实时全额结算（RTGS）系统为例，我们使用系统理论过程分析（STPA）推导了AI驱动的损失场景，并检验了基于LLM的交易的对抗性操纵作为其中一种损失场景。组件级实验表明，简单的对抗性输入会引起可测量的行为转变，从而导致人们遵循AI的建议。根据此处用于金融传染模型的组件到系统映射，这些转变改变了系统的弹性，增加了银行倒闭的数量，并降低了冲击导致级联中断的阈值，特别是在广泛或垄断性的AI采纳情况下。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新颖的评估框架，通过结合危害分析、组件测试和系统建模，将AI模型行为与复杂社会技术系统中的系统级风险联系起来，并以英国RTGS系统和LLM交易为例验证了其能有效量化系统级危害。
AI.keywords: 人工智能, 社会技术系统, 系统级风险, 危害分析, 金融传染模型
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种将结构化危害分析、组件级测试与概率系统建模相结合的新颖框架，成功连接了模型行为与系统级风险，克服了当前AI评估中过度关注模型本身的局限性，对关键基础设施中AI的治理具有重要的理论和现实意义。

title: Retrieval-augmented generation vs. deterministic tax computation in multi-agent financial advisory: A 2x2 factorial experiment
summary: Tax-loss harvesting demonstrates consistent benefits to long-term portfolio growth; yet implementing it efficiently often involves complex considerations that are specific to the holdings within that portfolio and the individual who owns it. We introduce a custom capital gains calculation engine and a RAG-retrieved vector store of market advisory reports to provide context for a multi-agent trade recommendation system. We investigate the effects of each context provider on the quality of recommendations, measured by relative capital gains incurred during portfolio liquidation. A 2x2 repeated-measures ANOVA revealed a significant main effect of the tax optimization engine ($F(1,29) = 9.17$, $p = .005$, $η^2_p = .240$): enabling the engine reduced tax savings by approximately 55 percentage points relative to the no-engine conditions. The RAG main effect was not significant ($p = .841$), nor was the interaction ($p = .553$). The RAG-only condition achieved the highest descriptive mean tax savings (47.7%), and the baseline condition performed second-best (30.6%), suggesting that the pre-trained language model's internalized financial knowledge may be sufficient for competent tax-loss harvesting recommendations without explicit tooling. These results indicate that augmenting LLM agents with domain-specific computation engines does not guarantee improved performance and may introduce conflicting optimization signals.

AI.title_translation: 检索增强生成与确定性税务计算在多主体金融咨询中的对比：一项2x2析因实验
AI.tldr: 在多主体金融咨询中，使用自定义的资本利得计算引擎和检索增强生成（RAG）的税务优化方法，实验发现，启用计算引擎反而显著降低了税收节省（约55%），而RAG未显示显著效果。仅使用预训练语言模型的内部金融知识（RAG-only和基线条件）取得了最佳的税收节省效果，表明增加特定领域的计算引擎可能引入冲突信号，并不一定能提升性能。
AI.motivation: 税务亏损收割对长期投资组合增长有益，但其实施涉及复杂的、与投资组合和个人相关的特定考量。本研究旨在探讨在多主体金融咨询系统中，使用检索增强生成（RAG）和确定性税务计算引擎对推荐系统质量的影响。
AI.method: 本研究采用2x2重复测量方差分析（ANOVA）方法，比较了自定义资本利得计算引擎和RAG检索的专家报告在多主体交易推荐系统中的效果。实验测量了投资组合清算期间产生的相对资本利得，以评估推荐质量。实验设置了四种条件：1. 仅有计算引擎；2. 仅有RAG；3. 计算引擎和RAG均有；4. 两者均无（基线）。
AI.result: 2x2重复测量ANOVA分析显示，税务优化引擎具有显著的主效应（F(1,29) = 9.17, p = .005, η²p = .240），启用该引擎相比未启用时，税收节省减少了约55%。RAG的主效应不显著（p = .841），交互作用也不显著（p = .553）。仅RAG条件实现了最高的平均税收节省（47.7%），基线条件次之（30.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 在多主体金融咨询场景下，为大型语言模型（LLM）代理增加领域特定的计算引擎，并不能保证性能提升，反而可能引入冲突的优化信号，导致税收节省减少。预训练语言模型内置的金融知识可能足以支持有效的税务亏损收割建议，无需额外的计算工具。
AI.translation: 税务亏损收割对长期投资组合增长有持续的好处；然而，有效实施它通常涉及复杂的考虑因素，这些因素特定于该投资组合中的持股以及拥有该投资组合的个人。我们引入了一个自定义的资本利得计算引擎和一个包含市场咨询报告的RAG检索向量存储，为多主体交易推荐系统提供背景信息。我们研究了每个上下文提供者对推荐质量的影响，通过投资组合清算期间产生的相对资本利得来衡量。一项2x2重复测量ANOVA分析显示，税务优化引擎具有显著的主效应（F(1,29) = 9.17, p = .005, η²p = .240）：与无引擎条件相比，启用该引擎使税收节省减少了约55%。RAG的主效应不显著（p = .841），交互作用也不显著（p = .553）。仅RAG条件实现了最高的描述性平均税收节省（47.7%），基线条件表现次佳（30.6%），这表明预训练语言模型内部的金融知识可能足以支持有效的税务亏损收割建议，而无需显式的工具。这些结果表明，用领域特定的计算引擎增强LLM代理并不能保证性能的提高，并且可能引入冲突的优化信号。
AI.summary: 本研究评估了在多主体金融咨询中，检索增强生成（RAG）和自定义资本利得计算引擎对税务优化效果的影响。通过一项2x2实验，研究发现启用计算引擎显著降低了税收节省，而RAG未产生显著影响。结果表明，仅依赖预训练语言模型的内部金融知识可能比引入复杂计算引擎更有效，后者甚至可能引入冲突信号。
AI.keywords: 税务亏损收割, 检索增强生成, 多主体系统, 金融咨询, 资本利得计算
AI.comments: 该研究的实验设计和结果具有重要的启示意义，特别是关于在金融咨询领域集成复杂计算工具的潜在弊端。研究结果表明，有时“少即是多”，预训练模型的内在知识可能足以应对某些任务。然而，研究的局限性在于其仅限于特定的金融咨询场景和特定的衡量指标（资本利得），未来的研究可以探索在更广泛的任务和不同的性能指标下，计算引擎和RAG的组合效果。

title: Partial Optimal Transport on the Circle for All Transported Masses in O(N log N)
summary: Partial optimal transport compares two measures while leaving part of the mass unmatched, which is what makes it robust to outliers, occlusion, and clutter. The quantity of interest is usually the whole profile - the optimal cost at every transported cardinality - because the right amount to transport is rarely known in advance, and on the real line the PAWL algorithm returns that profile in $O(N\log N)$. Much data is periodic rather than linear: angles, phases, orientations, time of day, hue, and every direction obtained by projecting onto a great circle. On the circle the same problem acquires a global circulation, or equivalently an optimized cut, which the naive exact method handles by running the line algorithm once per support gap, at $O(N^{2}\log N)$. We show that this factor $N$ is unnecessary. The line structure survives in cut-free form, and a free-gap invariant supplies, at every step, a cut at which all previous local updates remain valid line updates. This yields PAWC: an exact $O(N\log N)$ time, $O(N)$ memory algorithm returning all $K+1$ costs, nested active sets and plans in one run, together with a single gap that is simultaneously optimal for every cardinality. Slicing over great circles extends it to $\mathbb{S}^{d-1}$. Empirically the whole profile costs $0.56$ms at $N=4096$ against $1.5$s for a single transported fraction from a general solver; on occluded, cluttered mpeg-7 shapes, holding the descriptor fixed and varying only the cost, it retains $66\%$ of the clean-data retrieval score against $16\%$ for balanced circular OT, and on $\mathbb{S}^{2}$ it halves the fitting error of spherical sliced Wasserstein against contaminated targets, synthetic and real. Code is available at https://github.com/mint-vu/Partial_Wasserstein_on_Circles.

AI.title_translation: 所有传输质量下圆周上的部分最优传输：$O(N\log N)$ 复杂度
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在圆周上计算所有传输质量的部分最优传输的 $O(N\log N)$ 算法（PAWC），大幅提升了速度并保持了极高的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现实中许多数据具有周期性（如角度、相位、方向等），而现有的圆周部分最优传输的精确方法需要 $O(N^2\log N)$ 的时间复杂度，计算效率低下，本文旨在消除这种因全局循环或切割带来的额外 $N$ 阶复杂度。
AI.method: 利用无割形式的直线结构以及自由间隙不变量，开发了PAWC算法，在单次运行中返回所有基数下的最优代价、嵌套活动集和方案，并通过在大圆上进行切片扩展到高维球面 $\mathbb{S}^{d-1}$。
AI.result: 提出的PAWC算法在 $O(N\log N)$ 时间和 $O(N)$ 内存下运行，实验表明其在处理 $N=4096$ 的数据时仅需 0.56ms，在有遮挡和杂波的形状检索以及球面拟合任务中表现出极高的鲁棒性和准确性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了PAWC算法，能够以 $O(N\log N)$ 的时间复杂度精确求解圆周上的部分最优传输全景曲线，显著提升了算法在处理噪声和遮挡数据时的效率和准确性。
AI.translation: 部分最优传输通过在不匹配部分质量的同时比较两个测度，从而对异常值、遮挡和杂乱数据表现出稳健性。人们通常感兴趣的量是整个轮廓——每个传输基数下的最优成本，因为正确传输的数量往往事先未知，而在实数线上，PAWL算法能以 $O(N\log N)$ 的时间复杂度返回该轮廓。许多数据具有周期性而非线性：角度、相位、方向、一天中的时间、色调以及通过投影到大圆上获得的所有方向。在圆周上，同样的问题引入了全局循环或等价的优化切割，朴素的精确方法通过对每个支撑间隙运行一次线性算法来处理，时间复杂度为 $O(N^2\log N)$。我们证明了这个 $N$ 因子是不必要的。直线结构以无割形式保留，自由间隙不变量在每一步提供了一个切割，在该切割处所有先前的局部更新仍然保持为有效的直线更新。这产生了PAWC：一个精确的 $O(N\log N)$ 时间、$O(N)$ 内存的算法，在单次运行中返回所有 $K+1$ 个成本、嵌套活动集和方案，以及一个对每个基数同时最优的单个间隙。在大圆上进行切片将其扩展到了 $\mathbb{S}^{d-1}$。实验表明，当 $N=4096$ 时，获取整个轮廓的成本为 0.56ms（而通用求解器求解单个传输分数需要 1.5s）；在被遮挡、杂乱的 mpeg-7 形状上，在固定描述符且仅改变成本的情况下，它保留了 66% 的干净数据检索得分（平衡圆周最优传输仅为 16%）；在 $\mathbb{S}^{2}$ 上，它使对抗污染目标（合成和真实）的球面切片 Wasserstein 拟合误差减半。代码可在 https://github.com/mint-vu/Partial_Wasserstein_on_Circles 获取。
AI.summary: 本文研究了圆周上的部分最优传输问题，提出了一种名为PAWC的高效精确算法，将时间复杂度从 $O(N^2\log N)$ 降低至 $O(N\log N)$，能够为所有传输基数生成完整的代价曲线，并在多项实验中展现出优异的鲁棒性和运行效率。
AI.keywords: Partial Optimal Transport, Circle, $O(N\log N)$ Algorithm, Sliced Wasserstein, Robustness
AI.comments: 该论文在圆周上的部分最优传输问题上取得了重大突破，将算法时间复杂度从 $O(N^2\log N)$ 降低到 $O(N\log N)$，具有很高的理论价值和实际应用潜力。

title: PROOF-Gen: From Optimized Data to Better Distillation
summary:
Supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated trajectories is the standard first stage for distilling tool-calling capabilities into deployable models. Post-training pipelines that drive shipped tool-calling agents re-run this stage on a daily or weekly cadence, paying the frontier-teacher cost each cycle, yet the mechanism is generate-and-filter (keep the teacher's passing trajectories, discard the rest) and each cycle leaves behind the same hard scenarios because failures supply no signal. On τ2-bench, 57% of teacher trials fail, two-thirds of them near-misses (most tool calls correct, undone by one decisive error).
  We introduce PROOF-Gen (Per-scenario Reflective Optimization to Overcome FailedGeneration), which recovers golden trajectories from these failures via per-scenario prompt optimization. For each failed task, a reflector analyzes the execution trace and evaluation feedback, then writes corrective guidance that steers the teacher to a passing trajectory. The guidance is stripped before training, so the student learns from clean demonstrations with no task-specific scaffold.
  On τ2-bench, per-scenario optimization recovers 93% of failed scenarios. Fine-tuned on the combined data, Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 improves from Pass^1=0.132 to 0.529 and Gemma 4 E4B-it gains +7.2pp on BFCL v4 multi-turn. In a deployed pipeline, the method lifts trajectory quality by +6.3pp goal completion and transfers to a deployed on-device model (+1.5pp goal completion; +1.7 to +5.0pp across response-quality metrics), with positive transfer in every locale (non-English average +1.48pp).

AI.title_translation: PROOF-Gen：从优化数据到更好的蒸馏
AI.tldr: PROOF-Gen通过反思机制将教师模型的失败工具调用轨迹转化为高质量的训练数据，显著提升了模型蒸馏的效果和实际部署性能。
AI.motivation: 传统的教师生成轨迹蒸馏方法主要依赖“生成并过滤”机制，丢弃了大量的失败轨迹（特别是其中的近距离失误），导致每个训练周期都无法从困难场景中获取学习信号，且教师成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出了PROOF-Gen（基于每场景反射优化的失败生成克服方法），利用反射器分析失败任务的执行轨迹和评估反馈，编写纠正性引导以指导教师模型生成通过的轨迹，并在训练前剥离引导，使学生模型从干净的示范中学习。
AI.result: 在τ2-bench上，PROOF-Gen恢复了93%的失败场景；Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507的Pass^1从0.132提升至0.529；Gemma 4 E4B-it在BFCL v4多轮对话上提升了7.2个百分点；在实际部署中，目标完成率提升了6.3个百分点，并在设备端模型及多语言场景中表现出积极的正向迁移。
AI.conclusion: PROOF-Gen通过每场景的提示词优化，成功利用了教师模型的失败轨迹，显著提升了工具调用模型的蒸馏效果和实际部署性能。
AI.translation:
在由教师生成的轨迹上进行监督微调是将工具调用能力蒸馏到可部署模型中的标准第一阶段。驱动已部署的工具调用代理的后训练流水线每天或每周重复此阶段，每个周期都需支付前沿教师的成本，然而其机制却是“生成并过滤”（保留教师通过的轨迹，其余丢弃），并且每个周期都会留下相同的困难场景，因为失败无法提供任何信号。在τ2-bench上，57%的教师试验失败，其中三分之二是近距离失误（大多数工具调用正确，却被一个决定性的错误毁掉）。
我们引入了PROOF-Gen（基于每场景反射优化的失败生成克服方法），该方法通过每场景的提示词优化，从这些失败中恢复出黄金轨迹。对于每个失败的任务，反射器会分析执行轨迹和评估反馈，然后编写纠正性指导，引导教师走向通过的轨迹。在训练前会剥离这些指导，因此学生能够从干净的示范中学习，而没有任务特定的支架。
在τ2-bench上，每场景优化恢复了93%的失败场景。使用组合数据微调后，Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507的Pass^1从0.132提升至0.529，Gemma 4 E4B-it在BFCL v4多轮对话上获得了+7.2个百分点的提升。在部署的流水线中，该方法将目标完成率的轨迹质量提升了6.3个百分点，并迁移到了部署的端侧模型上（目标完成率提升+1.5个百分点；各项响应质量指标提升+1.7到+5.0个百分点），且在所有区域设置中均表现出正向迁移（非英语平均提升+1.48个百分点）。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了PROOF-Gen，一种通过每场景反思优化从教师模型的失败轨迹中恢复黄金轨迹的蒸馏方法。实验表明，该方法能显著提高工具调用模型的性能及实际部署的效果。
AI.keywords: 工具调用, 模型蒸馏, 监督微调, 提示词优化, 轨迹恢复
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种名为PROOF-Gen的方法，通过反思机制从教师模型的失败轨迹中恢复出高质量的“黄金轨迹”，解决了传统生成-过滤机制中失败样本浪费的问题。该方法在多个基准测试和实际部署中均表现出显著的性能提升，具有很高的实用价值。

title: The Loss Floor of Denoising Score Matching: Fisher Geometry from Schrödinger Bridges
summary: Denoising score matching trains diffusion models by regressing onto a conditional score, although generation ultimately requires the marginal score. The two objectives share the same population minimizer, but the conditional target remains random at fixed noisy state and introduces an irreducible excess in the training loss. We isolate this excess and show that, for a general corruption kernel under mild regularity assumptions, it is exactly the trace of the Fisher--Rao metric of the conditional endpoint family, integrated along the diffusion trajectory. This gives an exact conditional-variance decomposition of the denoising objective and identifies the information geometry observed in diffusion latent spaces as an intrinsic component of the training loss. We derive the result from a Schr"odinger bridge variational principle, in which the ideal objective arises as excess path-space relative entropy. For corruption diffusions, the Fisher term is proportional to the rate at which the noisy state loses mutual information about the clean data, separating the loss floor into an information flow determined by the data and a weight determined by the corruption schedule and objective. In the Gaussian case, this yields a closed form for the floor, recovers reparametrization invariance of the continuous-time objective, and relates its high-SNR divergence to the information dimension of the data. Finally, we show that raw losses obtained with different noise ranges or weightings need not rank models consistently because they contain different additive floors, and contrast the second-order geometry seen by training with the third-order conditional statistics entering numerical sampling error.

AI.title_translation: 去噪得分匹配的损失下限：来自薛定谔桥的Fisher几何
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了扩散模型去噪得分匹配中训练损失下限的几何本质，证明其为条件端点族Fisher-Rao度量的积分，并由薛定谔桥变分原理推导得出。
AI.motivation: 去噪得分匹配虽然训练目标与边缘得分共享总体极小值，但由于条件目标在固定噪声状态下具有随机性，导致训练损失中引入了不可约减的超额部分（即损失下限）。为了理解这一现象，论文旨在从信息几何和薛定谔桥的角度揭示该损失下限的数学本质。
AI.method: 利用薛定谔桥变分原理，推导去噪目标函数的精确条件方差分解，并将超额损失与条件端点族的Fisher-Rao度量及路径空间相对熵相联系。
AI.result: 证明了损失下限精确等于沿扩散轨迹积分的条件端点族的Fisher-Rao度量的迹；在一般污染核下，该Fisher项正比于噪声状态丢失干净数据互信息的速率；在高斯情况下推导出了下限的闭式解并与数据的信息维度相关联。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过薛定谔桥变分原理揭示了去噪得分匹配中损失下限的几何本质，将其精确刻画为条件端点族的Fisher-Rao度量积分与互信息流率，为扩散模型的理论分析和超参数选择提供了新的视角。
AI.translation: 去噪得分匹配通过回归到条件得分来训练扩散模型，尽管生成过程最终需要边缘得分。这两个目标共享相同的总体极小值，但在固定的噪声状态下，条件目标仍然是随机的，并在训练损失中引入了不可约减的超额部分。我们隔离了这种超额部分，并证明对于在温和正则性假设下的通用污染核，它正好是条件端点族的 Fisher-Rao 度量的迹，沿扩散轨迹进行积分。这给出了去噪目标的精确条件方差分解，并将扩散潜空间中观察到的信息几何识别为训练损失的一个内在组成部分。我们从薛定谔桥变分原理推导出了这一结果，其中理想的目标表现为超额路径空间相对熵。对于污染扩散，Fisher 项正比于噪声状态失去关于干净数据的互信息的速率，将损失下限分为由数据决定的信息流和由污染调度与目标决定的权重。在高斯情况下，这为下限产生了闭式解，恢复了连续时间目标的重参数化不变性，并将其高信噪比散度与数据的信息维度联系起来。最后，我们表明使用不同噪声范围或加权获得的原始损失不一定能一致地对模型进行排序，因为它们包含不同的加法下限，并对比了通过训练看到的二阶几何与进入数值采样误差的三阶条件统计量。
AI.summary: 论文研究了去噪得分匹配中由于条件目标随机性导致的训练损失下限（Loss Floor）。通过薛定谔桥变分原理，作者证明了该超额损失精确对应于条件端点族Fisher-Rao度量的迹沿扩散轨迹的积分，并将其与互信息流、高斯情况下的闭式解以及模型排序的潜在问题联系起来。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 去噪得分匹配, 薛定谔桥, Fisher-Rao度量, 信息几何
AI.comments: 该论文从薛定谔桥的视角深入剖析了去噪得分匹配中训练损失下限（Loss Floor）的几何本质，为理解扩散模型的训练动态和信息几何提供了坚实的理论基础。其创新在于将损失下限与Fisher-Rao度量及互信息流联系起来，具有重要的理论指导意义。

title: GATNextHop: A GAT for Shortest Path Routing with Cross-Topology Generalization
comments: Sixth Annual Computer Science Conference for CSU Undergraduates
summary: Common shortest-path algorithms, such as Dijkstra's (SPF), that OSPF uses, provide exact routing solutions but must be recomputed for each network topology, limiting scalability in dynamic or large-scale networks. This paper proposes the GATNextHop model to determine whether a Graph Neural Network, namely the Graph Attention Network, can approximate shortest paths and generalize across topologies. By training on synthetic graphs and evaluating on real-world Internet Service Provider networks from the Internet Topology Zoo, we aim to benchmark our model's ability to learn routing heuristics that transfer across network structures. Performance will be evaluated in terms of accuracy, inference speed, and generalization, comparing the GNN against Dijkstra's algorithm to quantify trade-offs between learned and classical routing approaches.
comment: Sixth Annual Computer Science Conference for CSU Undergraduates

AI.title_translation: GATNextHop：用于具有跨拓扑泛化能力的最短路径路由的图注意力网络
AI.tldr: 本文提出 GATNextHop 模型，利用图注意力网络（GAT）来近似最短路径路由并实现跨拓扑泛化。
AI.motivation: 传统的最短路径算法（如 OSPF 使用的 Dijkstra 算法）虽然能提供精确的路由解，但每次网络拓扑改变时都需要重新计算，限制了其在动态或大规模网络中的可扩展性。
AI.method: 提出了 GATNextHop 模型，采用图注意力网络（GAT）在合成图上进行训练，并在来自 Internet Topology Zoo 的真实 ISP 网络上进行评估，与 Dijkstra 算法进行对比。
AI.result: 通过在合成图上训练并在真实ISP网络上评估，量化了 GNN 模型在准确率、推理速度和泛化能力方面与经典路由方法的权衡。
AI.conclusion: GATNextHop 模型旨在通过学习路由启发式方法，实现跨拓扑结构的泛化，并在准确率、推理速度和泛化能力方面与传统 Dijkstra 算法进行性能权衡对比。
AI.translation: 诸如OSPF所使用的Dijkstra算法（SPF）等常见的最短路径算法，能够提供精确的路由解，但必须为每个网络拓扑重新计算，这限制了其在动态或大规模网络中的可扩展性。本文提出了GATNextHop模型，旨在探究图神经网络（即图注意力网络）是否能够近似最短路径并跨拓扑进行泛化。通过在合成图上进行训练并在来自Internet Topology Zoo的真实互联网服务提供商（ISP）网络上进行评估，我们的目标是检验模型学习可在不同网络结构间转移的路由启发式算法的能力。性能将从准确率、推理速度和泛化能力三个方面进行评估，并将GNN与Dijkstra算法进行比较，以量化学习型路由方法与经典路由方法之间的权衡。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 GATNextHop 模型，利用图注意力网络（GAT）来近似最短路径路由，并研究其在不同网络拓扑间的泛化能力，通过与 Dijkstra 算法的对比来评估其准确率、推理速度和泛化性能。
AI.keywords: 图神经网络, 图注意力网络, 最短路径路由, 跨拓扑泛化, 路由启发式算法
AI.comments: 本文创新性地探索了利用图注意力网络（GAT）来近似最短路径路由，并重点评估了其跨拓扑结构的泛化能力，为解决传统最短路径算法在动态或大规模网络中的扩展性瓶颈提供了新思路。

title: MARS: Multi-Specialist LLM Relay System for Competitive Programming
summary: Large Language Models excel at code generation, yet competitive programming exposes a persistent failure mode: existing multi-agent pipelines distribute work over generic planner, coder, and debugger roles and delegate the choice of algorithmic technique to the backbone alone. We present MARS (Multi-Agent Relay of Specialized LLMs), a prompt-only framework in which each agent is a topic specialist---dynamic programming, graphs, strings, geometry, and so on---grounded by retrieval-augmented generation over an algorithm-theory corpus. Given a problem, retrieval selects a small team of relevant specialists; a starter writes an initial C++17 solution, and each subsequent turn runs the candidate against public examples in a sandbox, lets the active specialist keep, repair, or hand off the draft, and forwards a structured packet to the next specialist. A single infrastructure-fixer pass normalizes boilerplate at the end. On the CodeContests test split with Gemma 4, MARS reaches $0.624 \pm 0.006$ pass rate at $2.3$ recorded pipeline stages per task ($+14.4$ percentage points over direct prompting), closing most of the gap to CodeSIM ($0.731$) at $3.3{\times}$ lower wall-clock cost and substantially smaller variance in per-task token spend. The source code is available on GitHub: https://github.com/fckand/mars.

AI.title_translation: MARS：面向竞技编程的多专家大模型接力系统
AI.tldr: MARS是一个基于主题专家和RAG的多智能体大模型接力系统，显著提升了竞技编程的代码生成通过率并降低了计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型多智能体代码生成管道多采用通用的规划者、编码者和调试者角色，无法有效解决竞技编程中复杂的算法选择与错误率高的问题。
AI.method: 提出MARS框架，包含主题专家智能体、基于检索增强生成（RAG）的算法理论接地、基于沙箱公开示例的测试与修复、多智能体接力机制以及统一的基础设施修复。
AI.result: 在CodeContests测试集（配合Gemma 4）上，MARS达到了0.624的通过率，比直接提示高出14.4个百分点，且在计算成本和代币消耗方差上显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: MARS框架通过结合主题专家、检索增强生成和沙箱验证，有效提升了大模型在竞技编程任务中的代码生成能力，兼具高效性与低成本。
AI.translation: 大语言模型在代码生成方面表现出色，然而竞技编程暴露出一个持续存在的失效模式：现有的多智能体管道将工作分配给通用的规划者、coder和调试者角色，并将算法技术的选择完全委托给骨干网络。我们提出了MARS（多专长LLM的多智能体接力），这是一个仅通过提示词的框架，其中每个智能体都是一个主题专家——动态规划、图、字符串、几何等——并通过对算法理论语料库的检索增强生成（RAG）进行接地。给定一个问题，检索选择一小群相关专家；启动器编写初始的C++17解决方案，随后的每个轮次在沙箱中针对公共示例运行候选代码，让活跃的专家保留、修复或交接草稿，并将结构化数据包转发给下一个专家。最后通过单次基础设施修复通道规范化模板代码。在使用Gemma 4的CodeContests测试集上，MARS达到了0.624 ± 0.006的通过率（每个任务2.3个记录的管道阶段，比直接提示高出14.4个百分点），弥补了与CodeSIM（0.731）之间的大部分差距，同时壁钟成本降低了3.3倍，每个任务的Token消耗方差显著减小。源码已开源：https://github.com/fckand/mars。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了MARS（多专长大模型接力系统），这是一个专为竞技编程设计的纯提示词框架。该框架利用通过检索增强生成（RAG）支持的主题专家团队，通过接力、沙箱测试和迭代修复，高效生成高质量的C++17解决方案。
AI.keywords: 多智能体系统, 竞技编程, 大语言模型, 检索增强生成, 代码生成
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了MARS框架，将多智能体系统与领域专家角色（如动态规划、图论等）结合，并通过RAG和沙箱测试进行迭代修复。相比传统通用角色分配方案，它在保持较低计算成本的同时大幅提升了竞技编程代码生成的通过率。

title: New Efficient Implicit-Explicit Deferred Correction methods
summary: In this work, we investigate implicit-explicit (IMEX) arbitrary high-order Deferred Correction (DeC) methods for the approximation of ordinary differential equations (ODEs). Such schemes are characterized by an iterative procedure that increases the order of accuracy by one at each iteration. More precisely, we study an efficient modification based on the introduction of interpolation processes between consecutive iterations, with the aim of systematically matching the accuracy achieved at each iteration with the order of the discretization employed. On the one hand, this modification leads to computational advantages, since the low-order iterations are performed on cheaper lower-order discretization structures; on the other hand, it endows the methods with a natural $p$-adaptive character, which is particularly appealing in the context of practical applications. We investigate this modification for two families of DeC schemes, providing numerical validation, efficiency assessments, and stability region plots. The numerical validation includes several examples involving stiff ODEs and partial differential equations (PDEs) with high-order spatial derivatives. The ability of the modified schemes to provide high-fidelity results at reduced computational cost, as well as the effectiveness of the adaptive strategy, is demonstrated through the numerical experiments.

AI.title_translation: 新的高效隐式-显式延迟校正方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的隐式-显式（IMEX）任意高阶延迟校正（DeC）方法，通过引入迭代间的插值过程来提高计算效率和p自适应性，适用于求解常微分方程（ODEs），并在数值实验中验证了其在高精度和低计算成本方面的有效性。
AI.motivation: 为了提高隐式-显式（IMEX）任意高阶延迟校正（DeC）方法在求解常微分方程（ODEs）时的计算效率和自适应性。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于迭代间插值过程的IMEX DeC方法，该方法允许在较低阶的离散结构上执行低阶迭代，从而实现计算优势和p自适应性。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，该方法能够以较低的计算成本提供高保真结果，并有效利用其自适应策略。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的IMEX DeC方法通过引入迭代间的插值过程，在计算效率和p自适应性方面表现出色，适用于求解包括stiff ODEs和具有高阶空间导数的PDEs在内的多种问题。
AI.translation: 在本工作中，我们研究了用于逼近常微分方程（ODEs）的隐式-显式（IMEX）任意高阶延迟校正（DeC）方法。这类格式的特点是迭代过程，在每次迭代中将精度提高一个阶数。更准确地说，我们研究了一种基于连续迭代之间引入插值过程的高效修改，目的是系统地使每次迭代达到的精度与所采用的离散化阶数相匹配。一方面，这种修改带来了计算优势，因为低阶迭代是在更便宜的低阶离散化结构上执行的；另一方面，它赋予了方法一种自然的p自适应特性，这在实际应用中尤其有吸引力。我们研究了两种DeC格式系列中的这种修改，提供了数值验证、效率评估和稳定性区域图。数值验证包括涉及stiff ODEs和具有高阶空间导数的偏微分方程（PDEs）的几个例子。通过数值实验证明了修改后的格式在降低计算成本的同时提供高保真结果的能力，以及自适应策略的有效性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种改进的隐式-显式（IMEX）延迟校正（DeC）方法，通过在迭代过程中引入插值，实现了计算效率的提升和p自适应性。该方法能够以更低的计算成本获得高精度的数值解，并已通过求解stiff ODEs和含高阶空间导数的PDEs的数值实验得到验证。
AI.keywords: 隐式-显式, 延迟校正, 插值, p自适应, 高阶方法
AI.comments: 该方法在提高计算效率和引入自适应性方面具有创新性，尤其是在处理stiff ODEs和高阶PDEs时。然而，对于大规模问题，其稳定性和收敛性仍需进一步深入研究。

title: Wontopos Tablet 2: Measuring Multilingual and Multimodal Memory Retrieval Without Lexical Matching
comments: 42 pages, 8 figures. Harness and per-question records released
summary:
We measure tablet-2, a production long-term memory engine for language models, on the text benchmarks the field already uses and on cross-lingual retrieval of photographs stored with no text at all. Its retrieval path contains no lexical matching, no keyword scoring, and no language model of its own.
  On LongMemEval-S (500 questions) it scores 95.7% [93.4, 97.1]; on BEAM-1M (700 questions, 2.21M stored memories) 67.5% [64.8, 70.2]. Those are question-sampling intervals, not the run-to-run spread, which is an order of magnitude narrower.
  Most of the paper is about how little they mean alone. Holding engine, corpus, settings and judge fixed, changing only the reader moves LongMemEval-S by 2.0 points; changing only the re-ask budget moves BEAM-1M by 8.9. Neither is stated in the reports we compare against, and the second exceeds most gaps there, so we give that table as a placement and not a ranking.
  For the multimodal axis we run two controls. Against BM25, configured as strongly as we could, we reach 95.2% mean recall@5 over 70 store-and-query language cells where BM25 reaches 19.0% and is exactly zero in 54. On captionless photographs a lexical method has no document to score at all. Open dense baselines on 300 Crossmodal-3600 photographs in 14 languages show that density confers no language independence: one scores 91.0% on English and 4.7% on Russian from identical image vectors, and a multilingual variant collapses on Telugu and Swahili. Our spread across languages is 14.0 against their 27.5 and 27.7.
  Three results run against us and are reported at equal weight: low-resource languages degrade sharply (Swahili 53.0%, Telugu 64.0%), attaching captions lowers cross-lingual retrieval by 11.4 points, and one setting omitted into one stage of our own retrieval cost 37 points of Korean top-1 accuracy while leaving nine languages untouched.
comment: 42 pages, 8 figures. Harness and per-question records released

AI.title_translation: Wontopos 平板 2：在没有词汇匹配的情况下测量多语言和多模态记忆检索
AI.tldr: 提出并评估了Wontopos Tablet 2长期记忆引擎，证明了其在无词汇匹配的条件下实现高效多语言和多模态检索的能力。
AI.motivation: 为了在没有词汇匹配、关键词评分和自身语言模型的情况下，测量长期记忆引擎Wontopos Tablet 2在多语言和多模态记忆检索中的表现。
AI.method: 使用Wontopos Tablet 2引擎在文本基准（LongMemEval-S, BEAM-1M）和无文本的跨语言照片检索（Crossmodal-3600）上进行评估，并与BM25以及开放密集基准进行对比。
AI.result: 在LongMemEval-S上得分95.7%，在BEAM-1M上得分67.5%；在多模态轴上，平均recall@5达到95.2%，显著优于BM25，并在多语言跨模态照片检索中表现出较好的语言鲁棒性，尽管低资源语言仍会急剧下降。
AI.conclusion: Wontopos Tablet 2在各项基准测试中表现出色，尤其在无文本的多模态图像检索中展现了强大的跨语言能力，但低资本语言仍面临性能下降的挑战。
AI.translation:
我们评估了 tablet-2（一个用于语言模型的生产级长期记忆引擎）在领域内现有的文本基准以及对存储时完全没有文本的跨语言照片进行检索的表现。其检索路径不包含词汇匹配、关键词评分，也没有自己的语言模型。
在 LongMemEval-S（500个问题）上，它获得了 95.7% [93.4, 97.1] 的分数；在 BEAM-1M（700个问题，2.21M个存储记忆）上获得了 67.5% [64.8, 70.2]。这些是问题抽样区间，而不是运行之间的离散度，后者要窄一个数量级。
本篇论文的大部分内容都在探讨这些数据单独存在的意义是多么有限。在保持引擎、语料库、设置和评判标准不变的情况下，仅改变阅读器就会使 LongMemEval-S 的得分波动 2.0 个百分点；仅改变重新询问的预算就会使 BEAM-1M 的得分波动 8.9 个百分点。这些都没有在我们与之比较的报告中说明，并且第二个波动超过了其中的大多数差距，因此我们提供该表格作为参考位置而非排名。
对于多模态轴，我们运行了两个对照组。与我们能配置得最强的 BM25 相比，在 70 个存储和查询语言单元中，我们的平均 recall@5 达到了 95.2%，而 BM25 达到了 19.0%，且在其中 54 个单元中完全为零。对于无标题的照片，词汇方法根本没有可评分的文档。在 14 种语言的 300 张 Crossmodal-3600 照片上的开放密集基准测试表明，密集性并不能带来语言独立性：其中一个基准在使用相同的图像向量时，在英语上的得分为 91.0%，在俄语上的得分为 4.7%，并且多语言变体在泰卢固语和斯瓦希里语上崩溃了。我们跨语言的分散度为 14.0，而它们的为 27.5 和 27.7。
有三个对我们不利的结果并以相等的权重进行了报告：低资源语言性能急剧下降（斯瓦希里语 53.0%，泰卢固语 64.0%），附加标题使跨语言检索降低了 11.4 个百分点，并且我们自己检索过程的一个阶段中遗漏的一个设置导致韩国语 top-1 准确率下降了 37 个百分点，而其他九种语言未受影响。
AI.summary: 本文评估了Wontopos Tablet 2这一长期记忆引擎，重点测试其在无词汇匹配情况下的多语言和多模态记忆检索能力。结果表明其在文本和图像检索中表现优异，超越了传统的BM25和部分密集基准，同时也揭示了评估设置对结果的巨大影响及低资源语言的性能瓶颈。
AI.keywords: 长期记忆引擎, 多模态检索, 跨语言检索, 词汇匹配, 语言模型
AI.comments: 该论文评估了一个名为Wontopos Tablet 2的长期记忆引擎，创新点在于展示了在完全没有词汇匹配和自带语言模型的情况下，如何实现跨语言和多模态记忆检索，并指出评估基准中模型和预算对结果的巨大影响。

title: HAP: Head-Adaptive Visual Token Pruning via Cross-Modal Alignment
summary:
Recent Vision-Language Models encode high-resolution images into long visual token sequences, incurring prohibitive prefill costs. To compress them, existing methods score each visual token by averaging text-to-visual attention uniformly across all heads, which assumes every head matches the query. However, our empirical analysis shows that misaligned heads dominate the average, amplifying background tokens and drowning out fine-grained cues.
  To address this, we propose PAQ (Prompt-Grounded Attention Quality), a metric quantifying how well each head aligns the prompt with image regions. Built on PAQ, our pruning proceeds in three stages. Given a target FLOPs budget, we first partition the transformer layers into groups and allocate a visual token budget to each. Within each group, we then aggregate per-head attention maps via PAQ-weighted softmax into a group-level matrix. Finally, we score visual tokens by this matrix's magnitude and retain the allocated budget per group. By weighting heads with PAQ, our method scores tokens by attention signals that more faithfully reflect prompt relevance, rather than diluting them through uniform averaging.
  Across 18 benchmarks, our method delivers state-of-the-art trade-offs. Specifically, on LLaVA-1.5-7B (9 tasks), retaining only \textbf{5.6\%} tokens preserves \textbf{99.1\%} of the original performance, surpassing the strongest baseline AutoPrune by 4.2 points. Code is available in https://github.com/baokou-fw2/HAP.

AI.title_translation: HAP：基于跨模态对齐的头自适应视觉Token剪枝
AI.tldr: 提出HAP方法，利用PAQ指标动态过滤注意力头噪声并进行视觉-语言模型的Token剪枝，在保留仅5.6%Token的情况下实现99.1%的原始性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言模型视觉Token剪枝方法通常通过在所有头上均匀平均文本到视觉的注意力来为每个Token评分，但这假设了每个头都匹配查询。作者的实证分析表明，未对准的头会主导平均结果，放大背景Token并淹没细粒度线索。
AI.method: 提出PAQ（Prompt-Grounded Attention Quality）指标量化注意力头与图像区域的对齐程度；设计了三阶段剪枝流程，包括层组划分与Token预算分配、基于PAQ加权Softmax的注意力图聚合、以及基于矩阵幅度的Token评分与保留。
AI.result: 在18个基准测试中取得了SOTA的性能权衡。在LLaVA-1.5-7B（9个任务）上，仅保留5.6%的Token即可保持原始性能的99.1%，比最强的基线AutoPrune高出4.2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种基于跨模态对齐的头自适应视觉Token剪枝方法（HAP），通过PAQ指标精准评估注意力头与提示词的对齐质量，有效解决了传统均匀平均带来的噪声问题，在多个基准测试中实现了SOTA的性能与计算成本平衡。
AI.translation:
最近的视觉-语言模型将高分辨率图像编码为长的视觉Token序列，从而导致过高的预填充成本。为了对其进行压缩，现有方法通过在所有头上均匀平均文本到视觉的注意力来对每个视觉Token进行评分，这假设了每个头都与查询相匹配。然而，我们的实证分析表明，未对准的头会主导平均结果，放大背景Token并淹没细粒度线索。
为了解决这个问题，我们提出了PAQ（提示基础注意力质量），这是一种量化每个头如何将提示与图像区域对齐的指标。建立在PAQ的基础上，我们的剪枝分三个阶段进行。给定目标FLOPs预算，我们首先将Transformer层划分为组，并为每个组分配一个视觉Token预算。在每个组内，我们然后通过PAQ加权Softmax将每个头的注意力图聚合到组级矩阵中。最后，我们通过该矩阵的幅度对视觉Token进行评分，并保留每个组分配的预算。通过用PAQ加权头，我们的方法通过更真实地反映提示相关性的注意力信号对Token进行评分，而不是通过均匀平均来稀释它们。
在18个基准测试中，我们的方法提供了最先进的权衡。具体来说，在LLaVA-1.5-7B（9个任务）上，仅保留5.6%的Token即可保留99.1%的原始性能，比最强的基线AutoPrune高出4.2个百分点。代码可在https://github.com/baokou-fw2/HAP获取。
AI.summary: 论文提出了HAP（基于跨模态对齐的头自适应视觉Token剪枝方法），旨在减少视觉-语言模型中高分辨率图像长Token序列带来的预填充成本。核心是引入PAQ指标评估头与提示词的对齐质量，通过加权聚合替代均匀平均，从而精准识别并保留与提示词相关的视觉Token。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言模型, Token剪枝, 跨模态对齐, 注意力机制, 模型压缩
AI.comments: 该论文针对视觉-语言模型中高分辨率图像生成的长视觉Token序列带来了巨大预填充成本的问题，提出了基于跨模态对齐的头自适应视觉Token剪枝方法（HAP）。通过创新的PAQ指标过滤掉未对准注意力头的噪声，使Token评分更贴合提示词相关性，在极高压缩率下仍保持了优异的性能，展现出强大的实用价值。

title: Data Mixing as Mixture Experiment: Response Surface Methodology and Optimal Design for Large Language Model Pretraining
summary: Data mixing is a central design problem in large language model pretraining: given a fixed token budget, practitioners must decide how much data to allocate to each domain. Recent proxy-based methods address this problem by training small models on candidate mixtures, fitting a response model, and using the response to select mixtures for larger-scale training. We show that this workflow has the structure of a classical mixture experiment. Under this view, data domains are mixture components, token shares are component proportions, proxy-training runs are experimental design points, and validation loss defines a response surface over the probability simplex. We develop this formulation using sparse second-order Scheffé response-surface models and construct model-robust $\mathcal{I}$-optimal designs for proxy data-mixing experiments. Using RegMix as an empirical case study, we demonstrate how the framework can both interpret observed mixture responses and design more efficient proxy experiments. The Scheffé analysis shows that domain value is strongly relational: several domains that are weak under additive effects become favourable through pairwise interactions, especially through combinations with web-derived text. The sparse Scheffé model preserves mixture rankings across model scales and remains competitive with a flexible machine-learning predictor while providing an explicit decomposition of additive and interaction effects. In a simulation study calibrated to observed proxy-training responses, model-robust $\mathcal{I}$-optimal designs recover the relevant mixture ordering after removing about 25\% of the original proxy runs. These results suggest that LLM data mixing should be treated not only as a prediction problem, but also as an experimental-design problem in which the proxy mixtures themselves can be chosen to improve statistical efficiency.

AI.title_translation: 数据混合作为混合实验：大型语言模型预训练的响应面方法和最优设计
AI.tldr: 该研究将大型语言模型（LLM）预训练中的数据混合问题视为经典的混合实验问题，并提出使用响应面方法和最优设计来提高数据混合的效率。
AI.motivation: 在固定 token 预算下，决定如何为每个领域分配数据是 LLM 预训练中的一个核心设计问题。现有的代理方法通过训练小模型来解决这个问题，但效率有待提高。
AI.method: 将数据混合视为混合实验，其中数据域是混合成分，token 份额是成分比例，代理训练是实验设计点，验证损失是响应面。研究者开发了基于稀疏二阶 Scheffé 响应面模型和模型鲁棒的 I-最优设计，用于代理数据混合实验。
AI.result: 通过 RegMix 的案例研究，该框架能够解释观察到的混合响应并设计更有效的代理实验。Scheffé 分析表明，领域价值具有很强的关联性，一些单独效果不佳的领域通过与网络文本等成对组合后变得更有利。稀疏 Scheffé 模型在不同模型规模下都能保持混合排序，并且与灵活的机器学习预测器相比，具有明确的加性与交互效应分解。在模拟研究中，模型鲁棒的 I-最优设计在移除约 25% 的原始代理运行时，能够恢复相关的混合排序。
AI.conclusion: LLM 数据混合不仅应被视为一个预测问题，还应被视为一个实验设计问题，通过选择代理混合物来提高统计效率。
AI.translation: 数据混合是大型语言模型预训练中的一个核心设计问题：给定固定的 token 预算，从业人员必须决定为每个领域分配多少数据。最近的代理方法通过训练小模型来处理这种混合，拟合响应模型，并使用响应来选择更大规模训练的混合。我们表明，这个工作流程具有经典混合实验的结构。在这个观点下，数据域是混合成分，token 份额是成分比例，代理训练运行是实验设计点，验证损失定义了概率单纯形上的响应面。我们使用稀疏二阶 Scheffé 响应面模型来开发这个公式，并为代理数据混合实验构建模型鲁棒的 I-最优设计。通过 RegMix 的经验案例研究，我们展示了该框架如何解释观察到的混合响应和设计更有效的代理实验。Scheffé 分析表明，领域价值是强相关的：一些在加性效应下较弱的领域，通过成对相互作用，特别是与网络衍生文本的组合，变得有利。稀疏 Scheffé 模型在不同模型规模下保持混合排序，并且与灵活的机器学习预测器相比，具有竞争优势，同时提供了加性和交互效应的明确分解。在与观察到的代理训练响应校准的模拟研究中，模型鲁棒的 I-最优设计在移除约 25% 的原始代理运行时，恢复了相关的混合排序。这些结果表明，LLM 数据混合不仅应被视为一个预测问题，还应被视为一个实验设计问题，其中代理混合物本身的选择可以提高统计效率。
AI.summary: 本研究将大型语言模型（LLM）预训练中的数据混合问题形式化为混合实验问题，并提出一种基于响应面方法和最优设计的解决方案。通过将数据域视为混合成分，token 份额视为成分比例，代理训练视为实验设计点，验证损失视为响应面，研究者开发了稀疏二阶 Scheffé 响应面模型和模型鲁棒的 I-最优设计。实验结果表明，该方法不仅能解释数据混合的复杂交互效应，还能通过更优化的实验设计来提高统计效率，从而在减少计算资源的同时获得更好的模型性能。
AI.keywords: 数据混合, 大型语言模型, 响应面方法, 最优设计, 混合实验, Scheffé 模型, 代理训练, 统计效率
AI.comments: 该研究将 LLM 数据混合问题与经典的混合实验理论联系起来，提供了一个新颖且富有洞察力的视角。利用响应面方法和最优设计来指导数据混合，有望显著提高预训练效率和模型性能。研究的亮点在于其理论的严谨性和实验的有效性，特别是 Scheffé 模型能够揭示领域间的交互效应，以及最优设计能够在减少代理实验次数的同时保持有效的混合排序。然而，该方法在实际大规模预训练中的可扩展性和计算成本仍需进一步评估。

title: ROI-Gated SAHI: Content-Adaptive Slicing-Based Inference for Efficient Object Detection
summary: Slicing-Aided Hyper Inference (SAHI) improves small object detection in high-resolution images but often spends substantial compute on background tiles. We propose region-of-interest (ROI)-Gated SAHI, an inference-time framework that introduces a lightweight proposer to localize foreground regions and restrict sliced refinement to informative areas. We evaluate the framework in two settings. On the COCO128 full split dataset comprising 128 images, static ROI-gating is slower on average than Full SAHI, achieving a speed ratio of 0.88, and yields a lower mAP@0.5 of 0.6602 compared with 0.7569 for Full SAHI. A simple adaptive routing policy with $τ=$ 0.4 educes the mean latency, achieving a slight gain of 1.02$\times$ over Full SAHI. On a three-image sparse-to-dense case study, ROI-gating achieves speedups ranging from 0.96$\times$ to 6.90$\times$ with a mean speedup of 3.41$\times$. These results show that ROI-gating is most beneficial in sparse scenes and requires policy-based routing for robust average behavior.

title: Dynamical System-Based Imitation Learning and Neuroadaptive Control for Trajectory Recovery in Autonomous Ships
comments: Preprint submitted to journal (under review). 22 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables
summary: Repetitive maritime operations can be effectively learned using the Imitation Learning (IL) paradigm, which transfers human expertise directly to Unmanned Surface Vehicle (USV) control systems. Dynamical Systems (DS) are widely used to model non-linear human demonstrations while offering inherent stability guarantees. However, real-world execution under persistent marine perturbations reveals a critical trade-off: standard DS-based IL approaches prioritize global target convergence at the expense of localized trajectory reproduction fidelity. To address this limitation, we present a hybrid learning-control architecture that integrates a DS-based IL reference generator with a neuroadaptive controller. Our approach introduces a control action that drives the USV back to the demonstrated path following exogenous disturbances, enabling dynamic human-like reactive alignment-termed behavioral tracking. The proposed methodology is validated using the Marine Systems Simulator (MSS) toolbox. Simulation results confirm that the framework generalizes complex maneuvering tasks while substantially improving trajectory tracking fidelity under disturbances compared to alternative control strategies.
comment: Preprint submitted to journal (under review). 22 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables

title: GlanceWAM: Sparse Test-Time Imagination for World-Action Models
summary: Video generative models provide rich physical priors for robot learning, yet existing world-action models (WAMs) face a fundamental trade-off: synchronous video generation at control rate is latency-prohibitive, while abandoning test-time visual imagination sacrifices task success. We show that visual imagination achieves both real-time inference and superior success rates when generated asynchronously off the critical path and consumed directly in latent space. We introduce GlanceWAM, which decouples imagination from control within a single video DiT: an asynchronous proposer glances ahead on a slow clock to imagine a single lookahead frame seconds into the future in the background, while an action head decodes action chunks at control rate (48 ms) purely in latent space without blocking. Enabled by a non-interfering attention mask that isolates video representations and staleness-robust horizon training that accommodates asynchronous lookahead aging, GlanceWAM breaks the speed-success dilemma. Trained purely on demonstrations, it attains 72.2% on the 24-task RoboCasa kitchen benchmark (surpassing synchronous Cosmos Policy at 67.1% and imagination-free co-training at 64.4%) and 99.0% on LIBERO, executing at 48 ms per chunk on an NVIDIA A100 GPU (24x faster than synchronous baselines). Code is available at https://github.com/linhanwang/GlanceWAM.

title: RefineRank: Joint Box Refinement and Ranking for Surgical Spatio-Temporal Grounding
summary: Surgical spatio-temporal grounding (STG) requires locating, at each video time specified by a procedural question, the object that the question asks about. Existing approaches face a trade-off: vision language models understand the question context but produce imprecise coordinates, whereas open-set detectors provide localized candidate boxes whose confidence does not reflect which box answers the question. We introduce RefineRank, which closes this gap at the candidate-box level. A compact trainable module, RefineNet, combines the language and regional features of a frozen medical vision language model with the proposals of a frozen open-set detector: it predicts a bounded coordinate correction and a quality score for every candidate box, and a fixed decoding rule returns the original or refined box with the highest score. On the MedVidBench Official Rankings (Verified), RefineRank records 0.421 STG mIoU, the highest displayed STG score, while its global multi-metric rank is 11. In a controlled evaluation on separate training and evaluation videos, coordinate correction raises the candidate oracle upper bound from 0.6772 to 0.7302, and ranking the joint pool of original and refined candidates by their RefineNet scores improves STG mIoU from 0.2719 to 0.4534, whereas separately trained selectors over the same pool reach at most 0.4186. These results show that a small box-level module can reconcile question understanding with precise localization without retraining either backbone. Code is available at [https://github.com/linzhe001/RefineRank](https://github.com/linzhe001/RefineRank).

title: SceneReGen: Generative Reconstruction of 3D Scenes from a Single Image
summary: Single-image 3D scene reconstruction must complete partially observed objects and place them coherently in a shared observation-aligned scene frame. Object-level generative priors offer strong completion ability, but their centered, scale-normalized outputs are typically expressed in an object frame, creating a fundamental representation gap between object generation and scene reconstruction. We introduce SceneReGen, a generative reconstruction framework that reinterprets scene reconstruction as the generation and assembly of complete object assets in a shared observation-aligned scene frame. SceneReGen addresses the generation-reconstruction gap through selective pose factorization: each object's observed orientation is encoded directly in the generated mesh, while translation and scale are estimated from instance-level and global scene evidence. Given a scene image and instance masks, a geometry encoder extracts dense cues; learnable shape queries condition a pretrained DiT-based 3D generator to produce complete meshes in their observed orientations, while position queries fuse object and scene features to assemble them in the shared frame. On the 3D-FUTURE evaluation subset, SceneReGen achieves the best scene-level CD, scene-level F-Score, and 3D bounding-box IoU among the evaluated methods, ties the best object-level CD, and ranks second in object-level F-Score. Qualitative outputs in autonomous-driving and embodied-AI scenes further illustrate the potential of asset-centric reconstruction beyond indoor furniture.

title: Evolutionary Recurrent Decision Model in Developing Adaptive and Maladaptive Behaviors
summary: This study introduces the evolutionarily recurrent decision model (ERDM), a computational reinforcement learning framework designed to examine how evolutionary mismatch, bounded rationality, and satisficing contribute to adaptive and maladaptive behavior. ERDM simulates agents across evolutionary recurrent environments, including threat, prey/goal-pursuits, and alliances. Agents learn through competing rewards abstracted from survival metrics. A validity study under varying adverse childhood experiences demonstrates that distinct adaptive and maladaptive strategies, such as learned helplessness, avoidance, healthy relationships, and aggression, emerge naturally without being hardwired. These results align with empirical literature, showcasing ecological validity. The results suggest that many psychopathology-relevant aspects may be interpreted as bounded cognitive systems operating under modern-ancestral environmental mismatch, positioning ERDM as a key computational cognitive tool that can be extended to other studies.

title: SoK: ARCUS: On the Efficiency and Efficacy of Hardware Fuzzing
summary: This work presents a comprehensive analysis of contemporary hardware fuzzing techniques applied across three major abstraction layers: Instruction Set Architecture (ISA), microarchitecture, and Register-Transfer Level (RTL). Our study examines key factors including input stimulus quality, mutation strategies, feedback mechanisms, target platforms, reference models, and achieved coverage. We find challenges, goals, and design trade-offs vary significantly across abstraction layers. We further identify several unmet needs in current hardware fuzzing practices, such as intelligent input generation, reliable and scalable golden reference models, expressive feedback channels, and cross-layer integration. Building on these insights, we outline future research directions, including hybrid fuzzing frameworks, AI-assisted test generation, scalable reference models, standardized evaluation metrics and benchmarks, and human-in-the-loop automation for guided exploration and analysis. Together, they aim to unlock efficient, reliable, and comprehensive hardware verification solutions.

title: MnemoDyn: Learning Resting State Dynamics from 40K FMRI sequences
summary: We present a dynamical-systems based model for resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI), trained on a dataset of roughly 40K rs-fMRI sequences covering a wide variety of public and available-by-permission datasets. While most existing proposals use transformer backbones, we utilize multi-resolution temporal modeling of the dynamics across parcellated brain regions. We show that MnemoDyn is compute efficient and generalizes very well across diverse populations and scanning protocols. When benchmarked against current state-of-the-art transformer-based approaches, MnemoDyn consistently delivers superior reconstruction quality. Overall, we find that with such large-scale pre-training on (non-proprietary) rs-fMRI datasets, we get a highly performant model for various downstream tasks. Our results also provide evidence of the efficacy of the model on small sample size studies which has implications for neuroimaging studies at large where resting state fMRI is a commonly acquired imaging modality.

title: An Echo Chamber of One: Should AI Psychosis Be a Distinct Clinical Entity?
summary: "AI psychosis" has entered public and clinical discourse as a label for the onset or exacerbation of psychotic symptoms, most commonly delusions, following intensive interaction with large language model (LLM)-based chatbots. Current evidence is limited to media reports, case reports, and early observational data, yet the scale of potential exposure is considerable, and public concern has prompted responses from industry and regulators. We examine whether AI-associated psychosis warrants recognition as a distinct clinical entity, drawing on clinical and technical viewpoints. We outline the proposed mechanism: LLM sycophancy, a tendency to agree with and flatter users that is reinforced through preference-based fine-tuning, combines with increasingly anthropomorphic design to create a bidirectional "echo chamber of one" capable of amplifying and co-constructing unusual beliefs. We then weigh arguments for and against nosological recognition. Potential benefits include improved case identification, tailored interventions, standardised research criteria, post-market surveillance, and pressure on developers and regulators to act. Reasons for caution include the risk of prematurely reifying a syndrome from anecdotal evidence, the possibility that existing diagnostic constructs already accommodate AI use as a contributing factor, the unproven causal claim in the term itself, stigma, and the risk that a psychosis-centric label obscures a broader spectrum of AI-associated mental health harms. We conclude with recommendations for clinicians, developers, researchers, and regulators, including a "technological history" in psychiatric assessment, pre-deployment benchmarking for sycophancy and delusion reinforcement, and post-deployment surveillance. Regardless of whether AI-associated psychosis earns a place in psychiatric nosology, the phenomenon it describes demands coordinated attention now.

title: CoDrift: Compositional Drifting for Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline reinforcement learning is intrinsically multi-objective: a policy must remain compatible with the behavioral support of a fixed dataset while preferentially selecting high-value actions. We recast these objectives in a common form by viewing each as an action-space motion field that specifies how generated actions should move. This perspective enables heterogeneous learning objectives to be combined directly through field composition. Inspired by drifting models, we propose CoDrift, a compositional framework for one-step generative policy learning. CoDrift combines three objective-level fields into a unified policy field. The conditional field preserves state-dependent behavioral structure, while the marginal field pools actions across states to provide a more stable generative signal in the single-positive-sample regime of continuous-control offline RL. The value field moves generated actions toward higher-value regions. The composed field is absorbed into a stochastic generator that produces an action with a single forward pass at deployment. We evaluate CoDrift on 73 tasks from OGBench and D4RL in both offline and offline-to-online settings. CoDrift compares favorably with state-of-the-art methods and achieves the best average rank in both settings.

title: More Rejective, Not More Discriminative: The Unit of Verification in Pre-Execution LLM Oversight
summary: Pre-execution oversight is core to trusted monitoring in AI control: a fallible LLM monitor vets planned actions before irreversible execution. Over-blocking forfeits usefulness and pressures deployers to disable it. Every protocol must fix a unit of verification: how many actions one call reviews. Existing designs take the unit as given; its effect on fallible monitors is unmeasured. Natural traces cannot isolate it: review length co-varies with error type and position. Catch alone misleads: rejecting everything catches everything. Measuring this needs boundary variation alone and a matched clean control. We introduce the twin-prefix framework, which supplies both. Each gold plan yields a prefix with one injected, environment-accepted error and a clean twin differing in one write. Judging each pair at five nested lengths ties verdict changes to the unit alone. Discrimination is scored by pre-registered informedness, catch minus false rejection. Longer review raises catch; false rejection climbs in lockstep. Informedness peaks at one or two actions for all six judges in both domains: longer windows make zero-shot monitors more rejective, not more discriminative. Replaying withheld observations traces the failure largely to observation deprivation. Safety cases should state the unit and co-report the clean series. Our framework is the first controlled, pre-registered instrument for this choice and never reads catch alone. Our calibrated short unit recovers up to 0.95 informedness over eight-action review, and no tested label-blind policy consistently beats it.

title: Luce: Relightable Gaussians for 3D Asset Generation
summary: High-fidelity image-to-3D generation requires a 3D representation that captures both geometry and appearance. To support relighting and integration into standard rendering pipelines, the representation should include physically based rendering (PBR) modalities such as albedo, metallic-roughness, and surface normals. We propose Luce, a 3D representation that unifies geometry and PBR materials within a voxelized multimodal Gaussian cloud, using dedicated Gaussian primitives for each modality. A variational autoencoder compresses this representation into a unified material-aware latent space. A rectified-flow transformer generates this latent from a single image, conditioned on multi-layer features from a pretrained image encoder that preserve both semantic context and fine spatial detail. The latent then decodes into relightable PBR Gaussians and an optional textured mesh with a tangent-space normal map.
