AI.comments: 本文针对导管原位癌(DCIS)自由边界模型中的非线性营养消耗函数恢复问题，提出了一种无导数的逆问题求解方法。创新点在于将逆问题转化为不动点问题，并开发了结合Picard迭代与Sperner搜索的同伦延拓法，无需计算目标泛函的导数或伴随状态，具有重要的理论和应用价值。

title: Native Multimodal Representation Learning for Click-Through Rate Prediction in E-Commerce Scenarios
summary: Multimodal representations have been widely adopted in industrial e-commerce recommendation systems. Due to their strong semantic understanding and generalization capabilities, they enhance the performance of traditional sparse ID-based Click-Through Rate (CTR) prediction models. Current multimodal application frameworks in the CTR prediction task typically follow a two-stage paradigm: first, pre-training a multimodal encoder on data from specific recommendation scenarios; second, extracting items' multimodal representations using this pre-trained multimodal encoder and integrating them into the CTR prediction model. However, the training objectives and data distribution of multimodal pre-training tasks often differ from those of the CTR prediction task, which limits the effectiveness of multimodal representation on downstream tasks. In this paper, we focus on how to learn Native Multimodal Representation for the CTR prediction task. One intuitive solution is to jointly train the multimodal encoder and CTR model end-to-end on the CTR task, with the expectation that the encoder can automatically learn downstream-relevant knowledge. However, we find that the end-to-end training does not bring performance improvements to existing multimodal application paradigms. Our analysis reveals that user behaviors in raw CTR data are driven by both multimodal semantics and non-multimodal factors, leading to ambiguous supervision and inconsistent encoder updates. To address this, we propose a Mine-Then-Train method that mines high-quality, multimodally interpretable training samples from CTR data and uses them to fine-tune the multimodal encoder for better alignment with user click preferences. Offline and online experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.title_translation: 电商场景下点击率预测的原生多模态表示学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种Mine-Then-Train方法，通过挖掘CTR数据中的多模态可解释样本微调编码器，解决了多模态表示在电商点击率预测中的监督模糊问题，提升了推荐性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态CTR预测通常采用两阶段范式，其预训练目标与CTR任务存在分布差异；而直接进行端到端联合训练又会因为用户行为受非多模态因素干扰而产生模糊监督和不一致的编码器更新，限制了性能提升。因此，需要研究如何为CTR预测任务学习原生的多模态表示。
AI.method: 提出了一种“Mine-Then-Train”方法，首先从CTR数据中挖掘高质量、多模态可解释的训练样本，然后利用这些样本对多模态编码器进行微调，以更好地对齐用户的点击偏好。
AI.result: 离线和在线实验结果均证明了所提方法的有效性，显著提升了电商场景下点击率预测的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过提出Mine-Then-Train方法，该论文成功解决了原生多模态表示在CTR预测中因监督信号模糊导致的训练难题，离线和在线实验均证明了其有效性。
AI.translation: 多模态表示已被广泛应用于工业级电商推荐系统中。由于其强大的语义理解和泛化能力，它们增强了传统稀疏ID基点击率（CTR）预测模型的性能。当前CTR预测任务中的多模态应用框架通常遵循两阶段范式：首先，在特定推荐场景的数据上预训练多模态编码器；其次，利用该预训练编码器提取物品的多模态表示，并将其整合到CTR预测模型中。然而，多模态预训练任务的训练目标和数据分布通常与CTR预测任务不同，这限制了多模态表示在下游任务中的有效性。在本文中，我们专注于如何为CTR预测任务学习原生多模态表示。一个直观的解决方案是在CTR任务上端到端地联合训练多模态编码器和CTR模型，期望编码器能自动学习下游相关知识。然而，我们发现端到端训练并没有给现有的大多数多模态应用范式带来性能提升。我们的分析表明，原始CTR数据中的用户行为是由多模态语义和非多模态因素共同驱动的，这导致了模糊的监督和不一致的编码器更新。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种“先挖掘后训练”（Mine-Then-Train）的方法，从CTR数据中挖掘高质量、多模态可解释的训练样本，并利用它们微调多模态编码器，以更好地与用户点击偏好对齐。离线和在线实验证明了我们方法的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文针对电商点击率预测中的多模态表示学习问题，指出传统两阶段范式和直接端到端训练的缺陷，提出了一种名为Mine-Then-Train的新方法，通过挖掘高质量的多模态可解释样本微调编码器，有效对齐了用户点击偏好，并在实验中取得了显著效果。
AI.keywords: Multimodal Representation, Click-Through Rate Prediction, E-Commerce, End-to-End Training, Mine-Then-Train
AI.comments: 该论文针对电商推荐系统中的点击率预测任务，指出了传统两阶段多模态框架以及端到端训练的局限性，并创新性地提出了Mine-Then-Train方法，通过挖掘多模态可解释样本来微调编码器，兼具理论分析与工业界落地验证，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Joint-Embedding Prediction of Masked Point Tubes for Self-Supervised Learning on 4D Point Cloud Videos
summary: Self-supervised representation learning for 4D point cloud videos is challenging because annotations are costly and reconstruction-based pretraining can overemphasize low-level geometric details. We propose a JEPA-style framework that learns from unlabeled spatiotemporal point clouds through latent point-tube prediction. Instead of reconstructing raw coordinates, the model masks spatiotemporal regions and predicts their target representations from visible context representations in feature space. To stabilize latent prediction, we incorporate Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization, which encourages non-collapsed embeddings without relying on explicit reconstruction targets. This formulation aims to capture both spatial structure and temporal dynamics while keeping the pretraining objective aligned with downstream semantic recognition. Experiments on action and gesture recognition benchmarks show that the learned representations improve downstream fine-tuning, limited-label learning, and cross-dataset transfer. These results suggest that JEPA-style latent prediction is a promising alternative to reconstruction-centered pretraining for 4D point cloud videos.

AI.title_translation: 面向4D点云视频自监督学习的掩码点管联合嵌入预测
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于联合嵌入预测的4D点云视频自监督学习方法，利用特征空间的掩码点管预测替代传统的底层几何重建。
AI.motivation: 4D点云视频的自监督表示学习面临标注成本高昂以及基于重建的预训练容易过度强调底层几何细节的挑战。
AI.method: 提出一个JEPA风格的框架，通过掩码时空区域并在特征空间中预测其目标表征，同时结合草图各向同性高斯正则化来稳定潜在预测并防止表示坍塌。
AI.result: 在动作和手势识别基准测试上的实验表明，学到的表征改善了下游微调、有限标签学习和跨数据集迁移。
AI.conclusion: 基于联合嵌入预测和草图各向同性高斯正则化的4D点云视频自监督学习方法，能有效捕获时空动态并提升下游任务性能。
AI.translation: 针对4D点云视频的自监督表示 learning 具有挑战性，因为标注成本高昂且基于重建的预训练会过度强调低层几何细节。我们提出了一个JEPA风格的框架，通过潜在点管预测从无标签的时空点云中进行学习。该模型不重建原始坐标，而是掩码时空区域，并从特征空间中的可见上下文表征预测其目标表征。为了稳定潜在预测，我们引入了草图各向同性高斯正则化，在不依赖显式重建目标的情况下鼓励非坍塌的嵌入。该公式旨在捕获空间结构和时间 dynamics，同时保持预训练目标与下游语义识别的一致性。在动作和手势识别基准上的实验表明，学到的表征改善了下游微调、有限标签学习和跨数据集迁移。这些结果表明，JEPA风格的潜在预测是4D点云视频重建中心预训练的一种有前景的替代方案。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种针对4D点云视频的自监督学习框架（JEPA-style），通过隐式点管预测和草图各向同性高斯正则化，在特征空间中预测被掩码的时空区域，从而有效捕捉空间结构与时间动态，并在多项下游任务中取得了优异表现。
AI.keywords: 4D点云视频, 自监督学习, 联合嵌入预测, 掩码点管, 潜在空间预测
AI.comments: 该论文将JEPA（联合嵌入预测架构）的思想引入4D点云视频的自监督学习中，通过掩码点管的空间时间潜在预测和草图各向同性高斯正则化，避免了传统重建方法过度关注底层几何细节的问题，对点云视频表征学习具有重要意义。

title: SIREN-Bench: Behavior-Driven Generation and Evaluation of Emergency-Vehicle Interactions
summary: Emergency vehicles (EMVs) can reorganize surrounding traffic as civilian vehicles brake, change lanes, or form rescue corridors in response to their passage. Evaluating these safety-critical interactions requires behavior-level control over both EMV privileges and civilian responses, together with consistent sensing and ground truth. Existing datasets and simulation benchmarks do not directly provide this combination. We present \textbf{SIREN}, a behavior-driven SUMO--CARLA co-simulation platform for generating EMV--civilian interactions. SIREN couples SUMO's network-level traffic evolution and behavior logic with CARLA's continuous vehicle control and synchronized onboard sensing; depending on the active behavior, the interaction is controlled by SUMO, CARLA, or jointly. We instantiate the platform as \textbf{SIREN-Bench-v1}, comprising seven parameterized interaction templates across emergency levels L1--L3 and three behavior families, with synchronized sensor observations and simulator-native annotations. We demonstrate the benchmark through three representative tasks: 3D object detection, trajectory prediction, and vision-language risk understanding. Evaluations of nine trajectory predictors, four LiDAR-based detectors, and five vision-language models reveal behavior-dependent failure modes. Traffic-clearance interactions are hardest for detection, privileged intersection traversal is hardest for prediction, and no learned predictor outperforms the constant-velocity reference on average. Vision-language models perform substantially better on normal traffic than on near-miss and collision events. These results demonstrate the value of behavior-centered benchmarking and establish SIREN as an extensible data-generation and evaluation platform for autonomous-driving and transportation safety research.

AI.title_translation: SIREN-Bench：紧急车辆交互的行为驱动生成与评估
AI.tldr: 本文提出了SIREN-Bench，一个基于SUMO-CARLA联合仿真的紧急车辆交互生成与评估平台，揭示了当前自动驾驶模型在紧急场景下的行为依赖性失效模式。
AI.motivation: 现有的数据集和仿真基准无法同时提供对紧急车辆（EMV）特权和普通车辆响应的行为级控制，以及一致的传感和地面真值，因此需要一个专门用于评估安全关键的紧急车辆交互的平台。
AI.method: 提出了SIREN（SUMO-CARLA联合仿真平台），结合SUMO的网络级流量演化/行为逻辑与CARLA的连续车辆控制/同步车载感知，并构建了包含7个参数化交互模板的SIREN-Bench-v1，用于测试3D目标检测、轨迹预测和视觉语言风险理解任务。
AI.result: 实验表明，交通清障交互对检测最具挑战性，特权交叉口通行对预测最难，且没有学习型预测器在平均性能上超过恒定速度参考；视觉语言模型在正常交通下的表现明显优于近距离接近和碰撞事件。
AI.conclusion: SIREN平台和SIREN-Bench-v1成功填补了紧急车辆交互场景下行为级控制与评估基准的空白，通过揭示现有模型在特定交互中的失效模式，为提升自动驾驶和交通安全研究提供了强有力的数据生成与评估工具。
AI.translation: 紧急车辆（EMV）可以通过促使民用车辆刹车、变道或在响应其通行时形成救援走廊来重新组织周围的交通。评估这些安全关键的交互需要对EMV特权和民用车辆响应进行行为级别的控制，同时还需要一致的感知和地面真值。现有的数据集和仿真基准并未直接提供这种组合。我们提出了\textbf{SIREN}，一个用于生成EMV与民用车辆交互的行为驱动型SUMO-CARLA联合仿真平台。SIREN将SUMO的网络级交通演化和行为逻辑与CARLA的连续车辆控制及同步车载感知相结合；根据活跃的行为，交互由SUMO、CARLA或两者联合控制。我们将该平台实例化为\textbf{SIREN-Bench-v1}，包含跨越L1-L3紧急级别和三个行为家族的七个参数化交互模板，并配有同步传感器观测和模拟器原生标注。我们通过三个代表性任务展示了该基准：3D目标检测、轨迹预测和视觉-语言风险理解。对九个轨迹预测器、四个基于LiDAR的检测器和五个视觉-语言模型的评估揭示了与行为相关的失效模式。交通清障交互对检测最具挑战性，特权交叉口通行对预测最难，并且在平均情况下，没有一个学习型预测器优于恒定速度参考。视觉-语言模型在正常交通上的表现明显优于险兆事件和碰撞事件。这些结果证明了以行为为中心的基准测试的价值，并确立了SIREN作为自动驾驶和交通安全研究的可扩展数据生成与评估平台地位。
AI.summary: 本文推出了SIREN，一个用于生成和评估紧急车辆与普通车辆交互的行为驱动SUMO-CARLA联合仿真平台，并实例化了SIREN-Bench-v1基准。通过三个代表性任务的评估，揭示了当前自动驾驶模型在行为相关交互中的失效模式，证明了行为中心基准的价值。
AI.keywords: 紧急车辆, 交互仿真, 自动驾驶基准, 轨迹预测, 视听语言模型
AI.comments: 本文针对自动驾驶中紧急车辆（EMV）与周围交通交互这一安全关键场景，创新性地提出了SIREN行为驱动的SUMO-CARLA联合仿真平台及SIREN-Bench-v1基准。通过覆盖多种紧急级别和行为模式的模板，揭示了当前主流感知、预测和VLM模型在特定紧急交互场景下的性能瓶颈与失效模式，对未来提升自动驾驶系统在复杂紧急情况下的安全性和鲁棒性具有重要价值。

title: The Sharp Tail of Uniform Stability
summary: Uniform stability controls how much one training example can change the loss at any test point. A new logarithmic-free upper bound shows that a $γ$-uniformly stable algorithm with loss in $[0,L]$ has generalization gap at most $O \left(γ\log(1/δ) +L\sqrt{\frac{\log(1/δ)}{n}}\right)$ with probability $1-δ$. Whether an actual bounded-loss learning algorithm can realize the linear dependence on $\log(1/δ)$ has remained open. The known construction realizes it only for auxiliary weakly dependent random variables whose pointwise range grows with $n$. The known learning lower bound holds only at constant probability. We close this gap. For every $n$, stability level $γ$, and loss bound $L$, we construct one deterministic $γ$-uniformly stable learning problem whose tail satisfies, simultaneously for $1\le p\le c n$, $\mathbb P \left( R(A_S)-R_S(A_S) \ge c'\min \left\{L,γp+L\sqrt{p/n}\right\} \right)\ge e^{-p}.$ The construction is ordinary bounded absolute-loss regression with constant labels. Its key is a multiscale collection of rare Rademacher features. A coordinatewise ramp is stable in sup norm, while an odd symmetrized maximum converts a unique extreme feature into a gap of order $γp$ without violating the loss bound. Geometrically spaced ramps put all confidence levels into the same problem. Together with the logarithmic-free upper bound, this determines the optimal high-probability and moment dependence of uniform stability up to universal constants.

AI.title_translation: 均匀稳定性的尖锐尾部
AI.tldr: 该论文通过构造一个确定性的学习问题，解决了关于均匀稳定性高概率泛化界中对数依赖性的长期公开问题，确定了其最优的高概率和矩依赖性。
AI.motivation: 以往的\gamma-均匀稳定算法的高概率泛化界存在对数因子或仅对辅助变量成立，且已知的学习下界仅在常数概率下成立，判断实际的有界损失学习算法能否实现对\log(1/\delta)的线性依赖性一直是一个公开问题。该论文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 构造了一个确定性的\gamma-均匀稳定学习问题，采用具有常数标签的普通有界绝对值回归，并利用多尺度稀有Rademacher特征、逐坐标斜坡函数（ramp）以及奇对称最大值算子。
AI.result: 论文构造了一个确定性的\gamma-均匀稳定学习问题，其泛化误差的尾部概率同时满足对于1\le p\le cn的\mathbb P \left( R(A_S)-R_S(A_S) \ge c'\min \left\{L,γp+L\sqrt{p/n}\right\} \right)\ge e^{-p}，从而确定了最优的高概率和矩依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功解决了均匀稳定性高概率泛化界中的公开问题，通过确定性构造证明了线性依赖于\log(1/\delta)的界限是可实现的，从而确定了均匀稳定性的最优高概率与矩依赖性。
AI.translation: 均匀稳定性控制了单个训练样本可以改变测试点损失的程度。一个新的无对数上界表明，一个损失在 $[0,L]$ 内的 $\gamma$-均匀稳定算法，以 $1-\delta$ 的概率具有至多 $O \left(\gamma\log(1/\delta) +L\sqrt{\frac{\log(1/\delta)}{n}}\right)$ 的泛化误差界。实际的有界损失学习算法是否能实现对 $\log(1/\delta)$ 的线性依赖性一直是一个公开问题。已知的构造仅对逐点范围随 $n$ 增长的辅助弱相关随机变量实现了这一点。已知的学习下界仅在常数概率下成立。我们缩小了这个差距。对于每个 $n$、稳定性水平 $\gamma$ 和损失界 $L$，我们构建了一个确定性的 $\gamma$-均匀稳定学习问题，其尾部同时满足对于 $1\le p\le cn$ 的 $\mathbb P \left( R(A_S)-R_S(A_S) \ge c'\min \left\{L,γp+L\sqrt{p/n}\right\} \right)\ge e^{-p}$。该构造是具有常数标签的普通有界绝对值回归。其关键是一个多尺度的稀有 Rademacher 特征集合。坐标方向的斜坡在上确界范数下是稳定的，而奇对称最大值将一个独特的极值特征转化为 $\gamma p$ 量级的间距，且不违反损失界。几何间距的斜坡将所有置信水平放入同一个问题中。连同无对数上界一起，这决定了均匀稳定性的最优高概率和矩依赖性，精确到泛常数。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了均匀稳定性的泛化误差尾部界，通过构造一个具体的确定性学习问题，解决了关于高概率下泛化误差对\log(1/\delta)依赖性的公开问题，并结合无对数上界，精确确定了均匀稳定性的最优高概率与矩依赖性。
AI.keywords: Uniform stability, Generalization gap, High-probability tail, Rademacher features, Regression
AI.comments: 该论文通过巧妙构造具有罕见Rademacher特征的确定性学习问题，完美关闭了均匀稳定性（uniform stability）高概率泛化误差界中长期存在的对数因子鸿沟，确定了最优的高概率与矩依赖性。

title: Are Android GUI Agents Robust Against Runtime Anomalies? AnTrap: Evaluating Agents in Dynamic Adversarial Environments
summary: GUI agents often encounter dynamic anomalies when deployed on Android devices, from unexpected pop-ups to action misuse, yet existing benchmarks lack systematic evaluation of agent robustness against runtime anomalies. We introduce AnTrap, a comprehensive benchmark that injects dynamic perturbations into agent execution trajectories. We propose a taxonomy organizing real-world anomalies into four layers (State, Thinking, Action and Round) with ten fine-grained subcategories, and develop a construction pipeline that preserves task solvability while introducing realistic adversarial conditions. Evaluating 16 leading GUI models, we reveal universal vulnerability to dynamic anomalies, with even the strongest models suffering significant performance degradation. Furthermore, we conduct GRPO training in both original and adversarial environments to validate our benchmark, separating environment-learnable anomalies from reasoning-bottlenecked ones. Our findings show that while single-step traps at state and action layers are largely addressable through adversarial reinforcement learning, deep contextual traps, like state deadlock, expose intrinsic limitations that cannot be resolved by training in environments with traps alone.

AI.title_translation: Android GUI智能体对运行时异常具有鲁棒性吗？AnTrap：在动态对抗环境中评估智能体
AI.tldr: 本文提出了AnTrap基准来评估Android GUI智能体在动态运行时异常下的鲁棒性，发现现有模型普遍脆弱，且深层上下文陷阱暴露出当前智能体的内在局限性。
AI.motivation: GUI智能体在Android设备部署时常遇到动态异常，但现有基准缺乏对智能体在运行时异常下鲁棒性的系统性评估。
AI.method: 提出AnTrap基准，引入将现实世界异常组织为四层（状态、思考、动作和轮次）及十个细粒度子类别的分类法，开发了一个在引入现实对抗条件的同时保持任务可解性的构建管道，并对16个领先的GUI模型进行了评估以及GRPO训练验证。
AI.result: 评估16个领先的GUI模型发现其对动态异常普遍脆弱，最强模型性能也显著下降；单步陷阱可通过对抗性强化学习解决，但状态死锁等深层上下文陷阱暴露出无法仅通过陷阱环境训练解决的内在局限性。
AI.conclusion: 尽管对抗性强化学习可以缓解单步陷阱，但深层上下文陷阱仍暴露了当前GUI智能体的内在局限性，无法仅靠环境训练解决。
AI.translation: GUI智能体在Android设备上部署时，经常会遇到从意外弹窗到动作滥用等动态异常，然而现有的基准缺乏对智能体在运行时异常下鲁棒性的系统性评估。我们推出了AnTrap，这是一个全面的基准测试，它将动态扰动注入到智能体执行轨迹中。我们提出了一个分类法，将真实世界的异常组织为四个层级（状态、思考、动作和轮次）以及十个细粒度的子类别，并开发了一个构建管道，在引入现实对抗条件的同时保持任务的可解性。通过对16个领先的GUI模型进行评估，我们揭示了它们对动态异常的普遍脆弱性，即使是最强的模型也会遭受显著的性能退化。此外，我们在原始环境和对抗环境中都进行了GRPO训练以验证我们的基准，将环境可学习的异常与推理瓶颈导致的异常区分开来。我们的研究结果表明，虽然状态层和动作层的单步陷阱在很大程度上可以通过对抗性强化学习来解决，但深层上下文陷阱（如状态死锁）暴露出无法仅通过在含有陷阱的环境中训练来解决的内在局限性。
AI.summary: 本文推出了AnTrap，一个旨在评估Android GUI智能体在动态对抗环境中鲁棒性的全面基准。通过建立四层异常分类法并注入动态扰动，研究评估了16个领先的GUI模型，揭示了其普遍的脆弱性，并通过GRPO训练验证了该基准，区分了环境可学习异常与推理瓶颈异常。
AI.keywords: Android GUI智能体, 鲁棒性评估, 运行时异常, 对抗性基准, 强化学习
AI.comments: 本文针对Android GUI智能体在运行时异常下的鲁棒性进行了开创性评估，提出了AnTrap基准和四层异常分类法，揭示了当前主流模型在动态对抗环境中的普遍脆弱性，为未来智能体架构的设计提供了重要启示。

title: TrAct: Bridging Robot Control and Visual Prediction with Visual Tracks
summary: Robot actions are inherently embodiment-specific and only weakly aligned with image-space visual changes, limiting their effectiveness as conditioning signals for robot world models. In contrast, visual tracks provide an embodiment-agnostic representation of how task-relevant points move through a scene, offering dense image-space guidance for accurate and spatially precise future video prediction. Building on this observation, we propose TrAct, a world-model-based robot decision-making framework that uses visual tracks as an intermediate interface between control and prediction. TrAct consists of three components: a Vision-Language-Action-and-Track model (VLAT) that jointly predicts candidate actions and corresponding visual tracks from the current observation and language instruction; a track-conditioned world model (TWM) that predicts future visual outcomes conditioned on the proposed tracks; and a vision-language reward model (VLAC) that scores the predicted outcomes. At inference time, VLAT generates candidate action-track pairs, TWM rolls out their visual consequences, and VLAC selects the track whose predicted outcome best satisfies the instruction; the action paired with the selected track is then executed by the robot. Experiments on the proposed LIBERO-INTEGRAL benchmark and real-world Franka manipulation show that TrAct improves success rates from 27% to 55% in simulation and from 49% to 76% on real-world tasks compared with the strong VLA baseline $π_{0.5}$. Furthermore, TWM consistently improves video prediction quality over the action-conditioned world model (AWM). These results demonstrate that visual tracks provide an effective shared interface between robot control and visual prediction, enabling more accurate world modeling and stronger robot generalization.

AI.title_translation: TrAct：通过视觉轨迹连接机器人控制与视觉预测
AI.tldr: TrAct是一个基于世界模型的机器人决策框架，它使用视觉轨迹作为控制和预测之间的中间接口，通过VLAT预测动作-轨迹对，TWM预测未来视觉结果，VLAC选择最佳轨迹对应的动作执行，在模拟和现实世界任务中均显著提高了成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人动作与视觉变化对齐较弱，限制了其作为机器人世界模型条件信号的有效性。视觉轨迹提供了一种与具体实现无关的表示，可以为未来的视频预测提供密集的图像空间引导。
AI.method: TrAct框架包含三个部分：1. 视觉-语言-动作-轨迹模型（VLAT），用于联合预测候选动作和对应的视觉轨迹。2. 轨迹条件世界模型（TWM），用于预测由轨迹引导的未来视觉结果。3. 视觉-语言奖励模型（VLAC），用于评估预测结果。在推理时，VLAT生成动作-轨迹对，TWM进行轨迹预测，VLAC选择最佳轨迹，最后执行与之配对的动作。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-INTEGRAL基准和Franka机械臂的实验中，TrAct将模拟环境中的成功率从27%提高到55%，真实世界任务的成功率从49%提高到76%。TWM在视频预测质量上持续优于动作条件世界模型（AWM）。
AI.conclusion: 视觉轨迹是连接机器人控制和视觉预测的有效接口，能够实现更准确的世界建模和更强的机器人泛化能力。
AI.translation: 机器人动作与其具体的实现方式（embodiment）紧密相关，并且与图像空间的视觉变化对齐较弱，这限制了它们作为机器人世界模型（robot world models）的条件信号（conditioning signals）的有效性。相比之下，视觉轨迹（visual tracks）提供了一种与具体实现无关（embodiment-agnostic）的表示，能够描绘任务相关点在场景中如何移动，从而为准确且在空间上精确的未来视频预测提供密集的图像空间引导。基于这一观察，我们提出了TrAct，一个基于世界模型的机器人决策框架，它使用视觉轨迹作为控制和预测之间的中间接口。TrAct包含三个组成部分：一个视觉-语言-动作-轨迹模型（VLAT），它能根据当前观测和语言指令联合预测候选动作和对应的视觉轨迹；一个轨迹条件世界模型（TWM），它能以预测的轨迹为条件来预测未来的视觉结果；以及一个视觉-语言奖励模型（VLAC），它对预测的结果进行评分。在推理时，VLAT生成候选的动作-轨迹对，TWM根据这些轨迹展开（rolls out）其视觉后果，VLAC选择其预测结果最能满足指令的轨迹；然后由机器人执行与所选轨迹配对的动作。在提出的LIBERO-INTEGRAL基准和真实世界的Franka操作任务上的实验表明，与强大的VLA基线$π_{0.5}$相比，TrAct在模拟中将成功率从27%提高到55%，在真实世界任务中从49%提高到76%。此外，TWM在视频预测质量上持续优于动作条件世界模型（AWM）。这些结果表明，视觉轨迹在机器人控制和视觉预测之间提供了一个有效的共享接口，能够实现更准确的世界建模和更强的机器人泛化能力。
AI.summary: TrAct框架通过引入视觉轨迹作为机器人控制和视觉预测之间的桥梁，解决了机器人动作信号与视觉变化对齐不佳的问题。该框架利用VLAT预测动作-轨迹对，TWM进行轨迹驱动的未来预测，并由VLAC评估结果以选择最佳动作。实验证明，TrAct显著提升了机器人任务的成功率，并改进了世界模型的预测质量，证明了视觉轨迹在增强机器人能力方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 视觉轨迹, 机器人控制, 视觉预测, 世界模型, 模仿学习
AI.comments: 该研究提出的TrAct框架通过视觉轨迹这一新颖的中间表示，成功地弥合了机器人控制和视觉预测之间的鸿沟，解决了长期存在的对齐问题。其在模拟和真实世界任务中均取得了显著的性能提升，证明了该方法的有效性和泛化能力。框架的三个组成部分（VLAT, TWM, VLAC）协同工作，实现了端到端的决策过程。然而，该方法对轨迹预测的准确性依赖较高，未来可探索更鲁棒的轨迹表示或预测方法。此外，LIBERO-INTEGRAL基准的提出也为相关研究提供了有力的支持。

title: A Few Shared Random Bits Suffice for Constant-Round Almost Stable Matching
summary:
We show that almost stable matching can be solved in constant distributed rounds on general bipartite graphs $G=(V,E)$ using only a few shared random bits. Specifically, in the $\congest$ model, we compute a matching whose expected number of blocking pairs is at most $\varepsilon |E|$ in $O\left(\frac{\log(1/\varepsilon)}{\varepsilon^4}\right)$ rounds using $O\left(\log(1/\varepsilon)\right)$ shared random bits. Thus, for every constant $\varepsilon>0$, the round complexity is $O(1)$, independent of the number of vertices and the maximum degree.
  Previous algorithms achieve constant round complexity only for bounded-degree or almost-regular graphs; on general graphs, their round complexity depends polylogarithmically on $n$. Our main technical idea is a degree-guarded freezing rule that allows widely varying degrees to be handled by a single global charging argument, avoiding the $Θ(\log n)$ successive degree thresholds used in previous work. The shared random bits are used only to select a common random output iteration.
  As consequences, we obtain an $O\left(
  \frac{\log(1/\varepsilon)}{\varepsilon^4}
  +
  \frac{\log n}{\varepsilon} \right)$-round $\congest$ algorithm without pre-shared randomness, via a low-diameter decomposition, and an $O\left(\frac{\log(1/\varepsilon)}{\varepsilon^4}\right)$-round algorithm in the fully-scalable Massively Parallel Computation ($\mpc$) model with linear total memory.

AI.title_translation: 极少量共享随机比特足以实现常数轮几乎稳定匹配
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在一般二分图上仅需少量共享随机比特即可在常数轮次内计算几乎稳定匹配的分布式算法。
AI.motivation: 以往的分布式稳定匹配算法只能在有界度或几乎正则图上实现常数轮次，而在一般图上的轮次复杂度依赖于顶点数的多对数级（polylogarithmic in n）。本研究旨在探索如何在一般二分图上仅使用极少量的共享随机比特，实现与顶点数和最大度无关的常数轮次“几乎稳定匹配”。
AI.method: 采用度数保护冻结规则（degree-guarded freezing rule）处理广泛变化的度数，避免了以往复杂的连续度数阈值，并利用少量共享随机比特选择公共随机输出迭代。
AI.result: 在 CONGEST 模型中，该算法能够在 $O\left(\frac{\log(1/\varepsilon)}{\varepsilon^4}\right)$ 轮内计算出期望阻塞对数至多为 $\varepsilon |E|$ 的匹配，仅需 $O(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ 个共享随机比特；无需预共享随机比特时复杂度为 $O\left(\frac{\log(1/\varepsilon)}{\varepsilon^4} + \frac{\log n}{\varepsilon}\right)$ 轮；在 MPC 模型中同样实现了 $O\left(\frac{\log(1/\varepsilon)}{\varepsilon^4}\right)$ 轮的高效算法。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了只需极少量的共享随机比特，即可在一般二分图上通过常数轮次的分布式算法高效计算几乎稳定匹配，显著改进了以往针对有界度或几乎正则图的限制，并在 CONGEST 和 MPC 模型中均得到了优秀的算法复杂度。
AI.translation:
我们证明了几乎稳定匹配可以在一般二分图 $G=(V,E)$ 上通过常数个分布式轮次解决，且仅需少量的共享随机比特。具体而言，在 $\congest$ 模型中，我们计算出一个匹配，其期望的阻塞对数最多为 $\varepsilon |E|$，轮次为 $O\left(\frac{\log(1/\varepsilon)}{\varepsilon^4}\right)$，使用的共享随机比特数为 $O\left(\log(1/\varepsilon)\right)$。因此，对于每个常数 $\varepsilon>0$，轮次复杂度为 $O(1)$，与顶点数和最大度无关。
先前的方法仅对有界度或几乎正则图实现了常数轮复杂度；在一般图上，其轮次复杂度依赖于 $n$ 的多对数阶。我们的主要技术思想是一个度数保护冻结规则（degree-guarded freezing rule），它允许通过单一的全局记账论证来处理广泛变化的度数，从而避免了先前工作中使用的 $\Theta(\log n)$ 个连续度数阈值。共享随机比特仅用于选择一个共同的随机输出迭代。
作为推论，我们通过低直径分解获得了无需预共享随机的 $O\left(\frac{\log(1/\varepsilon)}{\varepsilon^4} + \frac{\log n}{\varepsilon}\right)$ 轮 $\congest$ 算法，以及在具有线性总内存的全可扩展海量并行计算（$\mpc$）模型中 $O\left(\frac{\log(1/\varepsilon)}{\varepsilon^4}\right)$ 轮的算法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种在一般二分图上利用极少量共享随机比特在常数分布式轮次内求解几乎稳定匹配的新算法。通过引入度数保护冻结规则，算法在 CONGEST 和 MPC 模型中均实现了与图规模无关的常数轮次复杂度，突破了以往仅适用于特定图类的局限。
AI.keywords: 稳定匹配, 分布式算法, CONGEST模型, 大规模并行计算, 共享随机比特
AI.comments: 该论文在分布式图算法领域取得了突破性进展，首次在一般二分图上实现了常数轮次（与顶点数和最大度无关）的几乎稳定匹配，且仅需少量的共享随机比特。其核心技术“度数保护冻结规则”巧妙地避开了传统的多重度数阈值，简化了全局记账论证。

title: ACE: A Self-Correcting Agentic Canvas Editor for Multi-Slide Presentation Automation
comments: 26 pages, 12 figures, EMNLP 2026 Industry Track (Main paper)
summary: Commercial design platforms increasingly edit documents through large language model (LLM) agents, but two practical problems block reliable deployment: legacy document formats expose only \emph{flat}, absolutely positioned elements, so agents must recompute coordinates and routinely break layouts; and design has no unique ground truth, so diff-against-reference metrics penalize valid-but-different outputs. We present \textbf{ACE}, an agentic canvas editor over a \emph{hierarchical scene-graph} with a presentation-specialized action space (98 tools), paired with \textbf{CARE}, a content-aware router that feeds the agent only the relevant slice of each deck (avg.\ $\sim$89\% input-token reduction), and a \emph{self-correction} loop driven by a \emph{ground-truth-free} instruction-following (IF) judge whose natural-language critique is fed back as the next-turn instruction. With a fixed backbone, a scene-graph editor in a \emph{single turn} already matches a same-backbone \emph{agentic} HTML pipeline that iterates internally; adding self-correction lifts ACE significantly above it on instruction following (IF 4.23 vs.\ 3.81 on the full 94-task benchmark, paired $p{=}.010$, replicated by an out-of-loop judge) at 1.75$\times$ the speed and $\sim$44\% lower cost. VQ means are statistically indistinguishable, but 26 blind raters prefer ACE overall (58.7\% decisive win-rate) and prefer the self-corrected output 81\% of the time; the ranking is invariant across three judge families, and out-of-loop judges retain two-thirds of the self-correction gain, bounding circularity. 66\% of cases halt after one pass, and a strict-peak rollback removes every observed regression.
comment: 26 pages, 12 figures, EMNLP 2026 Industry Track (Main paper)

AI.title_translation: ACE：用于多幻灯片演示文稿自动化的自修正智能画布编辑器
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为ACE的智能画布编辑器，通过分层场景图、内容感知路由和自修正机制，实现了高效、高质量的多幻灯片演示文稿自动化生成。
AI.motivation: 现有的商业设计平台在使用大语言模型代理编辑文档时面临两大实用难题：1）传统文档格式仅暴露扁平的绝对定位元素，导致代理频繁破坏布局；2）设计缺乏唯一的标准答案，传统的对比参考指标无法评估有效但不同的输出。
AI.method: 提出ACE（一种基于分层场景图和专用动作空间的智能画布编辑器），配合CARE（内容感知路由器）以及由无标准答案指令遵循（IF）裁判驱动的自修正循环。
AI.result: 在完整94个任务的基准测试中，ACE的指令遵循得分显著提升（4.23对3.81），速度提升1.75倍，成本降低约44%，且在盲测中获得了58.7%的决定性胜率。
AI.conclusion: ACE通过分层场景图、内容感知路由和自修正循环，有效解决了多幻灯片演示文稿自动化中的布局破坏和缺乏标准答案评估的问题，在指令遵循、运行速度和成本效益上均显著优于传统HTML流水线方法。
AI.translation: 商业设计平台越来越多地通过大语言模型（LLM）代理来编辑文档，但两个实际问题阻碍了其可靠部署：传统的文档格式仅暴露“扁平的”、绝对定位的元素，因此代理必须重新计算坐标且经常破坏布局；此外，设计没有唯一的标准答案，因此对比参考的指标会惩罚有效但不同的输出。我们提出了ACE，这是一个基于“分层场景图”的智能画布编辑器，具有专门针对演示文稿的动作空间（98个工具），并配有CARE（一个内容感知路由器，只向代理提供每个文稿的相关切片，平均减少约89%的输入Token），以及一个由“无标准答案”指令遵循（IF）裁判驱动的“自修正”循环，其自然语言 critique 被反馈为下一轮的指令。在使用固定骨干网络的情况下，单轮场景图编辑器已经可以匹配同骨干网络的内部迭代“代理式”HTML流水线；加入自修正后，ACE在指令遵循方面显著超越了后者（在全部94个任务的基准测试中IF为4.23对3.81，配对$p=0.010$，由闭环外裁判复制）。VQ均值在统计上没有区别，但26名盲测评分员总体上更偏爱ACE（58.7%的决定性胜率），并且81%的时候更偏爱自修正后的输出；这种排名在三个裁判家族中保持不变，闭环外裁判保留了三分之二的自修正增益，限制了循环性。66%的案例在一次迭代后停止，严格的峰值回滚消除了所有观察到的回归。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了ACE，一个用于多幻灯片演示文稿自动化的自修正智能画布编辑器。通过采用分层场景图、内容感知路由器和基于无标准答案指令遵循的自修正循环，ACE解决了传统文档格式导致的布局破碎和设计评估难题，实现了更高的指令遵循度、更快的速度和更低的成本。
AI.keywords: 多幻灯片自动化, 大语言模型代理, 分层场景图, 自修正, 演示文稿设计
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种新颖的自修正智能画布编辑器（ACE），用于多幻灯片演示文稿的自动化生成。其创新之处在于引入了分层场景图（避免绝对坐标混乱）、内容感知路由器（大幅降低Token开销）以及无标准答案的自修正循环机制。这为大模型在复杂文档编辑领域的应用提供了高效、可靠的解决方案。

title: DRRG: A Discrete Diffusion Framework for Radiology Report Generation
summary:
Purpose: Automatic radiology report generation (RRG) has been widely explored to improve reporting accuracy and reduce radiologists' workload. Most existing methods rely on autoregressive (AR) frameworks that generate reports token by token and cannot revise earlier content, making them prone to error propagation and inconsistent with the iterative refinement process of radiological reporting. In contrast, discrete diffusion large language models (DLLMs) generate text through iterative denoising, naturally enabling report refinement. However, DLLMs have not been extensively investigated for RRG. In this study, we developed and evaluated a discrete diffusion framework for RRG that enables iterative refinement rather than conventional left-to-right autoregressive decoding.
  Materials and methods: We developed DRRG, a DLLM-based framework that formulates RRG as iterative masked-token denoising. DRRG incorporates a clinical-entities-aware complementary mask to improve token supervision coverage and emphasize clinically important entities, together with a concept-conditioning module that injects image-derived clinical concepts into visual representations. DRRG was trained and evaluated on MIMIC-CXR and CheXpert Plus.
  Results: On MIMIC-CXR, DRRG achieved BLEU-4 of 0.210, CheXpert-F1 of 0.549, RadGraph-F1 of 0.281, GREEN of 0.360, and RaTEScore of 0.604, outperforming the compared methods on most reported metrics, despite employing a substantially smaller LLM decoder. On CheXpert Plus, DRRG achieved the highest BLEU-4 (0.119) and CheXpert-F1 (0.347) among the compared methods.
  Conclusion: Discrete diffusion provides an effective alternative to autoregressive radiology report generation by enabling iterative, bidirectional report refinement. Incorporating clinically focused masking and image-derived concept conditioning improves report quality and clinical consistency.

AI.title_translation: DRRG：一种用于放射学报告生成的离散扩散框架
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于离散扩散的放射学报告生成框架（DRRG），通过迭代去噪和临床实体感知掩码替代传统自回归方法，显著提高了报告的质量和临床一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动放射学报告生成（RRG）大多依赖于逐词生成的自回归（AR）框架，无法修改早期生成的内容，容易导致错误传播，且与放射学报告编写的迭代精炼过程不符。因此，研究旨在开发基于离散扩散大语言模型（DLLM）的框架来实现迭代细化。
AI.method: 开发了名为DRRG的基于离散扩散大语言模型（DLLM）的框架，将放射学报告生成建模为迭代式掩码词元去噪。引入了临床实体感知互补掩码以提高监督覆盖率并强调临床重要实体，同时结合了概念条件模块，将图像衍生的临床概念注入视觉表示中。并在MIMIC-CXR和CheXpert Plus数据集上进行训练与评估。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-CXR数据集上，DRRG取得了0.210的BLEU-4、0.549的CheXpert-F1、0.281的RadGraph-F1、0.360的GREEN和0.604的RaTEScore，在大多数指标上超越了对比方法；在CheXpert Plus数据集上也取得了最高的BLEU-4和CheXpert-F1。
AI.conclusion: 离散扩散模型为放射学报告生成提供了一种有效的自回归替代方案，通过迭代式双向细化以及融入临床关注的掩码和概念条件，能够有效提高报告质量和临床一致性。
AI.translation:
目的：自动放射学报告生成（RRG）已被广泛研究，以提高报告准确性并减轻放射科医生的工作负担。大多数现有方法依赖于自回归（AR）框架，该框架逐个词元生成报告，且无法修改早期内容，容易导致错误传播，这与放射学报告编写的迭代精炼过程不一致。相比之下，离散扩散大语言模型（DLLM）通过迭代去噪生成文本，自然地支持报告精炼。然而，DLLM在RRG中的应用尚未被广泛研究。在本研究中，我们开发并评估了一个用于RRG的离散扩散框架，该框架支持迭代精炼，而非传统的从左到右的自回归解码。
材料与方法：我们开发了DRRG，这是一个基于DLLM的框架，将RRG表述为迭代式掩码词元去噪。DRRG结合了临床实体感知的互补掩码以提高词元监督覆盖率并强调临床重要实体，同时引入了一个概念条件模块，将图像派生的临床概念注入视觉表示中。DRRG在MIMIC-CXR和CheXpert Plus上进行了训练与评估。
结果：在MIMIC-CXR上，尽管使用了体积小得多的LLM解码器，DRRG的BLEU-4达到0.210，CheXpert-F1达到0.549，RadGraph-F1达到0.281，GREEN达到0.360，RaTEScore达到0.604，在多数报告指标上优于对比方法。在CheXpert Plus上，DRRG在对比方法中实现了最高的BLEU-4（0.119）和CheXpert-F1（0.347）。
结论：离散扩散为放射学报告生成提供了一种有效的自回归替代方案，能够实现迭代的双向报告精炼。结合临床重点掩码和图像派生的概念条件，可提高报告质量和临床一致性。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了DRRG，一个用于放射学报告生成的离散扩散框架。该框架通过迭代式掩码词元去噪替代传统的自回归解码，并结合了临床实体感知掩码和概念条件注入模块，在多个数据集上展现出优于现有方法的性能。
AI.keywords: 放射学报告生成, 离散扩散大语言模型, 迭代去噪, 临床实体感知掩码, MIMIC-CXR
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将离散扩散大语言模型（DLLM）引入放射学报告生成领域，摆脱了传统自回归模型容易产生错误累积的缺陷，并通过临床实体感知掩码和概念条件注入模块提升了临床准确性。

title: MatReplace: A Reference-Free, Conditioning-Aligned Benchmark for Material Replacement in Interior Scenes
summary: Material replacement is a common interior-design operation: changing the material of a selected surface while preserving its geometry, surroundings, and illumination. Despite its commercial relevance, no public benchmark isolates this task, and evaluating it is challenging. Reference-based metrics penalize valid outputs in this inherently one-to-many setting, favor the style of the reference generator, and cannot fairly compare editors that receive different forms of guidance. We introduce MatReplace, a reference-free benchmark that evaluates edits along four verifiable dimensions: local material correctness, global lighting harmony, outside preservation, and inside structure. It defines three tracks that vary one conditioning signal at a time: (A) instruction only, (B) instruction plus region mask, and (C) material reference image instead of instruction. Our results reveal a clear divide between naming and visually grounding materials. In Track A, leading closed-source editors achieve exemplar-level material rendering and surpass the exemplar anchor under our primary aggregate. In Track B, masks help only mask-compatible models with weak scene preservation, with task-paired, single-seed effects ranging from +0.137 to -0.090 across aligned model families. In Track C, reference-image conditioning degrades every family under both aggregates, by -0.031 to -0.508; in the worst cases, models repaint the reference image itself and perform worse than returning the input unchanged. Thus, named-material rendering is largely solved by the strongest closed editors on this distribution, but grounding materials from pixels remains an open challenge. Expert ratings validate our ranking (Kendall's tau = 0.68) and align with our aggregates more closely than GT-referenced or CLIP-based baselines.

AI.title_translation: MatReplace：室内场景材质替换的无参考、条件对齐基准
AI.tldr: 本文提出了 MatReplace——首个室内场景材质替换的无参考评估基准，揭示了顶尖AI模型在文字命名材质渲染上的优异表现以及在图像材质参考迁移上的局限性。
AI.motivation: 室内设计中的材质替换任务缺乏公共基准来评估，且传统的基于参考的评估指标存在惩罚有效输出、偏向特定生成器风格以及无法公平比较不同引导形式编辑器的缺陷。
AI.method: 引入名为 MatReplace 的无参考基准，沿四个可验证维度评估编辑：局部材质正确性、全局光照和谐度、外部保持和内部结构；并定义了三种变化单一条件信号的轨道（指令、指令加掩码、材质参考图像）。
AI.result: 顶尖的封闭源码编辑器在文本指令轨道（Track A）上表现极佳，甚至超越了示例锚点；但在图像参考轨道（Track C）中，所有模型家族的表现均出现退化，甚至不如返回原图。专家的评分与该基准的排序高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 封闭源码编辑器在文本命名材质渲染上表现出色，但基于像素的材质参考引导仍然是一个开放性挑战。专家评分验证了该基准的有效性。
AI.translation: 材质替换是一项常见的室内设计操作：在保持所选表面的几何形状、周围环境和光照的同时，改变其材质。尽管具有商业价值，但目前尚无公共基准来隔离此任务，且对其进行评估具有挑战性。基于参考的指标在此类天生的一对多设置中会惩罚有效的输出，偏爱参考生成器的风格，并且无法公平比较接受不同形式引导的编辑器。我们介绍了 MatReplace，这是一个无参考的基准，它沿四个可验证的维度评估编辑：局部材质正确性、全局光照和谐度、外部保持和内部结构。它定义了三个每次变化一个条件信号的轨道：（A）仅指令，（B）指令加区域掩码，以及（C）用材质参考图像代替指令。我们的结果揭示了命名材质与视觉定位材质之间明显的鸿沟。在轨道 A 中，领先的闭源编辑器实现了范例级别的材质渲染，并在我们的主要聚合指标下超越了范例锚点。在轨道 B 中，掩码仅对场景保持较弱的掩码兼容模型有帮助，在对齐的模型家族中，任务配对的单种子效果从 +0.137 到 -0.090 不等。在轨道 C 中，参考图像条件会使每个家族在两个聚合指标下都出现退化，幅度为 -0.031 到 -0.508；在最坏的情况下，模型会重新绘制参考图像本身，其性能甚至不如保持输入不变。因此，命名材质的渲染在很大程度上已被该分布下最强的闭源编辑器所解决，但从像素定位材质仍然是一个开放的挑战。专家评分验证了我们的排序（肯德尔 tau = 0.68），并且比基于 GT 参考或基于 CLIP 的基准更符合我们的聚合指标。
AI.summary: MatReplace 是一个针对室内场景材质替换的无参考基准，旨在解决传统评估指标在多解性设置下的局限性。它通过四个维度和三个轨道评估模型的性能，发现当前最强编辑器已基本解决文本指令材质渲染，但从像素提取材质参考依然困难。
AI.keywords: 材质替换, 室内设计, 无参考基准, 视觉生成, 条件对齐
AI.comments: MatReplace 填补了室内场景材质替换无公开基准的空白，通过无参考评估方式有效克服了一对多生成带来的挑战，揭示了当前AI在文字命名材质渲染与像素级材质参考迁移能力上的巨大鸿沟。

title: ExMesh++: From Multi-View Images to Relightable UV-PBR Mesh Assets via Topology-Adaptive Reconstruction and Decomposition
summary: Multi-view reconstruction extends beyond surface recovery to editable and relightable mesh assets. Such assets require well-formed topology, valid UV parameterization, and explicit PBR material maps. Existing surface reconstruction approaches optimize implicit fields, Gaussian primitives, or other intermediate representations. Converting them into such assets often requires surface extraction and texture baking. Inverse-rendering methods estimate materials and illumination, yet these components often remain tied to neural fields or point-based primitives rather than the final mesh. Joint optimization of geometry, materials, and lighting may also allow these variables to compensate for one another, leading to ambiguous decomposition. To address these limitations, we present ExMesh++, a staged framework for reconstructing relightable UV-PBR mesh assets from multi-view images. The first stage refines explicit mesh geometry and topology through adaptive vertex splitting and merging, while maintaining UV consistency as the topology changes. The second stage fixes the resulting mesh-UV carrier and optimizes UV-space PBR maps together with environment lighting. Building on this stable carrier, ExMesh++ models one-bounce diffuse indirect illumination through secondary-ray tracing with shared UV-PBR materials. Experiments demonstrate competitive geometry accuracy, strong relighting performance, and direct usability of the exported assets in standard DCC workflows.

AI.title_translation: ExMesh++：从多视图图像到通过拓扑自适应重建与分解的可重新光照 UV-PBR 网格资产
AI.tldr: ExMesh++ 是一个从多视图图像直接生成可重新光照 UV-PBR 网格资产的分阶段框架，通过拓扑自适应重建和 UV 空间材质分解，实现了高质量的几何与材质恢复，并无缝对接标准 DCC 工作流。
AI.motivation: 现有的多视图重建方法大多依赖隐式场或高斯基元，转换为可编辑资产需要表面提取和纹理烘焙；而逆向渲染方法往往将材质和光照绑定在神经场或点基元中，且几何、材质与光照的联合优化容易导致变量相互补偿并产生分解模糊。为此需要一种能直接输出高质量网格资产的框架。
AI.method: 提出 ExMesh++ 分阶段框架：第一阶段通过自适应顶点分裂和合并来细化显式网格几何体和拓扑，同时在拓扑变化时保持 UV 一致性；第二阶段固定网格-UV 载体，联合优化 UV 空间 PBR 材质和环境光照，并通过二次射线追踪对单次漫反射间接光照进行建模。
AI.result: 实验表明，ExMesh++ 具备竞争力的几何精度、强大的重新光照性能，并且导出的资产可直接用于标准的 DCC 工作流中。
AI.conclusion: 该论文成功开发了 ExMesh++ 框架，能够从多视图图像中高效、准确地重建出具备良好拓扑、有效 UV 参数化和显式 PBR 材质的可重新光照网格资产。
AI.translation: 多视图重建不仅局限于表面恢复，更延伸至可编辑且可重新光照的网格资产。此类资产需要良好的拓扑结构、有效的 UV 参数化以及显式的 PBR 材质贴图。现有的表面重建方法多优化隐式场、高斯基元或其他中间表示，将其转换为此类资产通常需要表面提取和纹理烘焙。逆向渲染方法虽能估计材质和光照，但这些成分往往依附于神经场或点基元，而非最终的网格。同时，几何、材质和光照的联合优化也容易导致这些变量相互补偿，从而产生模糊的分解。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了 ExMesh++，这是一个从多视图图像重建可重新光照 UV-PBR 网格资产的分阶段框架。第一阶段通过自适应顶点分裂和合并来精炼显式网格几何体与拓扑，同时在拓扑改变时维持 UV 的一致性；第二阶段固定所得的网格-UV 载体，并联合优化 UV 空间的 PBR 贴图与环境光照。在此稳定载体基础之上，ExMesh++ 通过使用共享的 UV-PBR 材质进行二次射线追踪，对一次漫反射间接光照进行建模。实验表明，该方法具有具有竞争力的几何精度、强大的重新光照性能，且导出的资产可直接用于标准的 DCC 工作流中。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 ExMesh++，一个从多视图图像重建可重新光照 UV-PBR 网格资产的分阶段框架。该方法通过拓扑自适应重建和 UV 空间 PBR 材质分解，克服了传统隐式场和逆向渲染方法中存在的几何与材质分解模糊、转换繁琐等局限性，在保证几何精度的同时实现了出色的重新光照效果。
AI.keywords: 多视图重建, UV-PBR网格资产, 拓扑自适应, 逆向渲染, 重新光照
AI.comments: ExMesh++ 提出了一个解决多视图图像重建可重新光照 UV-PBR 网格资产的创新分阶段框架，有效解决了几何、材质和光照联合优化中的模糊分解问题，并支持标准的 DCC 工作流，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Trajectory-Level Continuous Action Representation for Robotic Manipulation
summary: We propose CAT, a trajectory-level continuous action representation framework for robotic manipulation. Existing visuomotor systems often entangle action representation with control frequency or rely on fixed temporal parameterizations. This leads to representational redundancy at high sampling rates and limits the modeling of critical motion. CAT instead encodes action trajectories within a fixed real-time interval into a set of continuous latent tokens. To ensure temporal consistency across varying control frequencies, we further incorporate a frequency-aware positional encoding that establishs a shared temporal coordinate system. Trajectory-level regularization further stabilizes the latent representation. This approach prevents representation growth with timestep density and avoids reliance on predefined temporal parameterizations. Extensive system-level evaluations on LIBERO, MimicGen, and real-world long-horizon manipulation tasks demonstrate that CAT-based policies consistently outperform both competitive VQ-based and continuous visuomotor baselines under matched training settings. Across various model backbones and control frequencies, CAT consistently improves success rates. These results highlight the advantages of trajectory-level continuous action modeling for scalable robotic manipulation across varying control rates.

AI.title_translation: 面向机器人操作的轨迹级连续动作表示
AI.tldr: 本文提出了CAT框架，通过轨迹级连续动作表示和频率感知编码，解决了机器人操作中动作表示受控于采样频率的痛点，显著提升了跨频率的策略性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉运动系统常常将动作表示与控制频率交织在一起，或依赖于固定的时间参数化，这导致在高采样率下产生表征冗余，并限制了对关键运动的建模能力。因此，需要一种能够解耦动作表示与控制频率的新框架。
AI.method: 提出CAT框架，将固定实时时间间隔内的动作轨迹编码为一组连续潜在Token，结合频率感知位置编码建立共享时间坐标系，并采用轨迹级正则化稳定潜在表征。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、MimicGen以及真实世界的长周期操作任务上的系统级评估表明，在相同的训练设置下，基于CAT的策略持续优于基于VQ和连续视觉运动的基线方法，显著提高了各种模型骨干网络和控制频率下的成功率。
AI.conclusion: CAT框架通过轨迹级连续动作表示和频率感知位置编码，成功解耦了动作表示与控制频率，提升了机器人操作策略在不同控制频率下的性能和可扩展性。
AI.translation: 我们提出了CAT，一个用于机器人操作的轨迹级连续动作表示框架。现有的视觉运动系统通常将动作表示与控制频率交织在一起，或者依赖于固定的时间参数化。这导致在高采样率下出现表征冗余，并限制了对关键动作的建模。相反，CAT将固定实时时间间隔内的动作轨迹编码为一组连续的潜在Token。为了确保不同控制频率下的时间一致性，我们进一步结合了频率感知的位置编码，以建立共享的时间坐标系。轨迹级正则化进一步稳定了潜在表征。这种方法防止了表征随时间步密度增长，并避免了对预定义时间参数化的依赖。在LIBERO、MimicGen和真实世界长周期操作任务上的广泛系统级评估表明，在匹配的训练设置下，基于CAT的策略始终优于竞争性的基于VQ和连续视觉运动的基线。在各种模型骨干网和控制频率下，CAT始终能提高成功率。这些结果突出了轨迹级连续动作建模在跨不同控制速率的可扩展机器人操作方面的优势。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了CAT（Trajectory-Level Continuous Action Representation）框架用于机器人操作。CAT将固定时间间隔内的动作轨迹编码为连续潜在Token，并引入频率感知的位置编码以确保跨控制频率的时间一致性。实验证明，该方法在各种控制频率和模型骨干网络下均能显著提升机器人的操作成功率。
AI.keywords: 机器人操作, 动作表示, 视觉运动策略, 轨迹级建模, 频率感知位置编码
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了轨迹级别的连续动作表示框架（CAT），通过将固定真实时间间隔内的动作轨迹编码为连续潜在Token，并引入频率-aware的位置编码，有效解决了传统视觉运动系统在控制频率上的限制和表征冗余问题。在多个仿真平台（LIBERO、MimicGen）及真实世界长周期任务中表现优异，具有很高的实用价值和可扩展性。

title: Scalable Question-Centric Text-to-Image Evaluation: Reliable Ranking, Fine-Grained Diagnosis, and Cost-Aware Routing
summary: Modern text-to-image (T2I) models often have similar total scores but different strengths, making practical selection difficult. Fine-grained benchmarks decompose prompts into questions, yet often return them to prompt scores and fixed categories, weakening attribution and ignoring complexity. Related requirements are also scored separately or as one total, obscuring basic versus compositional failure. We present QC-T2I-Bench, a question-centric framework that converts open prompts into attributed atomic questions and organizes their dependencies with Davidsonian Scene Graphs (DSGs). We use hierarchy-constrained question aggregation to exclude downstream questions after a prerequisite fails and to prevent simple and complex prompts from receiving the same total weight. We then use the DSG structure to measure joint success within prompts and compare repeated entities across prompts, separating basic realization failures from failures under additional requirements. We evaluate multiple open-source T2I models on English and Chinese prompts. The resulting question-level evidence supports reliable ranking and fine-grained diagnosis: joint completion falls from 80.7\% for components with two capabilities to 37.2\% for those with seven or more. Finally, we reuse the same records for training-free routing; our cost-aware router matches ERNIE's 89.51-point estimate with 21.3\% less GPU-s/MP.

title: Structured Frequency-Domain Evidence for LLM-Based Time-Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time-series anomalies can appear not only as pointwise deviations but also as changes in recurring temporal structure, such as shifted periodicity or localized oscillatory fluctuations. However, existing LLM-based time-series anomaly detection methods mainly expose time-domain evidence through indexed values, plots, or de-seasonalized representations, leaving spectral structure implicit. We propose an evidence-augmented zero-shot TSAD framework that preserves indexed de-seasonalized observations while adding compact frequency-domain evidence computed with the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT). The evidence is constructed at two resolutions: global frequency-domain evidence summarizes sequence-level periodic context, while local frequency-domain evidence captures time-localized spectral departures. Experiments on AnomLLM with InternVL2-LLaMA3-76B, Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct, Gemini-2.5-Flash, and GPT-4o, together with evaluation on the TSB-AD-U subset, show that explicit frequency-domain evidence improves LLM-based TSAD baselines. These results suggest that frequency-domain evidence can complement indexed and de-seasonalized time-domain inputs for zero-shot LLM-based TSAD.

title: AHEAD: Adaptive Hindsight with Environment-Augmented Distillation for Agentic RL
summary: Training multi-turn LLM agents with reinforcement learning typically relies on trajectory-level rewards, which assign a uniform advantage to every step and cannot identify which decisions led to success or failure. Self-distillation methods can provide finer-grained supervision by augmenting RL with privileged information. However, existing approaches usually apply the same type of privileged information to every step in an indistinguishable manner, ignoring a key asymmetry: routine steps need little additional guidance, while critical error steps require corrective direction that environment feedback alone cannot provide. We propose AHEAD, a step-aware framework that matches different supervision sources to different step types. The teacher receives environment feedback on all steps as a grounded dense signal, and additionally receives LLM-generated corrective hints on error steps to supply the direction that environment feedback lacks. The method introduces minimal changes to the standard GRPO algorithm. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-based QA, and across three model scales, AHEAD raises task success (+13.3 points on ALFWorld and +11.0 on WebShop at 7B over GRPO), reaches a given success rate in fewer training steps, and solves tasks within tighter interaction budgets than outcome-only RL and prior self-distillation baselines.

title: PonderPounce: A Pretrained MLLM as an Episode Context Engine for Robot Control
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can integrate long visual histories, reason under partial observability, and infer behavior from a few examples. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) models generally inherit pretrained representations without using this contextual capacity as episode memory. Memory-dependent policies address this gap through purpose-built history mechanisms. PonderPounce instead reuses an MLLM's native causal context as robot memory. Ponder, a System2 MLLM, accumulates episode observations, demonstrations, and prior cognition in its native causal context and can generate subgoal text and demonstration reasoning for internal use. Pounce, a System1 VLA, receives the current observation, instruction, and proprioception directly; through the Ponder--Pounce interface, it asynchronously receives only the newest continuous cognition token and its age. Both are jointly trained end to end without a purpose-built memory module or separate bridge pretraining. Optimized serving achieves p50 latencies of 78ms for cognition refresh and 25ms for action-model invocation, supporting 20Hz action playback. On RoboMME with base-scale training data, PonderPounce reaches 60.83% with 9B and 50.04% with 0.8B under the same Pounce architecture and interface, versus 44.51% for FrameSamp+Modul and 17.93% for the current-observation π_{0.5}. With 9x data, it reaches 75.54% versus 57.88% for FrameSamp+Modul. On RoboCasa-DC, the same interface learns from action supervision alone and reaches 12.5% versus 11.6% for the strongest published demonstration-conditioned baseline, falling to 8.6% when cognition is replaced by a learned null state.

title: MC-CXR: A Multi-Context Chest X-ray Benchmark for Context-Induced Disruption in Vision-Language Models
comments: 15 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in clinical pipelines where a chest X-ray is interpreted alongside retrieved reports, preliminary notes, or prior imaging. Existing benchmarks measure whether models answer correctly in isolation, but not whether they preserve a correct image-only decision when plausible context conflicts with the image. We introduce Multi-Context Chest X-ray (MC-CXR), a benchmark of 240 cases expanded into 2,522 instances that isolates context-induced disruption through paired perturbation. Each case fixes the current image and target finding while presenting matched reliable and misleading context across text and prior CXR, with visual overlays where available. MC-CXR defines three task families and two paired metrics, the switch-to-wrong rate and the context-aligned error rate. We evaluate ten VLMs spanning open-source general, medical-domain, and closed-source systems. Image-only accuracy is necessary but insufficient. Mean switch rates range from 45.6-78.1% across misleading textual sources and 35.7-61.7% across misleading visual sources. Among switched predictions, 74.6% align with the misleading label for text versus 17.6% for visual context, a 57.0-point gap (95% CI 50.9-62.8). This text-visual asymmetry is observed under the standardized direct-answer protocol. The dataset is available on PhysioNet.

title: TransPhy: Visual In-Context Learning for Physically Grounded Image Editing
summary: Visual demonstrations provide a natural interface for specifying image transformations that are difficult to describe exhaustively with text. However, existing visual in-context learning (VICL) methods primarily focus on appearance-level relation transfer and provide limited support for physically grounded transformations, whose outcomes depend on material properties, geometry, object interactions, and environmental conditions. Given a source--target exemplar pair and a query image, physically grounded VICL requires a model to infer the demonstrated transformation, adapt its effects to the query-specific scene context, and preserve rule-irrelevant content. We introduce PhysVICL-74, comprising 74 physically grounded transformation rules and 5,240 source--target image pairs that form nearly 75K training and evaluation contexts. Its benchmark split separately evaluates novel-instance transfer and unseen-rule generalization. We further propose TransPhy, a framework that decomposes physically grounded VICL into physical-rule induction and transition-aligned rendering. TransPhy first predicts the demonstrated rule and an explicit query-specific target-state description, and then synthesizes the target image through token-wise mixture-of-experts adaptation, with expert routing guided by localized transition cues. Experiments show that TransPhy improves physical-rule adherence, query consistency, and unseen-rule generalization over existing visual in-context editing methods.

title: Strang's Conjecture: Positive Result on Strong Collapsible Complexes and a Code to Check the Conjecture
summary: Splines, which are piecewise polynomial functions with given smoothness, are used in numerous applications such as computer aided geometric design, algebraic geometry and for implementation of the finite element method. In many applications, it is important to know the dimension of the space of splines over a domain, but this continues to be an open problem. Strang's conjecture predicts the dimension of the space of bivariate $C^1$ splines of degree at most $k$ over a polygonal domain with no holes. For the cases, $k=4$ and $k \geq 5$ the conjecture has been proven true. For the case $k=2$, John Morgan and L. Ridgway Scott provided a counterexample. In this project, we begin by relating the space of bivariate $C^1$ splines of degree at most $k$ to various other function spaces. With the aid of some intrinsic operators on these spaces, we obtain a complex that yields an equivalence statement to Strang's conjecture. The equivalent statement admits a computational approach to the conjecture and thus we present an NGSolve code to check Strang's conjecture for a given mesh. In addition, we prove that if the simplicial complex associated to a triangulation is strongly collapsible (with a non-collinear condition), then Strang's conjecture holds for $k=2$.

title: Graph-Supervised Hierarchical Clinical Alignment for Radiology Report Generation with Large Language Models
summary: Radiology report generation (RRG) has recently benefited from large language models, which substantially improve report fluency. However, clinically faithful generation remains challenging because current supervision is still imposed mostly at the report level. This creates a granularity mismatch: radiology reports are composed of disease-grounded findings, while existing methods are trained mainly with whole-report objectives. To address this problem, we propose Graph-Supervised Hierarchical Clinical Alignment, which reformulates image-report supervision as a hierarchical clinical alignment problem. Our method structures this alignment as a disease-conditioned process, where supervision is decomposed into two levels: Disease-Centric Alignment for fine-grained disease-specific correspondence, and Global Clinical Semantic Alignment for report-level semantic coherence. A clinical knowledge graph is used as a training-time-only structural prior that defines disease-specific supervision units and their clinical relationships, introducing no additional overhead at inference. Because standard contrastive alignment could produce false negatives when studies share overlapping pathologies, we combine instance-conditioned discriminative matching with disease-conditioned soft regularization, enabling fine-grained yet clinically consistent cross-modal representations. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR, IU-Xray, and COV-CTR show that our method consistently improves performance on both conventional and clinical metrics. Notably, our 3B model surpasses several prior systems with larger 7B/13B backbones, suggesting that improving supervision structure, rather than increasing model size, can be more effective for RRG.

title: A mesh-free multiresolution deep energy method with phase-field modeling of brittle fracture
summary: Phase-field modeling of brittle fracture removes the need to track cracks explicitly by recasting their evolution as the minimization of an energy functional. In return it requires a discretization dense enough to resolve a localization band whose width is set by a regularization length and whose path is not known in advance. We propose a mesh-free discretization in which a single neural network represents the displacement and phase fields and is trained by minimizing the incremental energy directly. The coordinates enter the network through a multiresolution feature encoding built from $C^1$ quadratic B-spline grids, so the finest scale the representation can express is set by choice rather than reached through slow training, and the energy is estimated by stratified Monte Carlo integration on points redrawn at every optimizer iteration. This pairing proves critical, since the crack fails to advance both when the integration points are held fixed and when the encoding is too coarse to represent the band, while each ingredient tolerates a wide range of settings once the other is in place. Because the representation is globally $C^1$, the second- and the fourth-order fracture energy densities run on the identical discretization. Across six problems, from single-edge-notched tension and shear to a thick-walled ring on a single spline patch, the computed load-displacement curves follow staggered finite element references at matched regularization length, with peak loads within about 1% on the single-edge-notched tests and within 8% where the crack pattern changes topology. On a public benchmark dataset of random multi-crack configurations the method classifies the active or dormant state of 90% of the seeded cracks in twenty zero-shot runs, where the deep Ritz baseline of the dataset authors fails.

title: Anatomy of a Scam Call: What 10,000 real scam and spam calls reveal about how phone scammers operate
summary: Telephone fraud is pervasive and costly, but its inner workings are rarely observed at scale. We analyze a complete corpus of 10,211 inbound scam and spam calls -- 913 hours of audio and 330,956 transcribed turns from 5,780 distinct numbers -- collected over 54 days by an AI voice-agent honeypot that answered callers and kept them talking, and introduced in a companion data descriptor. We separate outright scams, which solicit sensitive information, from the larger stream of predatory but legal lead generation ("spam") that feeds them. Scam operations keep office hours (6.6x more calls per weekday than weekend day); thousands of disposable numbers run a small catalog of recycled scripts (thirty opening clusters, half the traffic in the top five); and callers solicit identity anchors -- a home address and a date of birth -- far more often than payment credentials, pressing through persistence and manufactured authority rather than overt threats. Our central experiment asks: does it matter who picks up? Every seeded lead carried one of ten fictitious identities drawn uniformly at random, so the identity a fraud operation reaches is fixed before the caller exists. Across 1,823 randomized calls, scammers spent about 15% more conversational turns per decade of the target's apparent age (rate ratio 1.15, 95% CI 1.08-1.23; randomization p = 0.005) -- yet what they asked for did not change (26.3% of calls reached a request for sensitive information; odds ratio 0.99 per decade, 95% CI 0.90-1.08). A second experiment casts early detection as a benchmark: from a scammer's opening lines alone, on a caller-disjoint split, escalation is predictable at 0.72 ROC-AUC from the first line and 0.87 by the eighth, and a plain bag-of-words classifier matches a fine-tuned on-device language model. Telephone fraud emerges as a templated industry that varies how hard it works a target, but not what it wants.

title: Syn2RealTrack: Bridging the Gap Between Synthetic and Real-World Datasets for Online Multi-View Multi-Target Tracking
comments: This paper has been accepted by the AI City Challenge Workshop of the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026)
summary: Multi-camera 3D perception systems for warehouse scenes are trained largely on synthetic data and evaluated on physically captured environments. The resulting synthetic-to-real gap, which corrupts ground-plane localization and cross-camera identity association, is usually treated as one deficiency for a single domain-adaptation module to absorb; we argue instead that it enters the pipeline at three separable points: the camera calibration, the object shape prior, and the assumption that the object census is known, each admitting a different local remedy. Our online pipeline, Syn2RealTrack, follows this decomposition: lens distortion is recovered from images alone under a calibration that provides none, detections are fused across views by a visibility-weighted part-based descriptor that abstains on occluded parts rather than guessing, person height is measured in closed form from calibration instead of copied from a synthetic prior, and a closed-world cardinality prior is paired with a causal filter that removes the phantom boxes the prior manufactures. The system therefore adapts by reallocating trust between geometry and appearance without retraining a feature extractor. On the AI City Challenge 2026 Track~1 evaluation server it reaches a 3D Higher Order Tracking Accuracy (HOTA) of 52.0118%. The code will be released at https://github.com/SKKUAutoLab/aic26_mc3dp

title: Centrality-Based Deployment of Queue Policies in Acyclic Multipath Routing Networks
summary: Excessive queueing delays constitute a significant impediment to latency-sensitive network applications. Although effective deployment of Active Queue Management (AQM) strategies has been proposed as a necessary solution, deployment remains sparse. This paper studies AQM deployment in a specific class of networks where routers/switches have a topological hierarchy, form acyclic paths, and adopt multipath routing. Our approach rests on the well-established premise that AQM deployment impacts packet-forwarding dynamics in networks carrying TCP flows, thus establishing a direct link between stability and network performance. We use fluid models for TCP and queue dynamics in the network, along with a simple threshold-based queue policy to outline a closed-loop model for the network. Stability analyses reveal that while the network is vulnerable to instability as the average round-trip time (RTT) of the TCP flows increases, it tolerates a much larger RTT without losing stability when the threshold-based AQM is deployed in an appropriate router. We then define a Katz centrality-based metric to choose the most appropriate router for AQM deployment, and argue that doing so ensures the greatest stabilising effect. Finally, packet-level simulations corroborate that the proposed deployment strategy ensures low-latency operation of the network.

title: From Gradient-Boosted Trees to Deep Recommenders: Practical Lessons from Migrating a Production Customer Support Recommender
summary: Product catalogs in fast-moving service businesses are shifting from static, independently priced SKUs toward dynamically bundled, discount-coupled offerings--a shift that strains the tree-based classifiers traditionally preferred for sparse and highly imbalanced data. These classifiers assume a fixed, slowly changing label space and struggle to incorporate multimodal signals such as tabular data and transcripts. We present the migration of a live, production conversational recommendation system from a gradient-boosted multiclass model to a pairwise-binary deep recommender. Because this system is critical to ecosystem growth initiatives and downstream features like dynamic pitching--surfacing the most relevant pitch text to a support agent in real time during a live customer conversation--maintaining live recommendation quality was a non-negotiable constraint. We detail the techniques that made this migration successful--reformulating recommendation as pairwise binary prediction to learn jointly from user and item features, and enhancing learned representations via negative sampling and noise injection. To efficiently incorporate long, live conversation context, we apply attention pooling over transcript chunks and benchmark it against TF-IDF and sentence-embedding baselines. Finally, we explore multiple architectures (including two-tower models, DeepFM, and their variants) and loss functions such as contrastive loss. Evaluating against a CatBoost baseline across all conversational stages, we demonstrate that our approach achieves parity at conversation beginning and outperforms at later conversational stages.

title: PlaceSeek: Human-Centered Geospatial Retrieval of Urban Outdoor Places via Semantic Grounding and Affective Alignment
comments: Accepted as a Research Paper (short) at ACM SIGSPATIAL 2026. This arXiv version is the full version of the paper
summary: People search for urban outdoor places not only by category or function, but also by what activities a place can support and how it is perceived. Existing geospatial retrieval remains largely POIcentric and metadata-driven, making it difficult to satisfy openended, affective, or activity-oriented needs. We present PlaceSeek, a human-centered outdoor place retrieval framework that maps natural-language queries to geolocated street-view imagery. PlaceSeek introduces an intent-aware retrieval mechanism that decomposes user queries into functional and affective sub-intents. A Semantic Grounding Module verifies whether candidate street-view results contain the physical evidence needed to support the intended activity, while an Affective Alignment Module re-ranks physically valid candidates using a LoRA-adapted vision-language model trained on human urban perception judgments. We evaluate PlaceSeek on 31,956 street-view locations in Milan across 10 naturallanguage queries annotated by five human evaluators. PlaceSeek achieves 88.0% Precision@5, a mean match score of 3.39/4.0, and 0.920 nDCG@5, outperforming CLIP, fine-tuned CLIP, SigLIP, and a VQA-based baseline. Ablation results show that physical grounding is essential for retrieval validity, while affective alignment improves ranking quality among physically valid candidates. These findings highlight that complex urban spatial queries require modeling both verifiable visual evidence and human perceptual preferences. PlaceSeek provides a potential framework for human-centered nextgeneration geospatial retrieval systems.
