We systematically evaluated three deep learning semantic segmentation frameworks, ResNet34-U-Net, ResNet50-DeepLabV3, and a hybrid ResNet50-ASPP-Transformer architecture, for kelp detection using high-resolution underwater RGB imagery collected from northeastern U.S. coastal waters. A dataset of 3,395 SSeg assisted annotated image-mask pairs was developed for model training and validation, while geographically independent sites were used for quantitative and qualitative evaluation. All models used consistent preprocessing, augmentation, and evaluation protocols. On independent test data, ResNet50-DeepLabV3 achieved the highest Dice (0.7120) and Intersection over Union (IoU; 0.6267), followed by ResNet34 U Net (Dice 0.6868; IoU 0.5978). The hybrid ASPP Transformer achieved the highest pixel accuracy (0.8528) but lower Dice (0.6437) and IoU (0.5746). External qualitative evaluation further showed that DeepLabV3 produced more consistent segmentation across varying environmental conditions, image qualities, and benthic habitats. Overall, ResNet50-DeepLabV3, termed Kelp-O-Tron, provided the best balance of segmentation accuracy, robustness, and generalization. The dataset, annotation workflow, and comparative evaluation provide resources for advancing automated underwater habitat mapping and ecological monitoring.

AI.title_translation: Kelp-o-Tron：水下海带森林分割深度学习架构的比较评估
AI.tldr: 本研究系统评估了三种深度学习语义分割框架在水下海带检测中的表现。ResNet50-DeepLabV3（Kelp-O-Tron）在分割准确性、鲁棒性和泛化能力方面表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 水下海带森林是重要的海岸生态系统，但由于光学退化、光照变化、浊度、植被重叠和复杂的水底背景，准确的水下海带分割仍然具有挑战性。
AI.method: 研究系统评估了ResNet34-U-Net、ResNet50-DeepLabV3和混合ResNet50-ASPP-Transformer三种深度学习语义分割框架，用于海带检测。使用了从美国东北部沿海水域收集的高分辨率水下RGB图像，并开发了一个包含3,395对图像-掩模的数据集进行训练和验证。所有模型均采用一致的预处理、增强和评估协议。
AI.result: 在独立测试数据上，ResNet50-DeepLabV3取得了最高的Dice（0.7120）和IoU（0.6267）分数，其次是ResNet34 U Net。混合ASPP Transformer的像素准确率最高（0.8528），但Dice和IoU较低。外部定性评估显示DeepLabV3在不同环境条件下产生了更一致的分割。
AI.conclusion: ResNet50-DeepLabV3，被命名为Kelp-O-Tron，在水下海带分割的准确性、鲁棒性和泛化能力之间提供了最佳平衡。本研究的数据集、注释工作流程和比较评估为推进自动化水下栖息地测绘和生态监测提供了资源。
AI.translation: 水下海带森林是重要的沿海生态系统，支持海洋生物多样性和生态系统动态，但由于光学退化、光照变化、浊度、植被重叠和复杂的水底背景，准确的水下海带分割仍然具有挑战性。我们系统评估了ResNet34-U-Net、ResNet50-DeepLabV3和混合ResNet50-ASPP-Transformer三种深度学习语义分割框架，用于使用从美国东北部沿海水域收集的高分辨率水下RGB图像进行海带检测。开发了一个包含3,395对SSeg辅助注释图像-掩模的数据集，用于模型训练和验证，而地理上独立的站点用于定量和定性评估。所有模型均采用一致的预处理、增强和评估协议。在独立测试数据上，ResNet50-DeepLabV3取得了最高的Dice（0.7120）和交并比（IoU；0.6267），其次是ResNet34 U Net（Dice 0.6868；IoU 0.5978）。混合ASPP Transformer取得了最高的像素准确率（0.8528），但Dice（0.6437）和IoU（0.5746）较低。外部定性评估进一步表明，DeepLabV3在不同的环境条件、图像质量和水底栖息地中产生了更一致的分割。总的来说，ResNet50-DeepLabV3，被称为Kelp-O-Tron，在分割准确性、鲁棒性和泛化能力之间提供了最佳平衡。该数据集、注释工作流程和比较评估为推进自动化水下栖息地测绘和生态监测提供了资源。
AI.summary: 本研究比较评估了ResNet34-U-Net、ResNet50-DeepLabV3和混合ResNet50-ASPP-Transformer三种深度学习模型在水下海带森林分割中的性能，旨在解决光学退化和浊度等挑战。利用一个包含3,395对图像-掩模的数据集，结果显示ResNet50-DeepLabV3（命名为Kelp-O-Tron）在Dice和IoU得分上表现最佳，并在不同环境条件下展现出优异的鲁棒性，使其成为自动化水下栖息地测绘中最有效的架构。
AI.keywords: 深度学习, 海带分割, 水下图像, 语义分割, DeepLabV3
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过系统比较和开发专用数据集（Kelp-o-Tron），为水下海带森林分割这一重要的生态监测挑战提供了一个实用的深度学习解决方案。DeepLabV3在不同条件下表现出的鲁棒性是其在实际应用中的关键创新和重要贡献。

title: Lexicographic Social Ranking on Monotonic Coalitional Rankings
comments: 18 pages, 1 figure, slightly modified version to be published in ADT 2026 - 9th International conference on Algorithmic Decision Theory
summary: Recent studies on social rankings in coalitional settings have introduced methods that rank individuals by lexicographically comparing vectors of their occurrences across coalitions ordered according to their strength. In this work, we focus on two such solutions: the lexicographical excellence (lex-cel) solution, which disregards coalition size, and the L^(1) solution, which additionally prioritizes smaller coalitions through a double lexicographic comparison. We investigate the combinatorial connections between these two solutions on monotonic coalitional rankings, where equivalence classes are compactly represented through sets of minimal (with respect to set inclusion) coalitions. After introducing general formulas for computing the lex-cel and L^(1) parameter vectors from these minimal coalitions, we also present worst-case running time results. Finally, to further explore the behavior of the two solutions through simulations designed to assess the distance of the rankings they produce, we show that the monotonicity assumption does not lead to actual redundancy in the rankings produced by the two solutions.
comment: 18 pages, 1 figure, slightly modified version to be published in ADT 2026 - 9th International conference on Algorithmic Decision Theory

AI.title_translation: 单调联盟排名上的词典式社会排名
AI.tldr: 本文研究了两种在单调联盟排名中进行社会排名的词典式解决方案（lex-cel和L^(1)），探讨了它们之间的组合联系，提出了计算公式，分析了最坏情况运行时间，并通过模拟表明单调性假设不会导致两种解决方案产生的排名冗余。
AI.motivation: 最近关于联盟环境中社会排名的研究引入了通过词典式比较个体在根据强度排序的联盟中出现向量的方法。本文旨在深入理解并比较其中两种解决方案：忽略联盟大小的词典式卓越（lex-cel）解决方案和额外通过双重词典式比较优先考虑较小联盟的L^(1)解决方案。
AI.method: 本文研究了lex-cel和L^(1)解决方案在单调联盟排名上的组合联系，其中等价类通过最小（关于集合包含）联盟集紧凑表示。研究方法包括：引入计算lex-cel和L^(1)参数向量的通用公式，分析最坏情况运行时间，并通过模拟评估它们产生的排名距离来进一步探索这两种解决方案的行为。
AI.result: 本文提出了从最小联盟计算lex-cel和L^(1)参数向量的通用公式，并给出了最坏情况运行时间结果。通过模拟，研究表明单调性假设不会导致lex-cel和L^(1)两种解决方案产生的排名出现实际冗余。
AI.conclusion: 尽管在单调联盟排名中，等价类可以通过最小联盟集紧凑表示，但对lex-cel和L^(1)这两种词典式社会排名解决方案的深入分析表明，单调性假设并不会导致它们所产生排名的实际冗余。
AI.translation: 最近关于联盟环境中社会排名的研究引入了通过词典式比较个体在根据强度排序的联盟中出现向量的方法。在这项工作中，我们关注两种这样的解决方案：词典式卓越（lex-cel）解决方案，它忽略联盟大小；以及L^(1)解决方案，它通过双重词典式比较额外优先考虑较小联盟。我们研究了这两种解决方案在单调联盟排名上的组合联系，其中等价类通过最小（关于集合包含）联盟集紧凑表示。在介绍了从这些最小联盟计算lex-cel和L^(1)参数向量的通用公式之后，我们还给出了最坏情况运行时间结果。最后，为了通过旨在评估它们产生的排名距离的模拟进一步探索这两种解决方案的行为，我们表明单调性假设不会导致这两种解决方案产生的排名出现实际冗余。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在单调联盟排名背景下的两种词典式社会排名解决方案：lex-cel和L^(1)。lex-cel忽略联盟大小，而L^(1)通过双重词典比较优先考虑较小联盟。作者探讨了这两种解决方案之间的组合联系，提出了基于最小联盟计算其参数向量的通用公式，并分析了最坏情况运行时间。通过模拟，研究发现即使在单调性假设下，这两种方案产生的排名也未显示出实际冗余。
AI.keywords: 词典式排名, 社会排名, 联盟排名, lex-cel, L^(1), 单调性
AI.comments: 该论文对两种重要的词典式社会排名解决方案（lex-cel和L^(1)）进行了深入的理论和计算分析。其创新之处在于提出了计算参数向量的通用公式，并结合模拟验证了在特定假设下（单调性）排名结果的非冗余性，这对于理解和应用这些排名机制具有重要意义。

title: Taming foundation model with invariance-oriented pre-training for broad-spectrum EEG analysis across signal-level, brain-state, and brain-health tasks
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a widely used window into human brain function, but most EEG models remain tied to a one-dataset-one-model supervised paradigm. Recent EEG foundation models offer a route toward reusable representations, but most remain reconstruction-centered, assuming that EEG content predictable from local context is necessarily transferable neural information. Here we present INCEPT, an invariance-oriented EEG foundation model trained on over 11,000 hours of unlabelled clinical EEG. Rather than prioritizing signal recovery alone, INCEPT learns representation-level stability across correlated EEG observations, separating stable neural structure and essential subject-sensitive information from the nuisance variability that dominates scalp recordings while preserving subject-, state- and condition-discriminative information. We evaluate INCEPT on a broad-spectrum benchmark of ten datasets spanning three levels of post-acquisition EEG analysis: signal-level assessment, brain-state decoding, and brain-health evaluation. INCEPT ranks first among recent EEG foundation models on 26 of 30 linear-probing metrics and 24 of 30 fine-tuning metrics, and also surpasses strong task-specific specialist encoders across diverse downstream settings. Objective ablations and representation analyses further show that invariance-oriented pre-training improves transfer and organizes subject-sensitive neural representations beyond reconstruction alone. These results establish invariance learning as a promising principle for building reusable EEG foundation models.

AI.title_translation: 驯服基础模型：面向不变性预训练的广谱脑电图分析，涵盖信号级、脑状态和脑健康任务
AI.tldr: INCEPT是一种面向不变性的脑电图基础模型，通过在大量未标记数据上预训练，在信号级、脑状态和脑健康任务中表现优于现有模型，证明不变性学习是构建可重用脑电图基础模型的有效原则。
AI.motivation: 目前的脑电图模型大多局限于“一个数据集一个模型”的监督范式，而现有的脑电图基础模型主要以重建为中心，假设可预测的脑电图内容是可转移的神经信息，但这种方法可能未能有效分离有用信息和干扰变异性。
AI.method: 本文提出了INCEPT，一个面向不变性的脑电图基础模型，在超过11,000小时的未标记临床脑电图数据上进行训练。INCEPT侧重于学习相关脑电图观测中表示层面的稳定性，旨在从头皮记录中分离稳定的神经结构和重要的受试者敏感信息，同时保留受试者、状态和条件判别信息。
AI.result: INCEPT在涵盖信号级评估、脑状态解码和脑健康评估的十个数据集的广谱基准测试中表现出色。它在30个线性探测指标中的26个和30个微调指标中的24个中排名第一，并超越了各种下游设置中强大的任务特定专家编码器。客观消融和表示分析进一步表明，面向不变性的预训练提高了迁移能力，并组织了超出单纯重建的受试者敏感神经表示。
AI.conclusion: 不变性学习是构建可重用脑电图基础模型的一个有前景的原则。
AI.translation: 脑电图（EEG）是了解人脑功能的一种广泛使用的窗口，但大多数脑电图模型仍受限于“一个数据集一个模型”的监督范式。最近的脑电图基础模型为可重用表示提供了一条途径，但大多数仍以重建为中心，假设从局部上下文可预测的脑电图内容必然是可转移的神经信息。本文提出了INCEPT，一个面向不变性的脑电图基础模型，在超过11,000小时的未标记临床脑电图数据上进行训练。INCEPT不仅仅优先考虑信号恢复，它还在相关的脑电图观测中学习表示层面的稳定性，将稳定的神经结构和必要的受试者敏感信息与头皮记录中占主导地位的干扰变异性分离，同时保留了受试者、状态和条件判别信息。我们在涵盖三种后采集脑电图分析水平（信号级评估、脑状态解码和脑健康评估）的十个数据集的广谱基准测试中评估了INCEPT。INCEPT在30个线性探测指标中的26个和30个微调指标中的24个中排名第一，并且在各种下游设置中也超越了强大的任务特定专家编码器。客观消融和表示分析进一步表明，面向不变性的预训练改善了迁移能力，并组织了超出单纯重建的受试者敏感神经表示。这些结果确立了不变性学习是构建可重用脑电图基础模型的一个有前景的原则。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为INCEPT的面向不变性的脑电图基础模型，旨在解决传统脑电图模型局限于单一数据集和以重建为中心的基础模型无法有效捕捉可转移神经信息的问题。INCEPT在超过11,000小时的未标记临床脑电图数据上进行训练，通过学习表示层面的稳定性，有效分离了稳定的神经结构和受试者敏感信息与干扰变异性。在涵盖信号级、脑状态和脑健康任务的广泛基准测试中，INCEPT在多数指标上优于现有脑电图基础模型和任务特定编码器，证明了不变性学习在构建可重用脑电图基础模型方面的巨大潜力。
AI.keywords: 脑电图基础模型, 不变性学习, 预训练, 广谱分析, 迁移学习
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了“不变性导向的预训练”这一新范式来构建脑电图基础模型，而非传统上侧重于信号重建。通过在海量未标记数据上学习表示层面的不变性，INCEPT能够更好地分离有用的神经信息和干扰，从而在多种下游任务中展现出卓越的泛化和迁移能力。这对于推动脑电图分析从“一个数据集一个模型”的旧范式向更通用、可重用的基础模型范式发展具有重要意义。

title: Comparison Invariants for Verifying Control Invariance
comments: To appear in the 26th Conference on Logic for Programming, Artificial Intelligence, and Reasoning
summary: Control invariance validates that dynamical systems have a control input that preserves a given property at all times. This paper introduces a set of sound axioms and proof rules in differential dynamic logic (dL) that enable verification of control invariance. First, the scalar and vector comparison principles, relating a system of differential equations to a comparison system such that invariance properties can be established more easily, are axiomatized in dL. This axiomatization primarily utilizes differential ghosts, which are proof-theoretic generalizations of comparison systems. Next, with the comparison principles serving as the basis, comparison invariants are introduced, and sound axioms and proof rules are derived. Comparison invariants reduce the question of control invariance to a functional inequality on its Lie derivative for a suitable class of functions, moreover, the right choice of function can result in decidable arithmetic. Furthermore, the perennially popular control barrier functions (CBFs) used in safety-critical control are shown to be a special instance of comparison invariants. This yields an axiomatization of CBFs that leads to a dedicated set of proof rules. The rules allow for the verification of CBFs, which are traditionally used for synthesizing safe controllers without verification. Lastly, comparison invariants are shown to unify several other safety verification techniques, including Darboux invariants and differential invariants, further cementing their versatility.
comment: To appear in the 26th Conference on Logic for Programming, Artificial Intelligence, and Reasoning

AI.title_translation: 验证控制不变性的比较不变量比较
AI.tldr: 本文在微分动态逻辑中提出了比较不变量，用于验证控制不变性，并统一了控制屏障函数等多种安全验证技术。
AI.motivation: 为了验证动态系统在控制输入下能够时刻保持特定属性（即控制不变性），并为常用于控制综合但缺乏验证的控制屏障函数（CBF）及其他安全验证技术提供统一的公理化证明规则。
AI.method: 在微分动态逻辑（dL）中对标量和向量比较原理进行公理化，引入比较不变量，并通过Lie导数的泛函不等式简化控制不变性验证。
AI.result: 通过比较不变量将控制不变性验证转化为Lie导数的泛函不等式，证明了控制屏障函数（CBF）是比较不变量的特例，并实现了对CBF、达布不变量和微分不变量的统一公理化。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功在微分动态逻辑中建立了一套用于验证控制不变性的可靠公理和证明规则，连接了传统控制理论中的CBF方法与形式化验证。
AI.translation: 控制不变性验证了动态系统在所有时间内都具有保持给定属性的控制输入。本文在微分动态逻辑（dL）中引入了一套健全的公理和证明规则，能够验证控制不变性。首先，在dL中公理化了标量和向量比较原理，将微分方程系统与比较系统联系起来，以便更容易地建立不变性属性。该公理化主要利用了作为比较系统的证明论泛化形式的微分幽灵。接着，以比较原理为基础，引入了比较不变量，并推导出了健全的公理和证明规则。比较不变量将控制不变性的问题简化为合适函数类在其Lie导数上的泛函不等式，此外，正确选择函数可以产生可判定的算术。进而，证明了在安全关键控制中广受欢迎的控制屏障函数（CBF）是比较不变量的一个特例。这产生了一个CBF的公理化，从而导出一套专门的证明规则。这些规则允许验证传统上用于合成安全控制器而缺乏验证的CBF。最后，证明了比较不变量统一了其他几种安全验证技术，包括达布不变量和微分不变量，进一步巩固了其多功能性。
AI.summary: 本文基于微分动态逻辑（dL），引入了一套用于验证控制不变性的健全公理和证明规则。通过公理化比较原理并引入比较不变量，简化了控制不变性的验证过程，同时证明了控制屏障函数（CBF）是比较不变量的特例，并统一了多种安全验证技术。
AI.keywords: 控制不变性, 微分动态逻辑, 比较不变量, 控制屏障函数, 形式化验证
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将比较原理引入微分动态逻辑（dL），统一了控制屏障函数（CBF）、达布不变量和微分不变量等多种安全验证技术，为控制不变性验证提供了坚实的公理化基础。

title: Fair Allocation with Optional Selling
summary: We consider fair allocation of indivisible goods in a setting in which agents have subjective valuation functions over the set of goods, and in addition, goods may be sold at given market prices. In this setting, a fair allocation involves {deciding which goods to sell, how to allocate the unsold goods, and how to divide the money received from the sold goods.} We adapt to this setting the definitions of share-based fairness notions, such as the maximin share (MMS) and the truncated proportional share (TPS), and comparison-based fairness notions such as EF1 and EFX (which we adapt to SEF1 and SEFX). We show the following results when the utility of each agent is additive both over goods and over money. With two agents, there are allocations that are simultaneously MMS and SEFX. With three agents, there are instances in which no allocation gives every agent more than $\frac{11}{12}$-MMS. With any number of agents, there are $\frac{2}{3}$-MMS allocations. There also are allocations that are simultaneously SEFX and $\frac{n}{2n-1}$-TPS. This latter ratio is best possible, even without the SEFX requirement.

AI.title_translation: 带可选出售的公平分配
AI.tldr: 本文研究了允许出售部分不可分物品换取资金并进行公平分配的新模型，拓展了经典的公平性定义，并证明了在不同智能体数量下的公平保证边界。
AI.motivation: 在现实资源分配中，部分物品可以通过出售换取资金再进行分配，现有的不可分物品公平分配文献较少结合市场价格和资金分配，因此需要研究引入“可选出售”机制如何影响和提升公平分配的结果。
AI.method: 通过理论分析，将经典的份额型（MMS, TPS）和比较型（EF1, EFX）公平性概念适配到带有可选出售机制的场景中，并在加性效用假设下研究了不同智能体数量时的存在性与近似保证。
AI.result: 研究表明：当有两名智能体时，存在同时满足MMS和SEFX的分配；三名智能体时，存在无法达到11/12-MMS的实例；任意数量智能体时，存在2/3-MMS分配，并且存在同时满足SEFX和n/(2n-1)-TPS的分配（该比例是最优的）。
AI.conclusion: 在允许可选出售的公平分配设定下，本文成功适配并研究了多种基于份额和基于比较的公平性概念，证明了在不同智能体数量下能够达到的MMS和TPS近似保证，为该扩展模型的理论边界提供了清晰的图景。
AI.translation: 我们研究了一设定下的不可分物品公平分配问题：在此设定中，智能体对物品集合具有主观效用函数，且物品可以按给定的市场价格出售。在此设定中，一个公平的分配涉及决定出售哪些物品、如何分配未售出的物品，以及如何分配从售出物品中获得的资金。我们将基于份额的公平概念（如最大极小份额MMS和截断比例份额TPS）以及基于比较的公平概念（如EF1和EFX，我们将其调整为SEF1和SEFX）适配到该设定中。当每个智能体的效用对物品和金钱都是可加的时，我们证明了以下结果：当有两个智能体时，存在同时满足MMS和SEFX的分配；当有三个智能体时，存在某些实例使得没有任何分配能给每个智能体带来超过11/12的MMS；对于任意数量的智能体，存在2/3-MMS的分配；同时还存在同时满足SEFX和n/(2n-1)-TPS的分配，且后一个比率是最优的，即使没有SEFX的要求也是如此。
AI.summary: 本文研究了结合可选出售机制的不可分物品公平分配问题，将MMS、TPS和SEFX等公平性概念拓展至该模型中。在加性效用下，文章分析了不同智能体数量时能达到的最优公平性保证，得出了关于MMS和TPS的理论上下界。
AI.keywords: 公平分配, 不可分物品, 可选出售, 最大极小份额 (MMS),  envy-freeness
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将商品的可选出售引入到不可分物品的公平分配问题中，拓展了诸如MMS、EF1/SEFX等经典的公平性概念，并为不同智能体数量的情况提供了明确的理论上下界，对机制设计和资源分配领域有重要贡献。

title: Pushdown Model Checking Above the Cubic Bottleneck
comments: Full version of the LICS 2025 paper "Pushdown Model Checking above the Cubic Bottleneck". Abstract shortened to fit arXiv requirements
summary:
Many problems in the verification of recursive programs can be reduced to pushdown model checking. In this problem, we are given as input a pushdown automaton (PDA) over a constant-sized stack alphabet, and a description of undesirable behaviors given by an intersection of NFAs, and the problem is to decide if there is a behavior of the PDA that belongs to the set of undesirable behaviors. It is well-known that there is an algorithm for this problem that runs in time $O(n^{2k} |Σ| + n^{3k})$, where $n$ is the maximum number of states of the PDA and the NFAs, $Σ$ is the common input alphabet, and $k-1$ is the number of NFAs. Despite the importance of this problem, no better algorithm is known for it.
  In this paper, we provide an explanation for this lack of progress using the lens of fine-grained complexity theory. We prove that if the $3k$-Clique hypothesis (resp. combinatorial $3k$-Clique hypothesis) is true, then for any $ε> 0$, there is no algorithm (resp. combinatorial algorithm) that solves this problem in time $O((n^{(ω-1)k} |Σ| + n^{ωk})^{1-ε})$ (resp. $O((n^{2k} |Σ| + n^{3k})^{1-ε})$) where $ω$ is the matrix multiplication exponent. Furthermore, using the combinatorial hypothesis, we also show that pushdown model checking over constant-sized input alphabets cannot be solved in time faster than $O(n^{3(k-1)-ε})$ for any $ε> 0$.
  Finally, we investigate the possibility of an $O(N^{3k-ε})$ time algorithm for this problem where $N$ is the total bit size of the input. We formulate a new hypothesis, the 2NPDA$(k)$ hypothesis, that helps explain the lack of $O(N^{3k-ε})$ time algorithms for this problem. To corroborate this hypothesis, we show a web of linear-time reductions between the 2NPDA$(k)$ hypothesis, pushdown model checking, and other problems in formal language and automata theory.
comment: Full version of the LICS 2025 paper "Pushdown Model Checking above the Cubic Bottleneck". Abstract shortened to fit arXiv requirements

AI.title_translation: 下推模型检查超越立方瓶颈
AI.tldr: 该论文利用细粒度复杂性理论来解释为什么在过去没有找到更优的算法来解决推入模型检查问题。研究表明，该问题的最优算法的运行时间受到 3k-Clique 假设的限制，并且无法在 O((n^(ω−1)k |Σ| + n^ωk)^(1−ε)) 或 O((n^(2k) |Σ| + n^(3k))^(1−ε)) 时间内解决，其中 ω 是矩阵乘法指数。此外，研究还提出了 2NPDA(k) 假设，以解释为什么该问题无法在 O(N^(3k−ε)) 时间内解决。
AI.motivation: 许多递归程序验证问题可归结为推入模型检查问题。尽管该问题很重要，但尚未找到比已知算法更好的算法，这促使研究人员利用细粒度复杂性理论来解释这种进展的缺乏。
AI.method: 该论文利用细粒度复杂性理论来分析推入模型检查问题的复杂性。它提出了 3k-Clique 假设和 2NPDA(k) 假设，并证明了这些假设与推入模型检查问题的运行时间界限之间的联系。此外，研究人员还展示了一系列线性时间归约，将 2NPDA(k) 假设、推入模型检查以及形式语言和自动机理论中的其他问题联系起来。
AI.result: 研究表明，如果 3k-Clique 假设（或组合 3k-Clique 假设）为真，则推入模型检查问题无法在 O((n^(ω−1)k |Σ| + n^ωk)^(1−ε))（或 O((n^(2k) |Σ| + n^(3k))^(1−ε))）时间内解决。此外，基于组合学假设，推入模型检查问题无法在 O(n^(3(k-1)−ε)) 时间内解决。研究还提出了 2NPDA(k) 假设，以解释为什么该问题无法在 O(N^(3k−ε)) 时间内解决，并展示了该假设与其他问题的线性时间归约。
AI.conclusion: 该论文利用细粒度复杂性理论，为推入模型检查问题缺乏更优算法提供了理论解释。研究结果表明，该问题的计算复杂性受到 3k-Clique 假设和新提出的 2NPDA(k) 假设的限制。
AI.translation:
许多递归程序验证问题可以归结为推入模型检查。在此问题中，我们得到一个具有恒定大小堆栈字母表的推入自动机（PDA）以及由 NFA 交集给出的不良行为描述，问题在于判断 PDA 是否存在属于不良行为集合的行为。众所周知，该问题存在一个算法，其运行时间为 O(n^(2k) |Σ| + n^(3k))，其中 n 是 PDA 和 NFA 的最大状态数，Σ 是公共输入字母表，k-1 是 NFA 的数量。尽管此问题很重要，但尚未找到更好的算法。
 在本文中，我们利用细粒度复杂性理论的视角来解释这种进展的缺乏。我们证明，如果 3k-Clique 假设（分别为组合 3k-Clique 假设）为真，则对于任何 ε > 0，不存在一个算法（分别为组合算法）能在 O((n^(ω-1)k |Σ| + n^ωk)^(1-ε))（分别为 O((n^(2k) |Σ| + n^(3k))^(1-ε))）时间内解决该问题，其中 ω 是矩阵乘法指数。此外，利用组合学假设，我们还表明，对于任何 ε > 0，推入模型检查（在恒定大小的输入字母表上）无法在 O(n^(3(k-1)−ε)) 时间内解决。
 最后，我们研究了该问题是否存在一个运行时间为 O(N^(3k−ε)) 的算法，其中 N 是输入的总比特大小。我们提出了一个新的假设，即 2NPDA(k) 假设，该假设有助于解释为什么该问题不存在 O(N^(3k−ε)) 时间算法。为了证实这一假设，我们展示了 2NPDA(k) 假设、推入模型检查以及形式语言和自动机理论中的其他问题之间的一系列线性时间归约。
AI.summary: 本研究利用细粒度复杂性理论，探究了推入模型检查问题（将递归程序验证归结为判定一个具有恒定栈字母表的 PDA 的行为是否属于 NFA 交集描述的不良行为集合）的计算复杂性。研究表明，该问题的求解时间受到 3k-Clique 假设的限制，无法实现 O((n^(ω−1)k |Σ| + n^ωk)^(1−ε)) 或 O((n^(2k) |Σ| + n^(3k))^(1−ε)) 的时间复杂度。此外，还提出了 2NPDA(k) 假设，以解释为何无法在 O(N^(3k−ε)) 时间内解决该问题，并通过线性时间归约将该假设与推入模型检查等问题联系起来。
AI.keywords: 推入模型检查, 细粒度复杂性, 3k-Clique 假设, 2NPDA(k) 假设, 算法时间界限
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地运用细粒度复杂性理论来解释推入模型检查领域长期存在的算法进展瓶颈。通过引入和分析 3k-Clique 假设和 2NPDA(k) 假设，论文不仅为现有算法的复杂度提供了理论依据，也为未来的研究指明了方向。研究结果具有重要的理论意义，并可能对实际的程序验证工具产生深远影响。然而，论文的结论依赖于尚未被证明的复杂性假设，这也是未来研究需要关注的方向。

title: Gripper-aware Vision Language Action Models
summary: Vision language action models (VLAs) have advanced general purpose robotic grasping and manipulation by enabling robots to interpret visual observations and natural language instructions to generate executable action sequences. However, existing VLAs often implicitly assume gripper invariance, despite grasping strategies being inherently embodiment-dependent. Different gripper types, such as parallel-jaw and suction, usually require distinct interaction strategies to achieve the same grasping objective. Moreover, current datasets for VLAs predominantly rely on parallel-jaw grippers, limiting gripper-aware learning. To address this gap, we introduce MiGA, a multi-gripper-aware dataset spanning five distinct gripper types across multiple robots with 103,000 demonstrations, explicitly capturing strategy divergence under shared task objectives. We further propose GVLA, which combines a new multi-gripper tokenizer with adapter-based policy routing. Our new gripper encoding induces structured embedding information that balances parameter sharing and strategy differentiation, while layer-wise probing confirms meaningful gripper-conditioned representations for VLAs. Intensive experiments in both simulation and real-world robots show that our GVLA outperforms the current baselines across evaluated settings. Our method also improves zero-shot generalization or few-shot adaptation to new objects or unseen tasks, and enable more efficient gripper adaptation.

AI.title_translation: 夹爪感知的视觉语言动作模型
AI.tldr: 本文提出了MiGA数据集和GVLA模型，首次显式解决机器人视觉语言动作模型中的夹爪多样性问题，显著提升了多夹爪机器人的操作性能与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉语言动作模型（VLA）隐式假设夹爪具身不变性，忽略了不同夹爪类型（如平行夹爪与吸盘）需要不同的交互策略，且当前数据集主要依赖平行夹爪，限制了夹爪感知学习。
AI.method: 提出了多夹爪感知数据集MiGA（包含5种夹爪类型、103,000个示范），以及结合了新型多夹爪分词器和基于适配器的策略路由的GVLA模型。
AI.result: 模拟和真实世界的密集实验表明，GVLA在各项评估设置中均优于当前基线，并提升了对新物体或未见任务的零样本泛化能力、少样本适应能力及夹爪适应效率。
AI.conclusion: GVLA通过显式引入夹爪感知能力，有效提升了多夹爪机器人操作系统的通用性、零样本泛化能力以及适应效率。
AI.translation: 视觉语言动作模型（VLA）通过使机器人能够解释视觉观察和自然语言指令来生成可执行的动作序列，从而推进了通用机器人抓取和操纵。然而，现有的VLA通常隐式假设夹爪是不变的，尽管抓取策略本质上是具身依赖的。不同的夹爪类型（如平行夹爪和吸盘）通常需要不同的交互策略来实现相同的抓取目标。此外，当前用于VLA的数据集主要依赖平行夹爪，限制了夹爪感知的学习。为了解决这一差距，我们推出了MiGA，这是一个跨多个机器人的五个不同夹爪类型、包含103,000个示范的多夹爪感知数据集，明确捕捉了共享任务目标下的策略分歧。我们进一步提出了GVLA，它将一个新的多夹爪分词器与基于适配器的策略路由相结合。我们新的夹爪编码引入了平衡参数共享和策略分异的结构化嵌入信息，而分层探测证实了VLA具有有意义的夹爪条件表示。在模拟和真实世界机器人中进行的密集实验表明，我们的GVLA在评估设置中优于当前基线。我们的方法还改进了对新物体或未见任务的零样本泛化或少样本适应，并实现了更高效的夹爪适应。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有视觉语言动作模型（VLA）忽视夹爪多样性的问题，推出了多夹爪感知数据集MiGA和GVLA模型。GVLA通过多夹爪分词器和适配器策略路由，有效平衡了参数共享与策略分歧，在仿真与真实世界的实验中均展现出优于现有基线的性能及出色的泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言动作模型, 多夹爪感知, 机器人抓取, 具身智能
AI.comments: 该论文指出了现有视觉语言动作模型（VLA）忽视夹爪差异的局限性，通过构建大规模多夹爪数据集MiGA并提出GVLA模型，有效解决了机器人操作中由于夹爪形态不同带来的策略分歧问题，具有很高的实用价值和创新性。

title: Conditional GraphGANFed: Optimizing Graph-Structured Molecule Generation in Federated Generative Adversarial Networks
summary: Generative adversarial networks (GANs) have garnered considerable attention in molecular discovery for their ability to generate novel and high-quality molecules. To efficiently train a GAN model while preserving data privacy, GraphGANFed has been proposed to incorporate federated learning and graph convolutional networks into GAN. Yet, GraphGANFed cannot produce synthetic molecules that only optimize a user-defined metric(s) to facilitate the new drug discovery process. To address this issue, we introduce a novel extension to GraphGANFed, namely conditional GraphGANFed (cGraphGANFed), by incorporating the critic network to assess generated molecules using user-defined metric(s). The evaluation results from both the critic network and discriminator are integrated into the loss function of the generator, guiding it to generate novel molecules that maintain similar chemical properties to real ones while optimizing user-defined metrics. Extensive simulations are conducted in two scenarios. First, cGraphGANFed endeavors to optimize all seven commonly used metrics, and the results show that cGraphGANFed significantly outperforms GraphGANFed in Validity and LogP, with a slight advantage in QED, across different settings. Second, cGraphGANFed focuses solely on optimizing QED, and the results show that the synthetic molecules produced by cGraphGANFed can achieve more than 10% improvement in QED than GraphGANFed. Also, the results demonstrate cGraphGANFed has enhanced resilience against mode collapses and performance reduction caused by non-IID data.

AI.title_translation: 条件GraphGANFed：优化联邦生成对抗网络中的图结构分子生成
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为cGraphGANFed的新型联邦图生成对抗网络，能够在保护隐私的同时，根据用户定义的指标优化合成出高质量的分子。
AI.motivation: 现有的 GraphGANFed 模型虽然结合了联邦学习和图卷积网络来保护数据隐私并生成分子，但它无法生成仅优化用户定义指标的合成分子，从而无法更好地辅助新药研发过程。
AI.method: 提出条件图联邦生成对抗网络（cGraphGANFed），通过引入一个评论网络（critic network）来评估用户定义指标下的生成分子，并将评论网络与判别器的评估结果整合到生成器的损失函数中，引导生成器生成优化了特定指标的新分子。
AI.result: 在优化七个常用指标的场景中，cGraphGANFed在有效性（Validity）和LogP上显著优于GraphGANFed；在仅优化QED的场景中，生成的分子比GraphGANFed实现了超过10%的QED提升。同时，该方法对模型崩塌和non-IID数据引起的性能下降表现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: cGraphGANFed成功克服了现有联邦分子生成方法无法优化特定指标的局限性，在保证隐私的前提下，显著提升了生成分子的质量和特定属性（如QED和LogP），同时增强了模型对非独立同分布（non-IID）数据的鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 生成对抗网络（GANs）因其能够生成新颖且高质量的分子而在分子发现领域引起了广泛关注。为了在保护数据隐私的同时高效训练GAN模型，GraphGANFed被提出，它将联邦学习和图 convolutional 网络融入到了GAN中。然而，GraphGANFed无法生成仅优化用户定义指标以促进新药发现过程的合成分子。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了GraphGANFed的一个新扩展，即条件 GraphGANFed（cGraphGANFed），通过引入评论网络使用用户定义的指标来评估生成的分子。评论网络和判别器的评估结果被整合到生成器的损失函数中，指导其生成既保持与真实分子相似的化学性质、又优化用户定义指标的新颖分子。在两种场景下进行了广泛的仿真。首先，cGraphGANFed致力于优化所有七个常用的指标，结果表明cGraphGANFed在不同设置下的有效性和LogP方面明显优于GraphGANFed，并在QED上具有微弱优势。其次，cGraphGANFed专注于优化QED，结果表明其产生的合成分子在QED上比GraphGANFed实现了超过10%的提升。此外，结果还表明cGraphGANFed增强了对模型崩溃以及由非IID数据引起的性能下降的抵抗力。
AI.summary: 论文提出了cGraphGANFed，这是一种基于联邦生成对抗网络的图结构分子生成扩展模型。通过整合评论网络对用户定义的指标进行评估，该模型能够在保护数据隐私的同时，生成满足特定化学性质并优化指定指标的新分子，实验证明其在有效性和特定属性优化方面具有显著优势。
AI.keywords: 联邦学习, 生成对抗网络, 图神经网络, 分子生成, 条件优化
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种条件图联邦生成对抗网络（cGraphGANFed），通过引入评估网络和融合用户定义的指标，解决了现有联邦分子生成模型无法按需优化特定化学指标的问题。在保护数据隐私的同时，提升了生成分子的有效性和目标属性，具有较强的创新性和实际应用价值。

title: HARQ-CC-Aided Slow Fluid Antenna Multiple Access with Highly Correlated Ports: An LST-Based Performance Analysis
summary: Hybrid automatic repeat request with chase combining (HARQ-CC) improves the reliability of slow fluid antenna multiple access (sFAMA) through multi-round combining. However, existing analysis has not fully utilized the structure of densely spaced and highly correlated fluid antenna system (FAS) ports to derive tractable per-round characterizations, thereby maintaining a computationally intensive process. This paper re-investigates downlink HARQ-CC-aided sFAMA with densely-spaced and highly-correlated FAS configuration. Under a spatial block correlation model, we first formulate two validity-corrected high-correlation approximations for the per-round selected-port signal-to-interference ratio (SIR) distribution and its Laplace--Stieltjes transform (LST): a Marcum-Q-kernel route and a lower-complexity step-threshold route. Closed-form expressions are also obtained for block-representative antenna selection (BR-AS) and fixed-position antenna (FPA). Then, the per-round characteristics are used to evaluate the multi-round accumulated-SIR distribution through SIR-domain Stieltjes convolution and numerical LST inversion, yielding the outage probability, average number of transmissions, and payload throughput. Numerical results show close agreement between the two evaluation methods. The analytical FAS results are conservative relative to simulation but preserve the performance trends and receiver ordering. The FAS receiver consistently outperforms the benchmarks, while the payload-throughput gain from increasing the HARQ transmission limit becomes marginal under severe multiuser interference.

AI.title_translation: 高相关端口下HARQ-CC辅助的慢速流体天线多址接入：基于LST的性能分析
AI.tldr: 本文研究了高相关端口下结合HARQ-CC的流体天线多址接入系统，利用LST和高相关近似方法分析并评估了系统的中断概率和吞吐量性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的慢速流体天线多址接入（sFAMA）性能分析未能充分利用密集间隔和高相关流体天线系统（FAS）端口的结构来推导易于处理的每轮特征，从而导致计算过程繁琐，因此需要重新研究并简化其性能分析。
AI.method: 在空间块相关模型下，制定了两种针对每轮选定端口SIR分布及其拉普拉斯-斯蒂尔杰斯变换（LST）的有效性修正的高相关近似方法（Marcum-Q核路径和低复杂度阶跃阈值路径），并结合SIR域Stieltjes卷积与数值LST求逆评估多轮累积SIR分布。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，所提出的两种评估方法高度一致。分析得出的FAS结果虽然相对于仿真结果较为保守，但能够准确保持性能趋势和接收机排序，且FAS接收机表现优于基准系统。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入空间块相关模型和高相关近似方法，本文成功实现了对HARQ-CC辅助的sFAMA系统性能的易于处理的分析，证明了流体天线接收机在性能上的优越性。
AI.translation: 带有追赶合并的混合自动重传 request (HARQ-CC) 通过多轮合并提高了慢速流体天线多址接入 (sFAMA) 的可靠性。然而，现有的分析尚未充分利用密集间隔且高度相关的流体天线系统 (FAS) 端口的结构来推导易于处理的每轮特征，从而保持了计算密集的进程。本文重新研究了具有密集间隔和高度相关 FAS 配置的下行 HARQ-CC 辅助 sFAMA。在空间块相关模型下，我们首先制定了两种针对每轮选定端口信干比 (SIR) 分布及其拉普拉斯-斯蒂尔杰斯变换 (LST) 的有效性修正的高相关近似方法：Marcum-Q 核路径和低复杂度阶跃阈值路径。还获得了块代表性天线选择 (BR-AS) 和固定位置天线 (FPA) 的闭式表达式。然后，利用每轮特征通过 SIR 域 Stieltjes 卷积和数值 LST 求逆评估多轮累积 SIR 分布，从而得出中断概率、平均传输次数和有效载荷吞吐量。数值结果表明这两种评估方法高度一致。分析得到的 FAS 结果相对于仿真结果较为保守，但保留了性能趋势和接收机排序。FAS 接收机始终优于基准，而在严重多用户干扰下，增加 HARQ 传输限制带来的有效载荷吞吐量增益变得微乎其微。
AI.summary: 本文研究了结合HARQ-CC的慢速流体天线多址接入（sFAMA）系统，针对密集间隔且高度相关的流体天线端口，提出了两种高相关近似方法及LST分析框架，用以评估系统的中断概率、平均传输次数和有效载荷吞吐量。
AI.keywords: 流体天线系统, 混合自动重传请求, 斯蒂尔杰斯变换, 物理层性能分析, 多址接入
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将HARQ-CC与慢速流体天线多址接入（sFAMA）相结合，特别针对高相关性的紧密间隔天线端口，利用LST方法进行了易于处理的性能分析，对未来无线通信系统设计具有参考价值。

title: Quantization Effects on Bangla Language Understanding in Large Language Models: A Systematic Evaluation
summary: Post-training quantization lowers the memory footprint of Large Language Models (LLMs) and speeds up inference, which is why it is now common for on-device deployment. Most of what we know about its effects, however, comes from English benchmarks. It is not clear whether the same holds for morphologically complex, low-resource languages such as Bangla, and this gap is what we address here. We evaluate three model families---Qwen-2.5-7B, LLaMA-3.1-8B, and GPT-OSS-20B---in full precision and in three quantized formats (GPTQ-Int8, GPTQ-Q8, GGUF-W8A16) across five Bangla natural language understanding benchmarks (Bangla MMLU, CommonsenseQA-BN, OpenBookQA-BN, PIQA-BN, and BoolQ-BN), using zero-shot evaluation through lm-evaluation-harness. To our knowledge this is the first controlled comparison of quantization formats on Bangla NLU. The three families do not respond the same way: GPT-OSS loses up to 57.35% accuracy on reasoning-heavy tasks under GGUF-W8A16, while Qwen and LLaMA hold steady under GPTQ, and in a few cases the quantized version edges out the full-precision one. BoolQ-BN, a comprehension task, stays stable across all three families regardless of format. Taken together, these results suggest quantization can work well for Bangla deployment, but the choice of architecture and quantization method matters more than the bit width alone. We discuss what this means for practitioners choosing a model to run on constrained hardware.

AI.title_translation: 大语言模型中量化对孟加拉语理解的影响：一项系统评估
AI.tldr: 本研究首次系统评估了量化对孟加拉语大语言模型理解能力的影响，发现模型架构和量化方法的选择比单纯的比特宽度更重要。
AI.motivation: 目前关于后训练量化对大语言模型影响的研究多基于英语基准，缺乏对形态复杂、低资源语言（如孟加拉语）量化效果的系统评估，因此作者旨在填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 评估了Qwen-2.5-7B、LLaMA-3.1-8B和GPT-OSS-20B三个模型家族在全精度及三种量化格式（GPTQ-Int8、GPTQ-Q8、GGUF-W8A16）下，在五个孟加拉语自然语言理解基准上的零样本表现。
AI.result: 不同模型家族对量化的反应差异显著：GPT-OSS在GGUF-W8A16下推理任务准确率下降高达57.35%，而Qwen和LLaMA在GPTQ下保持稳定（个别量化版本甚至优于全精度），且阅读理解任务（BoolQ-BN）在所有配置下均保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 量化技术适用于孟加拉语等低资源语言的模型部署，但不能仅依赖比特宽度，架构和量化方法的选择至关重要。
AI.translation: 后训练量化降低了大语言模型（LLMs）的内存占用并加速了推理，因此它现在是端侧部署的常见做法。然而，我们对其影响的大多数认知来自于英语基准测试。对于形态复杂、低资源语言（如孟加拉语）是否同样适用尚不清楚，而本文正是为了填补这一空白。我们评估了三个模型家族——Qwen-2.5-7B、LLaMA-3.1-8B和GPT-OSS-20B——在全精度以及三种量化格式（GPTQ-Int8、GPTQ-Q8、GGUF-W8A16）下，跨越五个孟加拉语自然语言理解基准（Bangla MMLU、CommonsenseQA-BN、OpenBookQA-BN、PIQA-BN和BoolQ-BN）的表现，使用lm-evaluation-harness进行零样本评估。据我们所知，这是对孟加拉语NLU量化格式的首次对照比较。这三个模型家族的反应并不相同：GPT-OSS在GGUF-W8A16下推理密集型任务的准确率下降高达57.35%，而Qwen和LLaMA在GPTQ下保持稳定，且在少数情况下量化版本略优于全精度版本。理解任务BoolQ-BN在所有三种模型家族的所有格式下都保持稳定。综上所述，这些结果表明量化可以很好地用于孟加拉语的部署，但架构和量化方法比单纯的比特宽度更重要。我们讨论了这对在受限硬件上运行模型的从业者意味着什么。
AI.summary: 该论文首次系统评估了后训练量化对孟加拉语大语言模型自然语言理解能力的影响，发现不同模型架构和量化方法对性能的影响存在显著差异，强调了在资源受限设备上部署时选择合适架构与量化方法的重要性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 后训练量化, 孟加拉语自然语言理解, 模型部署, 低资源语言
AI.comments: 该论文首次系统评估了后训练量化对低资源形态复杂语言（如孟加拉语）自然语言理解的影响，填补了该领域空白，对边缘计算和多语言大模型部署具有重要指导意义。

title: VIP: Variation-based Iterative-learning Planning for Robotic Navigation
summary: Over the past decade, autonomous robotic systems have been increasingly deployed in applications such as surveying, search and rescue, and last-mile delivery. These applications require robots to generate safe and efficient motion plans in large, complex, and obstacle-dense environments, often under limited onboard computing resources. However, conventional planning methods commonly rely on finite-dimensional trajectory parameterization or increasingly long prediction horizons, leading to rapidly growing computational costs, particularly in multi-robot scenarios. This paper presents a novel variation-based iterative-learning planning (VIP) framework for efficient motion planning of both single robots and robotic swarms. Instead of optimizing a large number of discrete trajectory variables, VIP directly updates the planning command as a continuous function in an infinite-dimensional function space. The same variation-based update can be implemented in a model-in-the-loop manner for offline planning or in a robot-in-the-loop manner between online physical executions. By avoiding the computational burden associated with horizon expansion and high-dimensional trajectory discretization, VIP maintains a per-iteration computational complexity of $\mathcal{O}(n)$, where $n$ denotes the number of spatial discretization points. Extensive simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework can efficiently generate and iteratively improve motion plans for different planning objectives, robotic platforms, and swarm configurations, highlighting its effectiveness, computational efficiency, and scalability as a general planning methodology.

AI.title_translation: VIP：基于变分的机器人导航迭代学习规划
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为VIP的新型机器人运动规划框架，通过在无限维函数空间中直接更新规划指令，实现了高效、低计算复杂度的单/多机器人导航。
AI.motivation: 传统的机器人运动规划方法依赖于有限维轨迹参数化或越来越长的预测视界，导致计算成本急剧增长，特别是在多机器人场景中，在资源有限的机载计算环境下难以应对大规模、复杂且充满障碍的环境。
AI.method: 提出基于变分的迭代学习规划（VIP）框架，不优化大量离散轨迹变量，而是在无限维函数空间中直接将规划指令更新为连续函数，支持离线的模型闭环（model-in-the-loop）或在线物理执行之间的机器人闭环（robot-in-the-loop）实现方式。
AI.result: 保持了每迭代 $\mathcal{O}(n)$ 的计算复杂度（$n$为空间离散化点数），广泛的仿真和真实世界实验证明了该框架能够为不同的规划目标、机器人平台和群配置高效生成并迭代改进运动 plans。
AI.conclusion: VIP框架通过在无限维函数空间中直接更新规划指令，实现了高效的单机器人及多机器人运动规划，仿真和真实实验均证明了其有效性和可扩展性。
AI.translation: 在过去的十年中，自主机器人系统越来越多地部署在测量、搜救和最后一英里配送等应用中。这些应用要求机器人在大型、复杂且充满障碍的环境中生成安全高效的运动规划，通常计算资源有限。然而，常规的规划方法通常依赖于有限维轨迹参数化或日益增长的预测视界，导致计算成本迅速增加，特别是在多机器人场景中。本文提出了一种新颖的基于变分的迭代学习规划（VIP）框架，用于单机器人和机器人群的高效运动规划。VIP不优化大量的离散轨迹变量，而是直接在无限维函数空间中将规划指令更新为连续函数。相同的基于变分的更新可以以离线规划的模型闭环方式或在线物理执行之间的机器人闭环方式实施。通过避免与视界扩展和高维轨迹离散化相关的计算负担，VIP保持了 $\mathcal{O}(n)$ 的每迭代计算复杂度，其中 $n$ 表示空间离散化点的数量。大量的模拟和真实世界实验表明，所提出的框架可以为不同的规划目标、机器人平台和群配置高效生成和迭代改进运动规划，突出了其作为通用规划方法的有效性、计算效率和可扩展性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了VIP（基于变分的迭代学习规划）框架，用于解决机器人（含单机与集群）在复杂环境中的高效运动规划问题。与传统方法不同，VIP通过在无限维函数空间中直接以连续函数形式更新规划指令，避免了视界扩展和高维轨迹离散化带来的计算负担，实现了$\mathcal{O}(n)$的计算复杂度，并通过实验验证了其高效性与可扩展性。
AI.keywords: 机器人导航, 运动规划, 变分迭代学习, 机器人群, 无限维函数空间
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种基于变分的迭代学习规划（VIP）框架，将轨迹规划建模为无限维函数空间中的连续函数更新，有效克服了传统方法在处理复杂环境和多机器人场景时计算成本急剧增加的痛点，具有极高的计算效率和可扩展性。

title: Beyond Semantic Accuracy: Consequence-Aware Evaluation for Safety-Critical Language Understanding
summary: Can language models be trusted in safety- critical operations? In such settings, strong per- formance on semantic metrics does not guaran- tee operational reliability: a misread altitude, a dropped execution condition, or a confused call- sign may score well under standard F1 yet carry sharply asymmetric operational consequences. We study this problem in air traffic control (ATC), where controller-pilot communication demands near-zero error tolerance, and use consequence-aware evaluation to test whether semantic scores misstate operational reliabil- ity. The framework is instantiated in a con- trolled diagnostic ATC benchmark grounded in aviation standards and feedback from 40 air traffic controllers across three countries. Evaluating 8 models, we uncover a system- atic semantic-safety gap: conventional scores give substantially higher performance estimates than consequence-aware evaluation, even for models that appear reliable under standard met- rics. Risk-aware fine-tuning narrows but does not close this gap, showing that consequence- aware evaluation is a necessary complement to standard NLP metrics before any real safety- critical deployment claim

AI.title_translation: 超越语义准确性：安全关键语言理解的后果感知评估
AI.tldr: 传统语义指标高估了大模型在安全关键任务（如航空管制）中的可靠性，本文提出了后果感知评估框架以弥补这一缺陷。
AI.motivation: 在安全关键型操作中，传统的语义指标（如F1分数）无法保证操作可靠性，微小的语义错误可能带来严重的不对称后果，因此需要研究后果感知的评估方法。
AI.method: 建立了一个基于航空标准和全球40位空中交通管制员反馈的受控诊断ATC基准测试，并评估了8个模型。
AI.result: 发现了系统的“语义-安全”鸿沟，传统指标给出的性能估计远高于后果感知评估；风险感知微调能够缩小但无法消除这一差距。
AI.conclusion: 传统语义指标高估了大模型在安全关键领域的可靠性，引入后果感知的评估是模型部署前的必要补充。
AI.translation: 语言模型能在安全关键型操作中被信任吗？在此类设置中，强劲的语义指标表现并不能保证运行可靠性：一个被误读的高度、一个丢失的执行条件或一个混淆的呼号在标准F1下得分可能很高，却会带来严重的不对称运行后果。我们在空中交通管制（ATC）领域研究了这一问题，这里的管制员与飞行员通信要求近乎零误差容忍度，并使用后果感知评估来检验语义分数是否错误估计了运行可靠性。该框架在基于航空标准和来自三个国家40名空中交通管制员反馈的受控诊断ATC基准中得以实例化。通过对8个模型的评估，我们揭示了一个系统性的“语义-安全”鸿沟：常规分数给出的性能估计明显高于后果感知评估，即使对于在标准指标下看起来可靠的模型也是如此。风险感知微调缩小了但并未完全弥合这一差距，这表明在提出任何真正的安全关键部署主张之前，后果感知评估是标准NLP指标的必要补充。
AI.summary: 本文针对语言模型在安全关键领域（如空中交通管制）的应用，指出传统语义评估指标无法反映真实的运行可靠性。为此，作者提出了一个后果感知的评估框架，并通过受控的ATC基准测试揭示了传统指标与实际安全性之间的鸿沟，证明了后果感知评估作为安全部署前提的必要性。
AI.keywords: 安全关键, 语言模型, 空中交通管制, 后果感知评估, 语义-安全鸿沟
AI.comments: 该论文指出了传统语义指标在安全关键领域（如空中交通管制）的局限性，并创新性地提出了结合后果感知的评估框架，对大语言模型在安全关键领域的落地评估具有重要指导意义。

title: Scalable datacenter replication with mostly-synchronous consensus on hardware
summary: Consistent replication of data among distributed processes -- a task involving the well-known consensus problem -- is notoriously expensive and hard to scale, affecting especially datacenter services with stringent performance requirements. To mitigate this problem, we introduce scalable replication in-hardware ( scarHW ): a network card design that improves throughput and latency of consistent replication even when increasing the number of replicas, whereas current systems operate at a small scale or with relaxed consistency guarantees. At the heart of scarHW is our novel POPUC consensus algorithm, implemented in an FPGA smartNIC to take full advantage of the "mostly synchronous" behavior of programmable network devices in the datacenter. Unlike widely-adopted "mostly asynchronous" coordination protocols such as Paxos or leaderless alternatives, POPUC implements a generalized variant of consensus dubbed collaborative consensus which allows for several simultaneous decisions, achieving great scalability without compromising availability. POPUC preserves safety guarantees in the presence of process crash-stop and message send/receive omission failures (capturing incidental asynchrony) and has been formally specified and verified in TLA+. Our FPGA prototype improves throughput and latency of widely-used services Redis and Zookeeper by up to two orders of magnitude compared to the state of the art. scarHW-based services also achieve zero downtime upon failure of a minority of replicas, offering a highly-robust, wire-speed, scalable replication system.

AI.title_translation: 基于硬件准同步共识的可扩展数据中心复制
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于智能网卡和新型协同共识算法的硬件加速数据中心复制方案，显著提升了分布式系统的一致性复制性能与扩展性。
AI.motivation: 分布式进程间的一致性数据复制（涉及共识问题）代价高昂且难以扩展，尤其影响对性能要求严格的数据中心服务，现有系统往往在规模或一致性保证上做出妥协。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 scarHW 的网卡设计，并在 FPGA smartNIC 上实现了一种名为 POPUC 的新型“协同共识（collaborative consensus）”算法，利用数据中心网络设备的“准同步”行为来实现高效的一致性复制。
AI.result: 基于 FPGA 的原型系统将 Redis 和 Zookeeper 等常用服务的吞吐量和延迟提升了多达两个数量级，且在少数副本发生故障时能实现零停机。
AI.conclusion: scarHW 通过硬件加速与 POPUC 算法的结合，成功实现了高性能、高扩展性且保证严格一致性的数据中心分布式复制，为现代分布式系统提供了强大的硬件-软件协同设计范例。
AI.translation: 在分布式进程之间进行一致的数据复制（涉及众所周知的共识问题）通常代价高昂且难以扩展，这尤其影响了具有严格性能要求的数据中心服务。为了缓解这一问题，我们推出了硬件可扩展复制（scarHW）：一种网卡设计，它不仅能在增加副本数量时提高一致性复制的吞吐量和延迟，而当前系统往往只能在小规模或放宽一致性保证的条件下运行。scarHW 的核心是我们新颖的 POPUC 共识算法，它在 FPGA 智能网卡中实现，以充分利用数据中心可编程网络设备“准同步”的行为。与广泛采用的“准异步”协调协议（如 Paxos 或无领导者替代方案）不同，POPUC 实现了一种广义的共识变体，称为协同共识，允许多个同时决策，在不损害可用性的情况下实现极大的可扩展性。POPUC 在存在进程崩溃停止和消息发送/接收遗漏故障（捕获偶然异步性）的情况下保持了安全性保证，并在 TLA+ 中进行了形式化规范和验证。我们的 FPGA prototype（原型）将广泛使用的服务 Redis 和 Zookeeper 的吞吐量和延迟比现有技术提高了多达两个数量级。基于 scarHW 的服务在少数副本发生故障时也能实现零停机，提供了一个高度健壮、线速且可扩展的复制系统。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了 scarHW，一种通过 FPGA 智能网卡实现的可扩展数据中心复制硬件设计。它核心采用了名为 POPUC 的新型协同共识算法，利用数据中心网络的准同步特性，在不牺牲可用性和安全性（形式化验证于 TLA+）的前提下，大幅提升了分布式复制的吞吐量和延迟。
AI.keywords: 数据中心复制, 共识算法, 硬件加速, 智能网卡, 可扩展性
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地结合了硬件卸载（FPGA smartNIC）与新型协同共识算法（POPUC），有效解决了分布式数据中心复制中扩展性与严格一致性难以兼得的痛点，性能提升达两个数量级，具有极高的工程应用价值和学术意义。

title: Towards Reliable AI-Based Histological Staining: A Systematic Study of Scaling and Uncertainty in Unpaired Generative Models
comments: 37th British Machine Vision Conference, November 2026, Lancaster, UK
summary: Liver fibrosis, the principal predictor of long-term outcome in chronic liver disease, is staged from histological estimates of collagen content. Sirius Red (SR) provides the standard quantitative readout (collagen proportionate area, CPA) but is not acquired at every clinical centre and consumes tissue, time, and reagent cost beyond the routine Hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) stain. AI-based virtual staining can generate SR directly from H&E, yet systematic benchmarks of unsupervised models are scarce and their predictive uncertainty has not been quantified, even though visually plausible outputs may not faithfully reproduce the underlying tissue structure. We therefore benchmark six unsupervised image-to-image architectures (GAN-based and diffusion-based) across 54 scaling configurations on a newly released paired H&E to SR mouse liver dataset, the first open resource for this translation task. Each configuration is evaluated jointly on perceptual, distributional, and task-specific axes plus a blinded expert reader study; the best per family is then retrained as a deep ensemble, the first systematic comparison of epistemic uncertainty across unsupervised stain-to-stain architectures. Across families, perceptual quality, task-specific error, and ensemble agreement measure largely independent axes of model fitness: GAN-based methods cluster tightly on perceptual metrics yet differ substantially on task error and ensemble agreement, while the diffusion-based method (CycleDiffusion) is qualitatively different on all three. No single metric captures these differences, so reliable virtual staining requires reporting and selecting on all three jointly. The dataset, tiling pipeline, models, and evaluation code are released publicly.
comment: 37th British Machine Vision Conference, November 2026, Lancaster, UK

AI.title_translation: 迈向可靠的AI组织学染色：无监督生成模型中缩放与不确定性的系统研究
AI.tldr: 论文首次对组织学虚拟染色的无监督生成模型进行了系统性基准测试和不确定性量化，发现感知质量、任务误差和集成一致性是独立的评估维度，必须联合使用以确保AI染色的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 肝纤维化分期依赖天狼星红（SR）染色计算胶原蛋白比例面积，但常规H&E染色更普遍且成本更低。虽然AI虚拟染色可将H&E转换为SR，但目前缺乏对无监督模型的系统性基准测试和预测不确定性的量化，视觉上逼真的输出可能无法真实反映潜在的组织结构。
AI.method: 在包含配对H&E和SR小鼠肝脏数据集上，对6种无监督图像到图像架构（基于GAN和扩散）的54种缩放配置进行了基准测试，并使用深度集成方法评估了认知不确定性，从感知、分布和任务特定维度进行了专家盲审与评估。
AI.result: 感知质量、任务特定误差和集成不确定性是模型适应度的独立维度。GAN方法在感知指标上聚集紧密但在任务误差和集成一致性上有本质差异，而扩散方法（CycleDiffusion）在三个维度上都表现出不同。没有单一指标能捕捉这些差异。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的AI虚拟染色不能仅依赖单一指标，必须联合评估感知质量、任务误差和集成不确定性。GAN模型和扩散模型在这些维度上表现出显著差异。
AI.translation: 肝纤维化是慢性肝病长期预后的主要预测指标，通常根据胶原蛋白含量的组织学估计进行分期。天狼星红（SR）提供了标准的定量读数（胶原蛋白比例面积，CPA），但并非每个临床中心都会采集，并且除了常规的苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色外，还消耗了组织、时间和试剂成本。基于AI的虚拟染色可以直接从H&E生成SR，然而无监督模型的系统性基准测试却很匮乏，且其预测不确定性尚未得到量化，尽管视觉上似是而非的输出可能无法忠实地再现潜在的组织结构。因此，我们在一个新发布的配对H&E到SR小鼠肝脏数据集（这是该转换任务的第一个公开资源）上，对54种缩放配置下的6种无监督图像到图像架构（基于GAN和基于扩散）进行了基准测试。每个配置都在感知、分布和任务特定轴上以及盲法专家阅读器研究中进行联合评估；然后将每个系列中最好的模型重新训练为深度集成，这是对无监督染色到染色架构之间认知不确定性的首次系统比较。在各个系列中，感知质量、任务特定误差和集成协议在很大程度上衡量了模型适应度的独立轴：基于GAN的方法在感知指标上紧密聚集，但在任务误差和集成协议上存在显着差异，而基于扩散的方法（CycleDiffusion）在所有三个方面都具有质的不同。没有单一指标能够捕获这些差异，因此可靠的虚拟染色需要联合报告和选择这三个指标。数据集、切片管道、模型和评估代码已公开。
AI.summary: 该论文对无监督生成模型在H&E到Sirius Red组织学虚拟染色中的应用进行了全面基准测试，评估了6种架构在54种缩放配置下的表现，量化了不确定性，并证明了感知质量、任务误差和不确定性是模型性能的三个独立评估维度。
AI.keywords: 虚拟染色, 肝纤维化, 生成对抗网络, 扩散模型, 不确定性量化
AI.comments: 该论文首次针对未配对生成模型在组织学虚拟染色（H&E转Sirius Red）中的性能缩放和不确定性进行了系统性基准测试，并发布了首个公开的配对小鼠肝脏数据集。其创新之处在于联合评估了感知质量、任务特定误差以及集成不确定性，发现这三个维度相互独立，强调了综合评估对于实现可靠AI虚拟染色的重要性。

title: Bandit Submodular Maximization under Matroid Constraints: Learning Compressed Exchange Policy
summary:
We study adversarial bandit maximization of monotone submodular functions under a matroid constraint. For a rank-$k$ matroid on $n$ elements, we give a randomized oracle-polynomial algorithm that makes one feasible value query per round and has expected $(1-1/e)$-regret $\widetilde O(n^{1/3}k^{2/3}T^{2/3})$. This is the first sublinear-regret algorithm for adversarial bandit submodular maximization under general matroid constraints.
  Technically, we view the problem as learning an exchange policy for the Poisson base walk. This connects the problem to contextual bandits and gives an information-theoretic sublinear-regret guarantee, but directly learning the exponentially many policies requires exponential time and space. We therefore introduce \emph{balanced fractional exchanges}, which compress the policy mixture into a single fractional base while retaining the exchange information needed by the Poisson analysis. This leads to an polynomial time algorithm with the same regret guarantee.

AI.title_translation: 拟阵约束下的强盗子模最大化：学习压缩交换策略
AI.tldr: 本文首次提出了拟阵约束下对抗性子模最大化的亚线性遗憾算法，通过引入压缩交换策略实现了多项式时间的高效求解。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决对抗性bandit环境下，单调子模函数在拟阵约束最大化问题中缺乏亚线性遗憾算法的空白，并克服直接学习指数级多策略所需的大量时间和空间消耗。
AI.method: 提出了一种随机化的谕言机多项式时间算法，将问题建模为泊松基游走的交换策略学习，并创新性地引入“平衡分数交换”（balanced fractional exchanges）来压缩策略混合。
AI.result: 该算法在每一轮进行一次可行的值查询，实现了期望的 $(1-1/e)$-遗憾界为 $\widetilde O(n^{1/3}k^{2/3}T^{2/3})$，这是该问题下的首个亚线性遗憾算法。
AI.conclusion: 研究成功解决了对抗性环境下拟阵约束子模最大化的bandit学习问题，设计了首个多项式时间亚线性遗憾算法，并在理论上证明了其有效性。
AI.translation: 我们研究了拟阵约束下单调子模函数的对抗性多臂老鼠（bandit）最大化问题。对于包含 $n$ 个元素、秩为 $k$ 的拟阵，我们提出了一种随机化的谕言机多项式时间算法，该算法在每一轮进行一次可行的值查询，并具有期望的 $(1-1/e)$-遗憾界 $\widetilde O(n^{1/3}k^{2/3}T^{2/3})$。这是首个在一般拟阵约束下的对抗性子模最大化问题中实现亚线性遗憾的算法。在技术上，我们将该问题视为学习泊松基游走（Poisson base walk）的交换策略。这把该问题与上下文强盗（contextual bandits）联系起来，并提供了信息论意义上的亚线性遗憾保证，但直接学习呈指数级增长的多种策略需要巨额的时间和空间。因此，我们引入了“平衡分数交换”（balanced fractional exchanges），它将策略混合压缩为一个单一的分数基（fractional base），同时保留了泊松分析所需的交换信息。这最终导出了一个具有相同遗憾保证的多项式时间算法。
AI.summary: 本文研究了拟阵约束下对抗性多臂老鼠子模函数最大化问题，提出了一种首创的亚线性遗憾算法。通过将泊松基游走的交换策略学习与平衡分数交换技术相结合，在保证多项式时间复杂度的同时，实现了最优的遗憾上界。
AI.keywords: Submodular Maximization, Bandit Optimization, Matroid Constraints, Regret Minimization, Compressed Exchange Policy
AI.comments: 该论文在对抗性多臂老鼠（bandit）子模函数最大化领域取得了重要突破，首次在一般拟阵约束下给出了亚线性的遗憾上界算法。通过引入平衡分数交换（balanced fractional exchanges）技术，成功解决了策略空间随基数呈指数级增长的难题，将计算复杂度降低至多项式时间，兼具理论创新性与高效性。

title: Dual-Based Weight Selection for Approximate Linear Programming
summary: Approximate Linear Programming (ALP) is widely used for large-scale Markov Decision Processes (MDPs), but its performance can be sensitive to the choice of state-relevance weights, which are typically selected heuristically. Performance bounds suggest aligning these weights with the discounted occupancy measure of the induced policy, and existing primal approaches address this through repeated greedy-policy construction. Nonetheless, they lack convergence guarantees and are computationally expensive. We propose a dual-based method that uses projected occupancy information from the ALP dual solution to construct a smooth stochastic policy and update the state-relevance weights, which avoids separate greedy-action calculations. We establish conditions under which the weights match the discounted occupancy of the induced policy and prove uniqueness and global convergence under appropriate smoothing. We also derive an a posteriori policy-loss bound that separates error from the weighted Bellman residual, occupancy mismatch, and stochastic-versus-greedy disagreement. Experiments on classical queueing and multi-priority scheduling problems show that the proposed approach reduces sensitivity to fixed weights and achieves comparable or better policy quality than primal updates at lower computational cost. Finally, we show that adaptive weighting is most valuable when the basis functions are sufficiently expressive for occupancy information to influence the resulting policy.

AI.title_translation: 基于对偶权重的近似线性规划权重选择方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于近似线性规划的基于对偶的权重选择方法，通过对偶解更新状态相关权重，克服了传统原始方法计算昂贵且无收敛保证的缺点，实现了高效且具理论保证的大规模MDP求解。
AI.motivation: 近似线性规划（ALP）的性能高度依赖于状态相关权重的选择，而现有基于原始方法的方法存在计算开销大且缺乏收敛保证的问题，因此需要一种更高效且有理论保证的权重选择机制。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于对偶的方法，利用ALP对偶解中的投影占用信息来构造平滑的随机策略并更新状态相关权重，从而避免了单独的贪婪动作计算。
AI.result: 建立了权重与诱导策略折扣占用相匹配的条件，证明了在适当平滑下的唯一性和全局收敛性，推导了后验策略损失界；实验表明该方法降低了对固定权重的敏感性，并以较低的计算成本达到了可比或更好的策略质量。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基于对偶的权重选择方法成功解决了近似线性规划对状态相关权重敏感的痛点，兼具理论收敛保证与较低的计算成本，是对大规模MDP求解技术的有力补充。
AI.translation: 近似线性规划（ALP）被广泛应用于大规模马尔可夫决策过程（MDPs），但其性能对状态相关权重的选择非常敏感，而这些权重通常是凭经验选择的。性能界限表明，这些权重应与所诱导策略的折扣占用测度相一致，现有的原始方法通过重复构建贪婪策略来解决这一问题。尽管如此，它们缺乏收敛保证且计算代价高昂。我们提出了一种基于对偶的方法，该方法利用来自ALP对偶解的投影占用信息来构建平滑的随机策略并更新状态相关权重，从而避免了单独的贪婪动作计算。我们确立了权重与所诱导策略的折扣占用相匹配的条件，并在适当的平滑条件下证明了唯一性和全局收敛性。我们还推导了一个后验策略损失界，将误差从加权贝尔曼残差、占用失配以及随机与贪婪动作的分歧中分离出来。对经典排队和多优先级调度问题的实验表明，所提出的方法降低了对固定权重的敏感性，并以较低的计算成本实现了可比或更好的策略质量。最后，我们表明，当基函数具有足够的表达力以使占用信息影响最终策略时，自适应加权最有价值。
AI.summary: 本文针对近似线性规划（ALP）在马尔可夫决策过程求解中对状态相关权重敏感的问题，提出了一种基于对偶的权重选择与平滑随机策略更新方法。该方法避免了传统原始方法中昂贵的贪婪策略计算，具有理论上的全局收敛保证和后验损失界，实验证明其在降低权重敏感性的同时降低了计算成本。
AI.keywords: 近似线性规划, 马尔可夫决策过程, 状态相关权重, 对偶方法, 策略收敛性
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的基于对偶的方法来解决近似线性规划（ALP）中状态相关权重选择的敏感性问题，避免了传统原始方法中计算昂贵且缺乏收敛保证的贪婪策略构建。论文理论分析扎实，给出了全局收敛性证明和后验策略损失界，并在实验中验证了其计算效率和鲁棒性。

title: Online and Incremental Fractional Vertex Cover on Trees
summary: In this paper we study the fractional vertex cover problem on trees in two related models: online and incremental. In the online model, the vertices of the tree are known a priori and the edges arrive one at a time. The goal is to maintain a fractional vertex cover of the tree, i.e., an assignment of fractional weights from [0,1] to the vertices such that the weights of endpoints of every edge sum up to at least one. After each edge arrival, we need to modify the fractional vertex cover to cover the new edge as well. However, we can only increase the values assigned to vertices. The problem was studied before (in the vertex arrival model) by Wang and Wong, who motivated it as a generalization of the ski-rental problem, but also (more importantly) by its close connection to the dual online matching problem. They presented a 1.901-competitive algorithm for general graphs in the vertex arrival model. We present an $\frac{11}{6} \approx 1.83$-competitive algorithm for trees in the more general edge arrival model. In addition, we study the fractional vertex cover problem in an incremental model, where we again seek a fractional vertex cover after every update, but all the updates to the tree are known to the algorithm a priori. In this model, we give a 1.5-competitive algorithm and provide a matching lower bound.

AI.title_translation: 树上的在线与增量分数顶点覆盖问题
AI.tldr: 本文研究了树上的在线和增量分数顶点覆盖问题，在线模型下给出了 11/6-竞争算法，增量模型下给出了 1.5-竞争算法及匹配下界。
AI.motivation: 为了解决树上分数顶点覆盖问题在在线模型（边到达）和增量模型下的算法设计与性能界定问题，改进现有通用图模型的结果并探索更紧密的竞争比。
AI.method: 在边到达的在线模型下提出了一个 11/6 的竞争算法；在增量模型下提出了一个 1.5 的竞争算法并证明了匹配的下界。
AI.result: 在边到达的在线模型中，针对树提出了 11/6 (约 1.83) 竞争力的算法；在增量模型中，给出了 1.5 竞争力的算法并证明了其匹配的下界。
AI.conclusion: 本文为树上的在线和增量分数顶点覆盖问题提供了改进的算法和匹配的下界，推进了该领域的理论理解。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们在两个相关模型（在线模型和增量模型）下研究了树上的分数顶点覆盖问题。在在线模型中，树的顶点是先验已知的，边则逐条到达。目标是维护树的分数顶点覆盖，即为顶点分配来自[0,1]的分数权重，使得每条边两个端点的权重之和至少为1。在每条边到达后，我们需要修改分数顶点覆盖以覆盖新到达的边，但我们只能增加分配给顶点的权重。该问题之前已被 Wang 和 Wong 在顶点到达模型下研究过，他们将其动机归结为滑雪租赁问题的推广，更重要的是它与对偶在线匹配问题紧密相关。他们针对一般图的顶点到达模型提出了一个 1.901-竞争的算法。我们在更一般的边到达模型下，针对树提出了一个 $\frac{11}{6} \approx 1.83$-竞争的算法。此外，我们在增量模型下研究了分数顶点覆盖问题，在该模型中，我们在每次更新后同样寻求一个分数顶点覆盖，但树的所有更新对算法来说都是先验已知的。在该模型中，我们给出了一个 1.5-竞争的算法并提供了匹配的下界。
AI.summary: 本文研究了树上的分数顶点覆盖问题，涵盖在线（边到达）和增量两种模型。在在线模型中，作者提出了一种 11/6 竞争力的算法；在增量模型中，提出了 1.5 竞争力的算法并证明了相应的下界。
AI.keywords: 分数顶点覆盖, 在线算法, 增量模型, 树, 竞争比
AI.comments: 本文研究了树上在线和增量分数顶点覆盖问题，在边到达的在线模型下将竞争比改进至11/6，并在增量模型下给出了1.5的紧密上下界，理论贡献显著。

title: Causal Modelling of Support Interventions for Student Competency Assessment
summary: Accurate assessment of student competencies is essential for enabling educators to identify individual needs, design targeted interventions, and evaluate the effectiveness of educational strategies. Empirical assessment procedures are typically grounded in psychometric models, such as item response theory, which relate student competence levels to performance on assessment tasks. In this paper, we advocate adopting a structural causal modelling approach to educational assessment, moving beyond probabilistic belief updating toward a framework that explicitly supports interventional and counterfactual reasoning. We propose a corresponding protocol for its construction and analyse the practical relevance of forms of reasoning that remain inaccessible to standard associative models, including the explicit modelling of interventions such as hints and the related counterfactual scenario analysis. Although our protocol requires the structural equations to be elicited from experts, the necessary information is purely logical and does not rely on probabilistic, less tenable assumptions. We illustrate the approach using data from an assessment that employs complex tasks designed to measure compulsory school student algorithmic skills.

AI.title_translation: 学生胜任力评估支持干预的因果建模
AI.tldr: 本文提出将结构因果模型引入学生胜任力评估，以支持提示干预和反事实推理等传统模型无法实现的功能。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于概率信念更新的心理测量学模型（如项目反应理论）无法支持干预和反事实推理，因此需要采用结构因果建模方法来更准确地评估学生胜任力并设计针对性干预。
AI.method: 提出了一种构建教育评估结构因果模型的协议，通过专家启发式获取结构方程（基于纯逻辑而非概率假设），并利用算法技能评估的复杂任务数据进行了实证。
AI.result: 该协议能够成功应用于义务教育阶段学生算法技能评估的复杂任务数据中，并展示了标准关联模型无法实现的干预（如提示）建模及反事实情境分析能力。
AI.conclusion: 结构因果模型为教育评估提供了一种超越传统概率模型的严谨框架，能够有效支持提示等干预措施的建模及反事实情境分析。
AI.translation: 准确评估学生的胜任力对于帮助教育者识别个体需求、设计有针对性的干预措施以及评估教育策略的有效性至关重要。实证评估程序通常基于心理测量模型（如项目反应理论），该模型将学生的胜任力水平与评估任务的表现联系起来。在本文中，我们主张在教育评估中采用结构因果建模方法，从概率信念更新转向一个明确支持干预和反事实推理的框架。我们提出了相应的构建协议，并分析了标准关联模型无法获得的各种推理形式的实际相关性，包括对提示等干预措施的显式建模以及相关的反事实情境分析。尽管我们的协议要求从专家那里引出结构方程，但必要的信息是纯逻辑的，不依赖于概率性的、站不住脚的假设。我们使用来自一项旨在测量义务教育学生算法技能的复杂任务评估的数据说明了这种方法。
AI.summary: 本文主张在教育评估中采用结构因果建模方法，以克服传统心理测量模型的局限，并提出了相应的构建协议，利用逻辑推理而非概率假设来进行干预和反事实分析。
AI.keywords: 结构因果模型, 学生胜任力评估, 教育干预, 反事实推理, 心理测量学
AI.comments: 本文创新性地引入结构因果模型（SCM）来改进学生胜任力评估，跳出了传统心理测量学的范式，支持干预和反事实推理，具有很强的教育实践指导意义。但方法依赖于专家的结构方程设定，实际应用中可能存在主观性和复杂性。

title: Quantifying the Relationship Between Team Dysfunctions and Performance in Capstone Projects
summary: This paper investigates the association between team dysfunctions and performance in the context of an engineering Capstone program. Capstone programs are considered fundamental in assessing the readiness of engineering and computer science students for professional practice, evaluating not only technical knowledge but also essential competencies such as teamwork, communication, design, and organization. Despite the recognized importance of team dynamics in such settings, their relationship with project performance remains insufficiently understood. Using survey data collected from student teams, we quantify team dynamics based on Lencioni's model of the five dysfunctions of a team, with all measures reverse-coded so that higher values indicate more positive team behaviors (i.e., lower dysfunction). The results indicate a weak-to-moderate relationship between team dynamics and performance. Each dysfunction score was computed as the sum of three corresponding survey items. All items were coded such that higher values indicate more positive team behaviors (i.e., lower dysfunction). Therefore, each score ranges from 3 to 9, where higher values reflect healthier team dynamics. This study analyzes empirical evidence on team effectiveness in project-based learning environments and offers insights for the design of Capstone programs. In particular, it highlights the importance of goal alignment and focus on deliverables while emphasizing that team dynamics should be considered alongside technical and contextual factors.

AI.title_translation: 量化毕业设计项目中团队失调与绩效之间的关系
AI.tldr: 本研究通过Lencioni模型量化了工程毕业设计项目中团队失调与绩效的关系，发现两者存在弱到中度相关性。
AI.motivation: 尽管团队动力学在工程及计算机科学专业的毕业设计项目中被广泛认为至关重要，但其与项目绩效之间的具体关系仍未得到充分的理解，因此需要通过实证数据来量化这种关系。
AI.method: 采用基于Lencioni团队五大失调模型的问卷调查法收集学生团队数据，并将所有测量指标进行逆向编码，使得更高的数值代表更积极的团队行为（即更低的失调程度），每个失调得分范围为3到9分。
AI.result: 结果表明，团队动态与项目绩效之间存在弱到中度的相关性，同时强调了目标一致性和对交付物关注的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明团队动态与项目绩效之间存在弱到中度的关系，强调了目标一致性和交付物关注度的重要性，并指出团队动态应与技术和情境因素一同纳入考量。
AI.translation: 本文调查了工程专业毕业设计项目背景下团队失调与绩效之间的关联。毕业设计项目被认为是评估工程和计算机科学学生为专业实践做准备的基础，不仅评估技术知识，还评估团队合作、沟通、设计和组织等基本能力。尽管在此类环境中团队动力学的重要性得到了认可，但它们与项目绩效的关系仍未得到充分理解。利用从学生团队收集的调查数据，我们基于Lencioni的团队五大失调模型量化了团队动力学，所有测量指标均进行逆向编码，以便更高的值指示更积极的团队行为（即更低的失调）。结果表明团队动力学与绩效之间存在弱到中度的关系。每个失调得分计算为三个相应调查项目的总和。所有项目均经编码，使较高值指示更积极的团队行为。因此，每个分数范围为3到9，较高的值反映更健康的团队动态。本研究分析了基于项目的学习环境中团队效能的实证证据，并为毕业设计项目的设计提供了见解。特别是，它突出了目标一致性和对交付物关注的重要性，同时强调应将团队动力学与技术和情境因素结合起来考虑。
AI.summary: 本文研究了工程专业毕业设计项目中团队失调与绩效之间的关系。研究利用Lencioni的团队五大失调模型通过问卷收集数据，并发现团队动态与项目绩效之间存在弱到中度的相关性，为项目式学习环境下的团队效能提供了实证见解。
AI.keywords: 团队失调, 项目绩效, 毕业设计项目, 工程教育, 团队动态
AI.comments: 该论文基于Lencioni的团队五大失调模型，对工程专业毕业设计项目中的团队动态与绩效关系进行了量化研究。创新点在于将心理学/管理学模型引入工程教育实践，但其结果显示团队动态与绩效仅存在弱到中度的相关性，提示我们在评估学生表现时需要综合考虑技术和情境因素。

title: Asynchronous Verifiable Information Dispersal with Low Space and Communication Complexity
summary:
The primary goal of a distributed storage system is to ensure that clients can both write and read data in a reliable and consistent manner, even in the presence of failures. While existing asynchronous verifiable information dispersal (AVID) protocols achieve optimal space complexity for storage and communication complexity for data retrieval in a Byzantine setting, the crucial operations of data dispersal and node recovery have received less attention.
  We propose an efficient AVID protocol that simultaneously guarantees low complexities for dispersal, storage, retrieval, and recovery. At the core of the proposed protocol lies a novel mechanism to encode data in a two-dimensional matrix and a bespoke dispersal algorithm. The protocol maintains an optimal communication complexity for retrieval while substantially improving upon the state of the art for recovery. Additionally, we describe how the protocol can be modified in order to reduce the space complexity and the communication complexity for dispersal, at the expense of a higher communication complexity for retrieval and recovery. As the proposed protocols strike a balance across all considered metrics, they are suitable for a broad range of real-world use cases.

AI.title_translation: 具有低空间和通信复杂度的异步可验证信息分发
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新型异步可验证信息分发协议，在分发、存储、检索和恢复各方面均实现了低通信和空间复杂度。
AI.motivation: 现有的异步可验证信息分发（AVID）协议虽然在存储和数据检索上达到了最优的复杂性，但在数据分发和节点恢复等关键操作上的关注较少，缺乏在所有关键指标（分发、存储、检索和恢复）上同时保持低复杂度的协议。
AI.method: 提出了一种核心机制，将数据编码为二维矩阵，并设计了一种定制的分发算法。
AI.result: 提出的协议保持了最优的检索通信复杂度，同时大幅改进了现有的恢复状态，并且可以通过修改在空间和分发通信复杂度与检索和恢复通信复杂度之间进行权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该论文成功提出了一种在分发、存储、检索和恢复方面均具有低复杂度的异步可验证信息 dispersal 协议，适用于各种实际应用场景。
AI.translation:
分布式存储系统的主要目标是确保客户端能够以可靠和一致的方式写入和读取数据，即使在存在故障的情况下也是如此。虽然现有的异步可验证信息分发（AVID）协议在拜占庭设置下实现了存储的最优空间复杂度和数据检索的通信复杂度，但数据分发和节点恢复的关键操作受到的关注较少。
我们提出了一种高效的AVID协议，同时保证了分发、存储、检索和恢复的低复杂度。该协议的核心在于一种将数据编码为二维矩阵的新机制以及定制的分发算法。该协议保持了检索的最优通信复杂度，同时大幅改进了恢复的最新技术水平。此外，我们描述了如何修改该协议以降低空间复杂度和分发通信复杂度，代价是更高的检索和恢复通信复杂度。由于所提出的协议在所有考虑的指标中取得了平衡，因此它们适用于广泛的真实世界用例。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种高效的异步可验证信息分发（AVID）协议，通过二维矩阵数据编码和定制的分发算法，在分发、存储、检索和恢复的复杂性之间取得了极佳的平衡。
AI.keywords: 异步可验证信息分发,分布式存储,拜占庭容错,通信复杂度,空间复杂度
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新的异步可验证信息分发（AVID）协议，在存储、通信、分发和恢复等多个关键指标之间取得了良好的平衡，显著改进了现有技术的恢复通信复杂度。

title: Thermal Tuning Overhead in Wafer-Scale Optical Interconnects for LLM MoE Training: A Cross-Layer Analysis and Ferroelectric-Based Mitigation
summary: The rapid scaling of large language models (LLMs), particularly mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures, has intensified interconnect demands because expert-parallel execution is communication-intensive. Wafer-scale optical interconnects based on dense wavelength-division multiplexing (DWDM) offer a promising path to higher bandwidth; however, conventional microring-resonator (MRR)-based links rely on thermo-optic tuning and are therefore vulnerable to workload-induced thermal fluctuations. In this work, we present a cross-layer analysis of wafer-scale optical interconnects for MoE workloads that combines workload profiling, packet-level network simulation, and transient thermal analysis. We implement a wafer-scale topology in the ht-sim simulator and construct an Ansys thermal model of a 3D-integrated GPU/EIC/PIC stack. Our results show that transient temperature variations can exceed the tracking capability of conventional thermo-optic control loops and thereby introduce repeated tuning stalls during communication phases. The stall durations injected into the network simulation are derived directly from the thermal model rather than assumed. We further evaluate a ferroelectric-based electro-optic tuning mechanism that removes the continuous thermal-tuning requirement. In a four-layer proxy simulation across three MoE models, eliminating the tuning stalls yields speedups of 2.7x for Mixtral 8x7B, 3.8x for Qwen-MoE 14.3B, and 3.3x for LLaMA-MoE 6.7B relative to the thermo-optic case. These results indicate that minimizing photonic tuning latency is important for realizing the performance potential of optical interconnects in large-scale AI systems.

AI.title_translation: 面向大模型MoE训练的晶圆级光互连热调谐开销：跨层分析与基于铁电的缓解方案
AI.tldr: 本文通过跨层分析发现传统晶圆级光互连的热调谐开销会导致大模型MoE训练性能下降，并证明采用铁电基电光调谐能带来最高3.8倍的加速。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型特别是MoE架构的快速扩展对互连带宽提出了极高要求，基于DWDM和微环谐振器的晶圆级光互连依赖热光调谐，容易受到工作负载引起的瞬态热波动影响，导致通信阶段频繁出现调谐停顿。
AI.method: 结合了工作负载画像、包级网络模拟（ht-sim）和瞬态热分析（Ansys建立3D集成GPU/EIC/PIC堆叠热模型），并在四个层的代理仿真中评估了三种MoE模型。
AI.result: 瞬态温度变化会超出传统热光控制回路的追踪能力，导致频繁的调谐停顿；而采用铁电基电光调谐消除热调谐开销后，相比热光调谐情况，Mixtral 8x7B、Qwen-MoE 14.3B和LLaMA-MoE 6.7B的速度分别提升了2.7倍、3.8倍和3.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 消除传统微环谐振器的热光调谐开销（通过铁电基电光调谐）可以显著缓解通信停顿，为大规模AI系统中的光互连带来了2.7倍至3.8倍的加速效果。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM），特别是混合专家（MoE）架构的快速扩展，加剧了互连需求，因为专家并行执行是通信密集型的。基于密集波分复用（DWDM）的晶圆级光互连为实现更高带宽提供了一条有前景的途径；然而，传统的基于微环谐振器（MRR）的链路依赖于热光调谐，因此容易受到工作负载引起的的热波动的影响。在这项工作中，我们对用于MoE工作负载的晶圆级光互连进行了跨层分析，该分析结合了工作负载画像、包级网络模拟和瞬态热分析。我们在ht-sim模拟器中实现了晶圆级拓扑，并构建了3D集成GPU/EIC/PIC堆叠的Ansys热模型。我们的结果表明，瞬态温度变化可能超过传统热光控制回路的跟踪能力，从而在通信阶段引入重复的调谐停顿。注入网络模拟中的停顿持续时间直接来源于热模型，而不是假设的。我们进一步评估了一种基于铁电的电光调谐机制，该机制消除了持续热调谐的需求。在跨三个MoE模型的四层代理仿真中，消除调谐停顿相对于热光情况，使Mixtral 8x7B的速度提升了2.7倍，Qwen-MoE 14.3B提升了3.8倍，LLaMA-MoE 6.7B提升了3.3倍。这些结果表明，最小化光子调谐延迟对于实现大规模AI系统中光互连的性能潜力至关重要。
AI.summary: 本文针对大语言模型MoE训练中的晶圆级光互连热调谐开销问题，进行了跨层分析，并提出利用铁电基电光调谐机制来取代传统热光调谐，从而消除热调谐停顿并大幅提升AI系统训练性能。
AI.keywords: 晶圆级光学互连, 大语言模型, 混合专家模型 (MoE), 热光调谐, 铁电基电光调谐
AI.comments: 该论文针对大模型Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)训练中的通信瓶颈与晶圆级光学互连的温控开销问题，进行了深入的跨层分析，并创新性地引入铁电基电光调谐机制，显著提升了训练性能。具有很高的工程应用价值和前瞻性。

title: EVEREST:Endogenous Vision-Language Reinforcement Reasoning Exploration for Urban Socio-Semantic Segmentation
summary: Urban socio-semantic segmentation leverages digital and satellite imagery to provide critical spatial semantic information for downstream applications such as urban resource allocation. Although existing methods achieve high segmentation accuracy, they still suffer from inaccurate delineation of target boundaries. The underlying issue is that current models primarily rely on passively aggregated global cross-modal cues, lacking active exploration of the environment. To address this limitation, we propose the EVEREST model, which adopts an egocentric exploration strategy that enables the model to actively investigate boundary cues and perform self-correction. In addition, we formulate discrete natural-language prompts as pseudocode to regularize the execution logic. Reinforcement learning is further employed to implement this irreducible process and elicit the model's structured reasoning capability. Our EVEREST achieves optimal performance on all metrics in the real world urban socio-semantic dataset, demonstrating the superiority of our model. Codes are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/EVEREST-9D21/.

AI.title_translation: EVEREST：用于城市社会语义分割的内生视觉语言强化推理探索
AI.tldr: 提出一种名为EVEREST的视觉语言强化推理探索模型，通过主动环境探索与强化学习显著提升了城市社会语义分割中目标边界的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的城市社会语义分割方法虽然精度较高，但由于主要依赖被动聚合的全局跨模态线索而缺乏对环境的主动探索，导致目标边界勾勒不准确。
AI.method: 提出 EVEREST 模型，采用自我中心探索策略主动调查边界线索并进行自我修正；将离散自然语言提示作为伪代码来规范执行逻辑；利用强化学习实现这一过程并激发模型的结构化推理能力。
AI.result: EVEREST 在真实世界城市社会语义数据集的所有指标上均实现了最优性能，证明了该模型的优越性。
AI.conclusion: EVEREST 模型通过主动探索环境、规范执行逻辑以及强化学习推理，有效解决了城市社会语义分割中边界模糊的问题，并在真实世界数据集上取得了最优性能。
AI.translation: 城市社会语义分割利用数字和卫星影像为城市资源分配等下游应用提供关键的空间语义信息。尽管现有方法获得了较高的分割精度，但它们仍然存在目标边界勾勒不准确的问题。其根本原因在于当前模型主要依赖被动聚合的全局跨模态线索，缺乏对环境的主动探索。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了 EVEREST 模型，该模型采用自我中心探索策略，使模型能够主动调查边界线索并进行自我修正。此外，我们制定了离散的自然语言提示作为伪代码来规范执行逻辑。进一步采用强化学习来实现这一不可约减的过程，并激发模型的结构化推理能力。我们的 EVEREST 在真实世界的城市社会语义数据集上的所有指标上都取得了最佳性能，证明了我们模型的优越性。代码可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/EVEREST-9D21/ 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 EVEREST 模型，用于解决城市社会语义分割中目标边界划分不准的问题。该模型通过自我中心探索策略主动探测边界线索，利用自然语言伪代码规范执行逻辑，并结合强化学习激发结构化推理能力，在真实数据集上取得了最优性能。
AI.keywords: 城市社会语义分割, 视觉语言模型, 强化学习, 自我中心探索, 伪代码规范化
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将自我中心探索、自然语言伪代码规范化与强化学习相结合，解决了城市社会语义分割中边界 delineation 不准确的问题，展现了较强的推理与泛化能力。

title: Aging of Prompt Engineering Techniques Across LLM Versions
summary: Prompt engineering and prompt engineering techniques (PETs) have become an integral part of software engineering for AI systems. However, new LLMs are released frequently and it remains unclear how the effectiveness of prompt engineering techniques changes across successive generations of Large Language Models (LLMs). To this end, we conduct a partial replication of the study by Khojah et al. (2025). We evaluate five techniques - Zero-Shot, Few-Shot, Chain-of-Thought (CoT), Contrastive Chain-of-Thought (CCoT), and an adapted version of Program-of-Thought (PoT) - on six instruction-tuned models grouped into three version pairs: GPT-3.5-Turbo/GPT-4o, Qwen2 7B Instruct/Qwen2.5 7B Instruct, and Mistral-7B-Instruct/Mistral-Large. We use a cleaned subset of the CodePromptEval dataset with 218 context-rich Python functions and 19,620 total generations assessed via pass@k-based functional correctness to evaluate model pairs on function-level code generation tasks. We show that prompt engineering "ages" in a model-family-specific way: Newer GPT models exhibit diminishing or even negative marginal gains from structured prompting, suggesting that instruction-following and reasoning scaffolds are increasingly internalized, whereas Qwen models continue to benefit substantially from Few-Shot and CCoT. Mistral models show mixed behavior with persistent gains from CCoT but attenuated benefits from CoT and PoT. Our results imply that effective prompting strategies must be adapted per model family and generation rather than transferred unchanged. This motivates future work on adaptive, model-aware prompting and broader, multi-dimensional code quality evaluation.

title: Code-Domain Grouped Index Modulation for Spectrally Efficient Spread-Spectrum Communications
summary: Efficient exploitation of spreading resources is important for improving the transmission efficiency of spread-spectrum communications. Code index modulation (CIM) conveys additional information through spreading-code indices without requiring extra radio-frequency chains. The fixed number of code-index branches in existing CIM schemes limits information allocation between the code-index and modulation-symbol domains as the target rate increases. This paper proposes code-domain grouped index modulation (CGIM), which partitions an orthogonal spreading-code bank into multiple groups and maps the in-phase and quadrature components of one quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM) symbol in each group onto two independent code indices. Group-wise despreading enables parallel detection. Group-wise maximum-likelihood (ML) and low-complexity greedy detection (GD) are developed, with both achieving joint ML decisions under the stated conditions. A pairwise error probability (PEP)-based bit error rate (BER) analysis is derived for Rayleigh and Nakagami-$m$ fading, with additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) as a benchmark. Numerical results show that CGIM achieves better BER performance than traditional CIM benchmark schemes at the same transmission rate, owing to a more balanced distribution of information bits between the code-index and modulation-symbol domains.

title: A Literate Programming Environment for Human and Machine Agents
summary: This paper introduces an environment for constructing literate programs in concert with language-aware machine agents. This environment includes a grammar for executable program essays, a parser that treats names as first-class objects, an internal name-graph which relates prose, names and executable artifacts, and a binding mechanism for existing languages and testing toolsets. This supports co-location of code with its most relevant natural language and structured data context, making better use of Large Language Model (LLM) context windows. It also provides LLM coding agents with a toolset more analogous to the symbol-aware search and usage information available in human programmer-facing Integrated Development Environments (IDEs). We describe a working implementation with bindings to three established programming languages, and several example programs.

title: On-Policy Self-Distillation in Diffusion Models
comments: Technical Report; Project Page at https://diffusionopsd.github.io GitHub Repo at https://github.com/worldbench/DiffusionOPSD
summary: Reinforcement learning can align diffusion models with human preferences and task-specific objectives, but endpoint rewards do not specify how an intermediate denoising prediction should change. We introduce DiffusionOPSD as an on-policy self-distillation framework that converts image-level reward guidance into explicit targets for clean-output predictions at sampled queries. At each outer iteration, a frozen behavior policy generates trajectories and supplies query states and anchors. Reward gradients construct bounded positive and negative targets around each anchor. The trainable policy fits these targets as detached supervision through finite fitting before an exponential moving average update refreshes the behavior policy. This setup lets us measure target construction and finite realization separately. Controlled same-query experiments show that larger target-construction gains do not necessarily translate into larger realized gains after a single fitting update. Across SD 3.5-M and the step-distilled Z-Image-Turbo, our approach achieves the best final held-out scores in 19 of 20 reward-matched settings across two backbones and ten evaluators. It outperforms the strongest competing method by up to 44.0% and reduces training GPU-hours relative to DiffusionNFT by 40% on SD 3.5-M and 63% on Z-Image-Turbo. These results support on-policy self-distillation as an efficient and analyzable approach to diffusion post-training by converting image-level reward guidance into explicit and continually refreshed intermediate supervision, thereby opening a path toward more efficient and diagnosable alignment.
comment: Technical Report; Project Page at https://diffusionopsd.github.io GitHub Repo at https://github.com/worldbench/DiffusionOPSD

title: Simthesizer: An Agent-Driven Simulation Framework for LLM Serving Systems
summary:
System-level simulation is an essential tool for exploring the rapidly expanding design space of LLM serving systems, where real deployments remain costly and often infeasible. However, modern LLM serving now evolves faster than human-driven simulator development can track, and emerging workloads and mechanisms, from agentic workflows to disaggregated serving, no longer fit the monolithic simulation pipeline that existing simulators assume. Each new mechanism therefore demands an invasive rewrite, leaving a widening development gap between deployed serving systems and the simulators that model them.
  To close this gap, we present Borg, a framework that realizes agent-driven simulator development. Borg introduces a composable simulator infrastructure that uniformly expresses the complete serving workflow, including the control decisions that coordinate it, and realizes it as a unified dynamic graph in Borg simulator. Synthesizer agent, a harnessed coding agent, then lowers natural-language feature requests onto this abstraction under simulator-specific guardrails and fidelity validation, evolving one shared simulator instead of building a new one for every feature. Under the same coding agent and harnesses, extensions built on Borg follow a vLLM-based real system with 2.51% average throughput error, versus 6.03% for extensions built on existing simulators. On identical workloads, Borg also simulates up to 284.96x and 23.19x faster than two state-of-the-art simulators, LLMServingSim2.0 and Vidur, respectively.

title: Expectation, Backlash, Recovery, and Excitement: How Model Releases Shape Reddit Perceptions of Conversational AI Systems
comments: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. The companion website is available at https://vavre.github.io/p/upai
summary: Conversational AI systems (CAISes) continuously change through model releases, feature updates, safety interventions, and access-policy shifts, yet user perceptions are often studied as static snapshots. We conduct a long-term, large-scale analysis of Reddit discussions to examine how users perceive CAIS model release interventions across providers. By combining sentiment classification and thematic concept analysis, we show that CAIS perceptions are dynamic and intervention-sensitive. Anthropic exhibits the clearest positive release profile through Claude Code and product-model fit, OpenAI shows backlash-and-recovery dynamics around GPT-5 and GPT-5.1, Grok-3 is shaped by provider identity and political discourse, and DeepSeek-R1 combines engineering praise with concerns about censorship, access, and reliability. These findings show that model releases are not merely technical updates, but user-facing interventions that reshape sentiment, expectations, and public discussion.
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. The companion website is available at https://vavre.github.io/p/upai

title: Parason: Revealing Subtask and Trial Parallelism in LLM Reasoning
summary: Scaling test-time reasoning has substantially improved the problem-solving ability of large language models (LLMs), but standard autoregressive decoding still executes long reasoning traces sequentially, creating severe latency for difficult tasks (up to days and weeks). Parallel reasoning offers a natural remedy. However, prior systems primarily focus on Subtask Parallelism, where the model learns to decompose a high-level task into smaller chunks that can be solved independently. This approach overlooks another pervasive form of parallelism: Trial Parallelism, where multiple speculative attempts explore, verify, and aggregate competing hypotheses in parallel. In this paper, we introduce Parason, which reveals and learns both forms of parallelism in LLM reasoning. Our analysis identifies Trial Parallelism as the majority of parallelizable reasoning computation (65.5% in DeepSeek-V4's reasoning steps in HLE), and it becomes increasingly dominant on hard problems. Guided by this taxonomy, Parason converts sequential reasoning traces into structured parallel trajectories with a context-free grammar, then trains models with Parallelism-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization (PA-GRPO), whose reward jointly balances accuracy, latency, and the two parallelism ratios. At inference time, Parason executes the learned parallel structure through tool calls, translating theoretical savings to real-world wall-clock acceleration. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks including AIME24 and AIME25 show that Parason achieves an average acceleration about 1.7$\times$ while maintaining competitive accuracy.

title: From local kernels to global form: modeling the emergence of musical content
comments: Accepted at XXV CIM - Colloquio di Informatica Musicale, L'Aquila, 2026
summary: Markov models are established tools for symbolic music, including non-homogeneous formulations. The narrower contribution examined here is an observation-driven estimation mechanism: overlapping sliding windows derive a trajectory of local transition kernels from one symbolic sequence rather than from an exogenous formal partition. We test this mechanism on 273 logical note events from Debussy's Syrinx (1913), using the often-proposed A-B-A' reading as a reference rather than ground truth. We apply the same validation to absolute-pitch and notated-duration kernels. At $L=6$, both reference boundaries attain the Jensen--Shannon maximum in both dimensions; the duration plateau is substantially narrower (64 of 267 comparisons) than the pitch plateau (210 of 267). Because the theoretical maximum for consecutive sliding-window comparisons is set by window geometry and equals $1/\sqrt{L-1}$ for maximal turnover of the entering/leaving transition, the pitch value at $L=6$ and its broad plateau are not, by themselves, strong evidence. Their cross-dimensional alignment is consistent with boundary sensitivity, while the broad plateaus preclude treating either curve alone as a unique automatic segmenter. Five-hundred-draw re-synthesis experiments quantify departure from the source in both dimensions and expose an exact-copy degeneracy at $L=2$.
comment: Accepted at XXV CIM - Colloquio di Informatica Musicale, L'Aquila, 2026

title: The Invisible Editorial Layer: Formalizing Undisclosed Inference-Time Steering, Probability Placement, and the Attribution Problem in Deployed Language Models
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are commonly evaluated under the assumption that their observable behavior is primarily determined by model weights, training data, alignment procedures, and user prompts. This view is incomplete. Modern inference pipelines may systematically modify the probability distribution produced by a model immediately before token selection, creating an additional layer of control between frozen weights and observed text.
  While controlled generation (e.g., PPLM, GeDi, DExperts, FUDGE) and text-watermarking systems (e.g., SynthID-Text) demonstrate the technical maturity of decoding- and logit-level interventions, the governance, security, and economic implications of an undisclosed inference policy remain comparatively underexplored. This paper examines the emergence of inference-time framing bias: the systematic modification of generated language toward political, ideological, institutional, or commercial frames via interventions applied after model inference but before token sampling.
  We formalize the operational reality Model != Deployed System and introduce three concepts: (1) the Inference Attribution Problem, characterizing why observed behavioral bias cannot generally be causally attributed to model weights alone under limited observability; (2) Probability Placement, defining a hypothetical advertising primitive in which commercial influence is implemented through systematic shifts in generation probabilities rather than explicit product insertions; and (3) Inference Policy Transparency, a governance principle for making deployment-layer interventions auditable. We examine these concepts in relation to Article 5 of the EU AI Act, the EU Digital Services Act, and FTC doctrines.

title: Maia 200: A Software Defined Dataflow System for Large-scale AI Acceleration
summary: We introduce Maia 200, an advanced AI accelerator delivering high performance-10 145 Tflop/s FP4 and 5072 Tflop/s FP8 within a 750W TDP and 7 TB/s HBM bandwidth. Maia exemplifies a new class of Software Defined Locally Accessed Dataflow Architectures (SDLA), which explicitly program dataflow engines to orchestrate highly specialized memories and data movement engines. This approach shifts the focus from today's thread-centric to data-movement-centric architecture, improving efficiency and scalability. Our taxonomy of data management, inspired by Flynn's classification, highlights how SDLA addresses challenges in modern AI computing. Maia 200 achieves significant cost and energy savings while supporting massive parallelism for AI inference workloads, making it a compelling solution for next-generation high-performance computing systems.

title: Data Leakage Inflates Generalizability of Power Outage Prediction Models
summary: Power outage prediction models are increasingly used in assessments of climate-driven infrastructure risk, yet current evaluation practices obscure whether these models generalize to the novel conditions such applications require. We identify three common methodological choices in power outage prediction models that influence their ability to generalize across spatial, temporal, and event-based settings. We compare the predictive performance impacts of different methodological decisions using publicly available data for the U.S. East Coast from 2018 to 2023 and feature sets derived from weather reanalysis and land-cover data, and embeddings from a GeoAI foundation model (Prithvi WxC).
