We evaluate 12 model configurations across three benchmarks and show that FedV-KGQA performs strongly, remains close to centralized performance, generalizes to 3-hop reasoning, and is robust to embedding perturbations.
comment: Accepted at ISWC 2026 (Research Track). To appear in the Proceedings of the 25th International Semantic Web Conference

AI.title_translation: FedV-KGQA：基于垂直分割知识图谱的多跳问答
AI.tldr: 提出了一种联邦垂直分割知识图谱的多跳问答框架，在保护数据隐私的前提下实现了接近中心化的推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中知识图谱问答的数据由于治理和数据主权约束分布在不同组织中，现有的中心化系统无法解决当所需事实分散在垂直分割孤岛上的多跳问题。
AI.method: 结合本地图增强、知识图谱嵌入以及主题实体锚定机制，确保原始三元组和关系参数不离开本地孤岛，并在运行时无需跨孤岛通信。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试的12种模型配置评估中表现优异，性能接近中心化系统，能够泛化到3跳推理，并且对嵌入扰动具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: FedV-KGQA是一个强大的联邦多跳知识图谱问答框架，能够在不暴露原始三元组和关系参数的前提下，实现接近中心化系统的问答性能。
AI.translation: 现实世界中用于知识图谱问答的数据由于治理和数据主权约束，常常分布在不同的组织中。虽然存在中心化系统，但当所需的事实分散在垂直分割的孤岛上时，它们无法回答多跳问题。在本文中，我们提出了FedV-KGQA，这是一个用于知识图谱多跳推理的框架，其中各个组织共享实体但拥有不相交的关系集。我们的方法结合了本地图增强和知识图谱嵌入，以确保原始三元组和关系参数永远不会离开每个孤岛，从而在无需集中式图访问的情况下建立结构化数据边界。我们进一步引入了一种主题实体锚定机制，在没有任何运行时跨孤岛通信的情况下，将问题锚定在正确的图邻域中。我们在三个基准测试中评估了12种模型配置，结果表明FedV-KGQA表现强劲，保持了接近中心化的性能，能够泛化到3跳推理，并且对嵌入扰动具有鲁棒性。
AI.summary: FedV-KGQA是一个用于垂直分割知识图谱的多跳问答框架。它通过本地图增强、知识图谱嵌入和主题实体锚定机制，在保护数据隐私的同时实现了跨组织的多跳推理，且性能接近中心化系统。
AI.keywords: 联邦学习, 知识图谱问答, 垂直分割, 多跳推理, 隐私保护
AI.comments: 该论文针对知识图谱问答中数据垂直分割的现实痛点，创新性地提出了FedV-KGQA框架，在保护数据隐私和符合数据主权的前提下，实现了跨机构的多跳推理，具有很高的实用价值。

title: BrowserForge: Scaling Web Episode via Parallel Browser Sandboxes
summary: Web agents that act from rendered pixels avoid the fragility and heavy token cost of reading a page's HTML or accessibility tree, but training them depends on large amounts of high-quality interaction trajectories, and how to produce such data at scale remains an open problem. Public datasets typically contain only a few thousand trajectories drawn from a fixed and narrow set of websites, and even recent automated synthesis pipelines stay bound to predefined site lists or tutorial sources, so the number of distinct websites the agent ever sees barely grows. We present BrowserForge, a framework that generates web interaction data at scale by driving many browser sandboxes in parallel over the open web. BrowserForge couples three components: an open-web sourcing stage that exposes the agent to hundreds of thousands of real, openly reachable websites; a sandbox cluster manager that schedules hundreds of concurrent browsers with high utilization; and a Proposer-Solver dual-agent loop that turns a raw page into an executable task and then collects a verified trajectory for it. A rule-plus-model cleaning pipeline removes failed runs and rewrites the surviving reasoning into a single unified chain-of-thought style. Page structure such as the accessibility tree is used only as a synthesis-time signal; the agent we train and release acts purely from the screenshot. The resulting corpus contains 203,238 trajectories, each collected from a distinct website, larger and more diverse than prior trajectory datasets. Fine-tuning a compact multimodal model on this corpus raises its success rate on the live Online-Mind2Web from 25.66% to 33.33% and consistently improves step accuracy on the static Multimodal-Mind2Web, with the gain growing as the corpus scales. Controlled analyses further confirm that open-web sourcing and broad website coverage are key contributors to the observed improvement.

AI.title_translation: BrowserForge：通过并行浏览器沙箱扩展Web任务轨迹
AI.tldr: BrowserForge通过并行浏览器沙箱在开放网络上大规模生成高质量Web交互数据，显著提升了视觉Web智能体的泛化能力与成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于像素的Web智能体训练依赖于大量高质量交互轨迹，但目前的数据集规模小、网站来源窄、缺乏多样性，无法满足大规模训练的需求。
AI.method: 提出了BrowserForge框架，包含开放网络溯源阶段、高利用率的沙箱集群管理器、用于生成任务和收集验证轨迹的Proposer-Solver双智能体循环，以及基于规则与模型的清理流水线。
AI.result: 生成了包含203,238条来自不同网站的轨迹的大规模语料库；在Online-Mind2Web上的成功率从25.66%提升至33.33%，并在Multimodal-Mind2Web上稳定提升了步骤准确率。
AI.conclusion: BrowserForge通过并行浏览器沙箱和开放网络数据生成策略，成功构建了大规模且多样化的Web交互数据集，显著提升了视觉Web智能体的性能和泛化能力。
AI.translation: 基于渲染像素行动的Web智能体避免了阅读页面HTML或可访问性树的脆弱性和高昂Token成本，但其训练依赖于大量高质量交互轨迹，如何在规模上产生此类数据仍然是一个开放性问题。公共数据集通常只包含从固定且狭窄的网站集合中提取的几千条轨迹，甚至最近的自动化合成流水线也局限于预定义的网站列表或教程来源，导致智能体见过的不同网站数量几乎没有增长。我们提出了BrowserForge，这是一个通过在开放网络上并行驱动大量浏览器沙箱来大规模生成Web交互数据的框架。BrowserForge结合了三个组件：一个开放网络溯源阶段，将智能体暴露于数十万个真实、公开可访问的网站中；一个以高利用率调度数百个并发浏览器的沙箱集群管理器；以及一个Proposer-Solver双智能体循环，将原始页面转化为可执行任务并为其收集验证过的轨迹。规则加模型清理流水线去除了失败的运行，并将幸存的推理重写为统一的思维链风格。页面结构（如可访问性树）仅用作合成时的信号；我们训练和发布的智能体完全根据截图进行操作。由此产生的语料库包含203,238条轨迹，每条轨迹收集自不同的网站，比以往的轨迹数据集更大、更多样化。在一个紧凑的多模态模型上微调该语料库，将其在实时Online-Mind2Web上的成功率从25.66%提高到33.33%，并持续提高静态Multimodal-Mind2Web上的步骤准确率，且增益随着语料库规模的扩大而增长。对照分析进一步证实，开放网络溯源和广泛的网站覆盖是观察到的性能提升的关键贡献者。
AI.summary: BrowserForge是一个利用并行浏览器沙箱在开放网络上大规模生成Web交互数据的框架。它通过双智能体循环和清洗流水线产出了包含二十多万条高质量轨迹的数据集，有效提升了视觉Web智能体的性能。
AI.keywords: Web Agents, Parallel Browser Sandboxes, Data Synthesis, Multimodal Models, Open Web
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种基于大规模并行浏览器沙箱的Web交互数据生成框架BrowserForge，通过“提议者-求解者”双智能体循环和开放网络溯源，有效解决了现有视觉Web智能体训练数据规模小、多样性差的痛点，显著提升了多模态智能体在真实环境中的泛化能力。

title: Research Methodologies for Cybersecurity in Enterprise Environments: A Narrative Review, Synthesis and Executable Guide
summary: Enterprise cybersecurity research draws on a wider range of methods than any single community routinely teaches. Researchers face a selection problem before they face a technical one: a study may simultaneously need a systematic review, a design-science artifact, a controlled detection experiment, an interview study, or an attack-graph model. This paper addresses that problem in two ways. First, it provides a narrative review and synthesis of methodological practices across a verified corpus of 151 works. We organise these practices into eleven methodology families, detailing for each what questions it answers, the strength of its supporting evidence, and its common failure modes. Second, we convert each family into an executable protocol comprising ordered steps, required instruments, evaluation criteria, common validity threats, and a reporting checklist. Every protocol is also visually mapped to make the sequence, decisions, and threats legible at a glance. We also treat contradictions in the literature as evidence. For example, reported rankings of intrusion-detection algorithms are wildly inconsistent across individually careful studies. We argue this pattern is most parsimoniously explained by variations in evaluation design rather than the algorithms themselves, as these studies differ in design dimensions known to shift results by more than the margins separating the algorithms. Ultimately, the evidence supports methodological pluralism disciplined by explicit validity reasoning. We conclude that researchers must match their evaluation design to the decision under study, triangulate technical against organisational evidence, explicitly state the population a result generalises to, and report the conditions under which the result would not hold.

AI.title_translation: 企业环境中网络安全的研究方法论：叙述性综述、综合与可执行指南
AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了企业网络安全研究中的11个方法论家族，并为每个家族提供了包含操作步骤与有效性威胁的可执行指南，以解决研究中的方法选择难题。
AI.motivation: 企业网络安全研究所需的方法跨度广泛，研究人员在面对技术问题前往往面临方法选择问题（如系统综述、设计科学人工制品、受控检测实验、访谈或攻击图模型等），现有研究缺乏对多样化方法论实践的系统梳理与可执行指导。
AI.method: 基于对151篇经过验证的文献语料库进行叙述性综述与综合，将方法实践归纳为11个方法论家族，并为每个家族构建包含步骤、工具、评估标准、有效性威胁和报告清单的可执行协议。
AI.result: 研究识别并整理了11个方法论家族，发现文献中入侵检测算法排名的不一致主要由评估设计差异引起，并通过证据支持了受显式有效性推理约束的方法论多元主义。
AI.conclusion: 网络安全研究需要方法论多元主义，并通过明确的有效性推理加以约束。研究者必须匹配评估设计、结合技术与组织证据、明确泛化群体并报告失效条件。
AI.translation: 企业网络安全研究所借鉴的方法范围比任何单一社区常规教授的方法都要广泛。在面对技术问题之前，研究人员首先面临着方法选择问题：一项研究可能同时需要系统综述、设计科学人工制品、受控检测实验、访谈研究或攻击图模型。本文从两个方面解决了这一问题。首先，它对来自151篇经过验证的文献语料库的方法论实践进行了叙述性综述和综合。我们将这些实践组织为十一个方法论家族，详细阐述了每个家族回答的问题、其支持证据的强度以及常见的失效模式。其次，我们将每个家族转化为一个可执行协议，包含有序的步骤、所需的工具、评估标准、常见的有效性威胁以及报告清单。每个协议还进行可视化映射，以便一眼就能看清顺序、决策和威胁。我们还将文献中的矛盾视为证据。例如，在各自严谨的研究中，报告的入侵检测算法排名存在巨大差异。我们认为，这种模式最简单合理的解释是评估设计的变异，而不是算法本身，因为这些研究在已知能使结果产生显著变化的涉及维度上存在差异。最终，证据支持受显式有效性推理约束的方法论多元主义。我们得出结论，研究人员必须将评估设计与所研究的决策相匹配，将技术证据与组织证据进行三角验证，明确声明结果可推广的人群，并报告结果不成立的条件。
AI.summary: 本文针对企业网络安全研究中方法选择的难题，通过对151篇文献的叙述性综述，将方法实践划分为11个家族，并为每个家族提供包含操作步骤与有效性威胁的可执行协议，倡导在明确有效性推理下的方法论多元主义。
AI.keywords: 企业网络安全, 方法论综述, 可执行协议, 有效性推理, 方法论多元主义
AI.comments: 该论文通过对151篇文献的叙述性综述，系统梳理了企业网络安全研究中的11个方法论家族，并为每个家族提供了可执行的协议，对规范网络安全研究设计具有重要价值。

title: Learning Whom to Trust : Decision-Generated Credibility in Social Learning
summary: Social interaction can improve collective learning but also amplify early mistakes. We study this tension when the credibility of social information is generated by the sender's own decision process rather than fixed ex ante. Reinforcement-learning agents make binary choices through a drift--diffusion process that jointly determines choice, decision time, and confidence; decision confidence then becomes social credibility by weighting anticipatory influence and retrospective social learning. Under balanced community exposure, the anticipatory field admits an exact quotient representation. Its local Jacobian is a scalar decision-sensitivity term multiplying the community-coupling matrix, which yields a common-mode amplification threshold and an analytical role for cross-community permeability in damping relative community differences. Monte Carlo experiments show the corresponding non-monotone performance pattern: moderate transmission accelerates correction, whereas strong transmission can lock populations into wrong consensus; low permeability instead sustains disagreement. Ablations reveal a dual role for confidence: credibility-sensitive transmission amplifies social error, while confidence-dependent private learning stabilises it. The model yields testable predictions linking sender confidence to receiver behaviour conditional on accuracy.

AI.title_translation: 学习信任谁：社会学习中由决策生成的信誉
AI.tldr: 本文通过构建一个将决策信心转化为社会可信度的强化学习模型，揭示了社会传播强度如何非单调地影响集体学习，并发现信心在其中具有放大错误与稳定私有学习的双重作用。
AI.motivation: 研究社交互动如何既能提高集体学习又能放大早期错误这一张力，特别是当社会信息的信誉由发送者自身的决策过程动态生成而非预先固定时的情况。
AI.method: 采用强化学习智能体通过漂移扩散过程（联合决定选择、决策时间和信心），结合数学分析（商表示、雅可比矩阵、蒙特卡洛实验）以及消融实验进行研究。
AI.result: 蒙特卡洛实验表明存在非单调的性能模式：适度传播加速纠错，而强传播将群体锁定在错误共识中；消融实验揭示了信心的双重作用（敏感传播放大错误，依赖信心的私有学习稳定错误）。
AI.conclusion: 通过建模决策生成的社会可信度，揭示了适度传播加速纠错、强传播导致错误共识的非单调规律，并指出了信心在私有学习与社会传播中的对立双重角色。
AI.translation: 社会互动可以改善集体学习，但也会放大早期错误。我们研究了这样一种张力：社会信息的信誉是由发送者自身的决策过程动态产生的，而不是在事前固定。强化学习智能体通过漂移扩散过程做出二元选择，该过程共同决定了选择、决策时间和信心；然后，决策信心通过对预期影响和回顾性社会学习进行加权，转化为社会可信度。在平衡的社区接触下，预期场允许一个精确的商表示。其局部雅可比矩阵是一个标量决策敏感度项乘以社区耦合矩阵，这产生了共模放大阈值以及交叉社区渗透性在阻尼相对社区差异方面的解析作用。蒙特卡洛实验显示了相应的非单调性能模式：适度传播加速纠错，而强传播则可能将群体锁定在错误共识中；低渗透性反而维持了分歧。消融实验揭示了信心的双重作用：对可信度敏感的传播放大了社会错误，而依赖信心的私有学习稳定了社会错误。该 model 得出了将发送者信心与条件准确率下的接收者行为联系起来的可检验预测。
AI.summary: 本文研究了社交网络中基于决策生成可信度的社会学习机制。通过建立结合漂移扩散与强化学习的数学模型，分析了决策信心如何转化为社会可信度并影响集体学习。研究发现，适度信息传播有助于纠错，而过强传播易导致错误共识，同时信心在私有学习与社会传播中扮演了稳定与放大的双重角色。
AI.keywords: 社会学习, 强化学习, 漂移扩散模型, 决策信心, 群体共识
AI.comments: 本文创新性地研究了基于决策生成可信度的社会学习模型，通过强化学习和漂移扩散过程揭示了信心在社会传播中的双重作用，对理解群体智慧与群体错误具有重要理论价值。

title: LeFlow: Generative Latent Flow Planning for World Models
summary: Latent world models are inherently strong encoders that transform image pixel to latent embedding, yet existing world models still rely on online trajectory optimization for action planning: for every state-goal pair, an iterative optimizer is run from scratch to search for optimal action sequences, treating the world model as a black-box simulator. This approach pays the full iterative optimization cost anew at every replanning step and reuses no planning experience across queries. In this work, we ask whether planning itself can be amortized once a latent world model has been learned. We present LeFlow, which learns a reusable latent trajectory prior operating directly in the latent dynamics space from the world model. LeFlow recasts planning as conditional latent trajectory generation: a rectified-flow model imagines a future latent path between the current and goal embeddings, an inverse dynamics decoder turns latent transitions into action chunks, and the frozen world model verifies each candidate by autoregressive rollout. Across four major goal-conditioned pixel-control benchmarks, LeFlow replaces iterative action-space optimization with amortized latent planning and fixed-budget rollout selection, achieving consistent success-rate gains with an order-of-magnitude reduction in planning time. Our results argue that latent world models should support not only prediction but reusable planning priors. Our code is available at https://github.com/hsiangwei0903/LeFlow.

AI.title_translation: LeFlow：面向世界模型的生成式潜流规划
AI.tldr: LeFlow将世界模型的在线轨迹优化转化为可复用的潜空间轨迹生成，在大幅提速的同时提升了任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有的潜世界模型虽然能将像素转换为潜嵌入，但动作规划仍依赖于针对每个状态-目标对从头运行的在线迭代优化，计算成本高且无法复用规划经验。因此，作者探讨了在学得潜世界模型后，如何将规划过程进行摊销（amortization）。
AI.method: 利用整流流模型（rectified-flow model）在潜动态空间生成连接当前状态与目标嵌入的未来潜空间路径；通过逆动力学解码器将潜空间转移转化为动作块；利用冻结的世界模型通过自回归前向演练对每个候选方案进行验证。
AI.result: 在四个主要的基于像素控制的目标条件基准测试中，LeFlow用摊销的潜空间规划和固定预算的演练选择替代了迭代动作空间优化，在保持或提升成功率的同时，将规划时间减少了一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: LeFlow成功将动作规划转化为可摊销的潜空间条件轨迹生成，有效解决了传统世界模型中在线轨迹优化计算成本高的问题，在多个基准测试中实现了规划效率和性能的大幅提升。
AI.translation: 潜世界模型本质上是强大的编码器，能够将图像像素转化为潜嵌入，然而现有的世界模型在动作规划时仍然依赖于在线轨迹优化：针对每一个状态-目标对，都需要从头运行迭代优化器来搜索最优动作序列，将世界模型视为黑盒模拟器。这种方法在每个重新规划的步骤中都需要承担全部的迭代优化成本，且无法在不同查询之间复用规划经验。在这项工作中，我们探讨了在学习了潜世界模型后，规划本身是否可以被摊销。我们提出了 LeFlow，它直接在世界模型的潜动态空间中学习一个可复用的潜空间轨迹先验。LeFlow 将规划重新表述为条件潜空间轨迹生成：整流流模型（rectified-flow model）构想当前嵌入与目标嵌入之间的未来潜路径，逆动力学解码器将潜转移转化为动作块，冻结的世界模型则通过自回归前向演练验证每个候选方案。在四个主要的基于像素控制的目标条件基准测试中，LeFlow 用摊销的潜空间规划和固定预算的演练选择替代了迭代动作空间优化，在实现一致的成功率提升的同时，将规划时间减少了一个数量级。我们的结果表明，潜世界模型不仅应支持预测，还应支持可复用的规划先验。代码已开源。
AI.summary: LeFlow提出了一种生成式潜流规划方法，通过学习一个可复用的潜空间轨迹先验，将传统的高成本在线迭代优化转化为条件潜空间轨迹生成，从而在大幅减少规划时间的同时提升了基于潜世界模型的规划性能。
AI.keywords: Latent World Models, Action Planning, Generative Flow, Trajectory Optimization, Amortized Planning
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将规划过程从耗时的在线迭代优化转化为可摊销的条件潜空间轨迹生成，通过引入整流流模型（rectified-flow model）在潜动态空间中生成轨迹，显著提升了基于潜世界模型的动作规划效率，实现了成功率与计算速度的双重突破。

title: The Optimal Asymptotic Rate of Generalized Covering Codes
summary:
Let $G_q$ be an alphabet of size $q\geq2$. We determine the optimal asymptotic rate of generalized covering codes $C\subseteq G_q^n$, whose covering centers in $G_q^{t\times n}$ are constrained to the product form $C^t$. For every fixed integer $t\geq1$ and every $ρ\in[0,1]$, we prove that \[ κ_t(ρ,q)= \begin{cases} 1-H_{q^t}(ρ),&0\leqρ<1-q^{-t},\\ 0,&1-q^{-t}\leqρ\leq1, \end{cases} \] where $κ_t(ρ,q)$ denotes the minimum asymptotic rate $n^{-1}\log_q|C|$ among codes whose $t$-th covering radius is at most $ρn$, and $H_{q^t}$ is the $q^t$-ary entropy function. When $q$ is a prime power, we prove that the same formula holds under the additional requirement that $C\leq\mathbb F_q^n$. Thus, both the product-form constraint and linearity are asymptotically cost-free: the resulting rate is the ordinary sphere-covering rate over an alphabet of size $q^t$. This extends the recent $t=2$ result of Elimelech and Schwartz for codes without a linearity constraint and the classical $t=1$ result of Cohen and Frankl for linear codes, thereby resolving both open problems posed by Elimelech and Schwartz.
  Our proofs are probabilistic and combine tools from information theory and probabilistic combinatorics, including the method of types, Janson's inequality, the second-moment method, and a structured alteration argument. Direct applications of Janson's inequality and the second-moment method are obstructed by highly dependent pairs of candidate error matrices. We overcome this obstruction by restricting the errors to a balanced exact-type class of optimal exponential size. Standard type-class estimates, together with Shearer's inequality, then give the required bounds on the number of error-matrix pairs whose selected rows have a prescribed difference.

AI.title_translation: 广义覆盖码的最优渐近率
AI.tldr: 论文确定了广义覆盖码的最佳渐近率，证明了乘积和线性约束在渐近上不增加编码代价，解决了两个公开问题。
AI.motivation: 确定广义覆盖码的最佳渐近率，并解决由Elimelech和Schwartz提出的关于无线性约束和线性约束的两个公开问题。
AI.method: 采用概率方法，结合信息论与概率组合学工具，包括类型方法、Janson不等式、二阶矩法以及结构化修正论证，并通过限制错误到平衡确切类型类中来克服高度相关的障碍。
AI.result: 证明了对于固定的整数 $t\ge 1$ 和 $\rho \in [0,1]$，广义覆盖码的最优渐近率为 $1-H_{q^t}(\rho)$（当 $\rho < 1-q^{-t}$ 时）及 $0$（当 $\rho \ge 1-q^{-t}$ 时），并且当 $q$ 是素数幂时，线性码也满足相同的公式。
AI.conclusion: 本文完全确定了广义覆盖码的渐近率，并证明了结构约束（乘积形式和线性）在渐近上是无代价的，解决了该领域的两个公开问题。
AI.translation: 设 $G_q$ 是一个大小为 $q\ge 2$ 的字母表。我们确定了广义覆盖码 $C\subseteq G_q^n$ 的最优渐近率，其在 $G_q^{t\times n}$ 中的覆盖中心受限于乘积形式 $C^t$。对于每个固定的整数 $t\ge 1$ 和每个 $\rho\in[0,1]$，我们证明了 $\kappa_t(\rho,q)$ 的公式，其中 $\kappa_t(\rho,q)$ 表示 $t$ 阶覆盖半径至多为 $\rho n$ 的码的最小渐近率。当 $q$ 是素数幂时，我们证明在附加线性要求 $C\le \mathbb{F}_q^n$ 下该公式同样成立。因此，乘积形式约束和线性约束在渐近上都是无代价的：所得的速率是大小为 $q^t$ 的字母表上的普通球覆盖率。这扩展了 Elimelech 和 Schwartz 最近关于无线性约束码的 $t=2$ 结果以及 Cohen 和 Frankl 关于线性码的经典 $t=1$ 结果，从而解决了 Elimelech 和 Schwartz 提出的两个公开问题。我们的证明是概率性质的，结合了信息论和概率组合学的工具，包括类型方法、Janson不等式、二阶矩法以及结构化修正论证。Janson不等式和二阶矩法的直接应用受到高度相关的候选错误矩阵对的阻碍。我们通过将错误限制在最佳指数大小的平衡确切类型类中来克服这一障碍。标准的类型类估计连同 Shearer 不等式，给出了对所选行具有规定差值的错误矩阵对数量所需界限。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了广义覆盖码的最优渐近率，证明了在给定约束下，乘积形式约束和线性约束在渐近上均是无代价的，其渐近率与具有相同参数的标准球覆盖率一致，从而解决了该领域的两个公开问题。
AI.keywords: 覆盖码, 渐近率, 信息论, 概率组合, 线性码
AI.comments: 该论文通过严谨的概率组合与信息论工具，成功解决了广义覆盖码渐近率的长期公开问题，证明了乘积形式约束和线性约束在渐近意义上是没有代价的。其技术亮点在于克服了错误矩阵高度相关的障碍，具有很高的理论价值。

title: Prompt Structure Redistributes, Not Reduces: An Empirical Analysis of Security-Weaknesses in LLM-Generated Python Code
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly generate code from natural-language prompts, making prompt engineering a key mechanism for shaping the security of generated software. Structured and security-oriented prompts are widely used to encourage safer code, yet their effects extend beyond whether detected weaknesses are simply present or absent. Using 424 security-sensitive Python tasks, we generate solutions with GPT-4o and LLaMA 3.1-8B under five prompt variants that progressively add structural and security guidance, and evaluate them with Bandit and CodeQL along two axes: generation compliance and security weakness prevalence, severity, and CWE distributions. Structured prompting substantially reduces refusals (e.g., GPT-4o invalid outputs drop from 338 of 424 to 37-52), enabling large-scale analysis, but security-oriented refinements do not consistently reduce overall weakness prevalence. For GPT-4o, stronger prompts primarily redistribute risk: high-severity findings fall (20.8% to 13.6%) while low-severity findings rise (32% to 43.5%); LLaMA shows weaker, less consistent shifts. We also observe security-driven semantic drift, where stricter prompts silently remove or rewrite explicitly requested unsafe constructs. Overall, prompt structure improves compliance but is an unreliable substitute for robust security controls in LLM-assisted development.

AI.title_translation: 提示结构重新分配而非减少：大模型生成Python代码中安全弱点的实证分析
AI.tldr: 提示词结构化和安全指导无法减少大模型生成代码的总体漏洞，而是将高危漏洞转化为低危漏洞，并导致语义漂移，因此不能替代真正的安全控制。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型广泛用于根据自然语言提示生成代码，结构化和面向安全的提示被广泛用于鼓励更安全的编码，但其对代码安全性的具体影响（不仅仅是存在与否）缺乏深入的实证分析。
AI.method: 使用424个对安全敏感的Python任务，在GPT-4o和LLaMA 3.1-8B模型下测试了5种不同结构和安全指导的提示词变体，并通过Bandit和CodeQL工具从生成合规性、安全弱点普遍性、严重程度及CWE分布等方面进行评估。
AI.result: 结构化提示显著降低了模型拒绝率并减少了无效输出；然而，安全导向的优化并未一致减少整体漏洞，对于GPT-4o而言，更强的提示词主要起到了重新分配风险的作用（高严重性问题从20.8%降至13.6%，而低严重性问题从32%升至43.5%），同时伴随安全驱动的语义漂移。
AI.conclusion: 提示词结构化虽然能显著提高生成合规性并减少拒绝率，但无法可靠地减少代码中的整体安全弱点，因此不能替代传统的稳健安全控制措施。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地根据自然语言提示生成代码，这使得提示词工程成为塑造生成软件安全性的关键机制。结构化和面向安全的提示被广泛用于鼓励编写更安全的代码，但其影响不仅限于检测到的弱点是简单存在还是不存在。利用424个对安全敏感的Python任务，我们在GPT-4o和LLaMA 3.1-8B模型下，使用逐步添加结构和安全指导的五种提示词变体生成了解决方案，并通过Bandit和CodeQL从生成合规性和安全弱点的普遍性、严重程度及CWE分布两个维度进行评估。结构化提示显著减少了拒绝响应（例如，GPT-4o的无效输出从424个中的338个下降到37-52个），从而支持了大规模分析，但面向安全的优化并未一致减少整体弱点的普遍性。对于GPT-4o而言，更强的提示词主要重新分配了风险：高严重性问题下降（从20.8%降至13.6%），而低严重性问题上升（从32%降至43.5%）；LLaMA显示出更弱且更不一致的变化。我们还观察到安全驱动的语义漂移，即更严格的提示词会静默删除或重写显式请求的不安全结构。总体而言，提示结构提高了合规性，但对于LLM辅助开发而言，它并不是可靠的安全控制替代品。
AI.summary: 该论文对大语言模型生成的Python代码中的安全弱点进行了实证分析，发现提示词结构和安全指导并未减少整体漏洞，而是重新分配了漏洞的严重性，并引发了语义漂移。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 代码生成, 提示词工程, 软件安全, 漏洞分析
AI.comments: 该论文通过实证分析揭示了提示词结构化和安全导向对大模型生成代码安全性的双重影响，指出提示词不能简单消除漏洞而是重分配风险，对安全软件工程领域有重要警示意义。

title: Bellman Calibration for Marginalized Importance Weighting in Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Marginalized importance weighting evaluates a target policy by reweighting offline state-action samples with its discounted occupancy ratio, characterized by an adjoint Bellman equation. Existing minimax, primal-dual, and fitted fixed-point estimators can leave residual occupancy-balance violations because of function-class approximation, regularization, or incomplete optimization. These violations are difficult to diagnose and reduce because the objectives generally lack a direct supervised validation loss for hyperparameter tuning, model selection, and early stopping. We introduce isotonic Bellman calibration, a one-dimensional, model-agnostic post-processing method that reduces these violations while preserving the ranking information in any initial occupancy-ratio estimate. The method corrects the estimate's scale and shape by applying fitted occupancy-ratio evaluation (FORE) over a one-dimensional class of nondecreasing transformations. We characterize Bellman calibration as a conditional fixed-point property equivalent to occupancy-balance against every test function of the calibrated ratio. More generally, we derive a calibration-refinement bound showing that any fitted ratio with small calibration error performs nearly as well as the best post-processing based on its fitted values. For isotonic Bellman calibration, we establish finite-sample calibration guarantees and a KL oracle inequality relative to the best monotone transformation of the initial estimate. Consequently, isotonic Bellman calibration achieves small calibration error and KL risk within statistical error of the best monotone correction, with guarantees for downstream target-occupancy functionals, including policy-value estimation.

AI.title_translation: 离线强化学习中边缘化重要性加权的贝尔曼校准
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新颖的保序贝尔曼校准方法，用于解决离线强化学习中边缘化重要性加权的占优平衡违背问题，具备强有力的理论和泛化保证。
AI.motivation: 现有的极大极小、原对偶和拟合不动点估计器由于函数类近似、正则化或不完全优化，会产生残差占优平衡违背，且缺乏直接用于超模型选择和早期停止的监督验证损失。
AI.method: 引入等渗贝尔曼校准（isotonic Bellman calibration），这是一种一维、与模型无关的后处理方法，通过在一维非递减变换类上应用拟合占优比例评估（FORE）来修正估计的尺度和形状。
AI.result: 建立了贝尔曼校准的条件不动点性质、标定-精炼界、有限样本校准保证以及关于最佳单调变换的KL预言机不等式，证明了其在下游目标占优泛函（如策略价值估计）上的良好性能。
AI.conclusion: 提出的等渗贝尔曼校准方法能够有效减少占优平衡违背，保持初始估计的排序信息，并在统计误差范围内达到最佳单调修正的效果，对下游策略价值估计具有重要意义。
AI.translation: 边缘化重要性加权通过其折扣占优比（由伴随贝尔曼方程表征）重新加权离线状态-动作样本来评估目标策略。由于函数类近似、正则化或不完全优化，现有的极大极小、原对偶和拟合不动点估计器可能会留下残差占优平衡违背。这些违背很难诊断和减少，因为目标通常缺乏直接的监督验证损失来进行超参数调优、模型选择和早期停止。我们引入了等渗贝尔曼校准（isotonic Bellman calibration），这是一种一维、模型无关的后处理方法，它在保持任何初始占优比估计中的排序信息的同时减少了这些违背。该方法通过在一维非递减变换类上应用拟合占优比评估（FORE），修正了估计的尺度和形状。我们将贝尔曼校准特征化为一个条件不动点性质，该性质等价于对校准比率的每个测试函数的占优平衡。更一般地，我们导出了一个校准-精炼界，表明具有小校准误差的任何拟合比率的表现几乎与基于其拟合值的最佳后处理一样好。对于等渗贝尔曼校准，我们建立了有限样本校准保证以及相对于初始估计的最佳单调变换的KL预言机不等式。因此，等渗贝尔曼校准在最佳单调修正的统计误差内实现了小的校准误差和KL风险，并对下游目标占优泛函（包括策略价值估计）提供了保证。
AI.summary: 该论文针对离线强化学习中占优平衡违背难以诊断和减少的问题，提出了一种新颖的一维保序贝尔曼校准方法，在保持初始排序信息的同时显著降低了校准误差，并提供了完善的理论保证。
AI.keywords: 离线强化学习, 边缘化重要性加权, 贝尔曼校准, 保序回归, 策略评估
AI.comments: 该论文针对离线强化学习中边缘化重要性权重估计的残差占优平衡违背问题，提出了一种新颖且模型无关的一维保序贝尔曼校准方法。这一方法不仅在理论上具备有限样本校准保证和KL预言机不等式，还为超参数调优和模型选择提供了有效的监督验证损失。

title: Improving Cross-Problem Vehicle Routing with Locally Augmented Preferences and Representation Disentanglement
summary: Multi-task vehicle routing problem (VRP) solvers seek to handle multiple VRP variants within a single unified model, avoiding the need to train a separate model for every variant. In spite of recent progress, current approaches remain limited on two fronts. On the training side, reinforcement learning suffers from reward-scale disparities and shrinking advantage signals as policies improve, whereas preference optimization stagnates once sampled tours become near-identical and thus fundamentally limited by the quality of the policy's own generated solutions, leaving both paradigms with weak supervision as training progresses. On the architecture side, existing fully shared encoders entangle constraint-dependent representations across heterogeneous variants, which limits generalization. We address these gaps with two model-agnostic contributions. First, we propose Preference Optimization with Locally Augmented Refinement (POLAR), a novel training algorithm that applies a local search refinement pass to the best decoded tour before forming preference pairs, yielding much more informative pairwise margins. Second, a Progressive Layered Extraction (PLE) encoder routes each encoder layer through one shared expert and a set of task-specific experts via a gating mechanism, progressively separating common routing structure from constraint-specific encodings. Through extensive experiments on various VRP variants, we show that POLAR and PLE together elevate the current state-of-the-art among neural multi-task solvers. We reduce the average gap to reference solutions by 21.3% relative to the strongest published baseline on 16 in-distribution variants, and outperform prior neural methods on 27 out of 32 unseen variants. Ablation studies confirm the efficacy of each contribution, showing that both improve cross-problem generalization across multiple backbone model architectures.

AI.title_translation: 通过局部增强偏好与表征解耦改进跨问题车辆路径规划
AI.tldr: 提出POLAR训练算法与PLE编码器，解决了多任务车辆路径求解中的弱监督与特征纠缠难题，显著提升了跨问题泛化能力并创下性能新高。
AI.motivation: 现有的一体化多任务车辆路径问题（VRP）求解器在训练和架构上面临两大局限：强化学习存在奖励尺度差异和优势信号萎缩问题，传统偏好优化受限于生成方案质量导致监督信号弱；全共享编码器导致异构变体间的约束依赖表征相互纠缠，限制了模型的泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出了两种与模型无关的创新方法：1）POLAR训练算法，对最优解码路径应用局部搜索求精后再形成偏好对；2）PLE编码器，通过门控机制将每个编码器层路由到一个共享专家和一组任务特定专家，逐步分离通用路由结构与约束特定编码。
AI.result: 在16个同分布变体上，平均相对参考解的差距比最强的已发布基线缩减了21.3%；在32个未见过的变体中，有27个变体的表现优于先前的神经方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过POLAR和PLE的协同作用，该方法有效克服了强化学习与传统偏好优化的局限，解决了异构变体中的特征纠缠问题，在多个已知和未知的VRP变体上取得了当前最优（SOTA）的性能。
AI.translation: 多任务车辆路径问题（VRP）求解器旨在单个统一模型中处理多个VRP变体，从而避免为每个变体训练单独模型的需要。尽管近期取得了进展，但当前方法在两个方面仍然受到限制。在训练方面，随着策略的改进，强化学习遭受奖励尺度差异和优势信号收缩的困扰，而一旦采样路径变得接近一致，偏好优化就会停滞不前，因此从根本上受到策略自身生成解质量的限制，导致两种范式在训练进行时都只有弱监督。在架构方面，现有的完全共享编码器将异构变体间的约束依赖表征纠缠在一起，限制了泛化能力。我们通过两项与模型无关的贡献来解决这些差距。首先，我们提出了带局部增强求精的偏好优化（POLAR），这是一种新颖的训练算法，它在形成偏好对之前，将局部搜索求精通道应用于最佳解码路径，从而产生信息更丰富的成对边际。其次，渐进分层提取（PLE）编码器通过门控机制将每个编码器层路由到一个共享专家和一组任务特定专家，逐步将通用路由结构与约束特定编码分离。通过对各种VRP变体的广泛实验，我们表明POLAR和PLE共同提升了当前神经多任务求解器的最新技术水平。在16个同分布变体上，相对于最强的已发布基线，我们将与参考解的平均差距相对缩减了21.3%，并且在32个未见过的变体中的27个上优于先前的神经方法。消融实验证实了每项贡献的有效性，表明这两者都改善了跨多个骨干模型架构的跨问题泛化能力。
AI.summary: 该论文针对多任务车辆路径问题提出了一种改进的通用求解框架。通过引入局部增强偏好优化（POLAR）算法提供更具信息量的成对边际监督，以及采用渐进分层提取（PLE）编码器实现通用路由结构与约束特定表征的解耦，实验证明该方法显著提升了跨问题的泛化能力，并在多个VRP变体上达到了最先进的性能。
AI.keywords: 车辆路径问题, 多任务求解器, 偏好优化, 表征解耦, 强化学习
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地结合了局部增强偏好优化（POLAR）与渐进分层提取（PLE）编码器，有效解决了多任务车辆路径问题（VRP）中由于监督信号弱和特征纠缠导致的泛化瓶颈，显著提升了模型在多个VRP变体上的跨问题泛化能力。

title: Parameterized Complexity of $L_p$-Lipschitz Constants for Input Convex Neural Networks and $L_p$-Norm Maximization over Zonotopes
summary:
Lipschitz constants are a standard way to quantify the sensitivity of neural networks to small input perturbations, but computing them is difficult even for shallow ReLU networks. We study this problem for two-layer input-convex neural networks (ICNNs), a restricted architecture where nonnegative output weights enforce convexity. Computing the $L_p$-Lipschitz constant for these networks is equivalent to maximizing the dual norm over a zonotope. While $L_1$- and $L_\infty$-norm maximization on zonotopes admit fixed-parameter and polynomial-time algorithms, respectively, the parameterized complexity of the remaining $L_p$-norms was open. We prove that, for every fixed $p\in (1,\infty)\cap \mathbb{Q}$, maximizing the $L_p$-norm over a zonotope in $\mathbb{R}^d$ is W[1]-hard with respect to the dimension $d$. Moreover, our hardness results imply that brute-force enumeration algorithms are essentially optimal for this problem under the Exponential Time Hypothesis. By duality, the same hardness results hold for computing the $L_p$-Lipschitz constant of two-layer ReLU ICNNs. Our proof first establishes the result for the $L_2$-norm and then transfers the construction to arbitrary fixed $p\in (1,\infty)\cap\mathbb{Q}$ using a suitable Taylor approximation. These results resolve the corresponding questions regarding the parameterized complexity status for zonotope norm maximization and two-layer ICNN Lipschitz constants.
  Our paper resolves an open problem posted at COLT'25. There are several independent concurrent papers resolving the same problem. Our paper prioritizes a clear exposition of the underlying mathematics and conceptual intuitions behind the proof. Additionally, we explicitly describe our research process including the use of LLMs.

AI.title_translation: 输入凸神经网络与Zonotope上$L_p$范数最大化的$L_p$-Lipschitz常数的参数化复杂性
AI.tldr: 论文证明了计算两层凸神经网络的 $L_p$-Lipschitz 常数（以及 zonotope 上的 $L_p$ 范数最大化）对于任意 $p \in (1,\infty)$ 是 W[1]-hard 的，解决了 COLT'25 的公开问题。
AI.motivation: 尽管 $L_1$ 和 $L_\infty$ 范数在zonotope上的最大化存在固定参数和多项式时间算法，但其余 $p$ 范数的参数化复杂性长期以来一直悬而未决，作者旨在解决这一COLT'25提出的公开问题。
AI.method: 通过建立 $L_2$ 范数的结果，并利用适当的泰勒近似将构造推广到任意固定的 $p\in (1,\infty)\cap\mathbb{Q}$，从而证明W[1]-hardness。
AI.result: 证明了对于每一个固定的 $p\in (1,\infty)\cap \mathbb{Q}$，在 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 的 zonotope 上最大化 $L_p$ 范数（以及计算两层ReLU ICNN的 $L_p$-Lipschitz 常数）关于维度 $d$ 是 W[1]-hard 的。
AI.conclusion: 对于任意固定的 $p\in (1,\infty)\cap \mathbb{Q}$，在维度 $d$ 作为参数的条件下，在zonotope上最大化 $L_p$ 范数以及计算两层ReLU ICNN的 $L_p$-Lipschitz 常数是 W[1]-hard 的，且在指数时间假设下暴力枚举算法本质上是最优的。
AI.translation:
Lipschitz常数是量化神经网络对微小输入扰动敏感性的标准方法，但即使对于浅层ReLU网络，计算它们也很困难。我们研究了两层输入凸神经网络（ICNNs）这一问题的输入凸神经网络（ICNNs），这是一种非负输出权重强制凸性的受限架构。计算这些网络的 $L_p$-Lipschitz 常数等价于在 zonotope 上最大化对偶范数。虽然 zonotope 上的 $L_1$ 和 $L_\infty$ 范数最大化分别承认固定参数算法和多项式时间算法，但其余 $p$ 范数的参数化复杂性仍未解决。我们证明，对于 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 中 zonotope 上的每一个固定 $p\in (1,\infty)\cap \mathbb{Q}$，最大化 $L_p$ 范数关于维度 $d$ 是 W[1]-hard 的。此外，我们的难解性结果表明，在指数时间假设下，暴力枚举算法对于该问题本质上是最优的。通过对偶性，同样的难解性结果也适用于计算两层 ReLU ICNN 的 $L_p$-Lipschitz 常数。我们的证明首先确立了 $L_2$ 范数的结果，然后使用合适的泰勒近似将构造转移到任意固定的 $p\in (1,\infty)\cap\mathbb{Q}$。这些结果解决了关于 zonotope 范数最大化和两层 ICNN Lipschitz 常数的参数化复杂性状态的相应问题。
我们的论文解决了在 COLT'25 上发布的一个公开问题。有几个独立的同期论文解决了同一个问题。我们的论文优先对证明背后的底层数学和概念直觉进行清晰的阐述。此外，我们明确描述了我们的研究过程，包括LLMs的使用。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了两层输入凸神经网络（ICNNs）的 $L_p$-Lipschitz 常数计算以及在 zonotope 上的 $L_p$ 范数最大化问题的参数化复杂性。通过将 $L_2$ 范数的结果通过泰勒近似推广，作者证明了当 $p\in (1,\infty)$ 时该问题是 W[1]-hard 的，解决了 COLT'25 提出的公开问题。
AI.keywords: Lipschitz constants, Input Convex Neural Networks, Zonotopes, Parameterized Complexity, W[1]-hard
AI.comments: 该论文解决了COLT'25上提出的一个公开问题，具有重要的理论价值。作者通过精巧的归约和泰勒近似证明了当 $p\in (1,\infty)$ 时，计算I-CNN的 $L_p$-Lipschitz常数及相关zonotope范数最大化问题是W[1]-hard的，排除了多项式时间算法存在的可能性，且结果在指数时间假设下表明暴力枚举已属最优。此外，文章展示了清晰的数学直觉，并透明地记录了LLMs在研究过程中的使用。

title: Lower Bounds for Linear Hashing via Arithmetic Kakeya
summary: Affine modular linear hashing is one of the simplest classical hash families. For a prime $p > u$, the hash function is obtained by choosing $s,t$ uniformly from $\mathbb{Z}_p$ and mapping each key $x \in \{0,\ldots,u-1\}$ to one of $n$ bins by $h(x) = [(sx+t) \bmod p] \bmod n$. Despite its simplicity, the maximum load of linear hashing remains poorly understood. For $n$ keys hashed into $n$ bins, the best known upper bound is $O((n \log n)^{1/3})$, whereas the best known lower bound is only $Ω(\log n / \log\log n)$. We prove a lower bound of $\exp(Ω(\log n / \log\log n))$ for universes of size $n^{1+o(1)}$. Surprisingly, there is a key set for which this load holds not just in expectation, but for every random seed. The proof is driven by two simple reductions: one transfers lower bounds from a real version of linear hashing to modular linear hashing, and the other transfers arithmetic Kakeya constructions to real hashing. We further show that, for sufficiently large $p$, the expected maximum loads in the modular and real settings are essentially the same, giving an alternative route to an $n^{1/3+o(1)}$ upper bound. Finally, we show that any uniform subpolynomial upper bound for either setting would imply a polynomial-length arithmetic Kakeya conjecture and hence the Kakeya conjecture for upper Minkowski dimension.

AI.title_translation: 通过算术Kakeya猜想建立线性哈希的下限
AI.tldr: 通过联系算术Kakeya猜想，论文大幅提升了经典线性哈希最大负载的下限，证明了其接近多项式的增长速度。
AI.motivation: 仿射模线性哈希虽然是经典且最简单的哈希族之一，但其最大负载长期以来理解不足，现有的上下界之间存在巨大差距（上界为 $O((n \log n)^{1/3})$，下界仅为 $\Omega(\log n / \log\log n)$），亟需更紧密的理论界。
AI.method: 通过两个关键约简：首先将实数线性哈希的下限转移到模线性哈希，其次将算术Kakeya构造转移到实数哈希；同时利用算术Kakeya猜想建立上下界联系。
AI.result: 证明了对于 $n^{1+o(1)}$ 大小的论域，线性哈希的最大负载下限为 $\exp(\Omega(\log n / \log\log n))$，且对某个特定的键集，该负载对每个随机种子均成立；同时给出了 $n^{1/3+o(1)}$ 上界的新证明路线，并证明了任何亚多项式上界都将蕴含算术Kakeya猜想。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明了仿射模线性哈希的极强下限，并通过约简展示了其与算术Kakeya猜想的深层联系，为理解哈希函数的最大负载提供了全新的几何视角。
AI.translation: 仿射模线性哈希是最简单的经典哈希族之一。对于一个素数 $p > u$，哈希函数通过从 $\mathbb{Z}_p$ 中均匀随机选择 $s, t$，将每个键 $x \in \{0,\ldots,u-1\}$ 映射到 $n$ 个桶中的一个，映射规则为 $h(x) = [(sx+t) \bmod p] \bmod n$。尽管其很简单，但线性哈希的最大负载仍然没有被很好地理解。对于 $n$ 个键哈希到 $n$ 个桶中，目前已知的最好上界是 $O((n \log n)^{1/3})$，而最好下界仅为 $\Omega(\log n / \log\log n)$。我们针对大小为 $n^{1+o(1)}$ 的论域，证明了 $\exp(\Omega(\log n / \log\log n))$ 的下限。令人惊讶的是，存在一个键集，对于该键集，这种负载不仅在期望意义下成立，而且对每一个随机种子都成立。该证明由两个简单的约简驱动：一个将实数版本线性哈希的下限转移到模线性哈希，另一个将算术Kakeya构造转移到实数哈希。我们进一步证明，对于足够大的 $p$，模设置和实数设置下的期望最大负载基本相同，从而为 $n^{1/3+o(1)}$ 的上界提供了另一条途径。最后，我们证明了这两种设置下的任何一致次多项式上界都将蕴含多项式长度的算术Kakeya猜想，进而蕴含上闵可夫维数的Kakeya猜想。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了经典仿射模线性哈希的最大负载问题，通过引入算术Kakeya构造和巧妙的约简方法，将线性哈希的下限大幅提升至 $\exp(\Omega(\log n / \log\log n))$，并揭示了该问题与数学中Kakeya猜想的内在联系。
AI.keywords: Linear Hashing, Arithmetic Kakeya, Maximum Load, Lower Bound, Modular Hashing
AI.comments: 该论文通过巧妙地将线性哈希的下限问题与算术Kakeya猜想联系起来，在解决长期悬而未决的线性哈希最大负载问题上取得了突破性进展，不仅给出了接近多项式的下限，还建立了与几何测度论中Kakeya猜想的深刻联系。

title: SPO++: Stream-Aligned Policy Optimization for Asynchronous Agentic RL
summary: Group-relative reinforcement learning waits for sibling rollouts of the same prompt, which is costly for long and variable tool-use trajectories. Single-stream Policy Optimization (SPO) removes this dependency with a persistent prompt-level value estimate, but its recipe whitens one advantage per trajectory before optimizing a token-mean actor loss. We show that trajectory centering generally does not center the token-weighted quantity consumed by the actor, and fix the mismatch by standardizing terminal-outcome advantages under the action-token measure. We additionally organize prompt evidence by the policy event that generated it rather than learner receipt order. Across matched runs on ALFWorld at two model scales and on Math-TIR, SPO++ improves online learning efficiency over SPO. A paired ablation identifies action-token-measure normalization as the strongest tested component.

title: Recursive Experiential-Working Memory Evolution for Long-Horizon Agent Harnesses
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) remains hard in long-horizon tasks, where growing histories obscure the task state and misalign skill invocation. We introduce Recuris, a recursive Experiential-Working Memory architecture for long-horizon agent harnesses, in which Working Memory tracks task progress and guides skill selection from Experiential Memory, grounding skill use in current needs rather than the full history. This coupling also turns execution into structured evidence that localizes failures to specific memory components. Across tasks, a fixed Meta-Agent turns that evidence into localized, validation-gated updates to Skill Memory that reshape execution and yield new evidence, forming a bounded recursive memory-evolution loop. Across four long-horizon benchmarks and ten models, Recuris improves task success in 35 of the 37 completed model-benchmark pairs, carrying frontier models to SOTA-level task success: on tau-bench it adds +17.8 points to GPT-5.6 Sol and +15.6 to Claude Opus 5, taking Opus 5 to 87.9%, and +16.6/+13.5 points on Qwen3.6-27B/35B on SkillFlow. The advantage widens as the interaction horizon grows, to +32.2 points on the longest tasks, and common long-horizon failures fall by up to 80%. These results position recursively evolving memory as a scalable foundation for RSI, enabling agents to continuously transform accumulated experience into increasingly effective long-horizon behavior. Code: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/Recuris

title: From Seeing to Acting: Smart Glasses as First-Person Intelligence Platforms
summary: Smart glasses are evolving from capture and display accessories into first-person intelligence platforms that connect human perception, persistent context, and digital or physical action. Their on-body viewpoint aligns with the wearer's vision, audition, motion, and hand-object interaction, but must operate under tight energy, thermal, privacy, and feedback constraints. Despite rapid progress in augmented reality, egocentric vision, multimodal models, human-computer interaction, and embodied intelligence, the literature remains fragmented across devices, tasks, and benchmarks. \textit{The key challenge is not whether a model can recognize, answer, remember, or act in isolation, but whether a complete system can sustain a reliable, temporally valid, correctable, and governable perception-state-interaction-action loop.} This survey is \textit{the \textbf{first} to systematically study smart glasses through such a unified framework}. We formalize first-person data flow and constrained task utility, characterize devices along eight verifiable hardware capability axes, organize the literature around seven interdependent foundational capabilities, and introduce an L0-L5 framework spanning capture, reactive perception, contextual assistance, persistent state, governed action, and embodied coupling. Across nine application scenes, we connect tasks with datasets, systems, products, stakeholders, failure consequences, and evidence gaps. We further present a nine-dimensional deployment framework, a claim-conditioned evaluation protocol, and an evidence ladder from controlled measurement to longitudinal field validation and audit. Together, these elements make smart glasses more comparable, deployable, and reproducibly evaluated, while outlining a roadmap toward trustworthy first-person intelligence.

title: Latent Action as Intention Enables Efficient Future Imagination for World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) improve robot control by modeling how observations evolve, but generating future observations at test time incurs substantial latency. Fast-WAM removes this process for efficiency; however, our matched implementations show lower generalization for Fast-WAM than for future-aware alternatives, especially with scarce robot demonstrations and in out-of-distribution scenarios. To bridge this gap, we introduce **LAWA**, a WAM architecture that uses compact latent actions as an operational representation of future intentions, enabling efficient test-time future imagination without generating future observations. Specifically, a discrete tokenizer enhanced by action-free pre-training produces manipulation-centric codebook targets. LAWA jointly denoises a continuous latent state anchored to these targets with executable action chunks while omitting the future-video branch at inference. On RoboCasa, LAWA achieves state-of-the-art average success rates of 65.6% and 80.8% in the few-shot and full data settings, improving over the matched Fast-WAM baseline by 9.6 and 4.5 points, respectively. It also preserves the performance level of the matched Joint-WAM variant while requiring 42.9% lower inference latency. LAWA also demonstrates competitive zero-shot robustness on LIBERO-Plus and superior performance on real-world tasks. These results show that future imagination need not be discarded: retaining it with compact latent actions yields an effective trade-off among performance, generalization, and latency. Code and models will be released.

AI.title_translation: 将潜动作作为意图实现世界动作模型的高效未来想象
AI.tldr: 提出 LAWA 架构，利用潜在动作作为意图表示，在实现高效推理的同时保持了卓越的机器人控制泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统的世界动作为模型（WAM）在测试时生成未来观测会产生大量延迟，而消除该过程的 Fast-WAM 方法虽然提高了效率，但泛化能力较差（尤其是在演示稀缺和分布外场景下）。因此，需要一种既能保持高效推理又能保留未来想象优势的方法。
AI.method: 提出 LAWA 架构，采用带有无动作预训练的离散分词器生成以操作为中心的代码簿目标，并联合去噪锚定于这些目标的连续潜在状态以及可执行的动作块，在推理时省略未来视频分支。
AI.result: 在 RoboCasa 上，LAWA 在少样本和全量数据设置下分别达到了 65.6% 和 80.8% 的最优平均成功率，比 Fast-WAM 分别提升了 9.6 和 4.5 个百分点，同时推理延迟比 Joint-WAM 降低了 42.9%，在 LIBERO-Plus 和真实世界任务中也表现出优越的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过使用紧凑的潜在动作作为未来意图的操作表示，LAWA 在不生成未来观测的情况下实现了高效的测试时未来想象，成功兼顾了高性能、强泛化能力与低推理延迟。
AI.translation: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过对观测演变过程进行建模来改善机器人控制，但在测试时生成未来观测会产生显着的延迟。Fast-WAM 移除了这一过程以提高效率；然而，我们的对比实验表明，与感知未来的替代方案相比，Fast-WAM 的泛化能力较低，尤其是在机器人演示稀缺和分布外场景下。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了 **LAWA**，这是一种 WAM 架构，它使用紧凑的潜在动作作为未来意图的操作表示，从而在不生成未来观测的情况下实现高效的测试时未来想象。具体而言，由无动作预训练增强的离散分词器会产生以操作为中心的代码簿目标。LAWA 联合去噪了锚定于这些目标的连续潜在状态以及可执行的动作块，同时在推理时省略了未来视频分支。在 RoboCasa 上，LAWA 在少样本和完整数据设置下分别取得了 65.6% 和 80.8% 的 SOTA 平均成功率，比匹配的 Fast-WAM 基线分别提高了 9.6 和 4.5 个百分点。它还保持了与匹配的 Joint-WAM 变体相当的性能水平，同时推理延迟降低了 42.9%。LAWA 还在 LIBERO-Plus 上表现出有竞争力的零样本鲁棒性，并在真实世界任务中表现出优异的性能。这些结果表明，未来意图的想象无需被摒弃：通过紧凑的潜在动作保留它可以实现性能、泛化和延迟之间的有效权衡。代码和模型将开源。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了 LAWA，这是一种新型的世界动作模型（WAM）架构，它将紧凑的潜在动作作为未来意图的紧凑表示。通过联合去噪连续潜伏状态和动作块，同时在推理时省略未来视频分支，LAWA 在不牺牲泛化能力的前提下实现了高效的测试时未来想象，在仿真和真实世界任务中均表现出优异的性能和效率。
AI.keywords: World Action Models, Latent Action, Robot Control, Future Imagination, Imitation Learning
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的世界动作为模型架构 LAWA，通过引入紧凑的潜在动作作为未来意图的操作表示，巧妙地平衡了机器人控制中的泛化性能与推理延迟，在少样本和全量数据设置下均取得了显著的性能提升。

title: Do Robotic World Models Really Follow Actions? Diagnosing and Aligning Action-Conditioned Generation for Policy Learning
summary: Action-conditioned world models are increasingly used as learned simulators for policy evaluation and improvement, yet their effectiveness rests on an unverified assumption: generated futures faithfully reflect arbitrary valid actions. Existing benchmarks are typically confined to expert demonstrations, leaving off-expert action following inadequately evaluated. To address this gap, we introduce WorldEcho, which probes action following over a broader action distribution using visual integrity and SE(3) trajectory alignment. Our diagnosis shows that current world models reasonably execute expert actions but struggle with diverse off-expert trajectories, either ignoring the commanded actions or producing visually invalid rollouts. We further propose WorldSync, which strengthens action following along three complementary axes: distributional coverage, representational grounding, and intervention-effect alignment. It broadens the training distribution over action consequences, grounds intermediate video representations in action-induced robot dynamics through an Action-Forcing Expert, and aligns predicted changes under action interventions with the corresponding changes in ground-truth futures. Experiments on RoboTwin benchmarks and real-robot tasks show that WorldSync improves WorldEcho metrics and serves as a more reliable simulator for iterative policy improvement, enabling policies to achieve higher success rates.

AI.title_translation: 机器人世界模型真的遵循动作吗？诊断和校准用于策略学习的动作条件生成
AI.tldr: 现有机器人世界模型在非专家动作下表现不佳。本文引入WorldEcho诊断，并提出WorldSync通过扩展训练分布、动作动态接地和干预效应校准来改进模型，使其成为更可靠的策略学习模拟器。
AI.motivation: 动作条件世界模型作为策略评估和改进的学习模拟器越来越受欢迎，但其有效性基于一个未经验证的假设：生成的未来忠实地反映了任意有效动作。现有基准通常仅限于专家演示，未能充分评估非专家动作的遵循情况。
AI.method: 论文首先引入WorldEcho来探测更广泛动作分布下的动作遵循情况，使用视觉完整性和SE(3)轨迹对齐进行诊断。然后提出WorldSync，通过三个互补轴线加强动作遵循：1) 扩大动作后果的训练分布；2) 通过动作强制专家将中间视频表征与动作引起的机器人动力学相结合；3) 将动作干预下的预测变化与真实未来中的相应变化对齐。
AI.result: 诊断结果显示，当前世界模型能合理执行专家动作，但在处理多样化的非专家轨迹时表现不佳，要么忽略指令动作，要么产生视觉上无效的展开。WorldSync在RoboTwin基准和真实机器人任务上的实验表明，它改进了WorldEcho指标，并作为迭代策略改进的更可靠模拟器，使策略能够实现更高的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 现有的动作条件世界模型在非专家动作遵循方面存在显著不足。通过引入诊断工具WorldEcho和改进方法WorldSync，可以显著提升世界模型在更广泛动作分布下的动作遵循能力，从而使其成为更可靠、更有效的策略学习模拟器，并提高策略的成功率。
AI.translation: 动作条件世界模型正越来越多地被用作策略评估和改进的学习模拟器，然而其有效性依赖于一个未经证实的假设：生成的未来忠实地反映了任意有效的动作。现有基准通常仅限于专家演示，未能充分评估非专家动作的遵循情况。为了弥补这一空白，我们引入了WorldEcho，它利用视觉完整性和SE(3)轨迹对齐，探测更广泛动作分布下的动作遵循情况。我们的诊断表明，当前的世界模型能合理执行专家动作，但在处理多样化的非专家轨迹时表现不佳，要么忽略指令动作，要么产生视觉上无效的展开。我们进一步提出了WorldSync，它沿着三个互补轴线加强动作遵循：分布覆盖、表征接地和干预效应对齐。它扩展了动作后果的训练分布，通过动作强制专家将中间视频表征与动作引起的机器人动力学相结合，并使动作干预下的预测变化与真实未来中的相应变化对齐。在RoboTwin基准和真实机器人任务上的实验表明，WorldSync改进了WorldEcho指标，并作为迭代策略改进的更可靠模拟器，使策略能够实现更高的成功率。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了机器人世界模型在遵循非专家动作方面的不足。通过引入诊断工具WorldEcho，发现现有模型在处理多样化非专家轨迹时表现不佳。为解决此问题，提出了WorldSync方法，它通过扩大训练分布、将视频表征与机器人动力学相结合以及对齐干预效应来增强动作遵循能力。实验证明，WorldSync显著提高了世界模型的可靠性，使其成为更有效的策略学习模拟器，从而提升了策略的成功率。
AI.keywords: 机器人世界模型, 动作条件生成, 策略学习, WorldEcho, WorldSync
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过明确指出并解决了机器人世界模型在非专家动作遵循方面的关键局限性，具有重要的创新性。它不仅提出了一个有效的诊断工具WorldEcho，还开发了WorldSync这一综合性方法来改进模型性能。通过关注非专家轨迹，论文解决了现有基准的盲点，并为构建更鲁棒、更通用的机器人策略学习模拟器提供了有价值的方向。其对训练分布、表征接地和干预效应的关注，为未来世界模型的设计提供了新的思路。

title: Symbolic Classification-Enabled LHC Limits Online BSM Global Fits
summary: Global fits of Beyond the Standard Model (BSM) physics often involve a two-way interplay between theory and experiment. Theoretical models provide guidance for experimental searches, while experimental results, in turn, constrain theoretical frameworks. A crucial aspect of this feedback loop is the direct inclusion of measurements and exclusion limits ``online'' global fits, i.e. during the parameter scans aspects of the global fits. However, incorporating the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) limits into such analyses has been computationally prohibitive, often due to time taken per parameter point exceeding the scales acceptable for global fit frameworks. In this study, we show that LHC limits can be incorporated ``online'' global fits by leveraging approximations derived from symbolic regression techniques. We utilize a dataset of ATLAS constraints from searches for electroweakino productions to derive a mathematical expression capable of classifying the phenomenological Minimal Supersymmetric Standard Model (pMSSM) parameter space as allowed or excluded. This is subsequently incorporated for making a global fit of the pMSSM to data, including the LHC Run-2 limits.

AI.title_translation: 基于符号分类的LHC限制在线BSM全局拟合
AI.tldr: 该论文通过符号回归技术解决了LHC限制在BSM全局拟合中计算开销巨大的问题，实现了高效的在线全局拟合。
AI.motivation: 在超越标准模型（BSM）的全局拟合中，将大型强子对撞机（LHC）的直接测量和排除限制“在线”纳入参数扫描计算量巨大，往往超出了全局拟合框架可接受的时间尺度，亟需一种高效的近似方法。
AI.method: 利用ATLAS关于电弱微子产生搜索的约束数据集，通过符号回归技术推导出能够将pMSSM参数空间分类为允许或排除的数学表达式，并将其整合到pMSSM的全局拟合中。
AI.result: 成功利用符号回归得到的数学表达式对pMSSM参数空间进行分类，并将其成功应用于结合LHC Run-2限制的pMSSM全局拟合中。
AI.conclusion: 利用符号回归近似LHC限制的方法行之有效，能够显著提高BSM参数空间全局拟合的计算效率，实现包含LHC Run-2限制的在线拟合。
AI.translation: 超越标准模型（BSM）物理的全局拟合通常涉及理论与实验之间的双向互动。理论模型为实验搜索提供指导，而实验结果反过来又制约理论框架。这种反馈循环的一个关键方面是将测量结果和排除限制“在线”直接纳入全局拟合中，即在全局拟合的参数扫描过程中。然而，将大型强子对撞机（LHC）的限制纳入此类分析在计算上往往是难以承受的，因为每个参数点所需的时间超出了全局拟合框架可接受的规模。在这项研究中，我们表明通过利用源自符号回归技术的近似值，可以将LHC限制纳入“在线”全局拟合中。我们利用ATLAS对电弱微子产生搜索的约束数据集，推导出一个数学表达式，该表达式能够将唯象最小超对称标准模型（pMSSM）参数空间分类为允许或排除。随后，该表达式被纳入到pMSSM与数据的全局拟合中，包括LHC Run-2的限制。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种利用符号回归近似技术将LHC实验限制纳入BSM全局拟合的方法，成功解决了传统计算耗时过长的问题，并将其应用于pMSSM模型的全局拟合中。
AI.keywords: 超越标准模型, 全局拟合, 符号回归, 大型强子对撞机, 超对称模型
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地引入了符号回归技术来近似LHC的实验约束，解决了标准模型之外物理（BSM）全局拟合中计算开销巨大的瓶颈，使“在线”全局拟合成为可能。

title: Quantification in Double-Categorical Database Schemas
summary: Double-categorical database schemas are enriched with universal quantification in the form of right adjoints to substitution. This allows phrasing of the important query, relational division. It is shown that such right adjoints together with suitable tabulators interpret modal operators, provide cartesian closed structure, and, when combined with global cocartesian structure, interpret first-order predicate logic and thus description logic. These structures are applied throughout to querying and optimization. It is seen, for example, that Frobenius reciprocity and Beck-Chevalley hold in any suitably structured double database schema and that these provide pushdown optimization rules. Such optimization rules are thus provably error-free as a property of the schema. Likewise, negation queries are derived from cocartesian and local implication structure.

AI.title_translation: 双范畴数据库模式中的量化
AI.tldr: 本文将通用量化引入双范畴数据库模式，以支持关系除法等重要查询，并通过解释模态运算符、提供笛卡尔闭合结构以及结合全局共笛卡尔结构来解释一阶谓词逻辑和描述逻辑，从而实现查询和优化的应用，并证明了优化规则的正确性。
AI.motivation: 在双范畴数据库模式中引入量化是为了能够表达关系除法等重要查询，并将其应用于查询和优化。
AI.method: 通过将通用量化以代换的右伴随形式引入双范畴数据库模式。这些右伴随结合适当的制表符可以解释模态运算符，提供笛卡尔闭合结构，并与全局共笛卡尔结构结合时，解释一阶谓词逻辑和描述逻辑。
AI.result: 结果表明，Frobenius互反律和Beck-Chevalley在任何结构合适的双数据库模式中都成立，并提供了下推优化规则。这些优化规则被证明是模式的一个属性，因此是无错误的。同样，否定查询是从共笛卡尔和局部蕴涵结构中导出的。
AI.conclusion: 通过在双范畴数据库模式中引入通用量化，可以有效地表达复杂查询（如关系除法和否定查询），并通过Frobenius互反律和Beck-Chevalley等原理提供经过验证的无错误优化规则，从而为数据库查询和优化提供了一个强大的理论框架。
AI.translation: 双范畴数据库模式通过代换的右伴随形式丰富了通用量化。这允许表达重要的查询，即关系除法。本文表明，这种右伴随与合适的制表符一起解释模态运算符，提供笛卡尔闭合结构，并且当与全局共笛卡尔结构结合时，解释一阶谓词逻辑和描述逻辑。这些结构在查询和优化中得到应用。例如，可以看出，Frobenius互反律和Beck-Chevalley在任何结构合适的双数据库模式中都成立，并且这些提供了下推优化规则。因此，这种优化规则作为模式的一个属性，被证明是无错误的。同样，否定查询是从共笛卡尔和局部蕴涵结构中导出的。
AI.summary: 本文在双范畴数据库模式中引入了通用量化（以代换的右伴随形式），以支持关系除法等复杂查询。研究表明，这些量化结构能够解释模态运算符、提供笛卡尔闭合结构，并结合全局共笛卡尔结构来解释一阶谓词逻辑和描述逻辑。这些理论框架被应用于数据库查询和优化，并证明了Frobenius互反律和Beck-Chevalley在其中成立，从而提供了可证明无错误的下推优化规则。此外，否定查询也可以通过共笛卡尔和局部蕴涵结构导出。
AI.keywords: 双范畴数据库模式, 通用量化, 关系除法, 查询优化, 范畴论
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将范畴论中的双范畴结构与通用量化相结合，为数据库模式的查询和优化提供了严谨的数学基础。通过证明优化规则的无错误性，提升了数据库系统设计的可靠性。其理论深度和对逻辑解释的应用是其重要性所在。

title: Finite-Sample Metric Non-Collapse for Geometrically Supervised Latent World Models in Control
comments: Revised version prepared in response to the editorial assessment. The main manuscript is 32 pages; detailed mathematical derivations have been moved to the accompanying Supplementary Material. The principal results and contributions are strengthened and clarified
summary: We establish a finite-sample learning-to-control theory for geometrically supervised latent models of nonlinear deterministic systems. Geometric supervision is used only during training: simulator state, proprioception, or state estimates with independently validated metric and directional error bounds supply observable-state distances and tangent directions, while deployment remains observation- and action-conditioned. We introduce an encoder-only local--global metric hinge that enforces directional resolution and separated-state discrimination. Under regular observable-factor, coverage, finite-capacity approximation, and uniform $C^{1,1}$ hypotheses, a computable one-sided regularization regime has a strong selection property: with high probability, every approximate empirical minimizer is simultaneously pointwise co-Lipschitz and uniformly approximately semiconjugate to the controlled dynamics. Approximation, sampling, and optimization errors remain explicit and separate. Norm-constrained tensor-product B-spline classes constructively realize the approximation hypotheses, and the interpolation exponent converting mean residual control into a uniform bound is sharp. A modular deterministic corollary transfers the learned certificates to trajectory, finite-horizon cost, learned-cost-head, and optimizer guarantees, while a validated finite-net result enables sharper model-specific certification. Controlled experiments isolate collapse and folding, quantify the analytic certificate's reserve, and demonstrate the control benefit of restored metric resolution. The principal contribution is a complete finite-sample implication from approximate empirical optimization to metric faithfulness, uniform controlled dynamics, and reliable planning for the same learned model.
comment: Revised version prepared in response to the editorial assessment. The main manuscript is 32 pages; detailed mathematical derivations have been moved to the accompanying Supplementary Material. The principal results and contributions are strengthened and clarified

AI.title_translation: 控制中几何监督潜在世界模型的有限样本度量非坍塌性
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对控制中几何监督潜在世界模型的有限样本理论，通过局部-全局度量铰链防止模型坍塌，实现了可靠的动力学建模与规划。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决控制中几何监督的潜在世界模型由于坍塌和折叠导致度量分辨率丢失的问题，建立完整的有限样本学习到控制的理论。
AI.method: 引入了一种仅编码器的局部-全局度量铰链（encoder-only local-global metric hinge），并利用范数约束的张量积 B 样条类实现近似假设，结合可计算的单侧正则化方案。
AI.result: 在一定假设下，每个近似经验极小化子同时具有逐点共 Lipschitz 性和一致近似半共轭性，且误差保持显式且分离，控制实验验证了恢复度量分辨率带来的控制优势。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功证明了通过有限样本近似经验极小化可以实现度量忠实性、一致受控动力学以及可靠的规划，为几何监督的潜在世界模型提供了坚实的理论基础。
AI.translation: 我们为非线性确定性系统的几何监督潜在模型建立了一种有限样本学习控制理论。几何监督仅在训练期间使用：模拟器状态、本体感觉或具有独立验证的度量和方向误差界的估计值提供可观测状态的距离和切线方向，而部署则保持观测和动作条件化。我们引入了一个仅编码器的局部-全局度量铰链，强制实现方向分辨率和分离状态判别。在正则可观测因子、覆盖率、有限容量近似和一致 $C^{1,1}$ 假设下，一个可计算的单侧正则化机制具有强选择性质：以高概率，每一个近似经验极小化子同时是逐点共 Lipschitz 的且与受控动力学一致近似半共轭。近似、采样和优化误差保持显式且独立。范数约束的张量积 B 样条类构造性地实现了近似假设，将平均残差控制转换为一致界的插值指数是尖锐的。一个模块化的确定性推论将所学的证书传递给轨迹、有限视野成本、学习成本头和优化器保证，而一个经过验证的有限网结果实现了更尖锐的模型特定认证。受控实验隔离了坍塌和折叠，量化了分析证书的储备，并证明了恢复度量分辨率的控制优势。主要贡献是从近似经验优化到度量忠实性、一致受控动力学以及同一学习模型的可靠规划的完整有限样本推论。
AI.summary: 本文为非线性确定性系统的几何监督潜在模型建立了有限样本学习控制理论，通过引入编码器局部-全局度量铰链，确保了度量非坍塌，实现了度量忠实性、一致受控动力学和可靠的规划。
AI.keywords: 有限样本学习, 潜在世界模型, 几何监督, 度量非坍塌, 控制理论
AI.comments: 该论文为控制领域的几何监督潜在世界模型建立了严谨的有限样本学习控制理论，解决了潜在空间中常见的坍塌和折叠问题，理论分析深入且具备实际控制验证。

title: Partial Progress on Stone's Conjecture: $P_0$-Membership of Fully Semimonotone Matrices with Positive Determinant
summary: Stone (Ph.D.\ thesis, Department of Operations Research, Stanford University, 1981) proved that every matrix in $U \cap Q_0$ is a $P_0$-matrix and conjectured that the same conclusion holds for the larger class $E_0^f \cap Q_0$ of fully semimonotone $Q_0$-matrices. Murthy and Parthasarathy [SIAM J.\ Matrix Anal.\ Appl.\ 16 (1995), 1268--1286] verified the conjecture for matrices of order up to $4 \times 4$, for $5 \times 5$ and $6 \times 6$ matrices under additional hypotheses, and for several special subclasses of arbitrary order, but the conjecture remains open in general. In this paper we prove that every $E_0^f$-matrix with positive determinant is a $P_0$-matrix, for matrices of arbitrary order $n$; our proof proceeds by induction on $n$, via an algebraic analysis of principal minors under principal pivotal transforms. We further exhibit a matrix $A \in E_0^f$ with $\det A > 0$ that fails to belong to $Q_0$, showing that the hypothesis $\det A > 0$ used in our theorem cannot, by itself, be deduced from membership in $Q_0$, and hence does not on its own yield a proof of Stone's conjecture. Stone's conjecture itself remains open.

title: A Human-Factors Guided Cognitive Model of Visuospatial Complexity in Embodied Active Vision
comments: Preprint; AIC 2025: Artificial Intelligence and Cognition
summary: We propose a novel framework for the analysis of multimodal data -- encompassing visual, auditory, and spatial stimuli -- foregrounding the role of complexity in embodied perception and interaction in dynamic, naturalistic settings. Grounded in theories of embodied cognition and active vision, we argue that embodied perceptual complexity emerges from an agent's dynamic engagement with the environment and must be analyzed holistically, as a combination of qualitative and quantitative attributes pertaining to, for instance, visuospatial and auditory features. Building on previous work on visual complexity, we expand this into a categorization of diverse complexity attributes -- quantitative, structural, dynamic, auditory, and interactional -- that together characterize multimodal complexity. We demonstrate how this model provides a theoretical framework for characterizing aspects of visuospatial complexity and their interactions, specifically in the context of everyday driving. We also discuss practical applications of the proposed model for creating and evaluating benchmark datasets (e.g., in driving) that centralize cognitive human factors, as well as applications aimed at systematically investigating the effect of visuospatial complexity on human active vision from the viewpoint of visual perception research. The proposed framework lays the foundation for automated methods that interpret complexity in 3D dynamic environments from a human-centered perspective, serving as a semantic template for explainable computational analysis of visuospatial complexity with a categorical focus on cognitive human factors.
comment: Preprint; AIC 2025: Artificial Intelligence and Cognition

title: InfoDPP-PAC: Principled Patch Selection for Whole Slide Image Analysis
summary: Each WSI slide contains thousands of candidate tissue patches, while supervision is usually available only at slide level. Existing bag-construction strategies like Uniform extraction and handcrafted heuristics do not control redundancy while attention-based multiple-instance models couple patch importance to a particular downstream classifier, and coreset methods optimise embedding-space coverage without modelling task-relevant patch quality. We introduce InfoDPP-PAC, a principled patch-selection framework that combines teacher-seeded Gaussian process relevance modelling, determinantal log-determinant diversity,submodular greedy optimisation, and a concentration-based adaptive stopping rule. The main theoretical result shows that the log-determinant diversity term used in DPP-style selection is the Gaussian process mutual information between a selected subset and the latent relevance function. We further derive a PAC-style certificate for residual information gain, allowing the number of retained patches to vary by slide rather than being fixed a priori. The empirical study evaluates whether the selected subset is diverse, spatially and morphologically covering, non-redundant, and enriched for the teacher-derived relevance signal. It does not claim end-to-end diagnostic improvement after retraining a downstream MIL model. On 202 HISTAI gastrointestinal whole-slide images, the adaptive rule uses 83.7% fewer patches on average than a fixed full budget while retaining 97.9% of full-budget composite selection quality. At a matched budget, InfoDPP-PAC achieves the highest mean teacher-derived relevance score among fourteen baselines, with diversity and composite scores close to the strongest coreset methods. The results support InfoDPP-PAC as a controlled quality-diversity-cardinality selection framework, rather than as a downstream clinical predictor.

title: Replicable Conformal Prediction
summary: Two analysts who calibrate the same predictive model on independent samples will deploy different prediction sets every time, because the calibration threshold inherits the randomness of the data. Wherever deployments must be audited, cached, or approved across sites, this instability is costly: no one can verify that two calibrations produced the same object. We ask two questions: when can independent calibrations yield the identical classifier, and what must that agreement cost? Perfect agreement is impossible, since a procedure that almost always returns one fixed answer cannot remain valid for every distribution, and exact agreement through shared randomness forces the procedure to ignore its data. Sharing a single random seed and rounding the calibrated threshold up to a coarse shared grid resolves the tension: the deployed classifier becomes identical across analysts with any desired probability, coverage guarantees survive, and the price is a quantified increase in set size and calibration data. Matching lower bounds show that no threshold method can pay less, and the method's one tuning constant vanishes asymptotically. Without any shared seed, a fixed grid still confines all analysts to two adjacent classifiers, and no method does better. Replicability also blocks gaming: selecting the most favorable of many recalibrations barely moves a replicable classifier, while the same selection silently undercovers standard conformal prediction. Experiments on real ImageNet outputs, a four-hospital site split, and four language-model families match the theory, including the measured sample-cost frontier.

title: Effective quasi-Polish categories of overt discrete spaces and compact Hausdorff spaces
summary:
We construct the category of overt discrete quasi-Polish spaces and the category of compact Hausdorff quasi-Polish spaces (and some of their subcategories) as internal categories of the category of effective quasi-Polish spaces and computable maps.
  To demonstrate that the constructions are natural, we show that Stone duality is computable, in the sense that the dual contravariant functors and the natural transformations demonstrating their adjointness are computable.

title: Improved bounds for the smallest 4-chromatic graph of girth six
comments: 12 pages, 1 figure. Ancillary files: independent verification scripts, SAT certificates, and a self-contained Lean 4 formal proof. Code and data: https://github.com/glaucorampone/G64, archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.21861488
summary: For integers $k,g \ge 3$ let $n_g(k)$ denote the minimum order of a graph with chromatic number $k$ and girth at least $g$. Exoo and Goedgebeur (DMTCS 2019) proved $26 \le n_6(4) \le 66$; their 66-vertex witness has remained the smallest known 4-chromatic graph of girth 6. We improve both bounds to $29 \le n_6(4) \le 64$. The upper bound is witnessed by an explicit 4-chromatic graph of girth 6 on 64 vertices with 152 edges; it is vertex- and edge-critical, and its automorphism group is cyclic of order 8 and acts semiregularly. The lower bound is an exhaustive isomorph-free computation in the SAT modulo symmetries framework with co-certificate learning, driven by the Liu-Postle edge-density bound for 4-critical graphs of girth five; it re-derives $n_6(4) \ge 26$ by a disjoint method and is validated on the known values $n_4(4)=11$ and $n_5(4)=21$. We complement the bounds with structural obstructions: no smaller witness arises from either known witness by local modifications; no 4-chromatic Cayley graph of girth 6 exists on 54-63 vertices (for orders 59 and 61 no vertex-transitive witness exists at all); and no witness on at most 63 vertices admits a semiregular automorphism group with two or three vertex orbits, for any finite group. Since every known witness of an $n_g(4)$ record with $g \ge 6$ is a lift of a small base graph along a semiregular action, these results close the most symmetric part of that regime below 64 vertices. All properties of the new graph are verified by independent programs and formally certified in the Lean 4 proof assistant: the non-3-colourability is established inside Lean by a formally verified checker that re-validates a 219,532-node refutation certificate, with a machine-checked soundness theorem.

title: A Comment on Local Hypercube Inequalities
summary: This comment gives dimension-independent analytic proofs of the local inequalities arising in the odd- and even-dimensional constructions of higher-dimensional partition charge functions. The prior works established these inequalities by exhaustive computation in low dimensions and tested them numerically in selected higher dimensions.

title: Multi-Stage Prompt-Guided Feature Modulation for Generalizable Brain Tumor Segmentation
comments: Accepted to BraTS MICCAI 2026 Task 3 (Generalizability Across Tumors)
summary: Accurate brain tumor segmentation from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is essential for diagnosis, treatment planning, surgical guidance, and disease monitoring. However, developing automated segmentation models that generalize across diverse tumor characteristics, imaging protocols, acquisition sites, and patient populations remains challenging. Variations in tumor morphology and imaging distributions can substantially degrade performance outside the training domain. Consequently, improving the robustness and generalization of deep learning-based segmentation models has become a key objective in medical image analysis. To improve segmentation robustness, we propose Multi-Stage Dynamic Prompt nnU-Net, a prompt-conditioned extension of nnU-Net. Three independent dynamic prompt modules are inserted into the deepest encoder stages. Each module contains a learnable bank of ten 256-dimensional prompt vectors and uses globally pooled encoder features to generate image-specific prompt representations. These representations are projected into feature-wise scaling $(γ)$ and shifting $(β)$ parameters that modulate encoder feature maps through Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM), enabling adaptive feature conditioning at multiple semantic levels. Evaluation on the BraTS GOAT validation dataset demonstrated that the proposed Multi-Stage Dynamic Prompt nnU-Net outperformed the baseline nnU Net across the majority of evaluated metrics and tumor subregions. The proposed model achieved average lesion-wise Dice scores of 76.16% (ET), 80.04% (TC), and 86.42% (WT), compared with 74.38%, 78.14% and 84.01% for the baseline model. The results demonstrate that multi-stage dynamic prompt conditioning improves segmentation accuracy and boundary delineation for brain tumor segmentation.
comment: Accepted to BraTS MICCAI 2026 Task 3 (Generalizability Across Tumors)

title: S-matrix informed neural networks for amplitude analysis
summary: Reconstructing scattering amplitudes from finite, noisy, and mutually inconsistent measurements is an ill-posed inverse problem common to many reactions relevant to particle physics. We introduce S-matrix informed neural networks (SINNs), and demonstrate their ability to learn scattering amplitudes directly from data while respecting first principles. We further develop a novel data selection procedure, which uses the response of constrained neural network ensembles to identify a set of experiments compatible with first principles, and with each other. We apply this framework to $ππ$ scattering, producing reusable amplitudes and correlated uncertainties without relying on a fixed functional form. We validate our results against residual model dependencies and training biases through closure tests and ablations. We find negligible impact of model architecture on our results. Our workflow unifies physics-constrained representation learning, data selection, and uncertainty quantification. Our strategy is transferable to other scattering processes, and other constrained physics problems limited by inconsistent data.

title: The ISCSLP 2026 Real-World Audio-Visual Speech Enhancement Challenge
comments: The First Real-World Audio-Visual Speech Enhancement (AVSE) Challenge
summary: Audio-visual speech enhancement (AVSE) uses visual-speech cues from a target speaker to recover that speaker's speech from noisy or overlapping speech. Many widely used protocols construct mixed signals from separately recorded audio sources and assume reliable video, leaving their performance under natural overlap and visual failure insufficiently characterized. The Real-World AVSE Challenge evaluates two related settings. Track~1 comprises two scenarios: real-world mixtures recorded with two speakers speaking simultaneously, without a corresponding clean reference signal, and synthetic remixes obtained by manually mixing the separately recorded speech of two speakers, with a clean reference signal available; Track~2 reuses audio but pairs it with a degraded target video and contains additional 3-m far-field recordings. The speakers in the development and test sets are disjoint. Evaluation metrics include clean-waveform fidelity, learned quality estimates, transcription accuracy, and speaker identification. In the remix task on the development set, the baseline model achieved an SI-SDR of $-4.069$~dB and an STOI of $0.388$ on Track~1, and an SI-SDR of $-2.851$~dB and an STOI of $0.470$ on Track~2. We release the AV-ConvTasNet checkpoints, the offline evaluator, and the official baseline results on the development and test sets.
comment: The First Real-World Audio-Visual Speech Enhancement (AVSE) Challenge

title: (Mis)Understanding Benign Overfitting in Equity Return Prediction
summary: Highly overparameterized models often predict well despite interpolating training data in complex domains, challenging the classical bias--variance tradeoff. We investigate whether this ``benign overfitting'' phenomenon extends to equity return prediction. Consistent with recent statistical theory, we document two key phenomena: first, a double descent pattern in the ridgeless model's prediction risk; and second, that while the optimal ridge model consistently outperforms its ridgeless counterpart, this performance gap becomes negligible at large parameter-to-observation ratios. Ultimately, however, both models fail to outperform a simple historical average. This empirical evidence aligns with our asymptotic results under the null hypothesis of zero slope coefficients, suggesting that standard equity predictors lack true forecasting power---even within highly flexible, nonlinear machine learning architectures. These findings reconcile modern and classical machine learning in asset pricing: in the absence of a true signal, they asymptotically collapse to the historical average benchmark.

title: EmoTra-TTS: Smooth Intra-Utterance Emotion Transitions for Speech Synthesis
summary: Psychological research on emotion dynamics has established that human affect is a continuous, evolving process: emotions rise, decay, and transition within seconds. Current emotional text-to-speech (TTS) systems, however, condition on a single discrete label or static embedding per utterance, fundamentally misaligning with the temporal nature of affect. While recent LLM-based TTS systems may implicitly vary prosody through text understanding, such variation is neither explicitly controllable nor precise enough for targeted intra-utterance transitions. We address three challenges: (1) a multi-pass flow blending pipeline synthesizes frame-aligned transition audio, circumventing the scarcity of natural intra-utterance transitions; (2) dual-stage Valence-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) conditioning guides prosodic planning in the LLM and acoustic realization in the flow decoder via frame-level VAD embeddings; (3) direction-magnitude decoupled injection structurally separates emotion direction from injection magnitude, preventing content degradation. EmoTra-TTS adds only +0.43% parameters with no latency overhead, achieves 30%-87% relative improvement on emotion transition quality, corroborated by 64.4%-79.5% overall win rates in pairwise preference tests against four SOTA baselines and two commercial systems.

title: Accelerating the Adoption of Residential Solar Power Systems: Policy Analysis using a Dynamic Structural Model
summary:
Problem definition: Solar electricity generation is a strategic component of energy portfolios designed to meet growing demand and reduce carbon emissions. Governments and municipalities encourage household photovoltaic (PV) adoption through upfront rebates and tax credits. Limited budgets require principled, data-driven policies that account for the drivers of adoption and the effects of incentives on adoption rates.
  Methodology/results: We develop a dynamic structural model of residential PV diffusion based on adoption decisions by forward-looking households that weigh the economic trade-offs between installing now and later. Adoption depends on return on investment and influence from neighboring adopters. The model segments households by home value and urbanization level, incorporates unobserved heterogeneity, and captures spatiotemporal installation dynamics. We estimate the model using Bayesian methods and detailed household-level data from Austin, Texas. In out-of-sample tests, it predicts installations more accurately than contemporary alternatives. We simulate counterfactual policies within the dynamic equilibrium of PV diffusion to evaluate rebate designs. The framework can also be adapted to study the adoption of other durable technologies.
  Managerial implications: A rebate offered for a limited period generates more adoption and emissions reductions than a prolonged, costlier program. This counterintuitive result arises from forward-looking behavior, neighbor influence, and accelerated adoption before the rebate expires. We also evaluate phased reductions and rebates differentiated by household segment. A two-step reduction outperforms multiple small reductions. Geographic differentiation improves policy performance, whereas differentiation by home value offers little advantage over a uniform rebate.

title: Differential Learning for Robust Prediction of Thermal Stability with Application to Energetic Materials
summary: Predicting thermal stability during handling and storage is essential for the design of safe and reliable energetic materials. However, experimental measurements vary significantly across laboratories due to differences in protocols and analysis methods, making it difficult to train reliable predictive models. We address this challenge through differential learning. Rather than predicting absolute decomposition temperatures, we instead train message passing neural networks to predict relative differences between pairs of molecules. This approach reduces sensitivity to systematic experimental errors and achieves >85% accuracy in ranking compounds by thermal stability, outperforming conventional regression methods on the same heterogeneous dataset. To understand what drives these predictions, we compare neural network models with interpretable alternatives built from descriptors derived from ab initio calculations and cheminformatics software. This analysis identifies bond dissociation enthalpy as a key determinant of thermal stability rankings, providing further insight into the complex chemistry of thermal decomposition. The differential learning framework generalizes across model architectures, from graph neural networks to classical descriptor-based approaches. Our results demonstrate that learning relative properties rather than absolute values offers a practical solution for modeling noisy experimental data, with direct applications in materials design where thermal stability predictions inform safety protocols.

title: Spatiotemporal Distillation via Recurrent Bottlenecks for Aortic Tracking
comments: Accepted at the 17th Statistical Atlases and Computational Models of the Heart (STACOM) Workshop, MICCAI 2026. Springer LNCS
summary: Cardiac cine-MRI serves as a direct visual indicator of cardiovascular hemodynamics by capturing the continuous wall motion of the aorta. Quantifying these dynamic structural changes across the cardiac cycle is essential for measuring aortic distensibility, a primary marker of arterial stiffness. However, standard 2D segmentation networks focus on each frame independently. Consequently, when rapid systolic flow temporarily obscures the aorta's boundaries, this lack of continuous context results in frame-to-frame tracking dropouts and boundary inconsistencies. Spatiotemporal ($2\text{D}+t$) networks can enforce temporal consistency across the sequence but suffer from a scarcity of expert annotations. To address this, we present a semi-supervised spatiotemporal ($2\text{D}$ to $2\text{D}+t$) knowledge distillation framework exploiting the cardiac cycle. The framework distills a spatial teacher's expertise into a spatiotemporal student network by executing a dynamic latent interception, pairing a recurrent spatiotemporal bottleneck with a residual spatial bypass. Our model selection strategy applies a baseline validation threshold ($\text{DSC} \ge 0.50$) prior to selecting the epoch that maximizes anatomical consistency. This strategy enables the spatiotemporal student model to achieve superior surface tracking accuracy ($\text{NSD@1mm} = 92.3\% \pm 0.2\%$) and high structural reliability ($\text{Frac}_{2\text{CC}} = 99.2\% \pm 0.6\%$), reducing population-wide structural anomalies by over 56\% compared to a 2D nnU-Net baseline.
