AI.title_translation: MPIB：大语言模型中医疗提示词注入攻击与临床安全的基准测试
AI.tldr: 本文提出了MPIB基准，用于评估大语言模型在医疗提示词注入攻击下的临床安全风险。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型和检索增强生成（RAG）系统在临床工作流中的普及，提示词注入攻击可能导致系统产生临床不安全或误导性的输出，迫切需要一个专门的基准来评估其在临床任务中的安全性与结果级风险。
AI.method: 引入了包含9,697个策划实例的医疗提示词注入基准（MPIB），采用多阶段质量门控和临床安全性检查构建，通过临床伤害事件率（CHER）和ASR2评估直接及间接RAG介导的提示词注入攻击下的临床安全性。
AI.result: 对多种基准LLM和防御配置的评估表明，ASR2和CHER3存在显著差异，且对抗性指令出现在用户查询中还是检索到的上下文中，其观察到的攻击成功率有所不同。
AI.conclusion: MPIB基准揭示了现有大语言模型在医疗提示词注入攻击下的安全漏洞，证明了区分中度和高严重性临床伤害事件的必要性，为未来安全防御配置的优化提供了重要依据。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）和检索增强生成（RAG）系统正日益集成到临床工作流中。然而，提示词注入攻击会引导这些系统产生临床上不安全或误导性的输出。我们介绍了医疗提示词注入基准（MPIB），这是一个用于在临床任务中评估直接提示词注入和间接RAG介导注入下临床安全性的数据集与基准套件。MPIB通过临床伤害事件率（CHER）强调结果级风险，该指标根据临床基础分类法衡量高严重性临床伤害事件，并与ASR2一同报告以区分中度或更严重与高严重性的结果。该基准包含通过多阶段质量门控和临床安全检查构建的9,,697个策划实例。在评估了多种基准LLM和防御配置后，我们发现ASR2和CHER3可能会产生显著差异，并且观察到的攻击率会根据对抗性指令是出现在用户查询中还是在检索到的上下文中而有所不同。MPIB数据集和评估代码已分别在Hugging Face和GitHub上开源。
AI.summary: 论文介绍了MPIB——一个用于评估医疗大语言模型在直接及间接提示词注入攻击下临床安全性的综合基准。通过包含9,697个实例的数据集和基于临床伤害事件率（CHER）的结果级风险评估，揭示了当前模型和防御配置在面对临床对抗攻击时的脆弱性和差异。
AI.keywords: Medical Prompt Injection, Clinical Safety, Large Language Models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Benchmark
AI.comments: 该论文针对大语言模型在医疗领域的安全性进行了深入探讨，创新性地提出了专注于临床伤害事件率（CHER）的医疗提示词注入基准（MPIB），填补了直接和间接提示词注入下临床安全评估的空白。其多阶段质量控制和基于结果的风险评估方法对未来医疗AI的安全防御具有重要意义。

title: Knowledization: Claim-Level Epistemic Control with Admissibility, Source Support, and Real-World Proxy Boundaries
summary: Near field mmWave sensing is poised to play a key role in future wireless systems, enabling environment-aware, embodied, and application adaptive operation under stringent form-factor and hardware constraints. However, achieving high spatial resolution in the near field typically requires large antenna arrays, multiple radio frequency (RF) chains, or mechanical scanning, creating a fundamental tension between spatial observability and system simplicity. This paper presents frequency as aperture clip on antenna fabric (FaACAF), a hardware efficient sensing by design architecture that synthesizes spatial aperture through the FaA paradigm using a single RF chain. FaACAF realizes a modular clip on aperture fabric, in which frequency selective clip on modules (CMs) are attached to a shared guided-wave substrate and implicitly coordinated by the instantaneous frequency modulated continuous wave (FMCW) excitation frequency. In this fabric, FMCW signaling simultaneously indexes the sensing aperture and orchestrates uplink/downlink signal distribution and echo multiplexing in a switch free, fully passive, and all analog manner, eliminating RF switching and multichannel front ends. An online self calibration mechanism stabilizes the frequency to aperture mapping under practical attachment variability without requiring full matrix calibration. Two case studies illustrate the robustness of the proposed approach and quantify the predictable sensing margin tradeoffs introduced by modular deployment. Overall, FaACAF demonstrates that near field spatial observability can be scaled through architectural coordination in the frequency domain rather than hardware expansion, providing a reconfigurable and hardware efficient pathway toward embodied sensing and integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) in future wireless systems.

AI.title_translation: 知识化：具有可采纳性、源支持和现实世界代理边界的声明级认识论控制
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为FaACAF的近场毫米波传感硬件高效架构，利用单射频链和频域协调实现高空间分辨率，无需复杂的硬件扩展。
AI.motivation: 近场毫米波传感中，实现高空间分辨率通常需要大型天线阵列、多个射频链或机械扫描，这在空间可观测性与系统简洁性之间造成了根本性的矛盾。本论文旨在解决这一矛盾，寻找一种硬件高效的传感架构。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为FaACAF的硬件高效传感架构，利用单个射频链通过FaA范式合成空间孔径。采用附加在共享导波基板上的频率选择性卡扣模块（CM），由瞬时FMCW激励频率隐式协调，实现无开关、全被动和全模拟的信号分配与回波复用，并包含一个在线自校准机制来稳定频率到孔径的映射。
AI.result: 通过两个案例研究验证了该方法的鲁棒性，并量化了模块化部署带来的可预测传感裕度权衡，证明了该架构在不依赖硬件扩展的情况下扩展近场空间可观测性的能力。
AI.conclusion: FaACAF架构通过频域的架构协调而非硬件扩展，成功扩展了近场空间可观测性，为未来无线系统中的具身传感和ISAC提供了一条可重构且硬件高效的途径。
AI.translation: 近场毫米波传感有望在未来的无线系统中发挥关键作用，在严格的外形尺寸和硬件限制下实现环境感知、具身和应用自适应操作。然而，在近场中实现高空间分辨率通常需要大型天线阵列、多个射频链路（RF）或机械扫描，这在空间可观测性和系统简洁性之间造成了根本性的矛盾。本文提出了天线结构上的频率作为孔径剪辑（FaACAF），这是一种通过设计实现硬件高效传感的架构，它利用单个RF链通过FaA范式合成空间孔径。FaACAF实现了一种模块化的剪辑孔径结构，其中频率选择性剪辑模块（CM）连接到共享的导波基板上，并通过瞬时调频连续波（FMCW）激励频率进行隐式协调。在这种结构中，FMCW信令以无开关、完全被动和全模拟的方式同时索引传感孔径并协调上行/下行信号分配和回波复用，消除了RF开关和多通道前端。在线自校准机制在不需要完整矩阵校准的情况下，稳定了实际连接变异性下的频率到孔径映射。两个案例研究说明了所提方法的鲁棒性，并量化了模块化部署引入的可预测传感裕度权衡。总体而言，FaACAF证明了近场空间可观测性可以通过频域的架构协调而不是硬件扩展来扩展，为未来无线系统中的具身传感以及集成传感和通信（ISAC）提供了一条可重构且硬件高效的途径。
AI.summary: 论文提出了FaACAF架构，这是一种用于近场毫米波传感的硬件高效设计。它通过在共享导波基板上附加频率选择性模块，利用单射频链和FMCW信令在频域合成空间孔径，消除了复杂的前端硬件，并通过在线自校准机制克服了附件变异性，为未来无线系统提供了一种可重构的传感与通信集成方案。
AI.keywords: 近场毫米波传感, 频率作为孔径, 硬件高效设计, 调频连续波, 集成传感与通信
AI.comments: 这篇论文针对近场毫米波传感中空间可观测性与系统复杂度之间的矛盾，创新性地提出了FaACAF架构。通过利用频率作为孔径（FaA）范式和无源频选模块，在单射频链下实现了高空间分辨率，为未来无线系统和集成传感与通信（ISAC）提供了一条高效、可重构的硬件路径。

title: Do physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) need to be deep? Shallow PINNs using the Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm
summary: This work investigates shallow physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for solving forward and inverse problems governed by nonlinear partial differential equations (PDEs). By formulating PINN training as a nonlinear least-squares problem, the Levenberg-Marquardt (LM) algorithm is used to efficiently optimize the network parameters. Exact analytical expressions for neural-network derivatives with respect to the input variables are derived, revealing the relationships between the network output and its spatial and temporal derivatives and providing a clearer interpretation of the PINN architecture. These expressions are then used to derive explicit formulas for the Jacobian matrix required by LM. The proposed approach is evaluated on the Burgers, Schrödinger, Allen-Cahn, and three-dimensional Bratu equations. Numerical results show that LM substantially outperforms BFGS, L-BFGS, and Adam in convergence speed, accuracy, and final loss values. Comparisons with deeper networks further demonstrate that shallow LM-PINNs can achieve higher accuracy with substantially fewer parameters, emphasizing the importance of considering network architecture and optimization strategy jointly. The explicit analytical Jacobian also provides computational and memory advantages that are particularly relevant to large-scale PINNs. Overall, these results suggest that, for a broad class of PDEs, shallow PINNs combined with effective second-order optimization can provide accurate and computationally efficient solutions to both forward and inverse problems.

AI.title_translation: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）需要很深吗？使用Levenberg-Marquardt算法的浅层PINNs
AI.tldr: 通过结合Levenberg-Marquardt算法，浅层物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在求解偏微分方程时，能够以极少的参数实现比深层网络更高的精度和更快的收敛速度。
AI.motivation: 探讨物理信息神经网络（PINNs）是否必须是深层的，并研究浅层PINN结合Levenberg-Marquardt算法在求解非线性偏微分方程正反问题中的性能。
AI.method: 将PINN训练表述为非线性最小二乘问题，利用Levenberg-Marquardt (LM) 算法进行优化，并推导了用于LM算法的精确解析雅可比矩阵表达式。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，LM算法在收敛速度、精度和最终损失值上显著优于BFGS、L-BFGS和Adam；与更深的网络相比，浅层LM-PINN可以用更少的参数达到更高的精度。
AI.conclusion: 对于广泛的偏微分方程，结合高效二阶优化的浅层PINN能够为正向和反向问题提供准确且计算高效的解决方案。
AI.translation: 本工作研究了用于求解由非线性偏微分方程（PDEs）支配的正向和反向问题的浅层物理信息神经网络（PINNs）。通过将PINN训练构建为一个非线性最小二乘问题，利用Levenberg-Marquardt（LM）算法来有效优化网络参数。推导了神经网络关于输入变量导数的精确解析表达式，揭示了网络输出与其时空导数之间的关系，并为PINN架构提供了更清晰的解释。然后利用这些表达式推导了LM所需的雅可比矩阵的显式公式。所提出的方法在Burgers、Schrödinger、Allen-Cahn和三维Bratu方程上进行了评估。数值结果表明，在收敛速度、精度和最终损失值方面，LM显着优于BFGS、L-BFGS和Adam。与更深网络的比较进一步表明，浅层LM-PINN可以用少得多的参数实现更高的精度，强调了联合考虑网络架构和优化策略的重要性。显式解析雅可比矩阵还提供了计算和内存优势，这与大规模PINN特别相关。总体而言，这些结果表明，对于广泛的PDE，浅层PINN结合高效的二阶优化可以为正向和反向问题提供准确且计算高效的解决方案。
AI.summary: 本文研究了结合Levenberg-Marquardt（LM）优化算法的浅层物理信息神经网络（PINNs），用于求解由非线性偏微分方程（PDEs）支配的正向和反向问题。通过推导精确的解析雅可比矩阵，该方法在收敛速度、精度和参数效率方面均显著优于传统的一阶或准牛顿优化器及深层网络，展示了浅层PINN的巨大潜力。
AI.keywords: 物理信息神经网络, 浅层网络, Levenberg-Marquardt算法, 偏微分方程, 非线性最小二乘
AI.comments: 该论文探讨了浅层物理信息神经网络（PINNs）结合Levenberg-Marquardt算法在求解偏微分方程方面的潜力，挑战了“网络越深越好”的传统观念，对网络架构和优化策略的联合设计具有重要启发意义。

title: CoMMa: Contribution-Aware Medical Multi-Agents for Decentralized Oncology Decision Support
summary: Recent multi-agent frameworks have shown promise for oncology decision support, yet most assume centralized data access and rely on prompt-based assignment, limiting their applicability in privacy-sensitive clinical settings. We propose Contribution-Aware Medical Multi-Agents (CoMMa), a decentralized LLM-agent framework where specialists operate on partitioned clinical data streams. Unlike prior approaches that share inputs across agents, CoMMa enforces data decentralization to include stronger role specialization and further enhances this via agent-specific finetuning. To enable reliable and interpretable coordination, we introduce a contribution-aware aggregation mechanism that replaces stochastic, narrative-based reasoning with deterministic embedding projections to approximate each agent's marginal utility. This yields explicit credit assignment over agents, providing a stable and interpretable decision pathway aligned with clinical requirements. We evaluate CoMMa on multiple oncology benchmarks, including real-world multidisciplinary tumor board datasets from large academic hospitals in North America and East Asia, as well as public datasets, demonstrating strong performance and generalization across heterogeneous clinical settings.

AI.title_translation: CoMMa：用于去中心化肿瘤学决策支持的贡献感知医学多智能体系统
AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向肿瘤学决策的去中心化医学多智能体框架（CoMMa），在保护患者隐私的同时，通过贡献感知聚合机制实现可靠且可解释的临床决策支持。
AI.motivation: 现有的多中心医疗决策多智能体框架大多假设集中式数据访问并依赖基于提示词的分配，这在隐私敏感的临床环境中限制了其应用。
AI.method: 提出了CoMMa框架，让专科智能体在分区临床数据流上运行并进行智能体特定的微调；引入了贡献感知聚合机制，用确定性嵌入投影替代随机叙事推理来近似每个智能体的边际效用。
AI.result: 在北美和东亚大型学术医院的真实多学科肿瘤委员会数据集以及公共数据集上的评估表明，CoMMa具有强劲的性能和跨异构临床设置的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: CoMMa框架成功实现了隐私敏感型临床环境下的去中心化肿瘤学决策支持，在保证数据隐私的同时提供了可靠、可解释和高性能的诊疗决策。
AI.translation: 近期的多智能体框架在肿瘤学决策支持方面展现出了潜力，然而大多数框架假设集中式数据访问并依赖基于提示词的任务分配，这限制了其在隐私敏感临床环境中的适用性。我们提出了贡献感知医学多智能体（CoMMa），这是一个去中心化的LLM智能体框架，其中的专科智能体在分区的临床数据流上运行。与以往在智能体之间共享输入的方法不同，CoMMa强制实行数据去中心化以实现更强的角色专业化，并通过针对特定智能体的微调进一步增强了这一点。为了实现可靠且可解释的协调，我们引入了一种贡献感知聚合机制，用确定性的嵌入投影替代了随机的、基于叙事的推理，以近似每个智能体的边际效用。这为智能体提供了显式的信用分配，从而产生了符合临床要求的稳定且可解释的决策路径。我们在多个肿瘤学基准测试上对CoMMa进行了评估，包括来自北美和东亚大型学术医院的真实多学科肿瘤委员会数据集以及公共数据集，展示了其在异构临床环境中的强大性能和泛化能力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了CoMMa，这是一个用于去中心化肿瘤学决策支持的贡献感知医学多智能体框架。它通过在分区数据上运行并采用贡献感知的聚合机制，在保护隐私的同时实现了可靠、可解释的临床决策。
AI.keywords: 医学多智能体, 肿瘤学决策支持, 去中心化学习, 贡献感知聚合, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种去中心化的医学多智能体框架CoMMa，解决了医疗场景中隐私保护和数据割裂的问题。通过引入基于贡献度的聚合机制和确定性嵌入投影，实现了明确的信用分配和可解释的决策路径，在多个肿瘤学基准测试中表现优异。

title: ICA: Information-Aware Credit Assignment for Visually Grounded Long-Horizon Information-Seeking Agents
comments: Accepted to the Main Conference of EMNLP 2026
summary: Long-horizon reinforcement learning for information seeking agents remains difficult because terminal rewards reveal whether the final answer is correct, but not which acquired information enabled it. This difficulty is amplified by text-derived webpage observations, where parsing, truncation, and summarization often produce incomplete and unstable content representations across trajectories. We propose an evidence-centric framework for web agent learning that represents information acquired through tools as identifiable units for comparison across trajectories. In particular, fetched webpages are represented as rendered snapshots, preserving layout and multimodal content as stable content-level observations. Building on these units, we introduce Information-Aware Credit Assignment, a post hoc reward propagation method that estimates turn-level utility scores from rollout success rates and assigns dense rewards to intermediate steps that introduced high-utility information. Integrated with GSPO, our method consistently improves performance on BrowseComp, GAIA, Xbench-DS, and Seal-0. Code and datasets will be released at https://github.com/pc-inno/ICA_MM_deepsearch.
comment: Accepted to the Main Conference of EMNLP 2026

AI.title_translation: ICA：面向视觉基础长周期信息寻求智能体的信息感知信用分配
AI.tldr: 提出了一种针对视觉基础长周期信息寻求智能体的信息感知信用分配（ICA）框架，利用渲染快照和事后奖励传播解决了长周期任务中的信用分配难题。
AI.motivation: 长周期信息寻求强化学习中，终端奖励只能反映最终答案的对错，无法指明是哪一步获取的信息起到了关键作用；且文本网页观测常存在解析、截断和总结问题，导致跨轨迹内容表示不完整且不稳定。
AI.method: 提出了一种证据中心的网页智能体学习框架，将获取的网页表示为保留布局和多模态内容的渲染快照；并引入信息感知信用分配（ICA）方法，根据 rollout 成功率估计轮次级效用分数，为引入高价值信息的中间步骤分配密集奖励。
AI.result: 与GSPO集成后，该方法在 BrowseComp、GAIA、Xbench-DS 和 Seal-0 上持续提升了性能。
AI.conclusion: ICA框架通过证据中心的方法和基于成功率的奖励传播，有效解决了长周期信息寻求智能体中的信用分配问题，提升了智能体在复杂网页浏览和搜索任务上的性能。
AI.translation: 面向信息寻求智能体的长周期强化学习仍然非常困难，因为终端奖励只能揭示最终答案是否正确，而无法显示是哪个获取的信息使其成为可能。文本派生的网页观察进一步加剧了这一困难，其中解析、截断和总结往往会在不同轨迹中产生不完整且不稳定的内容表示。我们为网络智能体学习提出了一个以证据为中心的框架，将通过工具获取的信息表示为可识别的单位，以便跨轨迹进行比较。特别地，获取的网页被表示为渲染的快照，将布局和多模态内容保留为稳定的内容级观察。在此基础上，我们引入了信息感知信用分配（Information-Aware Credit Assignment），这是一种事后奖励传播方法，它根据 rollout 成功率估计轮次级效用分数，并为引入高效用信息的中间步骤分配密集奖励。将我们的方法与 GSPO 相结合，在 BrowseComp、GAIA、Xbench-DS 和 Seal-0 上持续提升了性能。代码和数据集将在 https://github.com/pc-inno/ICA_MM_deepsearch 上发布。
AI.summary: 本文针对长周期信息寻求强化学习中信用分配困难及文本观测不稳定的问题，提出了信息感知信用分配（ICA）框架。该框架采用网页渲染快照作为稳定的多模态观测单元，并通过事后奖励传播方法（ICA）根据 rollout 成功率计算中间步骤的效用分数并分配密集奖励，在多个基准测试中验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 长周期强化学习, 信息寻求智能体, 信用分配, 多模态观察, 网页浏览
AI.comments: 本文创新性地提出了面向视觉基础长周期信息寻求智能体的信息感知信用分配（ICA）框架，通过渲染快照保留多模态信息并利用事后奖励传播解决长周期任务中的信用分配难题，在多个基准测试上表现优异。

title: PatientHub: A Unified Framework for Patient Simulation
summary: As Large Language Models increasingly power role-playing applications, simulating patients has become a valuable tool for training counselors and scaling therapeutic assessment. However, prior work remains fragmented: existing approaches rely on incompatible, non-standardized profiles, prompts, and evaluation metrics, hindering reproducibility, fair comparison, and reuse. We introduce PatientHub, a unified and modular framework that standardizes the creation, simulation, and evaluation of LLM-based patients. Our framework provides 16 patient simulators, a graph-based orchestrator for multi-turn, multi-session interactions, and a configurable LLM-as-a-judge evaluator that supports multiple rubric types. Via our command-line interface, users can generate patient profiles, run simulations, and apply rubric-driven evaluation at the turn and session level. To demonstrate PatientHub's utility, we compare several supported simulators under a shared interaction protocol and showcase its extensibility by prototyping a new simulator variant with minimal additional code. By consolidating existing work into a single reproducible pipeline, our framework eliminates much of the infrastructure overhead that currently fragments this research and accelerates the development of new methods. Our code and data are publicly available via https://github.com/Sahandfer/PatientHub.

AI.title_translation: PatientHub：一个统一的患者模拟框架
AI.tldr: PatientHub 是一个用于大语言模型患者模拟的统一、模块化框架，通过标准化配置、模拟和评估流程，解决了该领域研究碎片化的痛点。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型在患者模拟和治疗评估中展现出潜力，但先前的研究十分碎片化，依赖于不兼容且非标准化的配置文件、提示词和评估指标，阻碍了可复现性、公平比较和代码重用。
AI.method: 引入了 PatientHub 这一统一且模块化的框架，包含 16 个患者模拟器、一个用于多轮多会话交互的基于图的协调器，以及一个支持多种评分标准的可配置 LLM-as-a-judge 评估器，并提供命令行接口。
AI.result: 在统一的交互协议下对比了多个支持的模拟器，并通过极少量的额外代码展示了新模拟器变体的可扩展性，同时通过开源代码和数据消除了基础设施开销。
AI.conclusion: PatientHub 通过提供统一、可复现且模块化的管道，消除了当前患者模拟研究中的基础设施开销，促进了该领域的进一步发展。
AI.translation: 随着大语言模型日益赋能角色扮演应用，模拟患者已成为训练咨询师和扩展治疗评估的重要工具。然而，先前的研究仍然是碎片化的：现有方法依赖于不兼容、非标准化的配置文件、提示词和评估指标，阻碍了可复现性、公平比较和代码重用。我们推出了 PatientHub，这是一个统一且模块化的框架，标准化了基于大语言模型的患者的创建、模拟和评估。我们的框架提供了 16 个患者模拟器、一个用于多轮、多会话交互的基于图的协调器，以及一个支持多种评分准则的可配置的 LLM-as-a-judge 评估器。通过我们的命令行界面，用户可以生成患者档案、运行模拟，并在轮次和会话级别应用基于准则的评估。为了证明 PatientHub 的实用性，我们在共享的交互协议下比较了几个受支持的模拟器，并通过最少的附加代码展示了其可扩展性，原型化了一个新的模拟器变体。通过将现有工作巩固为一个可复现的管道，我们的框架消除了当前碎片化该研究的大部分基础设施开销，并加速了新方法的发展。我们的代码和数据已通过 https://github.com/Sahandfer/PatientHub 公开。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了 PatientHub，这是一个统一且模块化的框架，用于标准化基于大语言模型的患者模拟的创建、模拟和评估，它整合了多个模拟器、交互协调器和评估工具，旨在消除领域内的碎片化并加速新方法的发展。
AI.keywords: Patient Simulation, Large Language Models, Unified Framework, Role-playing, Therapeutic Assessment
AI.comments: PatientHub 为基于大语言模型的患者模拟领域提供了一个统一且模块化的框架，解决了以往研究中缺乏标准化和可比性的痛点，具有很高的实用价值和开源贡献度。

title: Efficient Streaming Algorithms for Two-Dimensional Congruence Testing and Congruence Hashing
summary: Geometric congruence asks whether two point multisets are identical up to translation and rotation, while congruence hashing seeks compact encodings that support efficient congruence queries. We study these problems in the streaming model under finite-precision rational inputs, where each coordinate is $p/q$ with $|p|,|q|\le U$. Our main results are two randomized polylogarithmic-space algorithms for 2D congruence identification (CI), which additionally requires outputting a valid transformation when congruent. With probability at least $1-δ$, our 3-pass product-anchor algorithm uses $O((\log n+\log U+\log \frac{1}δ)\log\log n\log \frac{1}δ)$ space in the turnstile model, while our 3-pass complex-moment algorithm uses $O(\log n(\log n+\log U+\log \frac{1}δ))$ space in the insertion-only model. Using CI as a building block, we obtain a 4-pass insertion-only congruence hashing algorithm over $m$ query sets using $O(m(\log n+\log U+\log m+\log \frac{1}δ))$ space and producing signatures of length $O(\log \frac{1}δ+\log U+\log m)$. Both algorithms presample primes for modular hashing to handle precision. The former algorithm uses finite-field embeddings and number-theoretic guarantees to recover rotations, and the latter hinges on a new non-vanishing complex moment criterion, thus avoiding additional number-theoretic conditions and the classical vanishing-moment obstacle. For the hardness results, we prove that any $p$-pass randomized streaming algorithm for 2D CI with error at most $δ$ requires $Ω(\frac{1}{p}(\log n+\log U+\log \frac{1}δ))$ space, matching the turnstile upper bound up to a $\log\log n$ factor. Moreover, approximate CI requires $\text{poly}(n)$ space even with $\text{poly}(n)$ passes. This sharply contrasts with the RAM model, where both exact and approximate versions are solvable in polynomial time.

AI.title_translation: 二维全等测试与全等哈希的高效流算法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了在流模型下解决二维几何全等测试和全等哈希的高效多趟随机算法，并证明了其空间下界。
AI.motivation: 针对大规模几何数据，传统RAM模型下的几何全等性测试和哈希方法在空间上无法满足流式处理的需求，因此需要在流模型（streaming model）下寻找使用极小空间的有效算法。
AI.method: 提出了两个随机多对数字/多趟流算法：一是基于转门模型（turnstile model）的3趟产品锚点算法（使用有限域嵌入和数论保证）；二是基于插入模型（insertion-only model）的3趟复数矩算法（基于新的非消逝复数矩准则）。同时使用素数预采样进行模哈希处理精度。此外，还证明了相应的空间下界。
AI.result: 给出了空间复杂度为多对数阶的3趟二维全等识别（CI）算法，以及4趟插入式全等哈希算法；同时证明了任何 $p$ 趟随机流算法的 $Ω(\frac{1}{p}(\log n+\log U+\log \frac{1}δ))$ 空间下界，且证明近似CI即使在多项式趟数下也需要 $\text{poly}(n)$ 空间。
AI.conclusion: 本文为二维几何全等性测试和全等哈希在流模型下提供了首批多对数字/多趟的高效随机算法和对应的空间下界，展现了流模型与RAM模型在几何问题处理上的显著复杂性差异。
AI.translation: 几何全等询问旨在判断两个点多重集在平移和旋转下是否相同，而全等高效查询则寻求支持有效全等查询的紧凑编码。我们在具有有限精度有理数输入的流模型下研究了这些问题，其中每个坐标为 $p/q$，满足 $|p|, |q| \le U$。我们的主要结果是两个随机多对数字对数字空间的二维全等识别（CI）算法，该算法在全等时还需输出一个有效的变换。在至少 $1-\delta$ 的概率下，我们的3趟产品锚点算法在转门模型中使用 $O((\log n+\log U+\log \frac{1}{\delta})\log\log n\log \frac{1}{\delta})$ 空间，而我们的3趟复数矩算法在仅插入模型中使用 $O(\log n(\log n+\log U+\log \frac{1}{\delta}))$ 空间。以CI为构建模块，我们获得了针对 $m$ 个查询集的4趟仅插入全等哈希算法，使用 $O(m(\log n+\log U+\log m+\log \frac{1}{\delta}))$ 空间并生成长度为 $O(\log \frac{1}{\delta}+\log U+\log m)$ 的签名。这两种算法都预采样素数用于模哈希以处理精度问题。前一种算法使用有限域嵌入和数论保证来恢复旋转，后一种算法则依赖于一个新的非消逝复数矩准则，从而避免了附加的数论条件和传统的消逝矩障碍。在困难性结果方面，我们证明了任何误差至多为 $\delta$ 的 $p$ 趟二维CI随机流算法都需要 $\Omega(\frac{1}{p}(\log n+\log U+\log \frac{1}{\delta}))$ 空间，这与转门模型的上界在 $\log\log n$ 因子上相匹配。此外，近似CI即使在多项式趟数下也需要 $\text{poly}(n)$ 空间。这与RAM模型形成了鲜明对比，在RAM模型中，精确和近似版本都可以在多项式时间内求解。
AI.summary: 本文研究了流模型下有限精度有理数输入的二维几何全等性测试与全等哈希问题。作者提出了两个创新的随机多趟算法，分别适用于转门模型和插入模型，能够以多对数空间实现全等识别，并衍生出高效的全等哈希算法。同时，本文还证明了空间下界，突显了流模型与传统RAM模型在全等性计算上的复杂性差异。
AI.keywords: Geometric Congruence, Streaming Algorithms, Congruence Hashing, Space Complexity, Randomized Algorithms
AI.comments: 该论文在几何流模型（streaming model）下研究了二维全等性测试与哈希问题，给出了高效的随机多趟算法和紧凑的下界证明。其创新之处在于通过产品锚点和复数矩准则克服了传统消逝矩（vanishing-moment obstacle）障碍，理论分析扎实，具有很高的理论价值。

title: Observability Engineering: From Measurement to Information Generation in Active Sensing Systems
summary: This article develops a four stage observability engineering framework for interaction driven sensing. The framework integrates physical modeling, information geometry, symmetry reduction, cross system correspondence, and observable world models into a unified engineering perspective, where sensing actions induce information structures that govern local distinguishability, while physical symmetries define equivalence classes of states that remain fundamentally indistinguishable. The proposed framework explains several common phenomena in modern sensing systems. Physically different architectures can exhibit comparable sensing capability when they induce similar quotient space information structures, whereas insufficient action diversity can lead to blind directions, ill conditioned estimation, and false identifiability. The framework also provides a quotient space language for comparing heterogeneous sensing architectures beyond hardware level descriptors, while clarifying how different forms of sensing diversity contribute to distinguishability. The framework is developed primarily through high frequency electromagnetic sensing, where geometric optics approximations provide an analytically interpretable physical realization. The broader observability engineering perspective, however, does not depend on geometric optics itself; it requires an action indexed observation family and a task relevant distinguishability measure. From this viewpoint, observability is not a passive property of sensor measurements alone, but an engineered outcome of action physics coupling under physical and symmetry constraints.

AI.title_translation: 可观测性工程：主动传感系统中的从测量到信息生成
AI.tldr: 提出了一种将可观测性从被动测量转变为主动工程设计的新框架，通过动作-物理耦合和对称性约束来统一解释和设计异构传感系统。
AI.motivation: 现代传感系统需要超越硬件层面的描述，理解感知动作如何诱导信息结构，以及物理对称性如何定义不可区分的状态等基本问题，从而将可观测性从被动测量转化为信息生成。
AI.method: 开发了一个四阶段的可观测性工程框架，集成了物理建模、信息几何、对称性约简、跨系统对应以及可观测世界模型，并通过高频电磁传感与几何光学近似进行了分析验证。
AI.result: 该框架解释了现代传感系统中的多种常见现象，包括不同物理架构在诱导相似商空间信息结构时表现出可比的感知能力，以及动作多样性不足会导致盲方向、估计病态和虚假可辨识性等问题。
AI.conclusion: 可观测性不再是传感器测量的单纯被动属性，而是通过动作与物理的耦合在物理和对称性约束下设计出来的结果，该框架为异构传感架构的分析和比较提供了统一的理论工具。
AI.translation: 本文针对交互驱动感知开发了一个四阶段的可观测性工程框架。该框架将物理建模、信息几何、对称性约简、跨系统对应以及可观测世界模型整合到一个统一的工程视角中。在此视角下，感知动作诱导出的信息结构决定了局部可辨识性，而物理对称性则定义了本质上不可区分的状态等效类。所提出的框架解释了现代传感系统中的几种常见现象：当不同物理架构诱导相似的商空间信息结构时，它们可以表现出可比的感知能力；而动作多样性不足则会导致盲方向、病态估计和虚假可辨识性。该框架还提供了一种商空间语言，用于超越硬件级描述来比较异构传感架构，同时阐明了不同形式的传感多样性如何对可辨识性做出贡献。该框架主要通过高频电磁传感进行开发，其中几何光学近似提供了一种具分析解释力的物理实现。然而，更广泛的可观测性工程视角并不依赖于几何光学本身，它需要一个动作索引的观测族和一个任务相关的可辨识性度量。从这个角度来看，可观测性不仅仅是传感器测量的被动属性，而是物理和对称性约束下动作与物理耦合的工程化成果。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对交互驱动感知的四阶段可观测性工程框架，通过将物理建模、信息几何、对称性约简与可观测世界模型统一，揭示了可观测性是动作物理耦合及约束下工程设计的结果，并能有效比较异构传感架构。
AI.keywords: 可观测性工程, 主动感知, 信息几何, 对称性约简, 商空间
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种开创性的可观测性工程框架，将主动感知中的物理建模、信息几何与对称性约简有机结合，把可观测性从被动的测量属性提升为主动设计的结果，对理解和设计复杂传感系统具有重要意义。

title: A Tale of Two Graphs: Separating Knowledge Exploration from Outline Structure for Open-Ended Deep Research
summary: Open-Ended Deep Research (OEDR) pushes LLM agents beyond short-form QA toward long-horizon workflows that iteratively search, connect, and synthesize evidence into structured reports. However, existing OEDR agents largely follow either linear ``search-then-generate'' accumulation or outline-centric planning. The former suffers from lost-in-the-middle failures as evidence grows, while the latter relies on the LLM to implicitly infer knowledge gaps from the outline alone, providing weak supervision for identifying missing relations and triggering targeted exploration. We present DualGraph memory, an architecture that separates what the agent knows from how it writes. DualGraph maintains two co-evolving graphs: an Outline Graph (OG), and a Knowledge Graph (KG), a semantic memory that stores fine-grained knowledge units, including core entities, concepts, and their relations. By analyzing the KG topology together with structural signals from the OG, DualGraph generates targeted search queries, enabling more efficient and comprehensive iterative knowledge-driven exploration and refinement.Across four established OEDR benchmarks, DualGraph consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in report depth, breadth, and factual grounding; for example, it reaches a 53.08 RACE score on DeepResearch Bench with GPT-5. Moreover, ablation studies confirm the central role of the dual-graph design.

AI.title_translation: 双图记：为开放式深度研究将知识探索与大纲结构相分离
AI.tldr: DualGraph是一种通过分离知识探索与大纲结构来优化开放式深度研究的智能体架构，能显著提升生成报告的深度与准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的开放式深度研究（OEDR）智能体采用线性搜索生成或大纲中心规划，存在证据增长导致的“迷失在中间”失效，以及大纲隐含知识缺口导致监督薄弱、难以触发有针对性探索的问题。
AI.method: 提出DualGraph内存架构，维护两个共同演化的图：用于写作的大纲图（OG）和作为语义记忆存储细粒度知识单元的知识图谱（KG），并结合两者的拓扑和结构信号生成有针对性的搜索查询。
AI.result: 在四个已建立的OEDR基准测试中，DualGraph在报告深度、广度和事实准确性方面持续优于最先进的基线，例如在使用GPT-5的DeepResearch Bench上达到了53.08的RACE分数。
AI.conclusion: DualGraph架构通过分离大纲结构与知识探索，显著提升了开放式深度研究智能体在报告深度、广度和事实准确性方面的性能。
AI.translation: 开放式深度研究（OEDR）将大模型智能体推向了超越短文本问答的长程工作流，这些工作流能够迭代地搜索、连接和合成证据，形成结构化的报告。然而，现有的OEDR智能体大体上遵循线性的“先搜索后生成”累积或以大纲为中心的规划。前者随着证据的增长而遭受“迷失在中间”的失效，而后者则依赖大模型仅从大纲中隐式推断知识缺口，这为识别缺失关系和触发针对性探索提供了薄弱的监督。我们提出了DualGraph内存架构，该架构将智能体所知道的内容与其如何编写内容相分离。DualGraph维护两个共同演化的图：大纲图（OG）和知识图谱（KG），其中知识图谱是一种存储细粒度知识单元（包括核心实体、概念及其关系）的语义记忆。通过分析KG拓扑结构以及来自OG的结构信号，DualGraph生成有针对性的搜索查询，从而实现更高效、更全面的迭代知识驱动探索与精炼。在四个已建立的OEDR基准测试中，DualGraph在报告深度、广度和事实准确性方面持续优于最先进的基线；例如，在使用GPT-5的DeepResearch Bench上，它达到了53.08的RACE分数。此外，消融实验证实了双图设计的核心作用。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DualGraph内存架构，通过将知识探索（知识图谱）与大纲结构（大纲图）分离，解决了开放式深度研究智能体中的长程规划与知识检索难题，并在多项基准测试中取得了超越当前最先进基线的表现。
AI.keywords: 开放式深度研究, 大模型智能体, 知识图谱, 大纲结构, 双图记忆架构
AI.comments: 该论文针对开放式深度研究（OEDR）中大模型长程工作流的痛点，创新性地提出了DualGraph架构，将大纲结构与知识探索解耦，有效解决了“迷失在中间”和监督微弱的问题。在多个基准测试中表现优异，具有很高的实用价值和理论启发意义。

title: You Can Learn Tokenization End-to-End with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Tokenization is a hardcoded compression step which remains in the training pipeline of Large Language Models (LLMs), despite a general trend towards architectures becoming increasingly end-to-end. Prior work has shown promising results at scale in bringing this compression step inside the LLMs' architecture with heuristics to draw token boundaries, and also attempts to learn these token boundaries with straight-through estimates, which treat the problem of drawing discrete token boundaries as a continuous one. We show that these token boundaries can instead be learned using score function estimates, which have tighter theoretical guarantees due to directly optimizing the problem of drawing discrete token boundaries to minimize loss. We observe that techniques from reinforcement learning, such as time discounting, are necessary to reduce the variance of this score function sufficiently to make it practicable. We demonstrate that the resultant method outperforms prior proposed straight-through estimates, both qualitatively and quantitatively at the $100$ million parameter scale.

AI.title_translation: 你可以通过强化学习端到端地学习分词
AI.tldr: 本文提出使用强化学习通过得分函数估计来端到端学习大语言模型的token分词边界，优于传统的直通估计方法。
AI.motivation: 目前大语言模型训练流程中仍保留了硬编码的分词步骤，尽管先前的工作尝试用启发式方法或直通估计（将离散边界处理为连续问题）将其纳入模型内部，但仍存在局限性，因此需要更具理论保障的方法来通过端到端学习解决离散token边界问题。
AI.method: 采用基于得分函数估计的方法直接优化离散token边界的最小化损失，并引入强化学习中的时间折扣等技术来减少方差，使其具备实用性。
AI.result: 在1亿参数规模下，该方法在定性和定量上均优于先前提出的直通估计方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过强化学习和时间折扣技术，端到端学习离散token边界在理论和1亿参数规模的实践中均可行且优于传统直通估计方法。
AI.translation: 分词是大语言模型（LLM）训练流程中保留的一个硬编码压缩步骤，尽管目前的总体趋势是架构越来越趋向于端到端。先前的研究在将这一压缩步骤引入LLM架构内部方面显示出有希望的大规模结果，包括使用启发式方法绘制token边界，以及尝试通过将绘制离散token边界的问题视为连续问题来用直通估计（straight-through estimates）学习这些边界。我们表明，这些token边界可以改用得分函数估计来学习，由于直接优化绘制离散token边界以最小化损失的问题，得分函数估计具有更严格的理论保证。我们发现，来自强化学习的技术（如时间折扣）对于充分降低该得分函数的方差以使其切实可行是必要的。我们在1亿参数规模下从定性和定量两方面证明了该方法优于先前提出的直通估计方法。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种利用强化学习（通过得分函数估计和时间折扣）端到端学习大语言模型离散token边界的新方法，克服了传统硬编码分词和直通估计的局限，并在1亿参数规模的实验中展现出优于现有方法的性能。
AI.keywords: Tokenization, Reinforcement Learning, Large Language Models, Score Function Estimates, End-to-End Architecture
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将强化学习引入大语言模型的端到端分词中，利用得分函数估计代替传统启发式或直通估计（straight-through estimates），并结合时间折扣等技术有效降低方差，在理论和1亿参数规模的实验上都取得了显著突破，推动了LLM向完全端到端架构的演进。

title: Open Rubric System: Scaling Reinforcement Learning with Pairwise Adaptive Rubric
summary: Scalar reward models compress multi-dimensional human preferences into a single opaque score, creating an information bottleneck that often leads to brittleness and reward hacking in open-ended alignment. We argue that robust alignment for non-verifiable tasks is fundamentally a principle generalization problem: reward should not be a learned function internalized into a judge, but an explicit reasoning process executed under inspectable principles. To operationalize this view, we present the Open Rubric System (OpenRS), a plug-and-play, rubrics-based LLM-as-a-Judge framework built around Pairwise Adaptive Meta-Rubrics (PAMR) and lightweight Pointwise Verifiable Rubrics (PVRs), which provide both hard-constraint guardrails and verifiable reward components when ground-truth or programmatic checks are available. OpenRS uses an explicit meta-rubric -- a constitution-like specification that governs how rubrics are instantiated, weighted, and enforced -- and instantiates adaptive rubrics on the fly by conditioning on the semantic differences between two candidate responses. It then performs criterion-wise pairwise comparisons and aggregates criterion-level preferences externally, avoiding pointwise weighted scalarization while improving discriminability in open-ended settings. To keep principles consistent yet editable across various domains, we introduce a two-level meta-rubric refinement pipeline (automated evolutionary refinement for general principles and a reproducible human-in-the-loop procedure for domain principles), complemented with pointwise verifiable rubrics that act as both guardrails against degenerate behaviors and a source of verifiable reward for objective sub-tasks. Finally, we instantiate OpenRS as reward supervision in pairwise RL training.

AI.title_translation: 开放评分系统：利用成对自适应评分标准扩展强化学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出了 Open Rubric System (OpenRS)，利用显式的成对自适应评分标准替代传统标量奖励模型，解决了大模型开放式对齐中的信息瓶颈和奖励造假问题。
AI.motivation: 传统的标量奖励模型将多维人类偏好压缩为单一晦涩的分数，造成信息瓶颈，容易在开放式对齐中导致脆弱性和奖励造假；因此，非可验证任务的稳健对齐本质上是一个原则泛化问题，奖励不应是被内化为裁判的学习函数，而应是在可检查原则下执行的显式推理过程。
AI.method: 提出 Open Rubric System (OpenRS)，核心包含成对自适应元评分标准（PAMR）和逐点可验证评分标准（PVR）；利用显式元规范根据两个候选响应的语义差异即时实例化自适应评分标准，进行准则维度的成对比较与外部聚合；同时引入两级元评分标准精细化流水线（自动化进化精细化与人类参与流程）。
AI.result: 通过将 OpenRS 实例化为成对强化学习训练中的奖励监督，成功实现了对开放式任务中多维偏好的有效捕捉与外部聚合，提高了判别能力并确保了原则的一致性与可编辑性。
AI.conclusion: OpenRS 框架通过用显式、可检查的推理过程替代内化的标量奖励模型，有效解决了开放式对齐中的奖励造假与信息瓶颈问题，并在成对强化学习训练中展现出良好的可扩展性和实用性。
AI.translation: 标量奖励模型将多维度的早期人类偏好压缩为单一的不透明分数，造成了信息瓶颈，这往往会导致在开放式对齐中出现脆弱性和奖励造假问题。我们认为，针对不可验证任务的稳健对齐从根本上说是一个原则泛化问题：奖励不应是内化到裁判中的学习函数，而应当是在可检查原则下执行的显式推理过程。为了使这一观点具有可操作性，我们提出了开放评分系统（OpenRS），这是一个即插即用的、基于评分标准的 LLM-as-a-Judge 框架，它围绕成对自适应元评分标准（PAMR）和轻量级逐点可验证评分标准（PVR）构建，在地面真实值或程序化检查可用时提供硬约束护栏和可验证的奖励组件。OpenRS 使用一个显式的元评分标准——一个类似宪法的规范，支配评分标准的实例化、加权和执行——并通过根据两个候选响应之间的语义差异进行条件化，即时实例化自适应评分标准。然后，它执行标准维度的成对比较并在外部聚合标准级别的偏好，避免了逐点加权标量化，同时提高了开放式设置中的可辨别性。为了使各领域的原则保持一致且可编辑，我们引入了两级元评分标准精细化流水线（针对通用原则的自动化进化精细化和用于领域原则的可复现人类参与流程），并辅以逐点可验证评分标准，该标准既充当防范退化行为的护栏，又是客观子任务的可验证奖励来源。最后，我们将 OpenRS 实例化为成对强化学习训练中的奖励监督。
AI.summary: 本文提出了开放评分系统 (OpenRS)，这是一个基于大语言模型作为裁判的框架，通过成对自适应元评分标准（PAMR）和逐点可验证评分标准（PVR），用显式推理过程替代了传统的标量奖励模型，从而解决了开放式对齐中的奖励造假问题，并成功应用于强化学习的奖励监督。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 奖励模型, LLM-as-a-Judge, 评分标准, 语言模型对齐
AI.comments: 该论文针对传统标量奖励模型在开放式对齐中的信息瓶颈和奖励造假问题，创新性地提出了基于成对自适应评分标准（PAMR）和逐点可验证评分标准（PVR）的Open Rubric System (OpenRS)。这种将奖励建模转化为显式推理过程的方法，显著提升了非验证性任务的对齐鲁棒性和可解释性，对强化学习中的奖励监督具有重要价值。

title: A Universal Neural Receiver that Learns at the Speed of Wireless
summary: Today we design wireless networks using mathematical models that govern communication in different propagation environments. We rely on measurement campaigns to deliver parametrized propagation models, and on the 3GPP standards process to optimize model-based performance, but as wireless networks become more complex this model-based approach is losing ground. Mobile Network Operators (MNOs) are counting on Artificial Intelligence (AI) to transform wireless by increasing spectral efficiency, reducing signaling overhead, and enabling continuous network innovation through software upgrades. They may also be interested in new use cases like integrated sensing and communications (ISAC). All we need is an AI-native physical layer, so why not simply tailor the offline AI algorithms that have revolutionized image and natural language processing to the wireless domain? We argue that these algorithms rely on off-line training that is precluded by the sub-millisecond speeds at which the wireless interference environment changes. We present an alternative architecture, a universal neural receiver based on convolution, which governs transmit and receive signal processing of any signal in any part of the wireless spectrum. Our neural receiver is designed to invert convolution, and we separate the question of which convolution to invert from the actual deconvolution. The neural network that performs deconvolution is very simple, and we configure this network by setting weights based on domain knowledge. By telling our neural network what we know, we avoid extensive offline training. By developing a universal receiver, we hope to simplify discussions about the proper choice of waveform for different use cases in the international standards. Since the receiver architecture is largely independent of technologies introduced at the base station, we hope to increase the rate of innovation in wireless.

AI.title_translation: 一种通用的神经网络接收器，能够以无线通信的速度进行学习
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种通用的神经网络接收器架构，用于解决传统无线网络模型在面对日益复杂的无线环境时面临的挑战。与依赖离线训练的传统AI算法不同，该接收器利用卷积神经网络，并通过设置基于领域知识的权重来避免大量的离线训练，从而能够以亚毫秒级的速度适应无线环境的变化。这种方法有望简化无线通信中的波形选择讨论，并加速无线技术的创新。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于模型的无线网络设计方法在面对日益复杂的无线环境时正逐渐失效。需要一种新的方法来提高频谱效率、降低信令开销、实现持续的网络创新，并支持新的用例，如集成传感与通信（ISAC）。
AI.method: 提出了一种通用的神经网络接收器架构，该架构基于卷积神经网络，能够反转卷积操作。通过将卷积反演问题与实际的解卷积操作分离开来，并利用基于领域知识配置的简单神经网络进行解卷积，从而避免了大量的离线训练，实现了在无线通信速度下的学习。
AI.result: 提出了一种通用的神经网络接收器，能够以无线通信的速度进行学习，有望简化波形选择的讨论，并加速无线技术的创新。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出了一种通用的神经网络接收器架构，它通过利用卷积神经网络和基于领域知识的权重配置，解决了传统AI算法在无线通信领域面临的离线训练瓶颈。这种方法有望简化无线通信的设计，并加速技术创新。
AI.translation: 如今，我们使用控制不同传播环境通信的数学模型来设计无线网络。我们依赖测量活动来提供参数化的传播模型，并依赖 3GPP 标准流程来优化基于模型的性能，但随着无线网络的日益复杂，这种基于模型的方法正在失去优势。移动网络运营商 (MNO) 依靠人工智能 (AI) 来彻底改变无线通信，方法是提高频谱效率、减少信令开销，并通过软件升级实现持续的网络创新。他们可能还对集成传感与通信 (ISAC) 等新用例感兴趣。我们所需要的只是一个人工智能原生的物理层，那么为什么不直接将彻底改变图像和自然语言处理的离线人工智能算法定制到无线领域呢？我们认为，这些算法依赖于离线训练，而无线干扰环境以亚毫秒级的速度变化，这阻碍了离线训练。我们提出了一种替代架构，一种基于卷积的通用神经网络接收器，它控制着无线频谱中任何信号的传输和接收信号处理。我们的神经网络接收器旨在反转卷积，我们将要反转哪个卷积的问题与实际的解卷积分离开来。执行解卷积的神经网络非常简单，我们通过设置基于领域知识的权重来配置该网络。通过告知我们的神经网络我们所知道的信息，我们避免了大量的离线训练。通过开发一种通用的接收器，我们希望简化关于在国际标准中为不同用例选择合适波形的讨论。由于接收器架构在很大程度上独立于基站引入的技术，我们希望提高无线通信的创新速度。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种创新的通用神经网络接收器架构，旨在克服传统基于模型的无线网络设计方法在应对快速变化的无线环境时的局限性。该接收器利用卷积神经网络实现信号处理，并通过结合领域知识来配置网络权重，从而避免了耗时且不切实际的离线训练。这种方法能够以无线通信的实时速度进行学习和适应，有望简化无线通信标准中的波形选择，并加速整个无线技术领域的创新。
AI.keywords: 神经网络接收器, 卷积, 无线通信, AI, 实时学习
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的神经网络接收器架构，解决了无线通信领域的一个关键挑战：如何在快速变化的无线环境中实现有效的实时学习和适应。通过利用卷积和基于领域知识的权重配置，该方法避免了传统AI算法的离线训练瓶颈，具有很高的理论和实践意义。然而，该架构的实际部署和性能验证，以及与其他先进无线通信技术的兼容性，仍需进一步的研究和评估。

title: Topology-Aware Decision Making for Multi-Session Localization and Mapping
summary: Operating in previously visited environments is becoming increasingly crucial for autonomous systems, with direct applications in autonomous driving, surveying, and warehouse or household robotics. This repeated exposure to observing the same areas poses significant challenges for mapping and localization across sessions, particularly in deciding when a prior model is sufficient for reliable localization and when new mapping is required. In this work, we propose a novel multi-session framework that builds on map-based localization, in contrast to the common practice of greedily running full SLAM sessions and trying to find correspondences between the resulting maps. The core contribution is a principled, topology-driven mechanism to detect multi-session mapping needs from the pose-graph structure. Specifically, our approach uses spectral connectivity metrics on the joint pose-graph to identify disconnections and weakly constrained regions, and selectively triggers mapping and loop closing only when the pose-graph topology indicates insufficient structural support. The resulting map and pose-graph are seamlessly integrated into the existing model, reducing accumulated error and enhancing global consistency while avoiding redundant remapping. We validate our method on overlapping sequences from datasets and demonstrate its effectiveness in a real-world mine-like environment.

AI.title_translation: 面向多会话定位与建图的拓扑感知决策方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于姿态图拓扑结构的智能决策框架，用于多会话定位与建图中按需触发建图，避免了冗余的重复建图。
AI.motivation: 在先前访问过的环境中进行重复作业时，如何决定何时利用先验模型进行可靠定位以及何时需要进行新图构建，是当前多会话定位与建图面临的重大挑战。传统的贪婪运行完整SLAM并寻找对应关系的方法存在局限性。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于拓扑驱动的机制来检测多会话建图需求，利用联合姿态图上的谱连通性指标来识别断开连接和约束薄弱的区域，并选择性地触发建图和回环闭合。
AI.result: 在数据集的重叠序列上验证了该方法，并在真实的矿井环境中展示了其有效性，能够在避免冗余重复建图的同时减小累积误差并增强全局一致性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的拓扑感知多会话建图与定位决策框架，能够有效识别姿态图中的薄弱区域，在减少冗余重复建图的同时保持全局一致性，并在真实矿井环境中验证了其有效性。
AI.translation: 在先前访问过的环境中运行对于自主系统变得越来越关键，其在自动驾驶、测绘以及仓储或家庭机器人领域有着直接应用。这种对同一区域的反复观察给跨会话的建图和定位带来了重大挑战，特别是难以决定何时先验模型足以进行可靠定位以及何时需要进行新地图构建。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种建立在基于地图定位基础上的新颖多会话框架，这与贪婪地运行完整SLAM会话并试图在所得地图之间寻找对应关系的常见做法形成了鲜明对比。核心贡献是一个有原则的、由拓扑驱动的机制，用于从姿态图结构中检测多会话建图需求。具体而言，我们的方法利用联合姿态图上的谱连通性指标来识别断开和弱约束区域，并且仅当姿态图拓扑表明结构支撑不足时，才选择性地触发建图和回环闭合。由此产生的地图和姿态图无缝集成到现有模型中，减少了累积误差并增强了全局一致性，同时避免了冗余的重复建图。我们在数据集的重叠序列上验证了我们的方法，并证明了其在现实世界矿井环境中的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文针对多会话定位与建图问题，摒弃了传统的贪婪式完整SLAM方法，提出了一种基于姿态图拓扑结构的谱连通性分析框架。该框架能够智能识别地图中的弱约束区域，仅在结构支撑不足时按需触发建图与回环闭合，从而在避免冗余计算的同时提高了全局定位的准确性和一致性。
AI.keywords: 多会话定位, 视觉建图, 拓扑感知, 姿态图优化, 谱连通性
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的拓扑感知多会话定位与建图决策机制，通过分析联合姿态图的谱连通性来决定何时需要触发新的建图，有效平衡了定位精度与计算冗余，在自动驾驶和机器人领域具有很高的实用价值。

title: VLANeXt: Recipes for Building Strong VLA Models
comments: Accepted in ICML 2026, Project Page: https://dravenalg.github.io/VLANeXt/
summary: Following the rise of large foundation models, Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) emerged, leveraging strong visual and language understanding from Vision-Language Models for general-purpose policy learning. Yet, the current VLA landscape remains fragmented and exploratory. Although many groups have proposed their own VLA models, inconsistencies in training protocols and evaluation settings make it difficult to identify which design choices truly matter. To bring structure to this evolving space, we reexamine the VLA design space under a unified framework and evaluation setup. Starting from a simple VLA baseline similar to RT-2, which is the origin of VLA, we systematically dissect design choices along three dimensions: foundational components, perception essentials, and action modelling perspectives. From this study, we distill 12 key findings that together form a practical recipe for building strong VLA models. The outcome of this exploration is a simple yet effective model, VLANeXt. It outperforms the state-of-the-art methods on the LIBERO and LIBERO-plus benchmarks and demonstrates strong performance in real-world experiments. We release a unified and easy-to-use codebase to reproduce our findings, explore the design space, and develop new VLA variants on top of a shared foundation. The codebase is available at https://github.com/DravenALG/VLANeXt.

title: Life-Bench: A Benchmark and Knowledge Graph Framework for Multimodal Personalization Beyond Concept Recognition
summary: As large language models increasingly power personal assistants, users expect them to reason over multimodal life histories, from recognizing people to understanding events to aggregating patterns, yet existing benchmarks primarily target concept-level recognition. We introduce Life-Bench, a fully synthetic, human-verified multimodal benchmark of over 11,800 question-answer pairs across 10 tasks, organized by required evidence scope: concept identification, event understanding, and aggregated reasoning. The benchmark's photo-centric personal histories are distributionally aligned with real user accounts under embedding statistic. The interconnected structure of personal data invites graph-based solutions; we propose LifeGraph, a personal knowledge graph framework providing structured retrieval with on-demand access to source visual evidence, showing particular promise on event and aggregated tasks. Systematic evaluation of four retrieval paradigms on Life-Bench demonstrates that accuracy degrades sharply with evidence scope, falling below 0.40 on aggregated tasks, and that no single paradigm dominates across categories. Performance beyond concept recognition remains modest for all evaluated methods, establishing personalization over multimodal histories as an open challenge and Life-Bench as a testbed for future progress.

AI.title_translation: Life-Bench：超越概念识别的多模态个性化基准与知识图谱框架
AI.tldr: 本文推出了Life-Bench基准和LifeGraph知识图谱框架，用于评估和提升大语言模型在多模态个人历史中的复杂推理能力，发现现有方法在处理聚合推理时表现明显不足。
AI.motivation: 现有的基准主要集中在概念级别的识别，而随着大语言模型驱动的个人助手普及，用户期望它们能够对多模态生活历史进行推理（从识别人物、理解事件到聚合模式），因此需要一个超越概念识别的多模态个性化评估基准和框架。
AI.method: 引入了Life-Bench基准（包含超过11,800个问答对，涵盖10个任务，分为概念识别、事件理解和聚合推理三类），并提出了LifeGraph个人知识图谱框架，该框架提供结构化检索以及对原始视觉证据的按需访问。
AI.result: 系统评估表明，随着证据范围的扩大，检索准确率急剧下降，在聚合任务上甚至降至0.40以下；没有单一的检索范式能够在所有类别中占主导地位，所有评估方法的表现都相对一般。
AI.conclusion: 多模态个人历史的个性化推理在概念识别之外仍然是一个重大挑战，现有的检索范式在处理复杂证据范围时表现不佳，这凸显了Life-Bench作为未来技术测试台的重要性。
AI.translation: 随着大型语言模型越来越多地驱动个人助手，用户期望它们能够对多模态生活历史进行推理，从识别人物、理解事件到聚合模式，然而现有的基准主要针对概念级别的识别。我们推出了 Life-Bench，这是一个完全合成的、经人工验证的多模态基准，包含来自 10 个任务的 11,800 多个问答对，按所需的证据范围组织：概念识别、事件理解和聚合推理。该基准以照片为中心的个人历史在嵌入统计下与真实用户账户的分布保持一致。个人数据的互联结构需要基于图的解决方案；我们提出了 LifeGraph，一个个人知识图谱框架，提供具有源视觉证据按需访问功能的结构化检索，在事件和聚合任务上显示出特别的前景。对 LifeBench 上四种检索范式的系统评估表明，准确率随着证据范围的扩大而急剧下降，在聚合任务上跌至 0.40 以下，并且没有单一的检索范式在各个类别中占据主导地位。对于所有评估的方法来说，概念识别之外的性能仍然很低，这确立了多模态历史个性化作为一个开放挑战，并将 Life-Bench 作为未来进展的测试平台。
AI.summary: Life-Bench是一个包含11,800多个问答对的多模态个性化基准，用于评估超出概念识别范围的推理能力。作者同时提出了LifeGraph知识图谱框架来应对这一挑战，实验证明当前多模态个性化推理仍是一个开放性难题。
AI.keywords: 多模态个性化, 个人知识图谱, 大语言模型, 基准测试, 复杂推理
AI.comments: 该论文填补了多模态个性化评估在概念识别之外的空白，构建了一个高质量的合成人类验证基准Life-Bench，并提出了LifeGraph知识图谱框架，对于推动个人AI助手向更深层次的事件理解和综合推理发展具有重要意义。

title: Carbon-Aware Data Center Workload Allocation: Emission Disclosure, Capacity Leasing, and Contract Reshuffling
summary: The rapid adoption of AI has driven rapid growth in computational demand, with large language models (LLMs) at the forefront since ChatGPT's debut in 2022. Meanwhile, large amounts of renewable energy are ultimately curtailed due to transmission congestion and inadequate demand. This work develops a power market model that allows hyperscalers to spatially migrate LLM inference workloads to geo-distributed modular datacenters (MDCs) co-located with renewable generation at the edge of the network. We introduce the optimization problems faced by the hyperscaler and MDCs in addition to consumers, producers, and the electric grid operator, where the hyperscaler leases MDC capacity while ensuring that required service level objectives (SLOs) are met. The overall market model is formulated as a complementarity problem, for which we establish equilibrium existence and uniqueness of certain aggregate market quantities. We further show that bilateral contract allocations can vary while preserving the same physical market outcome, so cleaner contract-attributed procurement need not imply additional clean generation. Applying the model to the IEEE RTS-24 bus system, we find that even when MDCs disclose the CO$_2$ emissions associated with their energy supply, renting less polluting MDCs yields limited system emission reductions because of \textit{contract reshuffling}. This effect can be mitigated when conventional loads are supplied through forward contracts such as power purchase agreements. Interestingly, this also reduces system congestion as the hyperscaler becomes increasingly cost-aware.

AI.title_translation: 碳感知数据中心工作负载分配：碳排放披露、容量租赁与合同重新洗牌
AI.tldr: 本文建立了一个电力市场模型，研究AI数据中心通过工作负载迁移来利用可再生能源，并揭示了由于“合同重新洗牌”效应，仅披露碳排放对系统级减排的作用有限。
AI.motivation: 随着AI和大型语言模型（LLMs）的爆发式增长，计算需求激增，同时由于输电拥堵和需求不足导致大量可再生能源被弃用。该研究旨在通过地理分布式模块化数据中心将LLM推理工作负载进行空间迁移，以消纳可再生能源并降低碳排放。
AI.method: 开发了一个电力市场模型，将超大规模数据中心、模块化数据中心（MDCs）、消费者、生产者和电网运营商纳入优化问题中，并将其表述为互补问题，证明了均衡的存在性和某些聚合市场数量的唯一性。
AI.result: 在IEEE RTS-24总线系统上的应用表明，即使MDCs披露其能源供应的CO2排放量，由于“合同重新洗牌”效应，租用污染较少的数据中心对系统整体碳减排的效果也十分有限；不过，当常规负荷通过购电协议等前向合同供应时，这种效应可以得到缓解，同时还能减少系统拥堵。
AI.conclusion: 通过空间迁移LLM工作负载，超大规模数据中心可以参与电力市场并实现碳成本感知。然而，由于合同重新洗牌效应，单纯披露碳排放并选择清洁度更高的数据中心对系统级减排的作用有限，该问题可以通过采用前向购电协议等方式得到缓解。
AI.translation: 人工智能的快速采用推动了计算需求的急剧增长，自2022年ChatGPT问世以来，大语言模型（LLMs）一直处于最前沿。与此同时，由于输电拥堵和需求不足，大量可再生能源最终被弃用。本研究开发了一个电力市场模型，允许超大规模数据中心（hyperscalers）将LLM推理工作负载空间迁移至与网络边缘可再生能源并址的地理分布式模块化数据中心（MDCs）。我们引入了超大规模数据中心和MDCs以及消费者、生产者和电网运营商所面临的优化问题，其中超大规模数据中心在确保满足所需服务质量目标（SLOs）的同时租赁MDC容量。整个市场模型被表达为一个互补问题，为此我们确定了某些聚合市场数量的均衡存在性和唯一性。我们进一步表明，双边合同分配可以在保持相同物理市场结果的同时发生变化，因此更清洁的合同归属采购并不一定意味着额外的清洁发电。将该模型应用于IEEE RTS-24总线系统，我们发现，即使MDCs披露与其能源供应相关的CO2排放量，由于“合同重新洗牌”，租用污染较少的数据中心所产生的系统减排效果也十分有限。当常规负荷通过电力购买协议等远期合同供应时，这种效应可以得到缓解。有趣的是，这也减少了系统拥堵，因为超大规模数据中心变得越来越具有碳成本意识。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种碳感知的数据中心工作负载分配电力市场模型，通过将LLM推理任务迁移至与可再生能源共址的边缘模块化数据中心（MDCs），研究了碳排放披露、容量租赁和合同重新洗牌对电力系统及减排的影响。
AI.keywords: Carbon-Aware Computing, Data Center Workload Allocation, Renewable Energy Curtailment, Complementarity Problem, Contract Reshuffling
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地构建了一个电力市场模型，研究了AI数据中心工作负载的时空迁移及其对碳排放和电网运行的影响，并揭示了“合同重新洗牌”现象，对理解碳感知计算和绿色能源采购具有重要启示。

title: Segmentation-Guided Homography Estimation for Long-Term Planar Tracking
comments: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Code: https://github.com/serycjon/WOFTSAM Project page: https://cmp.felk.cvut.cz/~serycjon/WOFTSAM/
summary: Recent state-of-the-art visual trackers produce high quality and long-term-stable segmentation masks. We propose to leverage these strengths for planar object tracking, in which the goal is to estimate a precise 8-degrees-of-freedom homography pose, a geometric representation not estimated by segmentation trackers. We present SAM-H - a planar object tracker that estimates homographies from segmentation mask contours via a training-free pipeline. When SAM-H is applied to masks from SAM 2, it sets a new state-of-the-art performance on the challenging PlanarTrack benchmark by a large margin, +18.4pp on the p@5 metric. We further show that segmentation-based and correspondence-based homography estimation are complementary, and propose WOFTSAM, which out-performs all prior methods on both PlanarTrack and POT-210. We also provide precise re-annotations of PlanarTrack initial poses, enabling more accurate benchmarking in the high-precision p@5 metric. The code and the re-annotations are available at https://github.com/serycjon/WOFTSAM

title: Topology enables learning-based hydrodynamic prediction of the global river system
comments: 21 pages, 4 figures. Main text only; the supplementary materials accompany the journal version
summary: Accurate river prediction is essential for water, food and energy security, yet remains challenging across entire river networks. Machine learning has transformed Earth-system modeling, but a system-level advance for river prediction lags for lack of reliable data. Exploiting the connectivity and dissipative dynamics of rivers, we introduce GraphRiverCast, a neural model for global river systems that predicts daily multivariate hydrodynamics at every reach of a 0.25°network with only sparse gauges and no initial state. It shows no intrinsic skill decay with lead time, outperforms leading global river models by 25% in accuracy, and robustly generalizes to ungauged reaches and finer resolutions. GraphRiverCast lifts learning-based river prediction from isolated basins to a unified global system and offers insights for machine learning in data-scarce Earth systems.

title: RT-NeuS: Towards Real-Time Neuro-Symbolic Video Understanding via Adaptive Temporal Verification
summary: Long-form video question answering (LVQA) requires answering natural-language queries about videos spanning minutes to hours, demanding temporal reasoning across thousands of frames. Standard vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with this task: their fixed frame budgets force aggressive downsampling that misses the temporal structure that complex queries depend on. Neuro-symbolic approaches address this by decomposing queries into atomic propositions, translating them into temporal logic specifications, and applying formal model checking to retrieve segments satisfying the specification. This yields up to 10% higher accuracy on temporally complex benchmarks, with interpretability and formal guarantees. However, constructing the video automaton requires grounding every proposition at every frame window via VLM calls, resulting in up to 130x slower inference than standard VLM prompting. We present RT-NeuS, a framework that preserves the accuracy and formal guarantees of temporal-logic-guided LVQA while closing this latency gap. RT-NeuS introduces coarse-to-fine adaptive sampling to identify the small set of query-relevant, visually distinct frames, and batched proposition detection with KV-cache reuse to evaluate all propositions per window in a single forward pass. We derive latency upper bounds as a function of video length, proposition count, and sampling density. Experiments on LongVideoBench, Video-MME, and MLVU reduce inference latency by up to 13x on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU, while matching or exceeding prior neuro-symbolic accuracy.

title: Spatio-Temporal Garment Reconstruction Using Diffusion Mapping via Pattern Coordinates
comments: arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2504.08353
summary: Reconstructing 3D clothed humans from monocular images and videos is a fundamental problem with applications in virtual try-on, avatar creation, and mixed reality. Despite significant progress in human body recovery, accurately reconstructing garment geometry, particularly for loose-fitting clothing, remains an open challenge. We propose a unified framework for high-fidelity 3D garment reconstruction from both single images and video sequences. Our approach combines Implicit Sewing Patterns (ISP) with a generative diffusion model to learn expressive garment shape priors in 2D UV space. Leveraging these priors, we introduce a mapping model that establishes correspondences between image pixels, UV pattern coordinates, and 3D geometry, enabling accurate and detailed garment reconstruction from single images. We further extend this formulation to dynamic reconstruction by introducing a spatio-temporal diffusion scheme with test-time guidance to enforce long-range temporal consistency. We also develop analytic projection-based constraints that preserve image-aligned geometry in visible regions while enforcing coherent completion in occluded areas over time. Although trained exclusively on synthetically simulated cloth data, our method generalizes well to real-world imagery and consistently outperforms existing approaches on both tight- and loose-fitting garments. The reconstructed garments preserve fine geometric detail while exhibiting realistic dynamic motion, supporting downstream applications such as texture editing, garment retargeting, and animation.
comment: arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2504.08353

title: ST-Lite: Training-Free KV Cache Compression with Spatio-Trajectory Guidance for Long-Horizon GUI Agents
comments: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. Camera-ready version. 37 pages
summary: Training-free KV cache compression is essential for deploying vision-language GUI agents under memory and latency constraints, yet existing methods are designed for generic language workloads and ignore the distinctive structure of GUI interaction traces. We characterize three GUI-specific workload properties--high inter-frame visual redundancy, extremely small UI-element spatial footprints, and near-uniform cross-layer attention sparsity--that cause existing schemes to retain as few as 39% of oracle-important KV pairs at the standard 20% budget. To address this, we propose ST-Lite, a training-free compression scheme whose three components each target one property: Trajectory-aware Semantic Gating (TSG) filters redundant historical frames, Component-centric Spatial Saliency (CSS) preserves fine-grained element boundaries, and a flat per-layer budget avoids hierarchical misallocation. Across seven GUI benchmarks and two backbones in the deployment-relevant 10%-40% window, ST-Lite consistently outperforms all existing compression baselines, matching or exceeding Full Cache task accuracy on the primary backbone at the 20% budget while delivering up to 2.35x decoding speedup at fivefold compression. The implementation is available at https://github.com/94wen94/ST-Lite.
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. Camera-ready version. 37 pages

title: Cloud-OpsBench: A Reproducible Benchmark for Agentic Root Cause Analysis in Cloud Systems
summary: LLM agents are increasingly explored for automating root cause analysis (RCA) in cloud-native systems, creating a need to evaluate both diagnostic correctness and the quality of the supporting investigation. Existing static benchmarks offer repeatable inputs but limited system-facing interaction, while live testbeds expose realistic tools but hinder controlled comparison because incident evidence varies across runs; both paradigms focus primarily on final answers. To address these limitations, we present Cloud-OpsBench, an evaluation infrastructure for interactive and evidence-grounded cloud RCA. It comprises 754 runtime-verified cases across 57 fault types on two microservice workloads spanning application services and Kubernetes platform layers. Each fault is captured as a state snapshot and replayed through standard diagnostic interfaces, with outcome labels and diagnostic evidence graphs that enable matched comparisons and process-level analysis. Across ten LLM agents, the strongest Joint RCA Accuracy (JRA) reaches 0.76 on OnlineBoutique and 0.68 on TrainTicket, while the corresponding Evidence Closure Rates (ECR) are only 0.38 and 0.15. This outcome--process gap shows that final-answer correctness alone substantially overestimates agents' ability to perform evidence-grounded diagnosis.

title: The On-Chain and Off-Chain Mechanisms of DAO-to-DAO Voting
summary: Voting is the primary mechanism through which Decentralised Autonomous Organisations (DAOs) reach decisions. Although transparent, the voting process can be opaque: it can involve many interacting smart contracts. The nexus of the decision-making process can be relocated and the true voter demographic obfuscated. DAOs can also govern other DAOs, a process known as metagovernance. We present a method for identifying DAO-to-DAO metagovernance on the Ethereum blockchain. We focus on the links between DAOs and token contracts. We use a signature-matching algorithm to handle a variety of DAO frameworks and voting schemes. Once we establish token-to-DAO relationships, we gather and process voting data to produce a list of metagovernance relationships. We apply this algorithm to an initial set of sixteen DAOs and we extend the dataset as more DAOs are identified. We produce a metagovernance network with 61 DAOs and 72 metagovernance relationships. We examine three case studies that show metagovernance of various forms: strategic, decisive, and nexus, where a DAO becomes a governance hub for multiple other DAOs. We demonstrate that metagovernance obscures voting context and introduces entities driven by self-interest that can significantly influence governance. We highlight instances of metagovernance between DAOs operating on the Ethereum blockchain where current governance tools fail to reveal such dynamics. Better tools are needed to preserve the transparency-centric ethos of DAOs and mitigate risks associated with metagovernance.

title: From Dialogue to Execution: Mixture-of-Agents Assisted Interactive Planning for Behavior Tree-Based Long-Horizon Robot Execution
summary: Interactive task planning with large language models (LLMs) lets robots generate high-level action plans from natural language, but over long horizons it asks many questions, and tabular plan representations become hard to manage. We propose a framework that integrates Mixture-of-Agents (MoA)-based proxy answering into interactive planning and generates Behavior Trees (BTs) for structured long-term execution. We formulate the MoA as an abstention-based delegation cascade: each expert agent answers only the questions entailed by its own prerequisite description, forwards the rest unchanged, and the human user acts as the terminal fallback. The question set is thus partitioned disjointly, so no answer fusion or arbitration is required while every question is still resolved. The BT represents task logic hierarchically and enables retry and dynamic switching among robot policies. Experiments on a cocktail-making task show that the method removes approximately 27% of the human responses while keeping the generated BTs within the baseline generator's own variance. Real-robot experiments on a smoothie-making task further demonstrate successful long-horizon execution with adaptive policy switching and recovery from action failures. We further analyze the failure modes of the framework and show that its applicability boundary is set by the reliability of the weakest action node rather than by the planner. These results indicate that MoA-assisted interactive planning improves dialogue efficiency while preserving execution quality in real-world robotic tasks.

title: EstLLM: Enhancing Estonian Capabilities in Multilingual LLMs via Continued Pretraining and Post-Training
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are predominantly trained on English-centric data, resulting in uneven performance for smaller languages. We study whether continued pretraining (CPT) can improve Estonian capabilities in multilingual LLMs while preserving English and general reasoning performance. Using Llama 3.1 8B and Apertus 8B as base models, we apply CPT with Estonian-enriched multilingual replay, followed by mostly English supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, and chat vector merging. Evaluation on Estonian benchmarks, targeted pairwise human evaluation, and an Estonian Chatbot Arena-style setup shows consistent improvements in Estonian language competence, reasoning, translation, and instruction-following. Although Apertus exhibits stronger Estonian capabilities before adaptation, the more English-centric Llama model achieves substantially larger gains after adaptation. While some English capabilities regress relative to the original instruction-tuned models, chat vector merging substantially restores English instruction-following and reasoning performance. These findings suggest that CPT with balanced multilingual replay and lightweight post-training alignment can substantially improve single-language capabilities in multilingual LLMs.

title: LocalSUG: City-Preference-Enhanced LLM for Query Suggestion in Local-Life Services
summary: In local-life service platforms, query suggestion reduces user effort by generating candidate queries from input prefixes. Traditional multi-stage systems rely heavily on historical popular queries, limiting their ability to capture long-tail and emerging demand. Although LLMs provide strong semantic generalization, their deployment in local-life services faces three challenges: insufficient city-preference awareness, exposure bias in preference optimization, and strict online latency constraints. We propose LocalSUG, an LLM-based query suggestion framework for local-life services. LocalSUG mines city-preference-enhanced candidates from term co-occurrence and injects them into prompts as dynamic references rather than fusing them into model parameters. This allows the model to adapt to changing city preferences, such as merchant openings or closures, while reducing stale or locally invalid suggestions. We further introduce a beam-search-driven GRPO algorithm to align training with inference-time decoding and optimize relevance together with business-oriented rewards. Finally, quality-aware beam acceleration and vocabulary pruning reduce online latency while preserving generation quality. Offline evaluations and large-scale online A/B testing show that LocalSUG improves CTR by +0.35% and reduces the no-result rate by 3.98%, demonstrating its effectiveness in real-world deployment.

title: GhazalBench: Canonical Verse Access in LLMs across Persian Ghazals and Shakespearean Sonnets
summary: Persian poetry plays an active role in Iranian cultural practice, where verses by canonical poets such as Hafez and Saadi are frequently quoted, paraphrased, or completed from incomplete cues. Supporting such interactions requires language models to reliably access canonical verses from semantic and lexical information. We introduce GhazalBench, a benchmark for evaluating how large language models (LLMs) access the canonical surface forms of Persian ghazal under usage-grounded conditions. Unlike prior work that primarily treats memorization as a liability, GhazalBench studies settings in which access to exact wording is functionally important. The benchmark evaluates completion and recognition under varied semantic and lexical cues. Across proprietary and open-weight multilingual LLMs, exact completion remains challenging, while recognition is substantially stronger. Performance also varies across poets and model families. Parallel experiments on Shakespearean sonnets yield markedly higher completion for several models, consistent with differences in exposure to canonical texts. {Additional experiments suggest that post-training may reduce direct continuation-based access to canonical text.} Our findings motivate evaluation frameworks that distinguish production from recognition and assess access to culturally significant canonical texts. GhazalBench is available at https://github.com/kalhorghazal/GhazalBench.

title: ADVERSA: Measuring Multi-Turn Guardrail Degradation and Judge Reliability in Large Language Models
comments: 12 pages, 12 figures. Independent research. Code and artifacts: https://github.com/Harry-Ashley/adversa-guardrail-degradation. Published in the 2026 IEEE/ACIS 24th International Conference on Software Engineering Research, Management and Applications (SERA), pp. 414-417. Recipient of the Best Paper Award at IEEE/ACIS SERA 2026
summary:
Most adversarial evaluations of large language model (LLM) safety assess single prompts and report binary pass/fail outcomes, which fails to capture how safety properties evolve under sustained adversarial interaction. We present ADVERSA, an automated red-teaming framework that measures guardrail degradation dynamics as continuous per-round compliance trajectories rather than discrete jailbreak events. ADVERSA uses a fine-tuned 70B attacker model (ADVERSA-Red, Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct with QLoRA) that eliminates the attacker-side safety refusals that render off-the-shelf models unreliable as attackers, scoring victim responses on a structured 5-point rubric that treats partial compliance as a distinct measurable state.
  We report a controlled experiment across three frontier victim models (Claude Opus 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT-5.2) using a triple-judge consensus architecture in which judge reliability is measured as a first-class research outcome rather than assumed. Across 15 conversations of up to 10 adversarial rounds, we observe a 26.7% jailbreak rate with an average jailbreak round of 1.25, suggesting that in this evaluation setting, successful jailbreaks were concentrated in early rounds rather than accumulating through sustained pressure. We document inter-judge agreement rates, self-judge scoring tendencies, attacker drift as a failure mode in fine-tuned attackers deployed out of their training distribution, and attacker refusals as a previously-underreported confound in victim resistance measurement. All limitations are stated explicitly. Attack prompts are withheld per responsible disclosure policy; all other experimental artifacts are released.
